declarations.name: simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order_le_of_no_isolated
declarations.informal: If the finite graph G of order n has no isolated vertices, then for every vertex v the dominating sets containing v have average size at most (5n − 2 deg(v) + 1)/6 (hence at most (5n − 1)/6).
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order_le_of_no_isolated {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hiso : ∀ w, 0 < G.degree w)
    (v : V) :
    simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order G v ≤
      (5 * (Fintype.card V : ℚ) - 2 * G.degree v + 1) / 6
declarations.source:
theorem simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order_le_of_no_isolated {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hiso : ∀ w, 0 < G.degree w)
    (v : V) :
    simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order G v ≤
      (5 * (Fintype.card V : ℚ) - 2 * G.degree v + 1) / 6 := by
  classical
  set D := simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing G v with hD
  set n := Fintype.card V with hn
  have memD : ∀ S, S ∈ D ↔ v ∈ S ∧ ∀ w, w ∈ S ∨ ∃ u ∈ S, G.Adj u w := by
    intro S; rw [hD]; unfold simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing; simp
  -- `D` is closed under supersets
  have hup : ∀ S ∈ D, ∀ T, S ⊆ T → T ∈ D := by
    intro S hS T hST
    rw [memD] at hS ⊢
    refine ⟨hST hS.1, fun w => ?_⟩
    rcases hS.2 w with h | ⟨u, hu, h⟩
    · exact Or.inl (hST h)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨u, hST hu, h⟩
  have hDne : D.Nonempty :=
    ⟨Finset.univ, (memD _).2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ v, fun w => Or.inl (Finset.mem_univ w)⟩⟩
  -- closed neighbourhoods and the vertices outside `N[v]`
  set N : V → Finset V := fun w => insert w (G.neighborFinset w) with hN
  set U : Finset V := (Finset.univ.erase v) \ G.neighborFinset v with hU
  have hUcard : U.card = n - 1 - G.degree v := by
    rw [hU, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ v),
      G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    · rfl
    · intro w hw
      rw [Finset.mem_erase]
      exact ⟨(G.ne_of_adj ((G.mem_neighborFinset v w).1 hw)).symm, Finset.mem_univ w⟩
  have hdegle : G.degree v ≤ n - 1 := by
    rw [← G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    have : G.neighborFinset v ⊆ Finset.univ.erase v := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Finset.mem_erase]
      exact ⟨(G.ne_of_adj ((G.mem_neighborFinset v w).1 hw)).symm, Finset.mem_univ w⟩
    calc (G.neighborFinset v).card ≤ (Finset.univ.erase v).card := Finset.card_le_card this
      _ = n - 1 := by rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ v)]; rfl
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨v⟩
  -- counts: `a x` sets containing `x`, `b x` avoiding `x`, `c x` sets in which `x` is critical
  set a : V → ℕ := fun x => (D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S)).card with ha
  set b : V → ℕ := fun x => (D.filter (fun S => x ∉ S)).card with hb
  set c : V → ℕ := fun x => (D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S ∧ S.erase x ∉ D)).card with hc
  have hab : ∀ x, a x + b x = D.card := fun x => Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
  have habc : ∀ x, a x = b x + c x := by
    intro x
    simp only [ha, hb, hc]
    have hsplit : (D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S)).card =
        ((D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S)).filter (fun S => S.erase x ∈ D)).card +
        ((D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S)).filter (fun S => ¬ S.erase x ∈ D)).card :=
      (Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _).symm
    rw [Finset.filter_filter, Finset.filter_filter] at hsplit
    rw [hsplit]
    congr 1
    -- erasing `x` matches the sets with `x` removable with the sets avoiding `x`
    apply le_antisymm
    · have inj : Set.InjOn (fun S : Finset V => S.erase x)
          ↑(D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S ∧ S.erase x ∈ D)) := by
        intro S hS T hT h
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at hS hT
        rw [← Finset.insert_erase hS.2.1, ← Finset.insert_erase hT.2.1]
        exact congrArg (insert x) h
      rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injOn inj]
      apply Finset.card_le_card
      intro T hT
      obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hT
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hS ⊢
      exact ⟨hS.2.2, by simp⟩
    · have inj : Set.InjOn (fun S : Finset V => insert x S) ↑(D.filter (fun S => x ∉ S)) := by
        intro S hS T hT h
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at hS hT
        rw [← Finset.erase_insert hS.2, ← Finset.erase_insert hT.2]
        exact congrArg (fun W => Finset.erase W x) h
      rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injOn inj]
      apply Finset.card_le_card
      intro T hT
      obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hT
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hS ⊢
      refine ⟨hup S hS.1 _ (Finset.subset_insert x S), Finset.mem_insert_self x S, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.erase_insert hS.2]; exact hS.1
  have hsum : ∑ S ∈ D, S.card = ∑ x, a x := by
    have h : ∀ S ∈ D, S.card = ∑ x, if x ∈ S then 1 else 0 := by
      intro S _
      rw [← Finset.card_filter, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
    simp only [ha]; rw [Finset.card_filter]
  -- `x ≠ v` critical in `S`: `S` meets some `N[w]`, `w ∉ N[v]`, exactly in `x`
  set E : V → V → Finset (Finset V) := fun w x => D.filter (fun S => S ∩ N w = {x}) with hE
  have hcrit : ∀ x, x ≠ v → c x ≤ ∑ w ∈ U, (E w x).card := by
    intro x hxv
    simp only [hc]
    refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) Finset.card_biUnion_le
    intro S hS
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hS
    obtain ⟨hSD, hxS, hSx⟩ := hS
    have hvS : v ∈ S.erase x := Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hxv.symm, ((memD S).1 hSD).1⟩
    rw [memD] at hSx
    push_neg at hSx
    obtain ⟨w, hwS, hwadj⟩ := hSx hvS
    have hNw : S ∩ N w = {x} := by
      ext y
      simp only [Finset.mem_inter, hN, Finset.mem_insert, G.mem_neighborFinset,
        Finset.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hyS, hy⟩
        by_contra hyx
        have hy' : y ∈ S.erase x := Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hyx, hyS⟩
        rcases hy with rfl | hy
        · exact hwS hy'
        · exact hwadj y hy' hy.symm
      · intro hyx
        rw [hyx]
        refine ⟨hxS, ?_⟩
        rcases ((memD S).1 hSD).2 w with h | ⟨u, hu, h⟩
        · left
          by_contra hne
          exact hwS (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h' => hne h'.symm, h⟩)
        · right
          by_cases hux : u = x
          · rw [← hux]; exact h.symm
          · exact absurd h (hwadj u (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hux, hu⟩))
    have hwU : w ∈ U := by
      rw [hU, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_erase, G.mem_neighborFinset]
      refine ⟨⟨fun h => hwS (h ▸ hvS), Finset.mem_univ w⟩, fun h => hwadj v hvS h⟩
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨w, hwU, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hSD, hNw⟩⟩
  -- at most two thirds of the sets meet `N[w]` in a single vertex
  have hthird : ∀ w, 3 * (D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1)).card ≤ 2 * D.card := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ : ∃ w', G.Adj w w' := by
      have := hiso w
      rw [← G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, Finset.card_pos] at this
      obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := this
      exact ⟨w', (G.mem_neighborFinset w w').1 hw'⟩
    have hww' : w ≠ w' := G.ne_of_adj hw'
    have hwN : w ∈ N w := by simp [hN]
    have hw'N : w' ∈ N w := by simp [hN, G.mem_neighborFinset, hw']
    set single := D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1) with hsingle
    set multi := D.filter (fun S => ¬ (S ∩ N w).card = 1) with hmulti
    have hsm : single.card + multi.card = D.card := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
    let φ : Finset V → Finset V := fun S => if w ∈ S then insert w' S else insert w S
    have hmaps : ∀ S ∈ single, φ S ∈ multi := by
      intro S hS
      rw [hsingle, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.card_eq_one] at hS
      obtain ⟨hSD, z, hz⟩ := hS
      rw [hmulti, Finset.mem_filter]
      by_cases hwS : w ∈ S
      · simp only [φ, if_pos hwS]
        refine ⟨hup S hSD _ (Finset.subset_insert _ _), fun h1 => ?_⟩
        have hw_in : w ∈ insert w' S ∩ N w := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hwS, hwN⟩
        have hw'_in : w' ∈ insert w' S ∩ N w := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, hw'N⟩
        exact hww' (Finset.card_le_one.1 h1.le w hw_in w' hw'_in)
      · simp only [φ, if_neg hwS]
        refine ⟨hup S hSD _ (Finset.subset_insert _ _), fun h1 => ?_⟩
        have hz_in : z ∈ S ∩ N w := by rw [hz]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self z
        have hzw : z ≠ w := fun h => hwS (h ▸ (Finset.mem_inter.1 hz_in).1)
        have hw_in : w ∈ insert w S ∩ N w := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, hwN⟩
        have hz_in' : z ∈ insert w S ∩ N w :=
          Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_inter.1 hz_in).1,
            (Finset.mem_inter.1 hz_in).2⟩
        exact hzw (Finset.card_le_one.1 h1.le z hz_in' w hw_in)
    have hfib : ∀ M, (single.filter (fun S => φ S = M)).card ≤ 2 := by
      intro M
      refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (t := {M.erase w', M.erase w}) ?_) Finset.card_le_two
      intro S hS
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, hsingle, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.card_eq_one] at hS
      obtain ⟨⟨_, z, hz⟩, hφ⟩ := hS
      rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
      by_cases hwS : w ∈ S
      · left
        simp only [φ, if_pos hwS] at hφ
        have hw'S : w' ∉ S := by
          intro h
          have h1 : w ∈ S ∩ N w := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨hwS, hwN⟩
          have h2 : w' ∈ S ∩ N w := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨h, hw'N⟩
          rw [hz, Finset.mem_singleton] at h1 h2
          exact hww' (h1.trans h2.symm)
        rw [← hφ, Finset.erase_insert hw'S]
      · right
        simp only [φ, if_neg hwS] at hφ
        rw [← hφ, Finset.erase_insert hwS]
    have hle2 : single.card ≤ 2 * multi.card :=
      Finset.card_le_mul_card_image_of_maps_to hmaps 2 (fun M _ => hfib M)
    omega
  have hEsum : ∀ w, ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase v, (E w x).card ≤
      (D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1)).card := by
    intro w
    rw [← Finset.card_biUnion]
    · apply Finset.card_le_card
      intro S hS
      obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hS
      rw [hE, Finset.mem_filter] at hx
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, hx.2, Finset.card_singleton]
      exact ⟨hx.1, rfl⟩
    · intro x _ y _ hxy
      rw [Function.onFun, Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro S hSx hSy
      rw [hE, Finset.mem_filter] at hSx hSy
      exact hxy (Finset.singleton_injective (hSx.2.symm.trans hSy.2))
  have hcsum : 3 * ∑ x, c x ≤ 3 * D.card + 2 * U.card * D.card := by
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ v)]
    have hcv : c v ≤ D.card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
    have h1 : ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase v, c x ≤ ∑ w ∈ U, (D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1)).card := by
      calc ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase v, c x
          ≤ ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase v, ∑ w ∈ U, (E w x).card :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => hcrit x (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hx)
        _ = ∑ w ∈ U, ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase v, (E w x).card := Finset.sum_comm
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun w _ => hEsum w
    have h2 : 3 * ∑ w ∈ U, (D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1)).card ≤ 2 * U.card * D.card := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      calc ∑ w ∈ U, 3 * (D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1)).card
          ≤ ∑ w ∈ U, 2 * D.card := Finset.sum_le_sum fun w _ => hthird w
        _ = 2 * U.card * D.card := by rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    omega
  have h2a : 2 * ∑ x, a x = n * D.card + ∑ x, c x := by
    have e1 : ∑ x, (a x + b x) = n * D.card := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => hab x, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Finset.card_univ]
    have e2 : ∑ x, a x = ∑ x, b x + ∑ x, c x := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => habc x
    rw [← e1, Finset.sum_add_distrib]; omega
  -- conclude
  have hm : U.card + G.degree v + 1 = n := by rw [hUcard]; omega
  have hDpos : (0 : ℚ) < D.card := by exact_mod_cast hDne.card_pos
  have qa : (2 : ℚ) * ((∑ x, a x : ℕ) : ℚ) = n * D.card + ((∑ x, c x : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h2a
  have qc : (3 : ℚ) * ((∑ x, c x : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ 3 * D.card + 2 * U.card * D.card := by
    exact_mod_cast hcsum
  have qm : (U.card : ℚ) + G.degree v + 1 = n := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have qs : ∑ S ∈ D, (S.card : ℚ) = ((∑ x, a x : ℕ) : ℚ) := by rw [← hsum, Nat.cast_sum]
  have qnD : (n : ℚ) * D.card = U.card * D.card + G.degree v * D.card + D.card := by
    rw [← qm]; ring
  unfold simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order
  rw [← hD, div_le_div_iff₀ hDpos (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 6), qs]
  linarith
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.11446 (On the local average order of dominating sets), Theorem 3.8, second statement (the first, the sum bound (n+1)/2 + ½ Σ_{u ∉ N[v]} (deg u + 1)/(2^{deg u + 1} − 1), is not stated here).

explanation.summary: The theorem bounds the average size of dominating sets containing a designated vertex v in a graph without isolated vertices. By decomposing dominating sets containing x into those where x is removable and those where x is critical, we obtain the identity 2 ∑ a(x) = n |D| + ∑ c(x). For x ≠ v, criticality requires the dominating set to meet the closed neighborhood of some vertex w ∉ N[v] in exactly {x}, and a 2-to-1 map shows that at most two-thirds of dominating sets meet N[w] in a single vertex. Combining these bounds yields 3 ∑ c(x) ≤ 3 |D| + 2 (n - 1 - deg(v)) |D|, from which the upper bound (5n - 2 deg(v) + 1)/6 follows immediately.

steps.claim: The family D of dominating sets containing v is nonempty, characterized by domination of every vertex, and closed under taking supersets.
steps.explanation: We define D as the collection of dominating sets containing v and n as |V|. A set S is in D if and only if v ∈ S and every vertex w is in S or has a neighbor in S. If S ∈ D and S ⊆ T, then v ∈ T and every vertex dominated by S is also dominated by T, so T ∈ D. The universal set Finset.univ dominates every vertex and contains v, so D is nonempty.

  set D := simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing G v with hD
  set n := Fintype.card V with hn
  have memD : ∀ S, S ∈ D ↔ v ∈ S ∧ ∀ w, w ∈ S ∨ ∃ u ∈ S, G.Adj u w := by
    intro S; rw [hD]; unfold simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing; simp
  -- `D` is closed under supersets
  have hup : ∀ S ∈ D, ∀ T, S ⊆ T → T ∈ D := by
    intro S hS T hST
    rw [memD] at hS ⊢
    refine ⟨hST hS.1, fun w => ?_⟩
    rcases hS.2 w with h | ⟨u, hu, h⟩
    · exact Or.inl (hST h)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨u, hST hu, h⟩
  have hDne : D.Nonempty :=
    ⟨Finset.univ, (memD _).2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ v, fun w => Or.inl (Finset.mem_univ w)⟩⟩

steps.claim: The set U of vertices not dominated by v alone has cardinality |U| = n - 1 - deg(v), and deg(v) ≤ n - 1.
steps.explanation: For any w, N[w] denotes the closed neighborhood {w} ∪ N(w). The set U = (V \ {v}) \ N(v) consists of all vertices other than v that are not adjacent to v. Since the neighbor set N(v) has size deg(v) and is disjoint from {v}, subtracting its size from |V \ {v}| = n - 1 yields |U| = n - 1 - deg(v). Because N(v) ⊆ V \ {v}, we also have deg(v) ≤ n - 1, and V is nonempty since it contains v.

    rw [hU, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ v),
      G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    · rfl
    · intro w hw
      rw [Finset.mem_erase]
      exact ⟨(G.ne_of_adj ((G.mem_neighborFinset v w).1 hw)).symm, Finset.mem_univ w⟩
  have hdegle : G.degree v ≤ n - 1 := by
    rw [← G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]

steps.claim: For each vertex x, the number a(x) of dominating sets containing x equals the number b(x) avoiding x plus the number c(x) in which x is critical: a(x) = b(x) + c(x).
steps.explanation: We partition {S ∈ D : x ∈ S} into those where S \ {x} is still in D and those where S \ {x} ∉ D. The latter sets are precisely those where x is critical, of which there are c(x). The former sets are in bijection with dominating sets avoiding x via S ↦ S \ {x}, with inverse T ↦ T ∪ {x} (which remains in D because D is closed under supersets). Hence their size is b(x), giving a(x) = b(x) + c(x). Together with a(x) + b(x) = |D|, this is the key splitting identity.
steps.code:
-- counts: `a x` sets containing `x`, `b x` avoiding `x`, `c x` sets in which `x` is critical
  set a : V → ℕ := fun x => (D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S)).card with ha
  set b : V → ℕ := fun x => (D.filter (fun S => x ∉ S)).card with hb
  set c : V → ℕ := fun x => (D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S ∧ S.erase x ∉ D)).card with hc
  have hab : ∀ x, a x + b x = D.card := fun x => Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
  have habc : ∀ x, a x = b x + c x := by
    intro x
    simp only [ha, hb, hc]
    have hsplit : (D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S)).card =
        ((D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S)).filter (fun S => S.erase x ∈ D)).card +
        ((D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S)).filter (fun S => ¬ S.erase x ∈ D)).card :=
      (Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _).symm
    rw [Finset.filter_filter, Finset.filter_filter] at hsplit
    rw [hsplit]
    congr 1
    -- erasing `x` matches the sets with `x` removable with the sets avoiding `x`
    apply le_antisymm
    · have inj : Set.InjOn (fun S : Finset V => S.erase x)
          ↑(D.filter (fun S => x ∈ S ∧ S.erase x ∈ D)) := by
        intro S hS T hT h
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at hS hT
        rw [← Finset.insert_erase hS.2.1, ← Finset.insert_erase hT.2.1]
        exact congrArg (insert x) h
      rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injOn inj]
      apply Finset.card_le_card
      intro T hT
      obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hT
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hS ⊢
      exact ⟨hS.2.2, by simp⟩
    · have inj : Set.InjOn (fun S : Finset V => insert x S) ↑(D.filter (fun S => x ∉ S)) := by
        intro S hS T hT h
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter] at hS hT
        rw [← Finset.erase_insert hS.2, ← Finset.erase_insert hT.2]
        exact congrArg (fun W => Finset.erase W x) h
      rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injOn inj]
      apply Finset.card_le_card
      intro T hT
      obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hT
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hS ⊢
      refine ⟨hup S hS.1 _ (Finset.subset_insert x S), Finset.mem_insert_self x S, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.erase_insert hS.2]; exact hS.1

steps.claim: The sum of the sizes of all dominating sets in D equals ∑_{x ∈ V} a(x).
steps.explanation: Each set cardinality |S| can be expressed as the sum of indicator values ∑_{x ∈ V} [x ∈ S]. Interchanging the summation over S ∈ D and x ∈ V double counts the pairs (x, S) with x ∈ S, yielding ∑_{S ∈ D} |S| = ∑_{x ∈ V} a(x).
steps.code:
have hsum : ∑ S ∈ D, S.card = ∑ x, a x := by
    have h : ∀ S ∈ D, S.card = ∑ x, if x ∈ S then 1 else 0 := by
      intro S _
      rw [← Finset.card_filter, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter, Finset.univ_inter]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
    simp only [ha]; rw [Finset.card_filter]

steps.claim: For x ≠ v, every dominating set in which x is critical meets N[w] in exactly {x} for some w ∈ U, so c(x) ≤ ∑_{w ∈ U} |E(w, x)|.
steps.explanation: If x ≠ v and x is critical in S, then S \ {x} contains v but fails to dominate the whole graph. Some vertex w is not dominated by S \ {x}, so S \ {x} is disjoint from N[w]. Since S dominated w, x must dominate w, meaning S ∩ N[w] = {x}. Moreover, w cannot be v (since v ∈ S \ {x}) nor adjacent to v (since v would dominate w), which places w in U. By the union bound, c(x) ≤ ∑_{w ∈ U} |E(w, x)|.
steps.code:
-- `x ≠ v` critical in `S`: `S` meets some `N[w]`, `w ∉ N[v]`, exactly in `x`
  set E : V → V → Finset (Finset V) := fun w x => D.filter (fun S => S ∩ N w = {x}) with hE
  have hcrit : ∀ x, x ≠ v → c x ≤ ∑ w ∈ U, (E w x).card := by
    intro x hxv
    simp only [hc]
    refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) Finset.card_biUnion_le
    intro S hS
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hS
    obtain ⟨hSD, hxS, hSx⟩ := hS
    have hvS : v ∈ S.erase x := Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hxv.symm, ((memD S).1 hSD).1⟩
    rw [memD] at hSx
    push_neg at hSx
    obtain ⟨w, hwS, hwadj⟩ := hSx hvS
    have hNw : S ∩ N w = {x} := by
      ext y
      simp only [Finset.mem_inter, hN, Finset.mem_insert, G.mem_neighborFinset,
        Finset.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hyS, hy⟩
        by_contra hyx
        have hy' : y ∈ S.erase x := Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hyx, hyS⟩
        rcases hy with rfl | hy
        · exact hwS hy'
        · exact hwadj y hy' hy.symm
      · intro hyx
        rw [hyx]
        refine ⟨hxS, ?_⟩
        rcases ((memD S).1 hSD).2 w with h | ⟨u, hu, h⟩
        · left
          by_contra hne
          exact hwS (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h' => hne h'.symm, h⟩)
        · right
          by_cases hux : u = x
          · rw [← hux]; exact h.symm
          · exact absurd h (hwadj u (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hux, hu⟩))
    have hwU : w ∈ U := by
      rw [hU, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_erase, G.mem_neighborFinset]
      refine ⟨⟨fun h => hwS (h ▸ hvS), Finset.mem_univ w⟩, fun h => hwadj v hvS h⟩
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨w, hwU, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hSD, hNw⟩⟩

steps.claim: For every vertex w, at most two-thirds of the dominating sets in D meet N[w] in exactly one vertex: 3 |{S ∈ D : |S ∩ N[w]| = 1}| ≤ 2 |D|.
steps.explanation: Since G has no isolated vertices, w has a neighbor w'. We partition D into sets meeting N[w] in 1 vertex ('single') and those meeting N[w] in a different number of vertices ('multi'). Define φ on 'single' by adding w' if w ∈ S, and adding w if w ∉ S. By superset closure, φ(S) ∈ D, and its intersection with N[w] has size at least 2, so φ(S) ∈ 'multi'. Each target set has at most two preimages (erasing w' or erasing w). Thus |single| ≤ 2 |multi|. Combining this with |single| + |multi| = |D| yields 3 |single| ≤ 2 |D|.
steps.code:
-- at most two thirds of the sets meet `N[w]` in a single vertex
  have hthird : ∀ w, 3 * (D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1)).card ≤ 2 * D.card := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ : ∃ w', G.Adj w w' := by
      have := hiso w
      rw [← G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, Finset.card_pos] at this
      obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := this
      exact ⟨w', (G.mem_neighborFinset w w').1 hw'⟩
    have hww' : w ≠ w' := G.ne_of_adj hw'
    have hwN : w ∈ N w := by simp [hN]
    have hw'N : w' ∈ N w := by simp [hN, G.mem_neighborFinset, hw']
    set single := D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1) with hsingle
    set multi := D.filter (fun S => ¬ (S ∩ N w).card = 1) with hmulti
    have hsm : single.card + multi.card = D.card := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
    let φ : Finset V → Finset V := fun S => if w ∈ S then insert w' S else insert w S
    have hmaps : ∀ S ∈ single, φ S ∈ multi := by
      intro S hS
      rw [hsingle, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.card_eq_one] at hS
      obtain ⟨hSD, z, hz⟩ := hS
      rw [hmulti, Finset.mem_filter]
      by_cases hwS : w ∈ S
      · simp only [φ, if_pos hwS]
        refine ⟨hup S hSD _ (Finset.subset_insert _ _), fun h1 => ?_⟩
        have hw_in : w ∈ insert w' S ∩ N w := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hwS, hwN⟩
        have hw'_in : w' ∈ insert w' S ∩ N w := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, hw'N⟩
        exact hww' (Finset.card_le_one.1 h1.le w hw_in w' hw'_in)
      · simp only [φ, if_neg hwS]
        refine ⟨hup S hSD _ (Finset.subset_insert _ _), fun h1 => ?_⟩
        have hz_in : z ∈ S ∩ N w := by rw [hz]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self z
        have hzw : z ≠ w := fun h => hwS (h ▸ (Finset.mem_inter.1 hz_in).1)
        have hw_in : w ∈ insert w S ∩ N w := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, hwN⟩
        have hz_in' : z ∈ insert w S ∩ N w :=
          Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_inter.1 hz_in).1,
            (Finset.mem_inter.1 hz_in).2⟩
        exact hzw (Finset.card_le_one.1 h1.le z hz_in' w hw_in)
    have hfib : ∀ M, (single.filter (fun S => φ S = M)).card ≤ 2 := by
      intro M
      refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (t := {M.erase w', M.erase w}) ?_) Finset.card_le_two
      intro S hS
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, hsingle, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.card_eq_one] at hS
      obtain ⟨⟨_, z, hz⟩, hφ⟩ := hS
      rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
      by_cases hwS : w ∈ S
      · left
        simp only [φ, if_pos hwS] at hφ
        have hw'S : w' ∉ S := by
          intro h
          have h1 : w ∈ S ∩ N w := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨hwS, hwN⟩
          have h2 : w' ∈ S ∩ N w := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨h, hw'N⟩
          rw [hz, Finset.mem_singleton] at h1 h2
          exact hww' (h1.trans h2.symm)
        rw [← hφ, Finset.erase_insert hw'S]
      · right
        simp only [φ, if_neg hwS] at hφ
        rw [← hφ, Finset.erase_insert hwS]
    have hle2 : single.card ≤ 2 * multi.card :=
      Finset.card_le_mul_card_image_of_maps_to hmaps 2 (fun M _ => hfib M)
    omega

steps.claim: For each vertex w, the sets E(w, x) for x ≠ v are pairwise disjoint, so ∑_{x ≠ v} |E(w, x)| ≤ |{S ∈ D : |S ∩ N[w]| = 1}|.
steps.explanation: If S ∈ E(w, x) ∩ E(w, y), then S ∩ N[w] is both {x} and {y}, so x = y by injectivity of singletons. Thus the sets E(w, x) are pairwise disjoint. Moreover, every S ∈ E(w, x) satisfies |S ∩ N[w]| = 1. The sum of the cardinalities of disjoint subsets is the cardinality of their union, which is bounded by the cardinality of the ambient family.
steps.code:
have hEsum : ∀ w, ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase v, (E w x).card ≤
      (D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1)).card := by
    intro w
    rw [← Finset.card_biUnion]
    · apply Finset.card_le_card
      intro S hS
      obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hS
      rw [hE, Finset.mem_filter] at hx
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, hx.2, Finset.card_singleton]
      exact ⟨hx.1, rfl⟩
    · intro x _ y _ hxy
      rw [Function.onFun, Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro S hSx hSy
      rw [hE, Finset.mem_filter] at hSx hSy
      exact hxy (Finset.singleton_injective (hSx.2.symm.trans hSy.2))
  have hcsum : 3 * ∑ x, c x ≤ 3 * D.card + 2 * U.card * D.card := by

steps.claim: The sum of criticalities satisfies 3 ∑_{x ∈ V} c(x) ≤ 3 |D| + 2 |U| |D|.
steps.explanation: Separate x = v from x ≠ v: trivially c(v) ≤ |D|. For the remaining vertices, summing c(x) ≤ ∑_{w ∈ U} |E(w, x)| and interchanging the order of summation gives ∑_{x ≠ v} c(x) ≤ ∑_{w ∈ U} |{S ∈ D : |S ∩ N[w]| = 1}|. Multiplying by 3 and applying the two-thirds bound to each w ∈ U yields 3 ∑_{x ≠ v} c(x) ≤ 2 |U| |D|. Adding 3 c(v) ≤ 3 |D| gives 3 ∑_{x ∈ V} c(x) ≤ 3 |D| + 2 |U| |D|.
steps.code:
rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ v)]
    have hcv : c v ≤ D.card := Finset.card_filter_le _ _
    have h1 : ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase v, c x ≤ ∑ w ∈ U, (D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1)).card := by
      calc ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase v, c x
          ≤ ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase v, ∑ w ∈ U, (E w x).card :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun x hx => hcrit x (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hx)
        _ = ∑ w ∈ U, ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase v, (E w x).card := Finset.sum_comm
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun w _ => hEsum w
    have h2 : 3 * ∑ w ∈ U, (D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1)).card ≤ 2 * U.card * D.card := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      calc ∑ w ∈ U, 3 * (D.filter (fun S => (S ∩ N w).card = 1)).card
          ≤ ∑ w ∈ U, 2 * D.card := Finset.sum_le_sum fun w _ => hthird w
        _ = 2 * U.card * D.card := by rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    omega

steps.claim: The sum of counts satisfies 2 ∑_{x ∈ V} a(x) = n |D| + ∑_{x ∈ V} c(x).
steps.explanation: Summing a(x) + b(x) = |D| over all n vertices gives ∑ a(x) + ∑ b(x) = n |D|. Summing a(x) = b(x) + c(x) over all vertices gives ∑ a(x) = ∑ b(x) + ∑ c(x). Adding these two equations cancels ∑ b(x) and yields 2 ∑ a(x) = n |D| + ∑ c(x).
steps.code:
have h2a : 2 * ∑ x, a x = n * D.card + ∑ x, c x := by
    have e1 : ∑ x, (a x + b x) = n * D.card := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => hab x, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Finset.card_univ]
    have e2 : ∑ x, a x = ∑ x, b x + ∑ x, c x := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => habc x
    rw [← e1, Finset.sum_add_distrib]; omega

steps.claim: The average size of dominating sets containing v is at most (5n - 2 deg(v) + 1)/6.
steps.explanation: Since |U| = n - 1 - deg(v), we have |U| + deg(v) + 1 = n. Multiplying the double counting identity by 3 gives 6 ∑_{S ∈ D} |S| = 3 n |D| + 3 ∑ c(x) ≤ 3 n |D| + 3 |D| + 2 |U| |D| = (5n - 2 deg(v) + 1) |D|. Dividing both sides by 6 |D| (which is strictly positive) yields the bound on the local average dominating order. Linear arithmetic closes the goal.
steps.code:
-- conclude
  have hm : U.card + G.degree v + 1 = n := by rw [hUcard]; omega
  have hDpos : (0 : ℚ) < D.card := by exact_mod_cast hDne.card_pos
  have qa : (2 : ℚ) * ((∑ x, a x : ℕ) : ℚ) = n * D.card + ((∑ x, c x : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h2a
  have qc : (3 : ℚ) * ((∑ x, c x : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ 3 * D.card + 2 * U.card * D.card := by
    exact_mod_cast hcsum
  have qm : (U.card : ℚ) + G.degree v + 1 = n := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have qs : ∑ S ∈ D, (S.card : ℚ) = ((∑ x, a x : ℕ) : ℚ) := by rw [← hsum, Nat.cast_sum]
  have qnD : (n : ℚ) * D.card = U.card * D.card + G.degree v * D.card + D.card := by
    rw [← qm]; ring
  unfold simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order
  rw [← hD, div_le_div_iff₀ hDpos (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 6), qs]
  linarith

declarations.name: matrix_unit_difference_rows_isTotallyUnimodular
declarations.informal: Every integer matrix whose rows are differences e_u − e_v of two standard basis vectors is totally unimodular: each square minor is 0, 1 or −1.
declarations.statement:
theorem matrix_unit_difference_rows_isTotallyUnimodular {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq n]
    (u v : m → n) :
    (Matrix.of fun (i : m) (j : n) =>
      (Pi.single (u i) (1 : ℤ) : n → ℤ) j - (Pi.single (v i) (1 : ℤ) : n → ℤ) j).IsTotallyUnimodular
declarations.source:
theorem matrix_unit_difference_rows_isTotallyUnimodular {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq n]
    (u v : m → n) :
    (Matrix.of fun (i : m) (j : n) =>
      (Pi.single (u i) (1 : ℤ) : n → ℤ) j - (Pi.single (v i) (1 : ℤ) : n → ℤ) j).IsTotallyUnimodular := by
  -- square matrices whose rows have at most one `1`, at most one `-1`, and zeros elsewhere
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ B : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℤ,
      (∀ i j, B i j = 0 ∨ B i j = 1 ∨ B i j = -1) →
      (∀ i j j', B i j = 1 → B i j' = 1 → j = j') →
      (∀ i j j', B i j = -1 → B i j' = -1 → j = j') →
      B.det = 0 ∨ B.det = 1 ∨ B.det = -1 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro B _ _ _; right; left; exact Matrix.det_isEmpty
    | succ k ih =>
      intro B h0 h1 h2
      by_cases hall : ∀ i, (∃ j, B i j = 1) ∧ (∃ j, B i j = -1)
      · -- every row sums to zero, so the all-ones vector is in the kernel
        left
        rw [← Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff]
        refine ⟨fun _ => 1, fun h => one_ne_zero (congrFun h 0), ?_⟩
        funext i
        obtain ⟨⟨j1, hj1⟩, ⟨j2, hj2⟩⟩ := hall i
        have hne : j1 ≠ j2 := by
          rintro rfl
          rw [hj1] at hj2
          norm_num at hj2
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_one, Pi.zero_apply]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_add j1 j2 hne (fun c _ hc => ?_) (by simp) (by simp), hj1, hj2]
        · norm_num
        · rcases h0 i c with h | h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd (h1 i c j1 h hj1) hc.1
          · exact absurd (h2 i c j2 h hj2) hc.2
      · push_neg at hall
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hall
        by_cases hz : ∀ j, B i j = 0
        · left; exact Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero i hz
        push_neg at hz
        obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := hz
        -- row `i` has a single nonzero entry, at `j0`
        have honly : ∀ j, j ≠ j0 → B i j = 0 := by
          intro j hj
          by_contra hne
          rcases h0 i j with h | h | h
          · exact hne h
          · rcases h0 i j0 with h' | h' | h'
            · exact hj0 h'
            · exact hj (h1 i j j0 h h')
            · exact hi ⟨j, h⟩ j0 h'
          · rcases h0 i j0 with h' | h' | h'
            · exact hj0 h'
            · exact hi ⟨j0, h'⟩ j h
            · exact hj (h2 i j j0 h h')
        have hB : B i j0 = 1 ∨ B i j0 = -1 := by
          rcases h0 i j0 with h | h | h
          · exact absurd h hj0
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr h
        set B' := B.submatrix i.succAbove j0.succAbove with hB'
        have hminor : B'.det = 0 ∨ B'.det = 1 ∨ B'.det = -1 := by
          refine ih B' (fun a b => h0 _ _) (fun a b b' hb hb' => ?_) (fun a b b' hb hb' => ?_)
          · exact Fin.succAbove_right_injective (h1 _ _ _ hb hb')
          · exact Fin.succAbove_right_injective (h2 _ _ _ hb hb')
        rw [Matrix.det_succ_row B i, Finset.sum_eq_single j0
          (fun j _ hj => by rw [honly j hj]; ring) (by simp)]
        rcases neg_one_pow_eq_or ℤ (i + j0 : ℕ) with hp | hp <;> rcases hB with hb | hb <;>
          rcases hminor with hd | hd | hd <;> simp [hp, hb, ← hB', hd]
  intro k f g _ hg
  set B := (Matrix.of fun (i : m) (j : n) =>
      (Pi.single (u i) (1 : ℤ) : n → ℤ) j - (Pi.single (v i) (1 : ℤ) : n → ℤ) j).submatrix
    f g with hBdef
  have entry : ∀ i j, B i j =
      (if g j = u (f i) then 1 else 0) - (if g j = v (f i) then 1 else 0) := by
    intro i j
    simp [hBdef, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have e1 : ∀ i j, B i j = 1 → g j = u (f i) := by
    intro i j h
    by_contra hc
    rw [entry, if_neg hc] at h
    split_ifs at h <;> norm_num at h
  have e2 : ∀ i j, B i j = -1 → g j = v (f i) := by
    intro i j h
    by_contra hc
    rw [entry, if_neg hc] at h
    split_ifs at h <;> norm_num at h
  have h0 : ∀ i j, B i j = 0 ∨ B i j = 1 ∨ B i j = -1 := by
    intro i j; rw [entry]; split_ifs <;> simp
  rcases key k B h0 (fun i j j' hj hj' => hg ((e1 i j hj).trans (e1 i j' hj').symm))
      (fun i j j' hj hj' => hg ((e2 i j hj).trans (e2 i j' hj').symm)) with h | h | h
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [h]⟩
  · exact ⟨1, by simp [h]⟩
  · exact ⟨-1, by simp [h]⟩
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.09349 (A near-quadratic lower bound for sets with no unique sums), Lemma 2.2 (determinants of unit-incidence minors). Stated as total unimodularity (Mathlib's `Matrix.IsTotallyUnimodular`) of the matrix with rows e_{u(i)} − e_{v(i)}; rows with u(i) = v(i) (zero rows) are allowed.

explanation.summary: To show that an integer matrix whose rows are differences of standard basis vectors e_{u(i)} - e_{v(i)} is totally unimodular, we first prove by induction on matrix dimension k that every k × k integer matrix with entries in {0, 1, -1} having at most one 1 and at most one -1 per row has determinant in {0, 1, -1}. In the inductive step, if every row has both signs, each row sums to 0, placing the all-ones vector in the kernel and forcing the determinant to be 0. Otherwise, some row contains at most one nonzero entry: if the row is all zeros, the determinant is 0; if it contains a single nonzero entry ±1, Laplace expansion along that row reduces the determinant to ±1 times the determinant of a (k - 1) × (k - 1) minor, which is in {0, 1, -1} by induction. Finally, any square submatrix of the difference matrix inherits the property that each row has at most one 1 and at most one -1 by injectivity of the column selection, completing the proof.

steps.claim: State the key induction lemma and prove the base case k = 0: any 0 × 0 matrix has determinant 1.
steps.explanation: We set up an auxiliary lemma (`key`): any k × k integer matrix B whose entries belong to {0, 1, -1} and whose rows each contain at most one 1 and at most one -1 has det B ∈ {0, 1, -1}. We argue by induction on k. For k = 0, the indexing type Fin 0 is empty, and the determinant of an empty matrix is 1 by `Matrix.det_isEmpty`, which is in {0, 1, -1}.
steps.code:
have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ B : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℤ,
      (∀ i j, B i j = 0 ∨ B i j = 1 ∨ B i j = -1) →
      (∀ i j j', B i j = 1 → B i j' = 1 → j = j') →
      (∀ i j j', B i j = -1 → B i j' = -1 → j = j') →
      B.det = 0 ∨ B.det = 1 ∨ B.det = -1 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro B _ _ _; right; left; exact Matrix.det_isEmpty

steps.claim: In the induction step, if every row of B contains both a 1 and a -1, then det B = 0.
steps.explanation: Assume the induction hypothesis for k × k matrices, and let B be a (k + 1) × (k + 1) matrix satisfying the conditions. If every row contains both a 1 and a -1, then by the uniqueness of 1 and -1 in each row, every other entry in that row is 0. Each row therefore sums to 1 + (-1) = 0. Thus the all-ones vector 1 = (1, 1, …, 1)ᵀ lies in the kernel of B. Since 1 ≠ 0 (using `one_ne_zero` and `congrFun`), B has a non-trivial kernel, so det B = 0 by `Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff`.
steps.code:
| succ k ih =>
      intro B h0 h1 h2
      by_cases hall : ∀ i, (∃ j, B i j = 1) ∧ (∃ j, B i j = -1)
      · -- every row sums to zero, so the all-ones vector is in the kernel
        left
        rw [← Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff]
        refine ⟨fun _ => 1, fun h => one_ne_zero (congrFun h 0), ?_⟩
        funext i
        obtain ⟨⟨j1, hj1⟩, ⟨j2, hj2⟩⟩ := hall i
        have hne : j1 ≠ j2 := by
          rintro rfl
          rw [hj1] at hj2
          norm_num at hj2
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_one, Pi.zero_apply]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_add j1 j2 hne (fun c _ hc => ?_) (by simp) (by simp), hj1, hj2]
        · norm_num
        · rcases h0 i c with h | h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd (h1 i c j1 h hj1) hc.1
          · exact absurd (h2 i c j2 h hj2) hc.2

steps.claim: If some row of B does not contain both 1 and -1, either it is all zeros (so det B = 0), or it has at least one nonzero entry.
steps.explanation: Negating the previous case gives some row i that does not contain both a 1 and a -1. If row i is identically zero, its determinant is immediately 0 by `Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero`. Otherwise, row i has at least one nonzero entry, at some column j0.
steps.code:
· push_neg at hall
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hall
        by_cases hz : ∀ j, B i j = 0
        · left; exact Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero i hz
        push_neg at hz
        obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := hz

steps.claim: Row i contains exactly one nonzero entry, at column j0, and this entry is either 1 or -1.
steps.explanation: Since B i j0 ≠ 0 and all entries lie in {0, 1, -1}, B i j0 must be 1 or -1. For any other column j ≠ j0, if B i j were nonzero, it would also be 1 or -1. If B i j and B i j0 had the same sign, that would contradict the hypothesis that row i has at most one 1 and at most one -1; if they had opposite signs, row i would contain both 1 and -1, contradicting the choice of row i. Hence, every entry of row i other than at j0 is 0.
steps.code:
-- row `i` has a single nonzero entry, at `j0`
        have honly : ∀ j, j ≠ j0 → B i j = 0 := by
          intro j hj
          by_contra hne
          rcases h0 i j with h | h | h
          · exact hne h
          · rcases h0 i j0 with h' | h' | h'
            · exact hj0 h'
            · exact hj (h1 i j j0 h h')
            · exact hi ⟨j, h⟩ j0 h'
          · rcases h0 i j0 with h' | h' | h'
            · exact hj0 h'
            · exact hi ⟨j0, h'⟩ j h
            · exact hj (h2 i j j0 h h')
        have hB : B i j0 = 1 ∨ B i j0 = -1 := by
          rcases h0 i j0 with h | h | h
          · exact absurd h hj0
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr h

steps.claim: The (k × k) minor B' obtained by deleting row i and column j0 has det B' ∈ {0, 1, -1}, and Laplace expansion along row i yields det B ∈ {0, 1, -1}.
steps.explanation: We delete row i and column j0 using the injective index embeddings `Fin.succAbove` to obtain a k × k matrix B'. Because `Fin.succAbove` is injective (`Fin.succAbove_right_injective`), B' preserves the property of having at most one 1 and at most one -1 per row, so det B' ∈ {0, 1, -1} by the induction hypothesis. Expanding det B along row i via `Matrix.det_succ_row` and using `Finset.sum_eq_single` reduces the determinant to det B = (-1)^(i + j0) * B i j0 * det B'. Since (-1)^(i + j0) ∈ {1, -1} by `neg_one_pow_eq_or`, B i j0 ∈ {1, -1}, and det B' ∈ {0, 1, -1}, their product det B must lie in {0, 1, -1}.
steps.code:
set B' := B.submatrix i.succAbove j0.succAbove with hB'
        have hminor : B'.det = 0 ∨ B'.det = 1 ∨ B'.det = -1 := by
          refine ih B' (fun a b => h0 _ _) (fun a b b' hb hb' => ?_) (fun a b b' hb hb' => ?_)
          · exact Fin.succAbove_right_injective (h1 _ _ _ hb hb')
          · exact Fin.succAbove_right_injective (h2 _ _ _ hb hb')
        rw [Matrix.det_succ_row B i, Finset.sum_eq_single j0
          (fun j _ hj => by rw [honly j hj]; ring) (by simp)]
        rcases neg_one_pow_eq_or ℤ (i + j0 : ℕ) with hp | hp <;> rcases hB with hb | hb <;>
          rcases hminor with hd | hd | hd <;> simp [hp, hb, ← hB', hd]

steps.claim: Any k × k submatrix B of the basis difference matrix has entries in {0, 1, -1}, with at most one 1 and at most one -1 in each row.
steps.explanation: Let B be a k × k submatrix chosen by row indices f and column indices g with g injective. Using `Matrix.submatrix_apply` and `Pi.single_apply`, entry B i j is (if g j = u (f i) then 1 else 0) - (if g j = v (f i) then 1 else 0). Thus each entry is 0, 1, or -1. Using `if_neg`, B i j = 1 implies g j = u (f i), and B i j = -1 implies g j = v (f i).
steps.code:
intro k f g _ hg
  set B := (Matrix.of fun (i : m) (j : n) =>
      (Pi.single (u i) (1 : ℤ) : n → ℤ) j - (Pi.single (v i) (1 : ℤ) : n → ℤ) j).submatrix
    f g with hBdef
  have entry : ∀ i j, B i j =
      (if g j = u (f i) then 1 else 0) - (if g j = v (f i) then 1 else 0) := by
    intro i j
    simp [hBdef, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have e1 : ∀ i j, B i j = 1 → g j = u (f i) := by
    intro i j h
    by_contra hc
    rw [entry, if_neg hc] at h
    split_ifs at h <;> norm_num at h
  have e2 : ∀ i j, B i j = -1 → g j = v (f i) := by
    intro i j h
    by_contra hc
    rw [entry, if_neg hc] at h
    split_ifs at h <;> norm_num at h
  have h0 : ∀ i j, B i j = 0 ∨ B i j = 1 ∨ B i j = -1 := by
    intro i j; rw [entry]; split_ifs <;> simp

steps.claim: Injectivity of g implies each row has at most one 1 and at most one -1, so applying the key lemma proves total unimodularity.
steps.explanation: If B i j = 1 and B i j' = 1, then g j = u (f i) = g j', so j = j' by the injectivity of g. Similarly, if B i j = -1 and B i j' = -1, then g j = v (f i) = g j', so j = j'. Thus B satisfies all hypotheses of `key`, giving det B ∈ {0, 1, -1}. Exhibiting 0, 1, or -1 as the corresponding element in the range of `SignType.cast` finishes the proof that the matrix is totally unimodular.
steps.code:
rcases key k B h0 (fun i j j' hj hj' => hg ((e1 i j hj).trans (e1 i j' hj').symm))
      (fun i j j' hj hj' => hg ((e2 i j hj).trans (e2 i j' hj').symm)) with h | h | h
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [h]⟩
  · exact ⟨1, by simp [h]⟩
  · exact ⟨-1, by simp [h]⟩

glossary.Matrix.det_isEmpty: The determinant of an empty square matrix (indexed by an empty type) is 1.
glossary.Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff: Over an integral domain, a square matrix has determinant 0 if and only if there is a non-zero vector in its kernel.
glossary.one_ne_zero: In any structure where 1 is non-zero, 1 ≠ 0.
glossary.congrFun: Equal functions agree at every argument.
glossary.Finset.sum_eq_add: If all terms in a finite sum other than two distinct indices a and b are zero, the sum equals f(a) + f(b).
glossary.Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero: A square matrix with an all-zero row has determinant 0.
glossary.Or.inl: Constructs a proof of a ∨ b from a proof of the left disjunct a.
glossary.Or.inr: Constructs a proof of a ∨ b from a proof of the right disjunct b.
glossary.Fin.succAbove_right_injective: The map skipping a designated element of Fin (n + 1) while preserving order is injective.
glossary.Matrix.det_succ_row: Laplace cofactor expansion of the determinant of an (n + 1) × (n + 1) matrix along a designated row.
glossary.Finset.sum_eq_single: If all terms in a finite sum except at a single index a are zero, the sum equals f(a).
glossary.neg_one_pow_eq_or: Any natural power of -1 in a ring is either 1 or -1.
glossary.Matrix.submatrix_apply: The entry at (i, j) of a submatrix formed by row map r and column map c is the entry of the original matrix at (r(i), c(j)).
glossary.Pi.single_apply: The indicator vector `Pi.single i x` evaluates to x at index i and 0 elsewhere.
glossary.if_neg: If a condition c is false, the conditional expression `if c then t else e` reduces to e.

caveats: In Mathlib, `Matrix.IsTotallyUnimodular` is defined by requiring square minors to lie in `Set.range SignType.cast`, which maps the three constructors of `SignType` (zero, pos, neg) to 0, 1, and -1 in ℤ.
Row and column deletion for minors is formally encoded using `Fin.succAbove`, the order-preserving injection that skips a specified index.

declarations.name: simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order_of_degree_eq_card_sub_two
declarations.informal: Let G be a connected graph of order n ≥ 3 and v a vertex of degree n − 2, with u the vertex other than v not adjacent to v. Then the dominating sets containing v have average size (n+1)/2 + (deg u + 1)/(2(2^{deg u + 1} − 1)).
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order_of_degree_eq_card_sub_two {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hconn : G.Connected)
    (hn : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V) (v u : V) (huv : u ≠ v) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj v u)
    (hdeg : G.degree v = Fintype.card V - 2) :
    simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order G v =
      ((Fintype.card V : ℚ) + 1) / 2 +
        ((G.degree u : ℚ) + 1) / (2 * (2 ^ (G.degree u + 1) - 1))
declarations.source:
theorem simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order_of_degree_eq_card_sub_two {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hconn : G.Connected)
    (hn : 3 ≤ Fintype.card V) (v u : V) (huv : u ≠ v) (hnadj : ¬ G.Adj v u)
    (hdeg : G.degree v = Fintype.card V - 2) :
    simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order G v =
      ((Fintype.card V : ℚ) + 1) / 2 +
        ((G.degree u : ℚ) + 1) / (2 * (2 ^ (G.degree u + 1) - 1)) := by
  classical
  set n := Fintype.card V with hn'
  set D := simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing G v with hD
  -- sets containing `v` inside `insert v W`: `2^|W|` of them, total size `2^|W| + |W| 2^|W| / 2`
  have count : ∀ W : Finset V, v ∉ W →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset V => v ∈ S ∧ S ⊆ insert v W)).card = 2 ^ W.card ∧
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset V => v ∈ S ∧ S ⊆ insert v W), (S.card : ℚ) =
        2 ^ W.card + W.card * 2 ^ W.card / 2 := by
    intro W hvW
    have himg : Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset V => v ∈ S ∧ S ⊆ insert v W) =
        W.powerset.image (insert v) := by
      ext S
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image,
        Finset.mem_powerset]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hvS, hSW⟩
        refine ⟨S.erase v, fun x hx => ?_, Finset.insert_erase hvS⟩
        have := hSW (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hx)
        rw [Finset.mem_insert] at this
        rcases this with h | h
        · exact absurd h (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hx)
        · exact h
      · rintro ⟨T, hTW, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self v T, Finset.insert_subset_insert v hTW⟩
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (insert v) (W.powerset : Set (Finset V)) := by
      intro S hS T hT h
      simp only [Finset.coe_powerset, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_powerset_iff,
        Finset.coe_subset] at hS hT
      have hvS : v ∉ S := fun h' => hvW (hS h')
      have hvT : v ∉ T := fun h' => hvW (hT h')
      rw [← Finset.erase_insert hvS, ← Finset.erase_insert hvT]
      exact congrArg (fun U => Finset.erase U v) h
    -- complements in `W` pair sizes `k` and `|W| - k`
    have hhalf : 2 * ∑ T ∈ W.powerset, (T.card : ℚ) = W.card * 2 ^ W.card := by
      have hc : ∑ T ∈ W.powerset, (T.card : ℚ) = ∑ T ∈ W.powerset, ((W.card : ℚ) - T.card) := by
        refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun T => W \ T) (fun T => W \ T) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        · intro T hT; simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT ⊢; exact Finset.sdiff_subset
        · intro T hT; simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT ⊢; exact Finset.sdiff_subset
        · intro T hT; simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT; exact Finset.sdiff_sdiff_eq_self hT
        · intro T hT; simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT; exact Finset.sdiff_sdiff_eq_self hT
        · intro T hT
          rw [Finset.mem_powerset] at hT
          rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hT, Nat.cast_sub (Finset.card_le_card hT)]
          ring
      rw [two_mul]
      nth_rewrite 2 [hc]
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ =>
        (show (T.card : ℚ) + ((W.card : ℚ) - T.card) = W.card by ring), Finset.sum_const,
        Finset.card_powerset, nsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast; ring
    rw [himg, Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj, Finset.card_powerset, Finset.sum_image hinj]
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    have : ∀ T ∈ W.powerset, ((insert v T).card : ℚ) = T.card + 1 := by
      intro T hT
      rw [Finset.mem_powerset] at hT
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (fun h => hvW (hT h))]
      push_cast; ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_powerset,
      nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    linarith
  -- every vertex other than `u` and `v` is a neighbour of `v`
  have hnbr : G.neighborFinset v = (Finset.univ.erase v).erase u := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro w hw
      rw [G.mem_neighborFinset] at hw
      rw [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
      exact ⟨fun h => hnadj (h ▸ hw), (G.ne_of_adj hw).symm, Finset.mem_univ w⟩
    · rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hdeg,
        Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨huv, Finset.mem_univ u⟩),
        Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ v)]
      rfl
  have hadj : ∀ w, w ≠ v → w ≠ u → G.Adj v w := by
    intro w hwv hwu
    rw [← G.mem_neighborFinset, hnbr, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
    exact ⟨hwu, hwv, Finset.mem_univ w⟩
  set Y : Finset V := insert u (G.neighborFinset u) with hY
  have hvY : v ∉ Y := by
    rw [hY, Finset.mem_insert, G.mem_neighborFinset]
    rintro (h | h)
    · exact huv h.symm
    · exact hnadj h.symm
  set X : Finset V := Finset.univ.erase v with hX
  set Z : Finset V := X \ Y with hZ
  have hvX : v ∉ X := Finset.notMem_erase v _
  have hvZ : v ∉ Z := fun h => hvX (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 h).1
  have hYX : Y ⊆ X := fun w hw => Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h => hvY (h ▸ hw), Finset.mem_univ w⟩
  have hXcard : X.card = n - 1 := by rw [hX, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ v)]; rfl
  have hYcard : Y.card = G.degree u + 1 := by
    rw [hY, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp), G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  have hZcard : Z.card + (G.degree u + 1) = n - 1 := by
    rw [hZ, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hYX, hXcard, ← hYcard]
    have := Finset.card_le_card hYX
    omega
  -- the dominating sets containing `v` are the sets containing `v` that meet `N[u]`
  set P := Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset V => v ∈ S ∧ S ⊆ insert v X) with hP
  set Q := Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset V => v ∈ S ∧ S ⊆ insert v Z) with hQ
  have hQP : Q ⊆ P := by
    intro S hS
    rw [hQ, Finset.mem_filter] at hS
    rw [hP, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ S, hS.2.1,
      hS.2.2.trans (Finset.insert_subset_insert v Finset.sdiff_subset)⟩
  have hDPQ : D = P \ Q := by
    ext S
    rw [hD, Finset.mem_sdiff, hP, hQ]
    unfold simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    have hSX : v ∈ S → S ⊆ insert v X := fun _ w _ => by
      rw [Finset.mem_insert, hX, Finset.mem_erase]
      by_cases h : w = v
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h, Finset.mem_univ w⟩
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hvS, hdom⟩
      refine ⟨⟨hvS, hSX hvS⟩, fun ⟨_, hSZ⟩ => ?_⟩
      rcases hdom u with h | ⟨w, hw, hwu⟩
      · have := hSZ h
        rw [Finset.mem_insert, hZ, Finset.mem_sdiff] at this
        rcases this with h' | h'
        · exact huv h'
        · exact h'.2 (by rw [hY]; exact Finset.mem_insert_self u _)
      · have := hSZ hw
        rw [Finset.mem_insert, hZ, Finset.mem_sdiff] at this
        rcases this with h' | h'
        · exact hnadj (h' ▸ hwu)
        · exact h'.2 (by rw [hY, Finset.mem_insert, G.mem_neighborFinset]; exact Or.inr hwu.symm)
    · rintro ⟨⟨hvS, _⟩, hnot⟩
      refine ⟨hvS, fun w => ?_⟩
      by_cases hwv : w = v
      · exact Or.inl (hwv ▸ hvS)
      by_cases hwu : w = u
      · -- `S` meets `N[u]`
        subst hwu
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        apply hnot
        refine ⟨hvS, fun x hx => ?_⟩
        rw [Finset.mem_insert, hZ, Finset.mem_sdiff, hX, Finset.mem_erase]
        by_cases hxv : x = v
        · exact Or.inl hxv
        · refine Or.inr ⟨⟨hxv, Finset.mem_univ x⟩, ?_⟩
          rw [hY, Finset.mem_insert, G.mem_neighborFinset]
          rintro (h | h)
          · exact hcon.1 (h ▸ hx)
          · exact hcon.2 x hx h.symm
      · exact Or.inr ⟨v, hvS, hadj w hwv hwu⟩
  obtain ⟨hPc, hPs⟩ := count X hvX
  obtain ⟨hQc, hQs⟩ := count Z hvZ
  have hDcard : (D.card : ℚ) = 2 ^ X.card - 2 ^ Z.card := by
    rw [hDPQ, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hQP, hPc, hQc,
      Nat.cast_sub (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.sdiff_subset)))]
    push_cast; ring
  have hDsum : ∑ S ∈ D, (S.card : ℚ) = (2 ^ X.card + X.card * 2 ^ X.card / 2) -
      (2 ^ Z.card + Z.card * 2 ^ Z.card / 2) := by
    rw [hDPQ, ← hPs, ← hQs, ← Finset.sum_sdiff hQP]; ring
  -- algebra, with `|X| = |Z| + (d + 1)` and `|X| = n - 1`
  set d := G.degree u with hd
  set z := Z.card with hz
  have hXz : X.card = z + (d + 1) := by rw [hXcard]; omega
  have hnq : (n : ℚ) = z + d + 2 := by
    have : n = z + (d + 1) + 1 := by omega
    rw [this]; push_cast; ring
  unfold simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order
  rw [← hD, hDsum, hDcard, hXz, hnq]
  have h2 : (2 : ℚ) ^ (d + 1) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have : (1 : ℚ) < 2 ^ (d + 1) := one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    linarith
  have h2z : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ z := by positivity
  rw [pow_add]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.11446 (On the local average order of dominating sets), Corollary 4.2. The paper's connectivity hypothesis is kept though the proof here does not use it; the proof counts the sets containing v that meet N[u] directly instead of differentiating the domination polynomial.

explanation.summary: The proof characterizes the dominating sets containing v by observing that because deg v = n - 2 and v is non-adjacent only to u, vertex v already dominates all vertices other than u. Consequently, a subset containing v is dominating if and only if it dominates u, which means it must intersect the closed neighborhood N[u]. The collection D of dominating sets containing v is therefore the difference D = P \ Q between all subsets containing v and those containing v that are disjoint from N[u]. Using a pairing argument between subsets and their complements to compute the size and total cardinality of each family, their quotient simplifies algebraically to the claimed formula.

steps.claim: Let n = |V| and let D be the family of dominating sets of G containing v.
steps.explanation: We work under classical logic, introduce the abbreviation n for the order of the vertex set V, and denote by D the collection of dominating sets of G that contain the vertex v.
steps.code:
classical
  set n := Fintype.card V with hn'
  set D := simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing G v with hD

steps.claim: For any subset W ⊆ V not containing v, the family of subsets of {v} ∪ W containing v is in bijection with the power set 𝒫(W) via T ↦ {v} ∪ T.
steps.explanation: Every subset S ⊆ {v} ∪ W containing v is of the form {v} ∪ T with T = S \ {v} ⊆ W. Conversely, inserting v into any T ⊆ W produces a subset of {v} ∪ W containing v. Because v ∉ W, the insertion operation T ↦ {v} ∪ T is injective on 𝒫(W), since removing v recovers the unique preimage T.
steps.code:
-- sets containing `v` inside `insert v W`: `2^|W|` of them, total size `2^|W| + |W| 2^|W| / 2`
  have count : ∀ W : Finset V, v ∉ W →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset V => v ∈ S ∧ S ⊆ insert v W)).card = 2 ^ W.card ∧
      ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset V => v ∈ S ∧ S ⊆ insert v W), (S.card : ℚ) =
        2 ^ W.card + W.card * 2 ^ W.card / 2 := by
    intro W hvW
    have himg : Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset V => v ∈ S ∧ S ⊆ insert v W) =
        W.powerset.image (insert v) := by
      ext S
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image,
        Finset.mem_powerset]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hvS, hSW⟩
        refine ⟨S.erase v, fun x hx => ?_, Finset.insert_erase hvS⟩
        have := hSW (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hx)
        rw [Finset.mem_insert] at this
        rcases this with h | h
        · exact absurd h (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hx)
        · exact h
      · rintro ⟨T, hTW, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨Finset.mem_insert_self v T, Finset.insert_subset_insert v hTW⟩
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (insert v) (W.powerset : Set (Finset V)) := by
      intro S hS T hT h
      simp only [Finset.coe_powerset, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_powerset_iff,
        Finset.coe_subset] at hS hT
      have hvS : v ∉ S := fun h' => hvW (hS h')
      have hvT : v ∉ T := fun h' => hvW (hT h')
      rw [← Finset.erase_insert hvS, ← Finset.erase_insert hvT]
      exact congrArg (fun U => Finset.erase U v) h

steps.claim: The sum of the sizes of all subsets of W equals |W| · 2^{|W|} / 2.
steps.explanation: Pairing each subset T ⊆ W with its complement W \ T defines a bijection on the power set 𝒫(W). Since |T| + |W \ T| = |W|, summing over all 2^{|W|} subsets gives 2 ∑_{T ⊆ W} |T| = ∑_{T ⊆ W} (|T| + |W \ T|) = |W| · 2^{|W|}, so the sum of cardinalities is |W| · 2^{|W|} / 2.
steps.code:
-- complements in `W` pair sizes `k` and `|W| - k`
    have hhalf : 2 * ∑ T ∈ W.powerset, (T.card : ℚ) = W.card * 2 ^ W.card := by
      have hc : ∑ T ∈ W.powerset, (T.card : ℚ) = ∑ T ∈ W.powerset, ((W.card : ℚ) - T.card) := by
        refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun T => W \ T) (fun T => W \ T) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        · intro T hT; simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT ⊢; exact Finset.sdiff_subset
        · intro T hT; simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT ⊢; exact Finset.sdiff_subset
        · intro T hT; simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT; exact Finset.sdiff_sdiff_eq_self hT
        · intro T hT; simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powerset] at hT; exact Finset.sdiff_sdiff_eq_self hT
        · intro T hT
          rw [Finset.mem_powerset] at hT
          rw [Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hT, Nat.cast_sub (Finset.card_le_card hT)]
          ring
      rw [two_mul]
      nth_rewrite 2 [hc]
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ =>
        (show (T.card : ℚ) + ((W.card : ℚ) - T.card) = W.card by ring), Finset.sum_const,
        Finset.card_powerset, nsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast; ring

steps.claim: The subsets of {v} ∪ W containing v have count 2^{|W|} and their sizes sum to 2^{|W|} + |W| · 2^{|W|} / 2.
steps.explanation: Applying the bijection T ↦ {v} ∪ T, the number of such subsets is |𝒫(W)| = 2^{|W|}. Since each subset {v} ∪ T has size |T| + 1, the sum of their sizes is ∑_{T ⊆ W} (|T| + 1) = |𝒫(W)| + ∑_{T ⊆ W} |T| = 2^{|W|} + |W| · 2^{|W|} / 2.
steps.code:
rw [himg, Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj, Finset.card_powerset, Finset.sum_image hinj]
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    have : ∀ T ∈ W.powerset, ((insert v T).card : ℚ) = T.card + 1 := by
      intro T hT
      rw [Finset.mem_powerset] at hT
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (fun h => hvW (hT h))]
      push_cast; ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_powerset,
      nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    linarith

steps.claim: The open neighborhood of v is exactly V \ {v, u}, so v is adjacent to all w ∉ {v, u}.
steps.explanation: Because v has degree n - 2, is not adjacent to u, and cannot be adjacent to itself, its neighborhood N(v) is a subset of (V \ {v}) \ {u}. Since both sets have cardinality n - 2, they must be equal: N(v) = (V \ {v}) \ {u}. Consequently, every vertex w distinct from both v and u is a neighbor of v.
steps.code:
-- every vertex other than `u` and `v` is a neighbour of `v`
  have hnbr : G.neighborFinset v = (Finset.univ.erase v).erase u := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro w hw
      rw [G.mem_neighborFinset] at hw
      rw [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
      exact ⟨fun h => hnadj (h ▸ hw), (G.ne_of_adj hw).symm, Finset.mem_univ w⟩
    · rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hdeg,
        Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨huv, Finset.mem_univ u⟩),
        Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ v)]
      rfl
  have hadj : ∀ w, w ≠ v → w ≠ u → G.Adj v w := by
    intro w hwv hwu
    rw [← G.mem_neighborFinset, hnbr, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_erase]
    exact ⟨hwu, hwv, Finset.mem_univ w⟩

steps.claim: Setting Y = N[u], X = V \ {v}, and Z = X \ Y, their cardinalities are |X| = n - 1, |Y| = deg u + 1, and |Z| + (deg u + 1) = n - 1.
steps.explanation: Let Y = {u} ∪ N(u) be the closed neighborhood of u. Since u ≠ v and v ≁ u, v ∉ Y, so Y ⊆ X = V \ {v}. The sizes are |X| = n - 1 and |Y| = deg u + 1 (as u ∉ N(u)). Therefore Z = X \ Y has cardinality |Z| = |X| - |Y| = (n - 1) - (deg u + 1).
steps.code:
set Y : Finset V := insert u (G.neighborFinset u) with hY
  have hvY : v ∉ Y := by
    rw [hY, Finset.mem_insert, G.mem_neighborFinset]
    rintro (h | h)
    · exact huv h.symm
    · exact hnadj h.symm
  set X : Finset V := Finset.univ.erase v with hX
  set Z : Finset V := X \ Y with hZ
  have hvX : v ∉ X := Finset.notMem_erase v _
  have hvZ : v ∉ Z := fun h => hvX (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 h).1
  have hYX : Y ⊆ X := fun w hw => Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨fun h => hvY (h ▸ hw), Finset.mem_univ w⟩
  have hXcard : X.card = n - 1 := by rw [hX, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ v)]; rfl
  have hYcard : Y.card = G.degree u + 1 := by
    rw [hY, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp), G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
  have hZcard : Z.card + (G.degree u + 1) = n - 1 := by
    rw [hZ, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hYX, hXcard, ← hYcard]
    have := Finset.card_le_card hYX
    omega

steps.claim: The dominating sets containing v are exactly D = P \ Q, where P is the family of all subsets containing v and Q is the family of subsets containing v disjoint from Y.
steps.explanation: Because v is adjacent to every vertex except u, any subset S containing v already dominates all vertices other than u. Thus S is a dominating set if and only if it dominates u, which means S contains u or a neighbor of u—in other words, S meets the closed neighborhood Y = N[u]. Expressing P as the subsets containing v within {v} ∪ X (which is all subsets containing v) and Q as those within {v} ∪ Z (which avoid Y), we have D = P \ Q with Q ⊆ P.
steps.code:
-- the dominating sets containing `v` are the sets containing `v` that meet `N[u]`
  set P := Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset V => v ∈ S ∧ S ⊆ insert v X) with hP
  set Q := Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset V => v ∈ S ∧ S ⊆ insert v Z) with hQ
  have hQP : Q ⊆ P := by
    intro S hS
    rw [hQ, Finset.mem_filter] at hS
    rw [hP, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ S, hS.2.1,
      hS.2.2.trans (Finset.insert_subset_insert v Finset.sdiff_subset)⟩
  have hDPQ : D = P \ Q := by
    ext S
    rw [hD, Finset.mem_sdiff, hP, hQ]
    unfold simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    have hSX : v ∈ S → S ⊆ insert v X := fun _ w _ => by
      rw [Finset.mem_insert, hX, Finset.mem_erase]
      by_cases h : w = v
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h, Finset.mem_univ w⟩
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hvS, hdom⟩
      refine ⟨⟨hvS, hSX hvS⟩, fun ⟨_, hSZ⟩ => ?_⟩
      rcases hdom u with h | ⟨w, hw, hwu⟩
      · have := hSZ h
        rw [Finset.mem_insert, hZ, Finset.mem_sdiff] at this
        rcases this with h' | h'
        · exact huv h'
        · exact h'.2 (by rw [hY]; exact Finset.mem_insert_self u _)
      · have := hSZ hw
        rw [Finset.mem_insert, hZ, Finset.mem_sdiff] at this
        rcases this with h' | h'
        · exact hnadj (h' ▸ hwu)
        · exact h'.2 (by rw [hY, Finset.mem_insert, G.mem_neighborFinset]; exact Or.inr hwu.symm)
    · rintro ⟨⟨hvS, _⟩, hnot⟩
      refine ⟨hvS, fun w => ?_⟩
      by_cases hwv : w = v
      · exact Or.inl (hwv ▸ hvS)
      by_cases hwu : w = u
      · -- `S` meets `N[u]`
        subst hwu
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        apply hnot
        refine ⟨hvS, fun x hx => ?_⟩
        rw [Finset.mem_insert, hZ, Finset.mem_sdiff, hX, Finset.mem_erase]
        by_cases hxv : x = v
        · exact Or.inl hxv
        · refine Or.inr ⟨⟨hxv, Finset.mem_univ x⟩, ?_⟩
          rw [hY, Finset.mem_insert, G.mem_neighborFinset]
          rintro (h | h)
          · exact hcon.1 (h ▸ hx)
          · exact hcon.2 x hx h.symm
      · exact Or.inr ⟨v, hvS, hadj w hwv hwu⟩

steps.claim: The size of D is 2^{|X|} - 2^{|Z|}, and the sum of sizes of sets in D is (2^{|X|} + |X| · 2^{|X|} / 2) - (2^{|Z|} + |Z| · 2^{|Z|} / 2).
steps.explanation: Applying the counting lemma to X and Z yields the counts and total sizes for P and Q. Because Q ⊆ P and D = P \ Q, both the cardinality and the sum of sizes for D are obtained by subtracting the corresponding values of Q from those of P.
steps.code:
obtain ⟨hPc, hPs⟩ := count X hvX
  obtain ⟨hQc, hQs⟩ := count Z hvZ
  have hDcard : (D.card : ℚ) = 2 ^ X.card - 2 ^ Z.card := by
    rw [hDPQ, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hQP, hPc, hQc,
      Nat.cast_sub (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.sdiff_subset)))]
    push_cast; ring
  have hDsum : ∑ S ∈ D, (S.card : ℚ) = (2 ^ X.card + X.card * 2 ^ X.card / 2) -
      (2 ^ Z.card + Z.card * 2 ^ Z.card / 2) := by
    rw [hDPQ, ← hPs, ← hQs, ← Finset.sum_sdiff hQP]; ring

steps.claim: The local average dominating order simplifies to (n + 1)/2 + (deg u + 1) / (2(2^{deg u + 1} - 1)).
steps.explanation: Let d = deg u and z = |Z|, so |X| = z + d + 1 and n = z + d + 2. The average size is the quotient of the sum of sizes by |D| = 2^{|X|} - 2^{|Z|}. Factoring out 2^z from the numerator and denominator using 2^{|X|} = 2^z · 2^{d+1}, the factor 2^z > 0 cancels. Since d + 1 ≥ 1, the denominator 2^{d+1} - 1 is non-zero. Algebraic division then yields (z + d + 3)/2 + (d + 1) / (2(2^{d+1} - 1)), which equals (n + 1)/2 + (d + 1) / (2(2^{d+1} - 1)).
steps.code:
-- algebra, with `|X| = |Z| + (d + 1)` and `|X| = n - 1`
  set d := G.degree u with hd
  set z := Z.card with hz
  have hXz : X.card = z + (d + 1) := by rw [hXcard]; omega
  have hnq : (n : ℚ) = z + d + 2 := by
    have : n = z + (d + 1) + 1 := by omega
    rw [this]; push_cast; ring
  unfold simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order
  rw [← hD, hDsum, hDcard, hXz, hnq]
  have h2 : (2 : ℚ) ^ (d + 1) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have : (1 : ℚ) < 2 ^ (d + 1) := one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    linarith
  have h2z : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ z := by positivity
  rw [pow_add]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

glossary.Fintype.card: The cardinality of a finite type as a natural number.
glossary.simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing: The collection of dominating sets of G containing vertex v.
glossary.Finset.mem_filter: An element belongs to Finset.filter p s if and only if it belongs to s and satisfies predicate p.
glossary.Finset.mem_univ: Every element of a finite type belongs to the universal finset Finset.univ.
glossary.true_and: The logical proposition True ∧ p is equivalent to p.
glossary.Finset.mem_image: An element b is in the image Finset.image f s if and only if b = f a for some a in s.
glossary.Finset.mem_powerset: A finset belongs to the power set of s if and only if it is a subset of s.
glossary.Finset.insert_erase: Inserting a into s \ {a} recovers s, provided a ∈ s.
glossary.Finset.mem_of_mem_erase: An element belonging to s \ {a} also belongs to s.
glossary.Finset.mem_insert: An element belongs to {a} ∪ s if and only if it equals a or belongs to s.
glossary.Finset.ne_of_mem_erase: An element belonging to s \ {a} is not equal to a.
glossary.Finset.mem_insert_self: The element a belongs to {a} ∪ s.
glossary.Finset.insert_subset_insert: If s ⊆ t, then {a} ∪ s ⊆ {a} ∪ t.
glossary.Finset.coe_powerset: The set coercion of the power set of a finset equals the set-theoretic power set of its coercion.
glossary.Set.mem_preimage: An element x belongs to f⁻¹(s) if and only if f x belongs to s.
glossary.Set.mem_powerset_iff: A set belongs to the power set of s if and only if it is a subset of s.
glossary.Finset.coe_subset: Inclusion of finsets is equivalent to inclusion of their coerced sets.
glossary.Finset.erase_insert: Removing a from {a} ∪ s yields s, provided a ∉ s.
glossary.congrArg: If a₁ = a₂, then f a₁ = f a₂.
glossary.Finset.sum_nbij': A sum over a finset equals a sum over another finset under an explicit bijection preserving summands.
glossary.Finset.mem_coe: An element belongs to the set coercion of a finset if and only if it belongs to the finset.
glossary.Finset.sdiff_subset: The set difference s \ t is a subset of s.
glossary.Finset.sdiff_sdiff_eq_self: For t ⊆ s, the complement of the complement s \ (s \ t) equals t.
glossary.Nat.cast_sub: If m ≤ n, the natural-to-group cast of n - m equals the cast of n minus the cast of m.
glossary.Finset.card_le_card: If s ⊆ t, then |s| ≤ |t|.
glossary.two_mul: Multiplication by 2 equals addition to oneself: 2 * n = n + n.
glossary.Finset.sum_add_distrib: The sum of f x + g x over a finset equals the sum of f x plus the sum of g x.
glossary.Finset.sum_congr: Sums over equal finsets with pointwise equal summands are equal.
glossary.Finset.sum_const: Summing a constant b over a finset s equals |s| • b.
glossary.Finset.card_powerset: The power set of a finset s has cardinality 2^|s|.
glossary.nsmul_eq_mul: Natural scalar multiplication in a semiring equals multiplication by the cast of the scalar.
glossary.Finset.card_image_of_injOn: If f is injective on s, the image Finset.image f s has cardinality |s|.
glossary.Finset.sum_image: If g is injective on s, the sum of f over g(s) equals the sum of f ∘ g over s.
glossary.Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le: If s ⊆ t and |t| ≤ |s|, then s = t.
glossary.G.mem_neighborFinset: A vertex w is in the open neighborhood of v if and only if v is adjacent to w.
glossary.Finset.mem_erase: An element belongs to s \ {b} if and only if it is not equal to b and belongs to s.
glossary.G.ne_of_adj: Adjacent vertices in a simple graph are distinct.
glossary.G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree: The cardinality of the open neighborhood of v equals the degree of v.
glossary.Finset.card_erase_of_mem: Removing an element a from a finset s containing a decreases its cardinality by 1.
glossary.Finset.notMem_erase: An element a does not belong to s \ {a}.
glossary.Finset.mem_sdiff: An element belongs to s \ t if and only if it belongs to s and does not belong to t.
glossary.Or.inl: Left introduction for disjunction: A implies A ∨ B.
glossary.Or.inr: Right introduction for disjunction: B implies A ∨ B.
