declarations.name: wild_number_complete_bipartite_min_proper_coloring
declarations.informal: Let 2 ≤ m ≤ n. For every proper edge colouring of the complete bipartite graph K_{m,n} with n colours (these are exactly its minimum proper edge colourings, since its chromatic index is its maximum degree n), the wild number is n.
declarations.statement:
theorem wild_number_complete_bipartite_min_proper_coloring (m n : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (c : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).lineGraph.Coloring (Fin n)) :
    simple_graph_wild_number (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)) c = n
declarations.source:
theorem wild_kmn_adj (m n : ℕ) (a : Fin m) (b : Fin n) :
    s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b) ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet := by
  simp

theorem wild_kmn_same_color_eq (m n : ℕ)
    (c : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).lineGraph.Coloring (Fin n))
    (a : Fin m) (b b' : Fin n)
    (h : c ⟨s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b), wild_kmn_adj m n a b⟩ =
      c ⟨s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b'), wild_kmn_adj m n a b'⟩) : b = b' := by
  by_contra hne
  apply c.valid _ h
  refine ⟨fun h' => hne ?_, ⟨Sum.inl a, by simp, by simp⟩⟩
  have := congrArg Subtype.val h'
  simpa using this

theorem wild_kmn_sees_all_colors (m n : ℕ)
    (c : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).lineGraph.Coloring (Fin n))
    (a : Fin m) (col : Fin n) :
    ∃ b : Fin n, c ⟨s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b), wild_kmn_adj m n a b⟩ = col := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun b : Fin n => c ⟨s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b), wild_kmn_adj m n a b⟩ :=
    fun b b' h => wild_kmn_same_color_eq m n c a b b' h
  exact (Finite.injective_iff_surjective.1 hinj) col

theorem wild_kmn_edge_cases (m n : ℕ) (f : Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n))
    (hf : f ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet) :
    ∃ a b, f = s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b) := by
  induction f using Sym2.ind with
  | h x y =>
    rcases x with a | b <;> rcases y with a' | b'
    · simp at hf
    · exact ⟨a, b', rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨a', b, Sym2.eq_swap⟩
    · simp at hf

theorem wild_number_complete_bipartite_min_proper_coloring (m n : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (c : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).lineGraph.Coloring (Fin n)) :
    simple_graph_wild_number (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)) c = n := by
  classical
  have a0 : Fin m := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  -- the star at a left vertex is colour-connecting
  let W0 : Finset (Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)) :=
    Finset.univ.image fun b : Fin n => s(Sum.inl a0, Sum.inr b)
  have hW0card : W0.card = n := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    intro b b' h
    simpa using h
  have hW0 : simple_graph_is_color_connecting (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)) c ↑W0 := by
    refine ⟨?_, fun e => ?_⟩
    · intro f hf
      simp only [W0, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.mem_range] at hf
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hf
      exact wild_kmn_adj m n a0 b
    · rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
      refine ⟨Sum.inl a0, fun v => ?_⟩
      have hr : ∀ b : Fin n, (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet ({f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, c ⟨f, hf⟩ = c e} ∪
          ↑W0)).Reachable (Sum.inl a0) (Sum.inr b) := by
        intro b
        apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
        rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj]
        refine ⟨Or.inr ?_, by simp⟩
        simp [W0]
      rcases v with a | b
      · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := wild_kmn_sees_all_colors m n c a (c e)
        refine (hr b).trans (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ?_)
        rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj, Sym2.eq_swap]
        exact ⟨Or.inl ⟨wild_kmn_adj m n a b, hb⟩, by simp⟩
      · exact hr b
  -- every colour-connecting set has at least n edges
  have hlow : ∀ W : Finset (Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)), simple_graph_is_color_connecting (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)) c ↑W →
      n ≤ W.card := by
    intro W hW
    -- the colour class of an edge e has at most m edges
    have hclass : ∀ e : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, ∃ CF : Finset (Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)), CF.card ≤ m ∧
        {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, c ⟨f, hf⟩ = c e} ⊆ ↑CF := by
      intro e
      choose g hg using fun a => wild_kmn_sees_all_colors m n c a (c e)
      refine ⟨Finset.univ.image fun a => s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr (g a)), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)
      · rintro f ⟨hf, hfc⟩
        obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := wild_kmn_edge_cases m n f hf
        simp only [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.mem_range]
        refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
        have : g a = b := wild_kmn_same_color_eq m n c a (g a) b ((hg a).trans hfc.symm)
        rw [this]
    have hcount : ∀ e : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, ∀ R : Finset (Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)),
        {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, c ⟨f, hf⟩ = c e} ∪ ↑W ⊆ ↑R → m + n ≤ R.card + 1 := by
      intro e R hR
      have hc := (hW.2 e).card_vert_le_card_edgeSet_add_one
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin] at hc
      have : Nat.card (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet ({f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, c ⟨f, hf⟩ = c e} ∪
          ↑W)).edgeSet ≤ R.card := by
        rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
        apply Nat.card_mono (Finset.finite_toSet R)
        rw [SimpleGraph.edgeSet_fromEdgeSet]
        exact Set.sdiff_subset.trans hR
      omega
    by_cases hne : W.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hne
      have hwE : w ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet := hW.1 hw
      obtain ⟨CF, hCF, hsub⟩ := hclass ⟨w, hwE⟩
      have hwC : w ∈ CF := hsub ⟨hwE, rfl⟩
      have := hcount ⟨w, hwE⟩ (CF ∪ W.erase w) (by
        intro f hf
        rcases hf with hf | hf
        · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_union_left _ (hsub hf))
        · by_cases hfw : f = w
          · subst hfw; exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_union_left _ hwC)
          · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hfw, hf⟩)))
      have h1 := Finset.card_union_le CF (W.erase w)
      have h2 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hw
      have h3 := Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨w, hw⟩
      omega
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
      subst hne
      obtain ⟨CF, hCF, hsub⟩ := hclass ⟨_, wild_kmn_adj m n a0 ⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
      have := hcount ⟨_, wild_kmn_adj m n a0 ⟨0, by omega⟩⟩ CF (by simpa using hsub)
      omega
  unfold simple_graph_wild_number
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h := Nat.sInf_le (show W0.card ∈ {k | ∃ W : Finset (Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)), W.card = k ∧
        simple_graph_is_color_connecting (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)) c ↑W} from
        ⟨W0, rfl, hW0⟩)
    rw [hW0card] at h
    exact h
  · exact le_csInf ⟨n, W0, hW0card, hW0⟩ fun k ⟨W, hk, hW⟩ => by rw [← hk]; exact hlow W hW
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.22142 (Wild number for spanning trees in complete and complete bipartite graphs), Theorem 4.2. The Lean takes proper colourings with n colours (Fin n); since χ'(K_{m,n}) = Δ = n, these are exactly the minimum proper colourings of the paper.

explanation.summary: To prove that the wild number of K_{m,n} is n under any n-edge-colouring, we construct a colour-connecting set of size n and show that no smaller colour-connecting set exists. The star W0 at any chosen left vertex has size n and is colour-connecting because it connects to all right vertices directly and to all left vertices via monochromatic edges of the given colour class. Conversely, each colour class has size at most m, while the union of any colour class with a colour-connecting set W must be a connected spanning subgraph on m + n vertices, requiring at least m + n - 1 edges. Pairing an edge w ∈ W with its colour class gives m + n ≤ m + |W|, which forces |W| ≥ n.

steps.claim: Every pair connecting a left vertex to a right vertex is an edge of K_{m,n}.
steps.explanation: By definition of the complete bipartite graph, any pair of the form s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b) belongs to the edge set; this is checked directly by simp.
steps.code:
theorem wild_kmn_adj (m n : ℕ) (a : Fin m) (b : Fin n) :
    s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b) ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet := by
  simp

steps.claim: Two edges incident to the same left vertex with the same colour must have the same right endpoint.
steps.explanation: Suppose, for contradiction, that b ≠ b' but the edges (a, b) and (a, b') share the same colour. Since both edges share the common vertex Sum.inl a, they are distinct adjacent vertices in the line graph. Because c is a proper colouring, adjacent edges must receive distinct colours, yielding a contradiction.
steps.code:
theorem wild_kmn_same_color_eq (m n : ℕ)
    (c : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).lineGraph.Coloring (Fin n))
    (a : Fin m) (b b' : Fin n)
    (h : c ⟨s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b), wild_kmn_adj m n a b⟩ =
      c ⟨s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b'), wild_kmn_adj m n a b'⟩) : b = b' := by
  by_contra hne
  apply c.valid _ h
  refine ⟨fun h' => hne ?_, ⟨Sum.inl a, by simp, by simp⟩⟩
  have := congrArg Subtype.val h'
  simpa using this

steps.claim: Every left vertex is incident to edges of all n colours.
steps.explanation: The assignment sending each right vertex b to the colour of the edge (a, b) is injective by wild_kmn_same_color_eq. Since the domain and codomain are both finite sets of size n, injectivity implies surjectivity, so every colour col is realized by some edge incident to a.
steps.code:
theorem wild_kmn_sees_all_colors (m n : ℕ)
    (c : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).lineGraph.Coloring (Fin n))
    (a : Fin m) (col : Fin n) :
    ∃ b : Fin n, c ⟨s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b), wild_kmn_adj m n a b⟩ = col := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun b : Fin n => c ⟨s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b), wild_kmn_adj m n a b⟩ :=
    fun b b' h => wild_kmn_same_color_eq m n c a b b' h
  exact (Finite.injective_iff_surjective.1 hinj) col

steps.claim: Every edge of K_{m,n} connects a left vertex to a right vertex.
steps.explanation: By induction on the unordered pair representation of an edge f = s(x, y), we perform case analysis on which side each vertex lies on. Edges with both endpoints on the left or both on the right are impossible by definition of bipartite graphs. An edge with one left and one right endpoint already has the desired form, possibly after swapping the endpoints with Sym2.eq_swap.
steps.code:
theorem wild_kmn_edge_cases (m n : ℕ) (f : Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n))
    (hf : f ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet) :
    ∃ a b, f = s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b) := by
  induction f using Sym2.ind with
  | h x y =>
    rcases x with a | b <;> rcases y with a' | b'
    · simp at hf
    · exact ⟨a, b', rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨a', b, Sym2.eq_swap⟩
    · simp at hf

steps.claim: The star W0 at a chosen left vertex a0 has cardinality n.
steps.explanation: Since m ≥ 2, we can choose a left vertex a0 = 0 ∈ Fin m. We let W0 be the set of all edges connecting a0 to vertices in Fin n. Because the map b ↦ s(Sum.inl a0, Sum.inr b) is injective, the cardinality of W0 equals |Fin n| = n.
steps.code:
theorem wild_number_complete_bipartite_min_proper_coloring (m n : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (c : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).lineGraph.Coloring (Fin n)) :
    simple_graph_wild_number (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)) c = n := by
  classical
  have a0 : Fin m := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  -- the star at a left vertex is colour-connecting
  let W0 : Finset (Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)) :=
    Finset.univ.image fun b : Fin n => s(Sum.inl a0, Sum.inr b)
  have hW0card : W0.card = n := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    intro b b' h
    simpa using h

steps.claim: The star W0 is colour-connecting for c.
steps.explanation: First, every element in W0 is an edge of K_{m,n} by wild_kmn_adj. Second, for any edge e, the subgraph formed by W0 and the colour class of e is connected: every right vertex b is directly reachable from a0 via W0, and every left vertex a is incident to some edge of colour c(e) connecting it to a right vertex b by wild_kmn_sees_all_colors, so a is reachable from a0 via b.
steps.code:
have hW0 : simple_graph_is_color_connecting (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)) c ↑W0 := by
    refine ⟨?_, fun e => ?_⟩
    · intro f hf
      simp only [W0, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.mem_range] at hf
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hf
      exact wild_kmn_adj m n a0 b
    · rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
      refine ⟨Sum.inl a0, fun v => ?_⟩
      have hr : ∀ b : Fin n, (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet ({f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, c ⟨f, hf⟩ = c e} ∪
          ↑W0)).Reachable (Sum.inl a0) (Sum.inr b) := by
        intro b
        apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
        rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj]
        refine ⟨Or.inr ?_, by simp⟩
        simp [W0]
      rcases v with a | b
      · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := wild_kmn_sees_all_colors m n c a (c e)
        refine (hr b).trans (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ?_)
        rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj, Sym2.eq_swap]
        exact ⟨Or.inl ⟨wild_kmn_adj m n a b, hb⟩, by simp⟩
      · exact hr b

steps.claim: For any colour-connecting set W and any edge e, the colour class of e has size at most m.
steps.explanation: Let W be colour-connecting. For any edge e, each left vertex a has an incident edge of colour c(e) by wild_kmn_sees_all_colors, and by wild_kmn_same_color_eq this right neighbour g(a) is unique. Any edge of colour c(e) connects some left vertex a to g(a) by wild_kmn_edge_cases, so the colour class is contained in {s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr (g(a))) | a ∈ Fin m}, which has size at most m.
steps.code:
-- every colour-connecting set has at least n edges
  have hlow : ∀ W : Finset (Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)), simple_graph_is_color_connecting (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)) c ↑W →
      n ≤ W.card := by
    intro W hW
    -- the colour class of an edge e has at most m edges
    have hclass : ∀ e : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, ∃ CF : Finset (Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)), CF.card ≤ m ∧
        {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, c ⟨f, hf⟩ = c e} ⊆ ↑CF := by
      intro e
      choose g hg using fun a => wild_kmn_sees_all_colors m n c a (c e)
      refine ⟨Finset.univ.image fun a => s(Sum.inl a, Sum.inr (g a)), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)
      · rintro f ⟨hf, hfc⟩
        obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := wild_kmn_edge_cases m n f hf
        simp only [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.mem_range]
        refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
        have : g a = b := wild_kmn_same_color_eq m n c a (g a) b ((hg a).trans hfc.symm)
        rw [this]

steps.claim: Any edge set R containing the union of a colour class and W has size at least m + n - 1.
steps.explanation: Because W is colour-connecting, the subgraph induced by the colour class of e and W is connected and spans all m + n vertices of K_{m,n}. Any connected graph on m + n vertices has at least m + n - 1 edges, so any finite superset R of these edges satisfies m + n ≤ |R| + 1.
steps.code:
have hcount : ∀ e : (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, ∀ R : Finset (Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)),
        {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, c ⟨f, hf⟩ = c e} ∪ ↑W ⊆ ↑R → m + n ≤ R.card + 1 := by
      intro e R hR
      have hc := (hW.2 e).card_vert_le_card_edgeSet_add_one
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin] at hc
      have : Nat.card (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet ({f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet, c ⟨f, hf⟩ = c e} ∪
          ↑W)).edgeSet ≤ R.card := by
        rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
        apply Nat.card_mono (Finset.finite_toSet R)
        rw [SimpleGraph.edgeSet_fromEdgeSet]
        exact Set.sdiff_subset.trans hR
      omega

steps.claim: Every colour-connecting set W has cardinality at least n.
steps.explanation: If W is nonempty, pick an edge w ∈ W. Its colour class C has size at most m and contains w. Setting R = C ∪ (W \ {w}), the union C ∪ W is contained in R, so m + n ≤ |R| + 1 ≤ |C| + (|W| - 1) + 1 ≤ m + |W|, which yields n ≤ |W|. If W is empty, the colour class C of an edge spans all m + n vertices, forcing m + n ≤ |C| + 1 ≤ m + 1, so n ≤ 1, contradicting 2 ≤ m ≤ n.
steps.code:
by_cases hne : W.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hne
      have hwE : w ∈ (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)).edgeSet := hW.1 hw
      obtain ⟨CF, hCF, hsub⟩ := hclass ⟨w, hwE⟩
      have hwC : w ∈ CF := hsub ⟨hwE, rfl⟩
      have := hcount ⟨w, hwE⟩ (CF ∪ W.erase w) (by
        intro f hf
        rcases hf with hf | hf
        · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_union_left _ (hsub hf))
        · by_cases hfw : f = w
          · subst hfw; exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_union_left _ hwC)
          · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hfw, hf⟩)))
      have h1 := Finset.card_union_le CF (W.erase w)
      have h2 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hw
      have h3 := Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨w, hw⟩
      omega
    · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
      subst hne
      obtain ⟨CF, hCF, hsub⟩ := hclass ⟨_, wild_kmn_adj m n a0 ⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
      have := hcount ⟨_, wild_kmn_adj m n a0 ⟨0, by omega⟩⟩ CF (by simpa using hsub)
      omega

steps.claim: The wild number of K_{m,n} under colouring c is n.
steps.explanation: By definition, the wild number is the infimum of the sizes of colour-connecting sets. The upper bound is witnessed by W0 of size n via Nat.sInf_le, and the lower bound follows from le_csInf since every colour-connecting set has size at least n. By le_antisymm, the wild number equals n.
steps.code:
unfold simple_graph_wild_number
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h := Nat.sInf_le (show W0.card ∈ {k | ∃ W : Finset (Sym2 (Fin m ⊕ Fin n)), W.card = k ∧
        simple_graph_is_color_connecting (completeBipartiteGraph (Fin m) (Fin n)) c ↑W} from
        ⟨W0, rfl, hW0⟩)
    rw [hW0card] at h
    exact h
  · exact le_csInf ⟨n, W0, hW0card, hW0⟩ fun k ⟨W, hk, hW⟩ => by rw [← hk]; exact hlow W hW

glossary.congrArg: Applying a function to both sides of an equality preserves the equality.
glossary.Subtype.val: Extracts the underlying value from a subtype element.
glossary.wild_kmn_same_color_eq: In a proper edge colouring of K_{m,n}, any two edges incident to the same left vertex with the same colour have identical right endpoints.
glossary.Sym2.ind: To prove a property for all unordered pairs, it suffices to prove it for pairs of the form s(x, y).
glossary.Sym2.eq_swap: An unordered pair is symmetric in its two arguments: s(a, b) = s(b, a).
glossary.Finset.card_image_of_injective: The image of a finite set under an injective function has the same cardinality as the original set.
glossary.Finset.card_univ: The cardinality of the universal finset of a finite type equals the type's cardinality.
glossary.Fintype.card_fin: The finite type Fin n has cardinality n.
glossary.wild_kmn_adj: Any pair connecting a left vertex Sum.inl a and a right vertex Sum.inr b is an edge of the complete bipartite graph K_{m,n}.
glossary.SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_: A graph is connected if and only if there exists a vertex from which every vertex is reachable.
glossary.SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable: Adjacent vertices in a graph are reachable from one another.
glossary.SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj: In a graph defined from an edge set, v and w are adjacent if and only if s(v, w) belongs to the edge set and v ≠ w.
glossary.Or.inr: Proves a disjunction from its right disjunct.
glossary.wild_kmn_sees_all_colors: In a proper edge colouring of K_{m,n} with n colours, every left vertex is incident to an edge of each colour.
glossary.Or.inl: Proves a disjunction from its left disjunct.
glossary.wild_kmn_edge_cases: Every edge in K_{m,n} connects some left vertex Sum.inl a to some right vertex Sum.inr b.
glossary.Nat.card_eq_fintype_card: The Nat.card of a finite type is equal to its Fintype.card.
glossary.Fintype.card_sum: The cardinality of a sum type α ⊕ β is the sum of the cardinalities of α and β.
glossary.Set.ncard_coe_finset: The set cardinality of the underlying set of a finset equals the finset cardinality.
glossary.Nat.card_coe_set_eq: The Nat.card of a set coerced to a type equals its set cardinality ncard.
glossary.Nat.card_mono: If s ⊆ t and t is finite, the cardinality of s is at most that of t.
glossary.Finset.finite_toSet: The underlying set of any finset is finite.
glossary.SimpleGraph.edgeSet_fromEdgeSet: The edge set of a graph built from a set of pairs consists of those pairs minus self-loops.
glossary.Finset.mem_union_left: An element belonging to s also belongs to the union s ∪ t.
glossary.Finset.mem_union_right: An element belonging to t also belongs to the union s ∪ t.
glossary.Finset.card_union_le: The cardinality of a union of two finsets is at most the sum of their cardinalities.
glossary.Finset.card_erase_of_mem: Erasing an element from a finset decreases its cardinality by 1.
glossary.Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty: A finset is not nonempty if and only if it is empty.
glossary.le_antisymm: If a ≤ b and b ≤ a, then a = b.
glossary.Nat.sInf_le: An element of a set of natural numbers is greater than or equal to the infimum of the set.
glossary.le_csInf: If a lower bound holds for all elements of a nonempty set, it is bounded above by the infimum.

caveats: The proof handles the case where W is empty separately, deriving a contradiction by showing that a connected spanning subgraph of K_{m,n} must have at least m + n - 1 edges, which would force n ≤ 1.
Several numerical inequalities on graph orders and edge counts are closed by the `omega` linear integer arithmetic decision procedure.

declarations.name: simple_graph_is_tree_exists_superadditive_balanced_separator
declarations.informal: Let T be a tree on a finite vertex set V and f a nonnegative superadditive set function (f(A) + f(B) ≤ f(A ∪ B) for disjoint A, B). Then some vertex v has the property that every connected component C of T − v satisfies f(C) ≤ f(V)/2, and the values f(C) over the components sum to at most f(V).
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_is_tree_exists_superadditive_balanced_separator {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] (T : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel T.Adj] (hT : T.IsTree)
    (f : Finset V → ℝ) (hf0 : ∀ S, 0 ≤ f S)
    (hsup : ∀ A B, Disjoint A B → f A + f B ≤ f (A ∪ B)) :
    ∃ v : V,
      (∀ w, w ≠ v →
        f (Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u) ≤
          f Finset.univ / 2) ∧
      ∑ C ∈ (Finset.univ.erase v).image
          (fun w => Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u), f C ≤
        f Finset.univ
declarations.source:
theorem tree_separator_superadditive_sum_le {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] (f : Finset V → ℝ)
    (hf0 : ∀ S, 0 ≤ f S) (hsup : ∀ A B, Disjoint A B → f A + f B ≤ f (A ∪ B))
    (𝒮 : Finset (Finset V)) (hd : (𝒮 : Set (Finset V)).PairwiseDisjoint id) :
    ∑ C ∈ 𝒮, f C ≤ f (𝒮.biUnion id) := by
  induction 𝒮 using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using hf0 ∅
  | insert C 𝒮 hC ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hC, Finset.biUnion_insert]
    have hd' : (𝒮 : Set (Finset V)).PairwiseDisjoint id :=
      hd.subset (by rw [Finset.coe_insert]; exact Set.subset_insert _ _)
    have hdisj : Disjoint C (𝒮.biUnion id) := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_biUnion_right]
      intro D hD
      exact hd (by simp) (by simp [hD]) (fun h => hC (h ▸ hD))
    have := hsup C _ hdisj
    have := ih hd'
    simp only [id] at *
    linarith

theorem tree_separator_reachable_transfer {V : Type*} (T : SimpleGraph V) (u v a z : V)
    (p : (T.deleteIncidenceSet u).Walk a z)
    (ha : ∀ y, (T.deleteIncidenceSet u).Reachable a y → y ≠ v) :
    (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable a z := by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
  | @cons a b z h p ih =>
    have hb : ∀ y, (T.deleteIncidenceSet u).Reachable b y → y ≠ v :=
      fun y hy => ha y (h.reachable.trans hy)
    refine SimpleGraph.Reachable.trans ?_ (ih hb)
    apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
    rw [SimpleGraph.deleteIncidenceSet_adj] at h ⊢
    exact ⟨h.1, ha _ (SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _), hb _ (SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _)⟩

theorem tree_separator_delete_le {V : Type*} (T : SimpleGraph V) (u v a : V)
    (ha : a = u ∨ a = v) : T.deleteIncidenceSet a ≤ T.deleteEdges {s(u, v)} := by
  intro x y h
  rw [SimpleGraph.deleteIncidenceSet_adj] at h
  rw [SimpleGraph.deleteEdges_adj]
  refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Sym2.eq_iff]
  rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) <;> rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> simp_all

theorem simple_graph_is_tree_exists_superadditive_balanced_separator {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] (T : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel T.Adj] (hT : T.IsTree)
    (f : Finset V → ℝ) (hf0 : ∀ S, 0 ≤ f S)
    (hsup : ∀ A B, Disjoint A B → f A + f B ≤ f (A ∪ B)) :
    ∃ v : V,
      (∀ w, w ≠ v →
        f (Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u) ≤
          f Finset.univ / 2) ∧
      ∑ C ∈ (Finset.univ.erase v).image
          (fun w => Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u), f C ≤
        f Finset.univ := by
  have hmono : ∀ A B : Finset V, A ⊆ B → f A ≤ f B := by
    intro A B hAB
    have := hsup A (B \ A) Finset.disjoint_sdiff
    rw [Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset hAB] at this
    linarith [hf0 (B \ A)]
  have mem_comp : ∀ v w u, u ∈ (Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u) ↔
      (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u := by
    intro v w u; simp
  have not_reach : ∀ v w, w ≠ v → ¬ (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w v := by
    intro v w hw h
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := h.symm
    cases p with
    | nil => exact hw rfl
    | cons h' _ => exact (SimpleGraph.deleteIncidenceSet_adj.1 h').2.1 rfl
  have comp_eq : ∀ v w w', (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w w' →
      (Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u) =
        (Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w' u) := by
    intro v w w' h
    ext z
    rw [mem_comp, mem_comp]
    exact ⟨fun hz => h.symm.trans hz, fun hz => h.trans hz⟩
  have hsum : ∀ v, ∑ C ∈ (Finset.univ.erase v).image
      (fun w => Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u), f C ≤
        f Finset.univ := by
    intro v
    refine (tree_separator_superadditive_sum_le f hf0 hsup _ ?_).trans
      (hmono _ _ (Finset.subset_univ _))
    intro C hC D hD hCD
    simp only [Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe] at hC hD
    obtain ⟨w1, -, rfl⟩ := hC
    obtain ⟨w2, -, rfl⟩ := hD
    rw [Function.onFun, Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hz1 hz2
    apply hCD
    simp only [id] at hz1 hz2
    exact comp_eq v w1 w2 (((mem_comp _ _ _).1 hz1).trans ((mem_comp _ _ _).1 hz2).symm)
  by_contra hcon
  have heavy : ∀ v, ∃ w, w ≠ v ∧ f Finset.univ / 2 <
      f (Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u) := by
    intro v
    by_contra h
    apply hcon
    refine ⟨v, fun w hw => ?_, hsum v⟩
    by_contra h2
    exact h ⟨w, hw, lt_of_not_ge h2⟩
  obtain ⟨v0⟩ := hT.1.nonempty
  let P := (Finset.univ : Finset (V × V)).filter fun p => p.2 ≠ p.1 ∧ f Finset.univ / 2 <
      f (Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet p.1).Reachable p.2 u)
  have hPne : P.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hh⟩ := heavy v0
    exact ⟨(v0, w), by simp [P, hw, hh]⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨v, w⟩, hp, hmin⟩ := P.exists_min_image
    (fun p => (Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet p.1).Reachable p.2 u).card) hPne
  simp only [P, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
  obtain ⟨hwv, hheavy⟩ := hp
  -- a neighbour u of v in the heavy component C
  obtain ⟨q⟩ := hT.1.preconnected w v
  obtain ⟨d, -, hd1, hd2⟩ := q.exists_boundary_dart
    (↑(Finset.univ.filter fun u => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u) : Set V)
    (by rw [Finset.mem_coe, mem_comp]) (by rw [Finset.mem_coe, mem_comp]; exact not_reach v w hwv)
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, mem_comp] at hd1 hd2
  have hfst : d.fst ≠ v := fun h => not_reach v w hwv (h ▸ hd1)
  have hsnd : d.snd = v := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hd2 (hd1.trans (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
      (SimpleGraph.deleteIncidenceSet_adj.2 ⟨d.adj, hfst, hne⟩)))
  set u := d.fst with hu_def
  have huv : T.Adj u v := hsnd ▸ d.adj
  have hwu : (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w u := hd1
  have hvu : v ≠ u := fun h => hfst h.symm
  -- the component of v in T - u is disjoint from C
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Finset.univ.filter fun z => (T.deleteIncidenceSet u).Reachable v z)
      (Finset.univ.filter fun z => (T.deleteIncidenceSet v).Reachable w z) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro z hz1 hz2
    rw [mem_comp] at hz1 hz2
    have h1 := hz1.mono (tree_separator_delete_le T u v u (Or.inl rfl))
    have h2 := (hz2.symm.trans hwu).mono (tree_separator_delete_le T u v v (Or.inr rfl))
    have hb := SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge.1 hT.2 huv
    rw [SimpleGraph.isBridge_iff] at hb
    exact hb (h1.trans h2).symm

  have hxv : ¬ (T.deleteIncidenceSet u).Reachable x v := by
    intro h
    rw [comp_eq u x v h] at hxheavy
    linarith
  have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter fun z => (T.deleteIncidenceSet u).Reachable x z) ⊆

    intro z hz
    rw [mem_comp] at hz
    rw [Finset.mem_erase, mem_comp]

    obtain ⟨q'⟩ := hT.1.preconnected x u
    obtain ⟨d', -, hd'1, hd'2⟩ := q'.exists_boundary_dart
      (↑(Finset.univ.filter fun z => (T.deleteIncidenceSet u).Reachable x z) : Set V)

      fun t ht htv => hxv (htv ▸ hd'1.trans ht)
    have hyz : (T.deleteIncidenceSet u).Reachable d'.fst z := hd'1.symm.trans hz
    obtain ⟨pyz⟩ := hyz

  omega

declarations.name: wild_number_complete_graph_two_coloring_range
declarations.informal: Let n ≥ 4. Every (surjective) 2-edge-colouring of K_n has wild number at most n − 2, and every integer 0 ≤ k ≤ n − 2 is the wild number of some 2-edge-colouring of K_n.
declarations.statement:
theorem wild_number_complete_graph_two_coloring_range (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    (∀ γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2, Function.Surjective γ →
        simple_graph_wild_number (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) γ ≤ n - 2) ∧
      ∀ k ≤ n - 2, ∃ γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2, Function.Surjective γ ∧
        simple_graph_wild_number (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) γ = k
declarations.source:
theorem wild_two_reachable_of_adj_reachable {V : Type*} {G G' : SimpleGraph V}
    (h : ∀ x y, G.Adj x y → G'.Reachable x y) {u v : V} (huv : G.Reachable u v) :
    G'.Reachable u v := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := huv
  induction p with
  | nil => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
  | cons hadj _ ih => exact (h _ _ hadj).trans ih

theorem wild_two_card_le_of_connected {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (S : Set (Sym2 V))
    (R : Finset (Sym2 V)) (hS : (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet S).Connected) (hR : S ⊆ ↑R) :
    Fintype.card V ≤ R.card + 1 := by
  have hc := hS.card_vert_le_card_edgeSet_add_one
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at hc
  have : Nat.card (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet S).edgeSet ≤ R.card := by
    rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    apply Nat.card_mono (Finset.finite_toSet R)
    rw [SimpleGraph.edgeSet_fromEdgeSet]
    exact Set.sdiff_subset.trans hR
  omega

theorem wild_two_wild_number_eq_of {V α : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (γ : G.edgeSet → α) (k : ℕ)
    (W0 : Finset (Sym2 V)) (hW0 : simple_graph_is_color_connecting G γ ↑W0) (hk : W0.card ≤ k)
    (hlow : ∀ W : Finset (Sym2 V), simple_graph_is_color_connecting G γ ↑W → k ≤ W.card) :
    simple_graph_wild_number G γ = k := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (simple_graph_wild_number_le_of_is_color_connecting G γ W0 hW0).trans hk
  · exact le_csInf ⟨_, W0, rfl, hW0⟩ fun j ⟨W, hj, hW⟩ => by rw [← hj]; exact hlow W hW

theorem wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin n} (h : i ≠ j) :
    s(i, j) ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet := by
  simpa using h

/-- Upper bound: some colour class is connected; join the components of the other one by a star. -/
theorem wild_two_upper (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) (γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2)
    (hγ : Function.Surjective γ) :
    simple_graph_wild_number (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) γ ≤ n - 2 := by
  classical
  let H : Fin 2 → SimpleGraph (Fin n) := fun c =>
    SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet, γ ⟨f, hf⟩ = c}
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
  have hHadj : ∀ c x y (hxy : x ≠ y),
      (H c).Adj x y ↔ γ ⟨s(x, y), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet hxy⟩ = c := by
    intro c x y hxy
    simp only [H, SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hf, hc⟩, -⟩; exact hc
    · intro hc; exact ⟨⟨wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet hxy, hc⟩, hxy⟩
  have hcompl : ∀ c x y, x ≠ y → ¬ (H c).Adj x y → (H (1 - c)).Adj x y := by
    intro c x y hxy h
    rw [hHadj c x y hxy] at h
    rw [hHadj (1 - c) x y hxy]
    revert h
    generalize γ ⟨s(x, y), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet hxy⟩ = a
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp
  -- one of the two classes is connected
  have hone : ∃ c, (H c).Connected := by
    by_cases h0 : (H 0).Connected
    · exact ⟨0, h0⟩
    · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      have h0' : ¬ (H 0).Preconnected := fun hp => h0 ⟨hp⟩
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Preconnected, not_forall] at h0'
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := h0'
      rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
      refine ⟨a, fun y => ?_⟩
      by_cases hy : (H 0).Reachable a y
      · -- y is in a's component: go through b
        have hby : ¬ (H 0).Reachable b y := fun h => hab (hy.trans h.symm)
        have hab' : a ≠ b := fun h => hab (h ▸ SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _)
        have hby' : b ≠ y := fun h => hby (h ▸ SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _)
        have h1 : (H 1).Adj a b := hcompl 0 a b hab' (fun h => hab h.reachable)
        have h2 : (H 1).Adj b y := hcompl 0 b y hby' (fun h => hby h.reachable)
        exact h1.reachable.trans h2.reachable
      · have hay : a ≠ y := fun h => hy (h ▸ SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _)
        exact (hcompl 0 a y hay (fun h => hy h.reachable)).reachable
  obtain ⟨c1, hc1⟩ := hone
  set c0 := 1 - c1 with hc0
  have hγc : ∀ e, γ e = c0 ∨ γ e = c1 := by
    intro e
    generalize γ e = a
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c1 <;> simp [hc0]
  -- representatives of the components of H c0
  let r : (H c0).ConnectedComponent → Fin n := fun C => Quot.out C
  have hr : ∀ C, (H c0).connectedComponentMk (r C) = C := fun C => Quot.out_eq C
  let C0 := (H c0).connectedComponentMk ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let W : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n)) := (Finset.univ.erase C0).image fun C => s(r C0, r C)
  have hrne : ∀ C, C ≠ C0 → r C0 ≠ r C := by
    intro C hC h
    apply hC
    rw [← hr C, ← hr C0, h]
  have hW : simple_graph_is_color_connecting (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) γ ↑W := by
    refine ⟨?_, fun e => ?_⟩
    · intro f hf
      simp only [W, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_erase] at hf
      obtain ⟨C, ⟨hC, -⟩, rfl⟩ := hf
      exact wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (hrne C hC)
    · rcases hγc e with he | he
      · rw [he]
        rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
        refine ⟨r C0, fun y => ?_⟩
        have hle : H c0 ≤ SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet
            ({f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet, γ ⟨f, hf⟩ = c0} ∪ ↑W) :=
          SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_mono Set.subset_union_left
        have hy : (H c0).Reachable (r ((H c0).connectedComponentMk y)) y :=
          SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.exact (hr _)
        by_cases hC : (H c0).connectedComponentMk y = C0
        · rw [hC] at hy
          exact hy.mono hle
        · refine SimpleGraph.Reachable.trans (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ?_) (hy.mono hle)
          rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj]
          refine ⟨Or.inr ?_, hrne _ hC⟩
          simp only [W, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_erase,
            Finset.mem_univ, and_true]
          exact ⟨_, hC, rfl⟩
      · rw [he]
        exact hc1.mono (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_mono Set.subset_union_left)
  refine (simple_graph_wild_number_le_of_is_color_connecting _ γ W hW).trans ?_
  -- H c0 has an edge, so it has fewer than n components
  obtain ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, he⟩ := hγ c0
  induction f using Sym2.ind with
  | h x y =>
  have hxy' : x ≠ y := by simpa using hf
  have hadj : (H c0).Adj x y := (hHadj c0 x y hxy').2 he
  have hcard : Fintype.card (H c0).ConnectedComponent < n := by
    have := Fintype.card_lt_of_surjective_not_injective (H c0).connectedComponentMk
      (fun C => ⟨r C, hr C⟩) (fun hinj => hxy' (hinj (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.sound hadj.reachable)))
    simpa using this
  have hWc : W.card ≤ (Finset.univ.erase C0).card := Finset.card_image_le
  rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.card_univ] at hWc
  omega

def wild_two_path_color (n : ℕ) : Sym2 (Fin n) → Fin 2 :=
  Sym2.lift ⟨fun i j => if i.val + 1 = j.val ∨ j.val + 1 = i.val then 0 else 1,
    fun i j => by simp only [or_comm]⟩

def wild_two_block_color (n k : ℕ) : Sym2 (Fin n) → Fin 2 :=
  Sym2.lift ⟨fun i j => if i.val < n - k ∧ j.val < n - k then 0 else 1,
    fun i j => by simp only [and_comm]⟩

theorem wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj {n : ℕ} (γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2) (c : Fin 2)
    (W : Set (Sym2 (Fin n))) (x y : Fin n) :
    (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet ({f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet, γ ⟨f, hf⟩ = c} ∪ W)).Adj x y ↔
      ∃ hxy : x ≠ y, (γ ⟨s(x, y), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet hxy⟩ = c ∨ s(x, y) ∈ W) := by
  simp only [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h | h, hxy⟩
    · exact ⟨hxy, Or.inl h.2⟩
    · exact ⟨hxy, Or.inr h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxy, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inl ⟨wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet hxy, h⟩, hxy⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inr h, hxy⟩

theorem wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj' {n : ℕ} (γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2) (c : Fin 2)
    (x y : Fin n) :
    (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet, γ ⟨f, hf⟩ = c}).Adj x y ↔
      ∃ hxy : x ≠ y, γ ⟨s(x, y), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet hxy⟩ = c := by
  have := wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj γ c ∅ x y
  simpa using this

theorem wild_two_attain (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n - 2) :
    ∃ γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2, Function.Surjective γ ∧
      simple_graph_wild_number (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) γ = k := by
  classical
  have h0n : 0 < n := by omega
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, h0n⟩⟩
  have two : ∀ a : Fin 2, a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by decide
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk1
  · -- k = 0: a Hamiltonian path and its complement
    let γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2 := fun e => wild_two_path_color n e.1
    refine ⟨γ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro c
      rcases two c with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨⟨s(⟨0, h0n⟩, ⟨1, by omega⟩), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp [Fin.ext_iff])⟩,
          by simp [γ, wild_two_path_color]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨s(⟨0, h0n⟩, ⟨2, by omega⟩), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp [Fin.ext_iff])⟩,
          by simp [γ, wild_two_path_color]⟩
    · refine wild_two_wild_number_eq_of _ _ 0 ∅ ⟨by simp, fun e => ?_⟩ (by simp) (fun _ _ => by simp)
      rw [Finset.coe_empty, Set.union_empty, SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
      refine ⟨⟨0, h0n⟩, fun y => ?_⟩
      rcases two (γ e) with hce | hce
      · -- the path
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := y
        induction m with
        | zero => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
        | succ m ih =>
          refine (ih (by omega)).trans (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ?_)
          rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj' γ]
          exact ⟨by simp [Fin.ext_iff], by rw [hce]; simp [γ, wild_two_path_color]⟩
      · -- the complement of the path (n ≥ 4)
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := y
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m 2 with h2 | h2
        · interval_cases m
          · exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
          · have a1 : (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet,
                γ ⟨f, hf⟩ = γ e}).Adj ⟨0, h0n⟩ ⟨3, by omega⟩ := by
              rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj' γ]
              exact ⟨by simp [Fin.ext_iff], by rw [hce]; simp [γ, wild_two_path_color]⟩
            have a2 : (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet,
                γ ⟨f, hf⟩ = γ e}).Adj ⟨3, by omega⟩ ⟨1, hm⟩ := by
              rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj' γ]
              exact ⟨by simp [Fin.ext_iff], by rw [hce]; simp [γ, wild_two_path_color]⟩
            exact a1.reachable.trans a2.reachable
        · apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
          rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj' γ]
          refine ⟨by simp [Fin.ext_iff]; omega, ?_⟩
          rw [hce]
          simp [γ, wild_two_path_color] <;> omega
  · -- k ≥ 1: a clique on n - k vertices, all other pairs coloured 1
    let γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2 := fun e => wild_two_block_color n k e.1
    have hcol : ∀ x y : Fin n, wild_two_block_color n k s(x, y) =
        if x.val < n - k ∧ y.val < n - k then 0 else 1 := fun x y => rfl
    let z : Fin n := ⟨0, h0n⟩
    let last : Fin n := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    refine ⟨γ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro c
      rcases two c with rfl | rfl
      · refine ⟨⟨s(z, ⟨1, by omega⟩), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp [z, Fin.ext_iff])⟩, ?_⟩
        show wild_two_block_color n k s(z, ⟨1, by omega⟩) = 0
        rw [hcol, if_pos (by simp [z]; omega)]
      · refine ⟨⟨s(z, last), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp [z, last, Fin.ext_iff]; omega)⟩, ?_⟩
        show wild_two_block_color n k s(z, last) = 1
        rw [hcol, if_neg (by simp [z, last]; omega)]
    · let W0 : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n)) :=
        (Finset.range k).image fun t => s(z, (⟨n - 1 - t, by omega⟩ : Fin n))
      have hW0mem : ∀ j : Fin n, n - k ≤ j.val → s(z, j) ∈ W0 := fun j hj => by
        simp only [W0, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
        refine ⟨n - 1 - j.val, by omega, ?_⟩
        congr 1
        exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
      have hW0card : W0.card ≤ k := Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)
      have hW0 : simple_graph_is_color_connecting (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) γ ↑W0 := by
        refine ⟨?_, fun e => ?_⟩
        · intro f hf
          simp only [W0, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Iio] at hf
          obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hf
          exact wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp only [ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, z]; omega)
        · rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
          rcases two (γ e) with hce | hce
          · refine ⟨z, fun y => ?_⟩
            by_cases hyz : y = z
            · rw [hyz]
            apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
            rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj γ]
            refine ⟨Ne.symm hyz, ?_⟩
            by_cases hy : y.val < n - k
            · left
              rw [hce]
              show wild_two_block_color n k s(z, y) = 0
              rw [hcol, if_pos ⟨by simp [z]; omega, hy⟩]
            · right
              exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (hW0mem y (by omega))
          · refine ⟨last, fun y => ?_⟩
            by_cases hyl : y = last
            · rw [hyl]
            apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
            rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj γ]
            refine ⟨Ne.symm hyl, Or.inl ?_⟩
            rw [hce]
            show wild_two_block_color n k s(last, y) = 1
            rw [hcol, if_neg (by simp [last]; omega)]
      refine wild_two_wild_number_eq_of _ _ k W0 hW0 hW0card (fun W hW => ?_)
      -- lower bound: transfer connectivity of (class 0) ∪ W to (a star in the clique) ∪ W
      let P : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n)) :=
        (Finset.range (n - k - 1)).image fun t => s(z, (⟨(t + 1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ h0n⟩ : Fin n))
      have hPcard : P.card ≤ n - k - 1 := Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)
      have he01 : s(z, (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin n)) ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet :=
        wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp [Fin.ext_iff, z])
      have hconn := hW.2 ⟨_, he01⟩
      have hc0 : γ ⟨_, he01⟩ = 0 := by
        show wild_two_block_color n k s(z, ⟨1, by omega⟩) = 0
        rw [hcol, if_pos (by simp [z]; omega)]
      rw [hc0] at hconn
      have hstar : ∀ x : Fin n, x.val < n - k →
          (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet (↑P ∪ ↑W : Set (Sym2 (Fin n)))).Reachable z x := by
        intro x hx
        by_cases hxz : x = z
        · rw [hxz]
        apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
        rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj]
        refine ⟨Or.inl ?_, Ne.symm hxz⟩
        simp only [P, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Iio]
        have : x.val ≠ 0 := fun h => hxz (Fin.ext h)
        refine ⟨x.val - 1, by omega, ?_⟩
        congr 1
        exact Fin.ext (by simp only; rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]; omega)
      have hconn' : (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet (↑P ∪ ↑W : Set (Sym2 (Fin n)))).Connected := by
        rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
        refine ⟨z, fun y => wild_two_reachable_of_adj_reachable ?_ (hconn.preconnected z y)⟩
        intro a b hab
        rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj γ] at hab
        obtain ⟨hab, h | h⟩ := hab
        · have h' : wild_two_block_color n k s(a, b) = 0 := h
          rw [hcol] at h'
          split_ifs at h' with hh
          · exact (hstar a hh.1).symm.trans (hstar b hh.2)
          · exact absurd h' (by decide)
        · apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
          rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj]
          exact ⟨Or.inr h, hab⟩
      have h1 := wild_two_card_le_of_connected _ (P ∪ W) hconn' (by rw [Finset.coe_union])
      rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h1
      have h2 := Finset.card_union_le P W
      omega

theorem wild_number_complete_graph_two_coloring_range (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    (∀ γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2, Function.Surjective γ →
        simple_graph_wild_number (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) γ ≤ n - 2) ∧
      ∀ k ≤ n - 2, ∃ γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2, Function.Surjective γ ∧
        simple_graph_wild_number (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) γ = k := by
  exact ⟨fun γ hγ => wild_two_upper n hn γ hγ, fun k hk => wild_two_attain n hn k hk⟩
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.22142 (Wild number for spanning trees in complete and complete bipartite graphs), Theorem 3.1 (with 0 ≤ wld automatic in ℕ).

explanation.summary: The wild number of an edge-colouring is the minimum number of edges needed to make every monochromatic subgraph connected. For any surjective 2-edge-colouring of K_n (n ≥ 4), at least one color class is connected, and the components of the other color class (at most n - 1 of them) can be connected by a star on their representatives, showing the wild number is at most n - 2. Conversely, every integer k from 0 to n - 2 is attained: k = 0 is achieved by coloring a Hamiltonian path with 0 and its complement with 1, while k ≥ 1 is achieved by coloring a clique of size n - k with 0 and all other edges with 1.

steps.claim: Reachability in G implies reachability in G' if every edge of G connects vertices reachable in G'.
steps.explanation: We induct on the walk connecting u to v in G. In the base case of an empty walk, u is reachable from u by reflexivity. For a step u - v - ... - w, the edge uv gives reachability in G' by hypothesis, which combines with the inductive hypothesis by transitivity.
steps.code:
obtain ⟨p⟩ := huv
  induction p with
  | nil => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
  | cons hadj _ ih => exact (h _ _ hadj).trans ih

steps.claim: If a spanning subgraph on V with edge set S ⊆ R is connected, then |V| ≤ |R| + 1.
steps.explanation: A connected graph on V has at least |V| - 1 edges. Since S ⊆ R and R is finite, the number of edges is at most |R|, whence |V| ≤ |R| + 1.
steps.code:
have hc := hS.card_vert_le_card_edgeSet_add_one
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at hc
  have : Nat.card (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet S).edgeSet ≤ R.card := by
    rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    apply Nat.card_mono (Finset.finite_toSet R)
    rw [SimpleGraph.edgeSet_fromEdgeSet]
    exact Set.sdiff_subset.trans hR
  omega

steps.claim: A color-connecting set of size ≤ k together with a lower bound of k on all color-connecting sets implies the wild number is k.
steps.explanation: By definition, the wild number is the infimum of the sizes of all color-connecting sets. The set W0 gives an upper bound of k, and the hypothesis provides a lower bound of k for any color-connecting set, yielding equality by antisymmetry.
steps.code:
apply le_antisymm
  · exact (simple_graph_wild_number_le_of_is_color_connecting G γ W0 hW0).trans hk
  · exact le_csInf ⟨_, W0, rfl, hW0⟩ fun j ⟨W, hj, hW⟩ => by rw [← hj]; exact hlow W hW

steps.claim: Any pair of distinct vertices in K_n forms an edge of the complete graph.
steps.explanation: In the complete graph ⊤, the edge set consists of all pairs of distinct vertices.
steps.code: simpa using h

steps.claim: Two distinct vertices x ≠ y are adjacent in the monochromatic subgraph H(c) iff edge {x, y} has color c.
steps.explanation: We define H(c) as the subgraph spanned by edges of color c. For any x ≠ y, {x, y} is an edge in the complete graph, and belongs to H(c) if and only if its color is c.
steps.code:
classical
  let H : Fin 2 → SimpleGraph (Fin n) := fun c =>
    SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet, γ ⟨f, hf⟩ = c}
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
  have hHadj : ∀ c x y (hxy : x ≠ y),
      (H c).Adj x y ↔ γ ⟨s(x, y), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet hxy⟩ = c := by
    intro c x y hxy
    simp only [H, SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hf, hc⟩, -⟩; exact hc
    · intro hc; exact ⟨⟨wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet hxy, hc⟩, hxy⟩

steps.claim: For distinct vertices x ≠ y, if {x, y} is not an edge in H(c), it is an edge in H(1 - c).
steps.explanation: Since every edge receives color 0 or 1, any edge not of color c must have color 1 - c.
steps.code:
have hcompl : ∀ c x y, x ≠ y → ¬ (H c).Adj x y → (H (1 - c)).Adj x y := by
    intro c x y hxy h
    rw [hHadj c x y hxy] at h
    rw [hHadj (1 - c) x y hxy]
    revert h
    generalize γ ⟨s(x, y), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet hxy⟩ = a
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp
  -- one of the two classes is connected

steps.claim: At least one of the two monochromatic subgraphs H(0) or H(1) is connected.
steps.explanation: If H(0) is connected, we are done. If not, let a and b be vertices in different components of H(0). For every vertex y, either y is reachable from a in H(0), in which case y cannot be reachable from b in H(0) so both {a, b} and {b, y} are edges in H(1); or y is not reachable from a in H(0), so {a, y} is directly an edge in H(1). In either case, a can reach y in H(1), so H(1) is connected.
steps.code:
have hone : ∃ c, (H c).Connected := by
    by_cases h0 : (H 0).Connected
    · exact ⟨0, h0⟩
    · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      have h0' : ¬ (H 0).Preconnected := fun hp => h0 ⟨hp⟩
      simp only [SimpleGraph.Preconnected, not_forall] at h0'
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := h0'
      rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
      refine ⟨a, fun y => ?_⟩
      by_cases hy : (H 0).Reachable a y
      · -- y is in a's component: go through b
        have hby : ¬ (H 0).Reachable b y := fun h => hab (hy.trans h.symm)
        have hab' : a ≠ b := fun h => hab (h ▸ SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _)
        have hby' : b ≠ y := fun h => hby (h ▸ SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _)
        have h1 : (H 1).Adj a b := hcompl 0 a b hab' (fun h => hab h.reachable)
        have h2 : (H 1).Adj b y := hcompl 0 b y hby' (fun h => hby h.reachable)
        exact h1.reachable.trans h2.reachable
      · have hay : a ≠ y := fun h => hy (h ▸ SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _)
        exact (hcompl 0 a y hay (fun h => hy h.reachable)).reachable

steps.claim: Component representatives for the disconnected color define a star W connecting a base representative to all other components.
steps.explanation: Let c1 be a connected color and c0 = 1 - c1. We choose a representative vertex r(C) for each connected component C of H(c0), fix a base component C0 containing 0, and form W by joining r(C0) to r(C) for every other component C.
steps.code:
obtain ⟨c1, hc1⟩ := hone
  set c0 := 1 - c1 with hc0
  have hγc : ∀ e, γ e = c0 ∨ γ e = c1 := by
    intro e
    generalize γ e = a
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c1 <;> simp [hc0]
  -- representatives of the components of H c0
  let r : (H c0).ConnectedComponent → Fin n := fun C => Quot.out C
  have hr : ∀ C, (H c0).connectedComponentMk (r C) = C := fun C => Quot.out_eq C
  let C0 := (H c0).connectedComponentMk ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let W : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n)) := (Finset.univ.erase C0).image fun C => s(r C0, r C)
  have hrne : ∀ C, C ≠ C0 → r C0 ≠ r C := by
    intro C hC h
    apply hC
    rw [← hr C, ← hr C0, h]

steps.claim: The star W is color-connecting for the 2-edge-colouring γ.
steps.explanation: Every edge in W connects representatives of different components, so its endpoints are distinct and it is an edge of K_n. Augmenting H(c1) by W preserves its connectivity. In H(c0) ∪ W, any vertex y can reach its component representative r(C) within H(c0), and r(C) is connected to r(C0) by an edge of W, so every vertex is reachable from r(C0).
steps.code:
have hW : simple_graph_is_color_connecting (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) γ ↑W := by
    refine ⟨?_, fun e => ?_⟩
    · intro f hf
      simp only [W, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_erase] at hf
      obtain ⟨C, ⟨hC, -⟩, rfl⟩ := hf
      exact wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (hrne C hC)
    · rcases hγc e with he | he
      · rw [he]
        rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
        refine ⟨r C0, fun y => ?_⟩
        have hle : H c0 ≤ SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet
            ({f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet, γ ⟨f, hf⟩ = c0} ∪ ↑W) :=
          SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_mono Set.subset_union_left
        have hy : (H c0).Reachable (r ((H c0).connectedComponentMk y)) y :=
          SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.exact (hr _)
        by_cases hC : (H c0).connectedComponentMk y = C0
        · rw [hC] at hy
          exact hy.mono hle
        · refine SimpleGraph.Reachable.trans (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ?_) (hy.mono hle)
          rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj]
          refine ⟨Or.inr ?_, hrne _ hC⟩
          simp only [W, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_erase,
            Finset.mem_univ, and_true]
          exact ⟨_, hC, rfl⟩
      · rw [he]
        exact hc1.mono (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_mono Set.subset_union_left)

steps.claim: The wild number of any surjective 2-edge-colouring of K_n is at most n - 2.
steps.explanation: Because γ is surjective, color c0 contains at least one edge, so two vertices belong to the same component of H(c0). Thus H(c0) has at most n - 1 components, meaning the star W has size at most n - 2. Since W is color-connecting, the wild number is at most |W| ≤ n - 2.
steps.code:
refine (simple_graph_wild_number_le_of_is_color_connecting _ γ W hW).trans ?_
  -- H c0 has an edge, so it has fewer than n components
  obtain ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, he⟩ := hγ c0
  induction f using Sym2.ind with
  | h x y =>
  have hxy' : x ≠ y := by simpa using hf
  have hadj : (H c0).Adj x y := (hHadj c0 x y hxy').2 he
  have hcard : Fintype.card (H c0).ConnectedComponent < n := by
    have := Fintype.card_lt_of_surjective_not_injective (H c0).connectedComponentMk
      (fun C => ⟨r C, hr C⟩) (fun hinj => hxy' (hinj (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.sound hadj.reachable)))
    simpa using this
  have hWc : W.card ≤ (Finset.univ.erase C0).card := Finset.card_image_le
  rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.card_univ] at hWc
  omega

steps.claim: The path coloring on unordered pairs is well-defined.
steps.explanation: The condition that indices differ by 1 is symmetric in i and j, so it lifts to Sym2(Fin n).
steps.code: fun i j => by simp only [or_comm]⟩

steps.claim: The block coloring on unordered pairs is well-defined.
steps.explanation: The condition that both indices are strictly less than n - k is symmetric in i and j, so it lifts to Sym2(Fin n).
steps.code: fun i j => by simp only [and_comm]⟩

steps.claim: Adjacency in the monochromatic graph of color c augmented by W is characterized by the edge having color c or belonging to W.
steps.explanation: By definition of a graph from an edge set, distinct vertices x ≠ y are adjacent in H(c) ∪ W iff the pair {x, y} belongs to the edge set of color c or to W.
steps.code:
simp only [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h | h, hxy⟩
    · exact ⟨hxy, Or.inl h.2⟩
    · exact ⟨hxy, Or.inr h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxy, h | h⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inl ⟨wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet hxy, h⟩, hxy⟩
    · exact ⟨Or.inr h, hxy⟩

steps.claim: Adjacency in the monochromatic graph of color c without augmentation is characterized by the edge having color c.
steps.explanation: This is the special case of the augmented adjacency characterization with W = ∅.
steps.code:
have := wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj γ c ∅ x y
  simpa using this

steps.claim: For k = 0, the path coloring is surjective.
steps.explanation: We define γ using wild_two_path_color. Edge {0, 1} has color 0 and edge {0, 2} has color 1 (valid since n ≥ 4), proving surjectivity.
steps.code:
classical
  have h0n : 0 < n := by omega
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, h0n⟩⟩
  have two : ∀ a : Fin 2, a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by decide
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk1
  · -- k = 0: a Hamiltonian path and its complement
    let γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2 := fun e => wild_two_path_color n e.1
    refine ⟨γ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro c
      rcases two c with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨⟨s(⟨0, h0n⟩, ⟨1, by omega⟩), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp [Fin.ext_iff])⟩,
          by simp [γ, wild_two_path_color]⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨s(⟨0, h0n⟩, ⟨2, by omega⟩), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp [Fin.ext_iff])⟩,
          by simp [γ, wild_two_path_color]⟩

steps.claim: For k = 0, color 0 is connected.
steps.explanation: Color 0 is the Hamiltonian path 0 - 1 - ... - (n-1). By induction on m, vertex 0 can reach every vertex m.
steps.code:
· refine wild_two_wild_number_eq_of _ _ 0 ∅ ⟨by simp, fun e => ?_⟩ (by simp) (fun _ _ => by simp)
      rw [Finset.coe_empty, Set.union_empty, SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
      refine ⟨⟨0, h0n⟩, fun y => ?_⟩
      rcases two (γ e) with hce | hce
      · -- the path
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := y
        induction m with
        | zero => exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
        | succ m ih =>
          refine (ih (by omega)).trans (SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable ?_)
          rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj' γ]
          exact ⟨by simp [Fin.ext_iff], by rw [hce]; simp [γ, wild_two_path_color]⟩

steps.claim: For k = 0, color 1 is connected, so the wild number is 0.
steps.explanation: Color 1 is the complement of the Hamiltonian path. Vertex 0 reaches any vertex m ≥ 2 directly since |m - 0| ≥ 2, and reaches 1 via the path 0 - 3 - 1 since n ≥ 4. Thus both colors are connected without adding any edges, showing the wild number is 0.
steps.code:
· -- the complement of the path (n ≥ 4)
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := y
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m 2 with h2 | h2
        · interval_cases m
          · exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl _
          · have a1 : (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet,
                γ ⟨f, hf⟩ = γ e}).Adj ⟨0, h0n⟩ ⟨3, by omega⟩ := by
              rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj' γ]
              exact ⟨by simp [Fin.ext_iff], by rw [hce]; simp [γ, wild_two_path_color]⟩
            have a2 : (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {f | ∃ hf : f ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet,
                γ ⟨f, hf⟩ = γ e}).Adj ⟨3, by omega⟩ ⟨1, hm⟩ := by
              rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj' γ]
              exact ⟨by simp [Fin.ext_iff], by rw [hce]; simp [γ, wild_two_path_color]⟩
            exact a1.reachable.trans a2.reachable
        · apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
          rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj' γ]
          refine ⟨by simp [Fin.ext_iff]; omega, ?_⟩
          rw [hce]
          simp [γ, wild_two_path_color] <;> omega
  · -- k ≥ 1: a clique on n - k vertices, all other pairs coloured 1

steps.claim: For k ≥ 1, the block coloring is surjective.
steps.explanation: We define γ using wild_two_block_color with a clique of size n - k on {0, ..., n - k - 1}. Edge {0, 1} has color 0 (since n - k ≥ 2) and edge {0, n - 1} has color 1 (since n - 1 ≥ n - k), proving surjectivity.
steps.code:
let γ : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet → Fin 2 := fun e => wild_two_block_color n k e.1
    have hcol : ∀ x y : Fin n, wild_two_block_color n k s(x, y) =
        if x.val < n - k ∧ y.val < n - k then 0 else 1 := fun x y => rfl
    let z : Fin n := ⟨0, h0n⟩
    let last : Fin n := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    refine ⟨γ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro c
      rcases two c with rfl | rfl
      · refine ⟨⟨s(z, ⟨1, by omega⟩), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp [z, Fin.ext_iff])⟩, ?_⟩
        show wild_two_block_color n k s(z, ⟨1, by omega⟩) = 0
        rw [hcol, if_pos (by simp [z]; omega)]
      · refine ⟨⟨s(z, last), wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp [z, last, Fin.ext_iff]; omega)⟩, ?_⟩
        show wild_two_block_color n k s(z, last) = 1
        rw [hcol, if_neg (by simp [z, last]; omega)]

steps.claim: For k ≥ 1, the set W0 of k edges from 0 to the remaining vertices is color-connecting.
steps.explanation: Let W0 be the k edges joining vertex 0 to the vertices {n - k, ..., n - 1}. In color 0 plus W0, 0 connects to all vertices < n - k via color 0 and to all vertices ≥ n - k via W0. In color 1, vertex n - 1 is adjacent to every other vertex because no pair containing n - 1 is entirely inside the clique.
steps.code:
· let W0 : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n)) :=
        (Finset.range k).image fun t => s(z, (⟨n - 1 - t, by omega⟩ : Fin n))
      have hW0mem : ∀ j : Fin n, n - k ≤ j.val → s(z, j) ∈ W0 := fun j hj => by
        simp only [W0, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
        refine ⟨n - 1 - j.val, by omega, ?_⟩
        congr 1
        exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
      have hW0card : W0.card ≤ k := Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)
      have hW0 : simple_graph_is_color_connecting (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) γ ↑W0 := by
        refine ⟨?_, fun e => ?_⟩
        · intro f hf
          simp only [W0, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Iio] at hf
          obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hf
          exact wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp only [ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, z]; omega)
        · rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
          rcases two (γ e) with hce | hce
          · refine ⟨z, fun y => ?_⟩
            by_cases hyz : y = z
            · rw [hyz]
            apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
            rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj γ]
            refine ⟨Ne.symm hyz, ?_⟩
            by_cases hy : y.val < n - k
            · left
              rw [hce]
              show wild_two_block_color n k s(z, y) = 0
              rw [hcol, if_pos ⟨by simp [z]; omega, hy⟩]
            · right
              exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (hW0mem y (by omega))
          · refine ⟨last, fun y => ?_⟩
            by_cases hyl : y = last
            · rw [hyl]
            apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
            rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj γ]
            refine ⟨Ne.symm hyl, Or.inl ?_⟩
            rw [hce]
            show wild_two_block_color n k s(last, y) = 1
            rw [hcol, if_neg (by simp [last]; omega)]

steps.claim: For k ≥ 1, every color-connecting set has size at least k, so the wild number is k.
steps.explanation: Let W be any color-connecting set. Consider a star P of n - k - 1 edges from 0 spanning the clique. Since color 0 plus W is connected and any color 0 edge within the clique can be routed through 0 using P, the graph spanned by P ∪ W is connected. Hence n ≤ |P ∪ W| + 1 ≤ (n - k - 1) + |W| + 1 = n - k + |W|, which forces |W| ≥ k. By wild_two_wild_number_eq_of, the wild number is k.
steps.code:
refine wild_two_wild_number_eq_of _ _ k W0 hW0 hW0card (fun W hW => ?_)
      -- lower bound: transfer connectivity of (class 0) ∪ W to (a star in the clique) ∪ W
      let P : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n)) :=
        (Finset.range (n - k - 1)).image fun t => s(z, (⟨(t + 1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ h0n⟩ : Fin n))
      have hPcard : P.card ≤ n - k - 1 := Finset.card_image_le.trans (by simp)
      have he01 : s(z, (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin n)) ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet :=
        wild_two_top_mem_edgeSet (by simp [Fin.ext_iff, z])
      have hconn := hW.2 ⟨_, he01⟩
      have hc0 : γ ⟨_, he01⟩ = 0 := by
        show wild_two_block_color n k s(z, ⟨1, by omega⟩) = 0
        rw [hcol, if_pos (by simp [z]; omega)]
      rw [hc0] at hconn
      have hstar : ∀ x : Fin n, x.val < n - k →
          (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet (↑P ∪ ↑W : Set (Sym2 (Fin n)))).Reachable z x := by
        intro x hx
        by_cases hxz : x = z
        · rw [hxz]
        apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
        rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj]
        refine ⟨Or.inl ?_, Ne.symm hxz⟩
        simp only [P, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Iio]
        have : x.val ≠ 0 := fun h => hxz (Fin.ext h)
        refine ⟨x.val - 1, by omega, ?_⟩
        congr 1
        exact Fin.ext (by simp only; rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]; omega)
      have hconn' : (SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet (↑P ∪ ↑W : Set (Sym2 (Fin n)))).Connected := by
        rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
        refine ⟨z, fun y => wild_two_reachable_of_adj_reachable ?_ (hconn.preconnected z y)⟩
        intro a b hab
        rw [wild_two_fromEdgeSet_adj γ] at hab
        obtain ⟨hab, h | h⟩ := hab
        · have h' : wild_two_block_color n k s(a, b) = 0 := h
          rw [hcol] at h'
          split_ifs at h' with hh
          · exact (hstar a hh.1).symm.trans (hstar b hh.2)
          · exact absurd h' (by decide)
        · apply SimpleGraph.Adj.reachable
          rw [SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet_adj]
          exact ⟨Or.inr h, hab⟩
      have h1 := wild_two_card_le_of_connected _ (P ∪ W) hconn' (by rw [Finset.coe_union])
      rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h1
      have h2 := Finset.card_union_le P W
      omega

steps.claim: Every surjective 2-edge-colouring of K_n has wild number at most n - 2, and every 0 ≤ k ≤ n - 2 is attained.
steps.explanation: The upper bound wild_two_upper and the attainability theorem wild_two_attain directly establish the two parts of the conjunction.
steps.code: exact ⟨fun γ hγ => wild_two_upper n hn γ hγ, fun k hk => wild_two_attain n hn k hk⟩
