declarations.name: graph_edge_partition_card
declarations.informal: With the four-part partition of V induced by an edge xy: deg x = |A| + |C| + 1, deg y = |B| + |C| + 1, and |V| = 2 + |A| + |B| + |C| + |P|.
declarations.statement:
theorem graph_edge_partition_card {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (x y : V) (hxy : G.Adj x y)
    (A B C P : Finset V)
    (hAmem : ∀ v, v ∈ A ↔ (G.Adj x v ∧ ¬ G.Adj y v ∧ v ≠ y))
    (hBmem : ∀ v, v ∈ B ↔ (G.Adj y v ∧ ¬ G.Adj x v ∧ v ≠ x))
    (hCmem : ∀ v, v ∈ C ↔ (G.Adj x v ∧ G.Adj y v))
    (hPmem : ∀ v, v ∈ P ↔ (¬ G.Adj x v ∧ ¬ G.Adj y v))
    (hcover : (Finset.univ : Finset V) = {x} ∪ {y} ∪ A ∪ B ∪ C ∪ P) :
    G.degree x = A.card + C.card + 1 ∧
      G.degree y = B.card + C.card + 1 ∧
      Fintype.card V = 2 + A.card + B.card + C.card + P.card
declarations.source:
/-- Degree and vertex-count identities for the edge partition. -/
theorem graph_edge_partition_card {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (x y : V) (hxy : G.Adj x y)
    (A B C P : Finset V)
    (hAmem : ∀ v, v ∈ A ↔ (G.Adj x v ∧ ¬ G.Adj y v ∧ v ≠ y))
    (hBmem : ∀ v, v ∈ B ↔ (G.Adj y v ∧ ¬ G.Adj x v ∧ v ≠ x))
    (hCmem : ∀ v, v ∈ C ↔ (G.Adj x v ∧ G.Adj y v))
    (hPmem : ∀ v, v ∈ P ↔ (¬ G.Adj x v ∧ ¬ G.Adj y v))
    (hcover : (Finset.univ : Finset V) = {x} ∪ {y} ∪ A ∪ B ∪ C ∪ P) :
    G.degree x = A.card + C.card + 1 ∧
      G.degree y = B.card + C.card + 1 ∧
      Fintype.card V = 2 + A.card + B.card + C.card + P.card := by
  have hxyne : x ≠ y := hxy.ne
  have hxA : x ∉ A := fun h => G.irrefl ((hAmem x).mp h).1
  have hyA : y ∉ A := fun h => ((hAmem y).mp h).2.2 rfl
  have hxB : x ∉ B := fun h => ((hBmem x).mp h).2.2 rfl
  have hyB : y ∉ B := fun h => G.irrefl ((hBmem y).mp h).1
  have hxC : x ∉ C := fun h => G.irrefl ((hCmem x).mp h).1
  have hyC : y ∉ C := fun h => G.irrefl ((hCmem y).mp h).2
  have hxP : x ∉ P := fun h => ((hPmem x).mp h).2 hxy.symm
  have hyP : y ∉ P := fun h => ((hPmem y).mp h).1 hxy
  have hAC : Disjoint A C := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvA hvC
    exact ((hAmem v).mp hvA).2.1 ((hCmem v).mp hvC).2
  have hAB : Disjoint A B := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvA hvB
    exact ((hAmem v).mp hvA).2.1 ((hBmem v).mp hvB).1
  have hAP : Disjoint A P := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvA hvP
    exact ((hPmem v).mp hvP).1 ((hAmem v).mp hvA).1
  have hBC : Disjoint B C := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvB hvC
    exact ((hBmem v).mp hvB).2.1 ((hCmem v).mp hvC).1
  have hBP : Disjoint B P := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvB hvP
    exact ((hPmem v).mp hvP).2 ((hBmem v).mp hvB).1
  have hCP : Disjoint C P := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvC hvP
    exact ((hPmem v).mp hvP).1 ((hCmem v).mp hvC).1
  have hxy_disj_sing : Disjoint ({x} : Finset V) {y} := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]
    simpa using hxyne
  have hxy_A : Disjoint ({x} ∪ {y} : Finset V) A := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]⟩
  have hxy_B : Disjoint ({x} ∪ {y} : Finset V) B := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]⟩
  have hxy_C : Disjoint ({x} ∪ {y} : Finset V) C := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]⟩
  have hxy_P : Disjoint ({x} ∪ {y} : Finset V) P := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]⟩
  have hACy : Disjoint (A ∪ C) ({y} : Finset V) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_right], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_right]⟩
  have hBCx : Disjoint (B ∪ C) ({x} : Finset V) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_right], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_right]⟩
  have hNx : G.neighborFinset x = A ∪ C ∪ {y} := by
    ext v
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hv
      by_cases hvy : v = y
      · exact Or.inr hvy
      · by_cases hyv : G.Adj y v
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ((hCmem v).mpr ⟨hv, hyv⟩))
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ((hAmem v).mpr ⟨hv, hyv, hvy⟩))
    · rintro ((hvA | hvC) | hvy)
      · exact ((hAmem v).mp hvA).1
      · exact ((hCmem v).mp hvC).1
      · rw [hvy]; exact hxy
  have hNy : G.neighborFinset y = B ∪ C ∪ {x} := by
    ext v
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hv
      by_cases hvx : v = x
      · exact Or.inr hvx
      · by_cases hxv : G.Adj x v
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ((hCmem v).mpr ⟨hxv, hv⟩))
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ((hBmem v).mpr ⟨hv, hxv, hvx⟩))
    · rintro ((hvB | hvC) | hvx)
      · exact ((hBmem v).mp hvB).1
      · exact ((hCmem v).mp hvC).2
      · rw [hvx]; exact hxy.symm
  have hdegx : G.degree x = A.card + C.card + 1 := by
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hNx,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hACy, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hAC,
      Finset.card_singleton]
  have hdegy : G.degree y = B.card + C.card + 1 := by
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hNy,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hBCx, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hBC,
      Finset.card_singleton]
  have d2 : Disjoint (({x} ∪ {y}) ∪ A : Finset V) B := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]; exact ⟨hxy_B, hAB⟩
  have d3 : Disjoint ((({x} ∪ {y}) ∪ A) ∪ B : Finset V) C := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    refine ⟨?_, hBC⟩
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]; exact ⟨hxy_C, hAC⟩
  have d4 : Disjoint (((({x} ∪ {y}) ∪ A) ∪ B) ∪ C : Finset V) P := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    refine ⟨?_, hCP⟩
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    refine ⟨?_, hBP⟩
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]; exact ⟨hxy_P, hAP⟩
  have hcard : Fintype.card V = 2 + A.card + B.card + C.card + P.card := by
    rw [← Finset.card_univ, hcover,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d4, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d3,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d2, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hxy_A,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hxy_disj_sing, Finset.card_singleton,
      Finset.card_singleton]
  exact ⟨hdegx, hdegy, hcard⟩

explanation.summary: An edge xy in a simple graph partitions the remaining vertices into four sets: those adjacent only to x (A), only to y (B), to both (C), or to neither (P). The proof first shows that {x}, {y}, A, B, C, and P are mutually disjoint. It then identifies the neighborhood of x as A ∪ C ∪ {y} and that of y as B ∪ C ∪ {x}, which immediately yields deg x = |A| + |C| + 1 and deg y = |B| + |C| + 1 by disjoint union additivity. Finally, decomposing the total vertex set into these six disjoint sets shows |V| = 2 + |A| + |B| + |C| + |P|.

steps.claim: x ≠ y, and neither x nor y belongs to A, B, C, or P.
steps.explanation: Since x and y are adjacent in a simple graph, irreflxivity of adjacency implies x ≠ y. For any set S among A, B, C, and P, if x or y belonged to S, it would contradict either the irreflxivity of adjacency (no vertex is adjacent to itself) or the non-adjacency and distinctness requirements in the definitions of those sets.
steps.code:
have hxyne : x ≠ y := hxy.ne
  have hxA : x ∉ A := fun h => G.irrefl ((hAmem x).mp h).1
  have hyA : y ∉ A := fun h => ((hAmem y).mp h).2.2 rfl
  have hxB : x ∉ B := fun h => ((hBmem x).mp h).2.2 rfl
  have hyB : y ∉ B := fun h => G.irrefl ((hBmem y).mp h).1
  have hxC : x ∉ C := fun h => G.irrefl ((hCmem x).mp h).1
  have hyC : y ∉ C := fun h => G.irrefl ((hCmem y).mp h).2
  have hxP : x ∉ P := fun h => ((hPmem x).mp h).2 hxy.symm
  have hyP : y ∉ P := fun h => ((hPmem y).mp h).1 hxy

steps.claim: The sets A, B, C, and P are pairwise disjoint.
steps.explanation: For any two distinct sets among {A, B, C, P}, having a common element would lead to a contradiction: an element in A ∩ C or A ∩ B would be both adjacent and non-adjacent to y; an element in A ∩ P or C ∩ P would be both adjacent and non-adjacent to x; and an element in B ∩ C or B ∩ P would be both adjacent and non-adjacent to x or y.
steps.code:
have hAC : Disjoint A C := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvA hvC
    exact ((hAmem v).mp hvA).2.1 ((hCmem v).mp hvC).2
  have hAB : Disjoint A B := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvA hvB
    exact ((hAmem v).mp hvA).2.1 ((hBmem v).mp hvB).1
  have hAP : Disjoint A P := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvA hvP
    exact ((hPmem v).mp hvP).1 ((hAmem v).mp hvA).1
  have hBC : Disjoint B C := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvB hvC
    exact ((hBmem v).mp hvB).2.1 ((hCmem v).mp hvC).1
  have hBP : Disjoint B P := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvB hvP
    exact ((hPmem v).mp hvP).2 ((hBmem v).mp hvB).1
  have hCP : Disjoint C P := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro v hvC hvP
    exact ((hPmem v).mp hvP).1 ((hCmem v).mp hvC).1

steps.claim: The singletons {x} and {y} are disjoint from each other and from each of A, B, C, and P; moreover, A ∪ C is disjoint from {y} and B ∪ C is disjoint from {x}.
steps.explanation: Since x ≠ y, the singletons {x} and {y} are disjoint. For any set S ∈ {A, B, C, P}, disjointness of {x} ∪ {y} from S reduces by Finset.disjoint_union_left to x ∉ S and y ∉ S, which were established earlier. Similarly, disjointness of A ∪ C from {y} reduces to y ∉ A and y ∉ C, and disjointness of B ∪ C from {x} reduces to x ∉ B and x ∉ C.
steps.code:
have hxy_disj_sing : Disjoint ({x} : Finset V) {y} := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]
    simpa using hxyne
  have hxy_A : Disjoint ({x} ∪ {y} : Finset V) A := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]⟩
  have hxy_B : Disjoint ({x} ∪ {y} : Finset V) B := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]⟩
  have hxy_C : Disjoint ({x} ∪ {y} : Finset V) C := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]⟩
  have hxy_P : Disjoint ({x} ∪ {y} : Finset V) P := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]⟩
  have hACy : Disjoint (A ∪ C) ({y} : Finset V) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_right], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_right]⟩
  have hBCx : Disjoint (B ∪ C) ({x} : Finset V) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    exact ⟨by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_right], by rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_right]⟩

steps.claim: The neighbor set of x is the union A ∪ C ∪ {y}.
steps.explanation: A vertex v is adjacent to x if and only if it is in A ∪ C ∪ {y}. Given x Adj v, if v = y then v ∈ {y}. If v ≠ y, we check whether y Adj v: if so, v is a common neighbor and belongs to C; if not, v satisfies the conditions for membership in A. The reverse inclusion holds because every element of A, C, or {y} is adjacent to x by definition or by the hypothesis x Adj y.
steps.code:
have hNx : G.neighborFinset x = A ∪ C ∪ {y} := by
    ext v
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hv
      by_cases hvy : v = y
      · exact Or.inr hvy
      · by_cases hyv : G.Adj y v
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ((hCmem v).mpr ⟨hv, hyv⟩))
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ((hAmem v).mpr ⟨hv, hyv, hvy⟩))
    · rintro ((hvA | hvC) | hvy)
      · exact ((hAmem v).mp hvA).1
      · exact ((hCmem v).mp hvC).1
      · rw [hvy]; exact hxy

steps.claim: The neighbor set of y is the union B ∪ C ∪ {x}.
steps.explanation: Symmetrically, a vertex v is adjacent to y if and only if it is in B ∪ C ∪ {x}. Given y Adj v, if v = x then v ∈ {x}. If v ≠ x, we check whether x Adj v: if so, v ∈ C; if not, v ∈ B. Conversely, every element of B, C, or {x} is adjacent to y, using symmetry of adjacency for x Adj y.
steps.code:
have hNy : G.neighborFinset y = B ∪ C ∪ {x} := by
    ext v
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hv
      by_cases hvx : v = x
      · exact Or.inr hvx
      · by_cases hxv : G.Adj x v
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ((hCmem v).mpr ⟨hxv, hv⟩))
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ((hBmem v).mpr ⟨hv, hxv, hvx⟩))
    · rintro ((hvB | hvC) | hvx)
      · exact ((hBmem v).mp hvB).1
      · exact ((hCmem v).mp hvC).2
      · rw [hvx]; exact hxy.symm

steps.claim: deg x = |A| + |C| + 1 and deg y = |B| + |C| + 1.
steps.explanation: The degree of x is the size of its neighborhood N(x) = (A ∪ C) ∪ {y}. Since A ∪ C is disjoint from {y} and A is disjoint from C, the cardinality of the union is the sum of the cardinalities: |A| + |C| + |{y}| = |A| + |C| + 1. The degree of y follows identically from N(y) = (B ∪ C) ∪ {x}.
steps.code:
have hdegx : G.degree x = A.card + C.card + 1 := by
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hNx,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hACy, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hAC,
      Finset.card_singleton]
  have hdegy : G.degree y = B.card + C.card + 1 := by
    rw [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hNy,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hBCx, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hBC,
      Finset.card_singleton]

steps.claim: In the cumulative union ({x} ∪ {y} ∪ A ∪ B ∪ C) ∪ P, each set is disjoint from the preceding union.
steps.explanation: Using Finset.disjoint_union_left repeatedly, disjointness of ({x} ∪ {y} ∪ A) with B reduces to disjointness of {x, y} with B and A with B. Next, disjointness with C reduces to disjointness of C with {x, y}, with A, and with B. Finally, disjointness with P reduces to disjointness of P with {x, y}, A, B, and C, all of which were previously established.
steps.code:
have d2 : Disjoint (({x} ∪ {y}) ∪ A : Finset V) B := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]; exact ⟨hxy_B, hAB⟩
  have d3 : Disjoint ((({x} ∪ {y}) ∪ A) ∪ B : Finset V) C := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    refine ⟨?_, hBC⟩
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]; exact ⟨hxy_C, hAC⟩
  have d4 : Disjoint (((({x} ∪ {y}) ∪ A) ∪ B) ∪ C : Finset V) P := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    refine ⟨?_, hCP⟩
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]
    refine ⟨?_, hBP⟩
    rw [Finset.disjoint_union_left]; exact ⟨hxy_P, hAP⟩

steps.claim: |V| = 2 + |A| + |B| + |C| + |P|, completing the proof.
steps.explanation: Since {x} ∪ {y} ∪ A ∪ B ∪ C ∪ P covers the entire vertex set V, and each piece in the union is disjoint from the rest, the cardinality of V is the sum of the cardinalities of the six parts: |{x}| + |{y}| + |A| + |B| + |C| + |P| = 1 + 1 + |A| + |B| + |C| + |P| = 2 + |A| + |B| + |C| + |P|. Combining this with the two degree formulas yields the conjunction.
steps.code:
have hcard : Fintype.card V = 2 + A.card + B.card + C.card + P.card := by
    rw [← Finset.card_univ, hcover,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d4, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d3,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint d2, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hxy_A,
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hxy_disj_sing, Finset.card_singleton,
      Finset.card_singleton]
  exact ⟨hdegx, hdegy, hcard⟩

glossary.Finset.disjoint_left: Two finite sets are disjoint if and only if no element of the first belongs to the second.
glossary.Finset.disjoint_singleton_left: A singleton {a} is disjoint from s if and only if a ∉ s.
glossary.Finset.disjoint_union_left: A union s ∪ t is disjoint from u if and only if both s and t are disjoint from u.
glossary.Finset.disjoint_singleton_right: A set s is disjoint from the singleton {a} if and only if a ∉ s.
glossary.SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset: A vertex w is in the neighbor finset of v if and only if v and w are adjacent in G.
glossary.Finset.mem_union: An element belongs to s ∪ t if and only if it belongs to s or to t.
glossary.Finset.mem_singleton: An element belongs to {a} if and only if it equals a.
glossary.Or.inl: Given a proof of proposition a, constructs a proof of the disjunction a ∨ b.
glossary.Or.inr: Given a proof of proposition b, constructs a proof of the disjunction a ∨ b.
glossary.SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degre: The cardinality of the neighbor finset of a vertex v equals the degree of v.
glossary.Finset.card_union_of_disjoint: The cardinality of the union of two disjoint finite sets is the sum of their cardinalities.
glossary.Finset.card_singleton: The cardinality of any singleton set is 1.
glossary.Finset.card_univ: The cardinality of the universal finset on α equals Fintype.card α.

caveats: The partition of V is represented formally as a left-associated nested binary union of finsets ({x} ∪ {y} ∪ A ∪ B ∪ C ∪ P); establishing that the cardinality adds up requires proving disjointness step by step at each binary union layer.

declarations.name: five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound
declarations.informal: In any 5-vertex graph with minimum degree at least 2 and adjacent vertices x and y, the idle measures at α = 1/2 satisfy 1 < 2 S0 + m_xy.
declarations.source:
lemma five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_idle_eval_common {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (x y z : V)
    (hxz : G.Adj x z) (hyz : G.Adj y z) :
    let μ := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x
    let ν := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y
    μ z = 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ)) ∧
    ν z = 1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) := by
  intro μ ν
  have hzx : z ≠ x := hxz.ne.symm
  have hzy : z ≠ y := hyz.ne.symm
  dsimp [μ, ν, graph_idle_measure]
  simp only [hzx, hzy, hxz, hyz, ↓reduceIte]
  refine ⟨by ring, by ring⟩

lemma five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_min_eval_xy {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hδ : 2 ≤ G.minDegree) (x y : V) (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    let μ := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x
    let ν := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y
    min (μ x) (ν x) = 1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) ∧
    min (μ y) (ν y) = 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ)) ∧
    μ x - min (μ x) (ν x) = 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) ∧
    ν y - min (μ y) (ν y) = 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ)) := by
  intro μ ν
  have hne : x ≠ y := hxy.ne
  have hne' : y ≠ x := hne.symm
  have hyx : G.Adj y x := hxy.symm
  have hdegx : 2 ≤ G.degree x := le_trans hδ (SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree G x)
  have hdegy : 2 ≤ G.degree y := le_trans hδ (SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree G y)
  have hμx : μ x = 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp [μ, graph_idle_measure]; simp
  have hμy : μ y = 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [μ, graph_idle_measure]; simp [hne', hxy]; ring
  have hνy : ν y = 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp [ν, graph_idle_measure]; simp
  have hνx : ν x = 1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [ν, graph_idle_measure]; simp [hne, hyx]; ring
  have hle_x : ν x ≤ μ x := by
    rw [hνx, hμx]
    have : (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ↑(G.degree y)) ≤ 1 / (2 * 2) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (G.degree y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdegy
      linarith
    linarith
  have hle_y : μ y ≤ ν y := by
    rw [hμy, hνy]
    have : (1 : ℝ) / (2 * ↑(G.degree x)) ≤ 1 / (2 * 2) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (G.degree x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdegx
      linarith
    linarith
  have hmin_x : min (μ x) (ν x) = ν x := min_eq_right hle_x
  have hmin_y : min (μ y) (ν y) = μ y := min_eq_left hle_y
  refine ⟨by rw [hmin_x, hνx], by rw [hmin_y, hμy], by rw [hmin_x, hμx, hνx], by rw [hmin_y, hνy, hμy]⟩

lemma five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_sum_triple_le_S0 {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (x y z : V)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z) :
    let μ := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x
    let ν := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y
    let S0 := ∑ v, min (μ v) (ν v)
    min (μ x) (ν x) + min (μ y) (ν y) + min (μ z) (ν z) ≤ S0 := by
  intro μ ν S0
  have h_nonneg : ∀ i : V, 0 ≤ min (μ i) (ν i) := by
    intro i
    have hμ : 0 ≤ μ i := graph_idle_measure_nonneg G (1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x i
    have hν : 0 ≤ ν i := graph_idle_measure_nonneg G (1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) y i
    exact le_min hμ hν
  have h := Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg (s := {x, y, z}) h_nonneg
  have hx : x ∉ ({y, z} : Finset V) := by simp [hxy, hxz]
  have hy : y ∉ ({z} : Finset V) := by simp [hyz]
  rw [Finset.sum_insert hx, Finset.sum_insert hy, Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  linarith

lemma five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_sum_pair_le_S0 {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (x y : V) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    let μ := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x
    let ν := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y
    let S0 := ∑ v, min (μ v) (ν v)
    min (μ x) (ν x) + min (μ y) (ν y) ≤ S0 := by
  intro μ ν S0
  have h_nonneg : ∀ i : V, 0 ≤ min (μ i) (ν i) := by
    intro i
    have hμ : 0 ≤ μ i := graph_idle_measure_nonneg G (1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x i
    have hν : 0 ≤ ν i := graph_idle_measure_nonneg G (1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) y i
    exact le_min hμ hν
  have h := Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg (s := {x, y}) h_nonneg
  have hx : x ∉ ({y} : Finset V) := by simp [hxy]
  rw [Finset.sum_insert hx, Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  linarith

lemma five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_case1_arith (dx dy : ℝ) (hx2 : 2 ≤ dx) (hx4 : dx ≤ 4) (hy2 : 2 ≤ dy) (hy4 : dy ≤ 4) :
    1 < 1 / dy + 1 / dx + 2 * min (1 / (2 * dx)) (1 / (2 * dy)) +
        min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) := by
  rcases le_total dx dy with hle | hle
  · have h1 : min (1 / (2 * dx)) (1 / (2 * dy)) = 1 / (2 * dy) := by
      apply min_eq_right
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h2 : min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) = 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx) := by
      apply min_eq_right
      have : 1 / (2 * dy) ≤ 1 / (2 * dx) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        linarith
      linarith
    rw [h1, h2]
    have : (1 : ℝ) / dy + 1 / dx + 2 * (1 / (2 * dy)) + (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) =
           1 / 2 + 2 / dy + 1 / (2 * dx) := by ring
    rw [this]
    have hdy : 2 / dy ≥ 2 / 4 := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith) hy4
    have hdx : 1 / (2 * dx) > 0 := by positivity
    linarith
  · have h1 : min (1 / (2 * dx)) (1 / (2 * dy)) = 1 / (2 * dx) := by
      apply min_eq_left
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h2 : min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) = 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy) := by
      apply min_eq_left
      have : 1 / (2 * dx) ≤ 1 / (2 * dy) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        linarith
      linarith
    rw [h1, h2]
    have : (1 : ℝ) / dy + 1 / dx + 2 * (1 / (2 * dx)) + (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) =
           1 / 2 + 2 / dx + 1 / (2 * dy) := by ring
    rw [this]
    have hdx : 2 / dx ≥ 2 / 4 := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith) hx4
    have hdy : 1 / (2 * dy) > 0 := by positivity
    linarith

lemma five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_case2_arith (nx ny : ℕ) (hx2 : 2 ≤ nx) (hy2 : 2 ≤ ny) (hsum : nx + ny ≤ 5) :
    let dx : ℝ := nx
    let dy : ℝ := ny
    1 < 1 / dy + 1 / dx + min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) := by
  intro dx dy
  have hx2_r : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (nx : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx2
  have hy2_r : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (ny : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy2
  rcases le_total nx ny with hle | hle
  · have hx_le : nx ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hx_eq : nx = 2 := by omega
    have hy_le : ny ≤ 3 := by omega
    have hx : dx = 2 := by
      show (nx : ℝ) = 2; exact_mod_cast hx_eq
    have hy : dy ≤ 3 := by
      show (ny : ℝ) ≤ 3; exact_mod_cast hy_le
    have hdx_le_dy : dx ≤ dy := by
      show (nx : ℝ) ≤ (ny : ℝ); exact_mod_cast hle
    have h2 : min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) = 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx) := by
      apply min_eq_right
      have : 1 / (2 * dy) ≤ 1 / (2 * dx) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        linarith
      linarith
    rw [h2, hx]
    have : (1 : ℝ) / dy + 1 / 2 + (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * 2)) = 3 / 4 + 1 / dy := by ring
    rw [this]
    have hdy : 1 / dy ≥ 1 / 3 := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith) hy
    linarith
  · have hy_le : ny ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hy_eq : ny = 2 := by omega
    have hx_le : nx ≤ 3 := by omega
    have hy : dy = 2 := by
      show (ny : ℝ) = 2; exact_mod_cast hy_eq
    have hx : dx ≤ 3 := by
      show (nx : ℝ) ≤ 3; exact_mod_cast hx_le
    have hdy_le_dx : dy ≤ dx := by
      show (ny : ℝ) ≤ (nx : ℝ); exact_mod_cast hle
    have h2 : min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) = 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy) := by
      apply min_eq_left
      have : 1 / (2 * dx) ≤ 1 / (2 * dy) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        linarith
      linarith
    rw [h2, hy]
    have : (1 : ℝ) / 2 + 1 / dx + (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * 2)) = 3 / 4 + 1 / dx := by ring
    rw [this]
    have hdx : 1 / dx ≥ 1 / 3 := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith) hx
    linarith

/-- Lower bound 1 < 2 S₀ + m_xy for idle measures at α = 1/2 on 5-vertex graphs of minimum degree at least 2. -/
theorem five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hcard : Fintype.card V = 5)
    (hδ : 2 ≤ G.minDegree) (x y : V) (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    let μ := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x
    let ν := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y
    let S0 := ∑ v, min (μ v) (ν v)
    let μ1 (a : V) := μ a - min (μ a) (ν a)
    let ν1 (b : V) := ν b - min (μ b) (ν b)
    let m_xy := min (μ1 x) (ν1 y)
    1 < 2 * S0 + m_xy := by
  intro μ ν S0 μ1 ν1 m_xy
  have hne : x ≠ y := hxy.ne
  have hdegx_ge2 : 2 ≤ G.degree x := le_trans hδ (SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree G x)
  have hdegy_ge2 : 2 ≤ G.degree y := le_trans hδ (SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree G y)
  have hdegx_le4 : G.degree x ≤ 4 := by
    have := G.degree_lt_card_verts x
    omega
  have hdegy_le4 : G.degree y ≤ 4 := by
    have := G.degree_lt_card_verts y
    omega
  have hdx2_r : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (G.degree x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdegx_ge2
  have hdy2_r : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (G.degree y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdegy_ge2
  have hdx4_r : (G.degree x : ℝ) ≤ 4 := by exact_mod_cast hdegx_le4
  have hdy4_r : (G.degree y : ℝ) ≤ 4 := by exact_mod_cast hdegy_le4
  have hmin_xy := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_min_eval_xy G hδ x y hxy
  have hm_xy_eq : m_xy = min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ))) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) := by
    dsimp [m_xy, μ1, ν1]
    rw [hmin_xy.2.2.1, hmin_xy.2.2.2]
  by_cases hdisj : Disjoint (G.neighborFinset x) (G.neighborFinset y)
  · -- Case 2: disjoint neighbors
    have hunion : (G.neighborFinset x ∪ G.neighborFinset y).card = G.degree x + G.degree y := by
      rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    have hsub : G.neighborFinset x ∪ G.neighborFinset y ⊆ Finset.univ := Finset.subset_univ _
    have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Finset.card_univ, hcard, hunion] at hle
    have hS0_ge : 1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) + 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ)) ≤ S0 := by
      have hpair := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_sum_pair_le_S0 G x y hne
      dsimp [μ, ν, S0] at hpair
      rw [hmin_xy.1, hmin_xy.2.1] at hpair
      exact hpair
    have h2S0 : 1 / (G.degree y : ℝ) + 1 / (G.degree x : ℝ) ≤ 2 * S0 := by
      have : 1 / (G.degree y : ℝ) + 1 / (G.degree x : ℝ) =
          2 * (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) + 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) := by ring
      linarith
    have hbound := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_case2_arith (G.degree x) (G.degree y) hdegx_ge2 hdegy_ge2 hle
    dsimp at hbound
    rw [hm_xy_eq]
    linarith
  · -- Case 1: common neighbor exists
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] at hdisj
    have hnonempty : (G.neighborFinset x ∩ G.neighborFinset y).Nonempty :=
      Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hdisj
    rcases hnonempty with ⟨z, hz⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_inter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] at hz
    have hxz : G.Adj x z := hz.1
    have hyz : G.Adj y z := hz.2
    have hzx : z ≠ x := hxz.ne.symm
    have hzy : z ≠ y := hyz.ne.symm
    have hx_ne_z : x ≠ z := hxz.ne
    have hy_ne_z : y ≠ z := hyz.ne
    have hcommon := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_idle_eval_common G x y z hxz hyz
    have hS0_ge : 1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) + 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ)) +
        min (1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ))) ≤ S0 := by
      have htriple := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_sum_triple_le_S0 G x y z hne hx_ne_z hy_ne_z
      dsimp [μ, ν, S0] at htriple
      rw [hmin_xy.1, hmin_xy.2.1, hcommon.1, hcommon.2] at htriple
      exact htriple
    have h2S0 : 1 / (G.degree y : ℝ) + 1 / (G.degree x : ℝ) +
        2 * min (1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ))) ≤ 2 * S0 := by
      have : 1 / (G.degree y : ℝ) + 1 / (G.degree x : ℝ) +
          2 * min (1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ))) =
          2 * (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) + 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ)) +
               min (1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)))) := by ring
      linarith
    have hbound := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_case1_arith (G.degree x : ℝ) (G.degree y : ℝ)
        hdx2_r hdx4_r hdy2_r hdy4_r
    rw [hm_xy_eq]
    linarith

lemma five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_case1_arith (dx dy : ℝ) (hx2 : 2 ≤ dx) (hx4 : dx ≤ 4) (hy2 : 2 ≤ dy) (hy4 : dy ≤ 4) :
    1 < 1 / dy + 1 / dx + 2 * min (1 / (2 * dx)) (1 / (2 * dy)) +
        min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) := by

      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h2 : min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) = 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx) := by
      apply min_eq_right
      have : 1 / (2 * dy) ≤ 1 / (2 * dx) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        linarith
      linarith
    rw [h1, h2]
    have : (1 : ℝ) / dy + 1 / dx + 2 * (1 / (2 * dy)) + (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) =
           1 / 2 + 2 / dy + 1 / (2 * dx) := by ring
    rw [this]
    have hdy : 2 / dy ≥ 2 / 4 := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith) hy4
    have hdx : 1 / (2 * dx) > 0 := by positivity
    linarith
  · have h1 : min (1 / (2 * dx)) (1 / (2 * dy)) = 1 / (2 * dx) := by
      apply min_eq_left
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h2 : min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) = 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy) := by
      apply min_eq_left
      have : 1 / (2 * dx) ≤ 1 / (2 * dy) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        linarith
      linarith
    rw [h1, h2]
    have : (1 : ℝ) / dy + 1 / dx + 2 * (1 / (2 * dx)) + (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) =
           1 / 2 + 2 / dx + 1 / (2 * dy) := by ring
    rw [this]
    have hdx : 2 / dx ≥ 2 / 4 := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith) hx4
    have hdy : 1 / (2 * dy) > 0 := by positivity
    linarith

lemma five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_case2_arith (nx ny : ℕ) (hx2 : 2 ≤ nx) (hy2 : 2 ≤ ny) (hsum : nx + ny ≤ 5) :
    let dx : ℝ := nx
    let dy : ℝ := ny
    1 < 1 / dy + 1 / dx + min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) := by
  intro dx dy
  have hx2_r : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (nx : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx2
  have hy2_r : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (ny : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hy2
  rcases le_total nx ny with hle | hle
  · have hx_le : nx ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hx_eq : nx = 2 := by omega
    have hy_le : ny ≤ 3 := by omega
    have hx : dx = 2 := by
      show (nx : ℝ) = 2; exact_mod_cast hx_eq
    have hy : dy ≤ 3 := by
      show (ny : ℝ) ≤ 3; exact_mod_cast hy_le
    have hdx_le_dy : dx ≤ dy := by
      show (nx : ℝ) ≤ (ny : ℝ); exact_mod_cast hle
    have h2 : min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) = 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx) := by
      apply min_eq_right
      have : 1 / (2 * dy) ≤ 1 / (2 * dx) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        linarith
      linarith
    rw [h2, hx]
    have : (1 : ℝ) / dy + 1 / 2 + (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * 2)) = 3 / 4 + 1 / dy := by ring
    rw [this]
    have hdy : 1 / dy ≥ 1 / 3 := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith) hy
    linarith
  · have hy_le : ny ≤ 2 := by omega
    have hy_eq : ny = 2 := by omega
    have hx_le : nx ≤ 3 := by omega
    have hy : dy = 2 := by
      show (ny : ℝ) = 2; exact_mod_cast hy_eq
    have hx : dx ≤ 3 := by
      show (nx : ℝ) ≤ 3; exact_mod_cast hx_le
    have hdy_le_dx : dy ≤ dx := by
      show (ny : ℝ) ≤ (nx : ℝ); exact_mod_cast hle
    have h2 : min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy)) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dx)) = 1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * dy) := by
      apply min_eq_left
      have : 1 / (2 * dx) ≤ 1 / (2 * dy) := by
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        linarith
      linarith
    rw [h2, hy]
    have : (1 : ℝ) / 2 + 1 / dx + (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * 2)) = 3 / 4 + 1 / dx := by ring
    rw [this]
    have hdx : 1 / dx ≥ 1 / 3 := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by linarith) hx
    linarith

/-- Lower bound 1 < 2 S₀ + m_xy for idle measures at α = 1/2 on 5-vertex graphs of minimum degree at least 2. -/
theorem five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hcard : Fintype.card V = 5)
    (hδ : 2 ≤ G.minDegree) (x y : V) (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    let μ := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x
    let ν := graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y
    let S0 := ∑ v, min (μ v) (ν v)
    let μ1 (a : V) := μ a - min (μ a) (ν a)
    let ν1 (b : V) := ν b - min (μ b) (ν b)
    let m_xy := min (μ1 x) (ν1 y)
    1 < 2 * S0 + m_xy := by
  intro μ ν S0 μ1 ν1 m_xy
  have hne : x ≠ y := hxy.ne
  have hdegx_ge2 : 2 ≤ G.degree x := le_trans hδ (SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree G x)
  have hdegy_ge2 : 2 ≤ G.degree y := le_trans hδ (SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree G y)
  have hdegx_le4 : G.degree x ≤ 4 := by
    have := G.degree_lt_card_verts x
    omega
  have hdegy_le4 : G.degree y ≤ 4 := by
    have := G.degree_lt_card_verts y
    omega
  have hdx2_r : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (G.degree x : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdegx_ge2
  have hdy2_r : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (G.degree y : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdegy_ge2
  have hdx4_r : (G.degree x : ℝ) ≤ 4 := by exact_mod_cast hdegx_le4
  have hdy4_r : (G.degree y : ℝ) ≤ 4 := by exact_mod_cast hdegy_le4
  have hmin_xy := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_min_eval_xy G hδ x y hxy
  have hm_xy_eq : m_xy = min (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ))) (1 / 2 - 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) := by
    dsimp [m_xy, μ1, ν1]
    rw [hmin_xy.2.2.1, hmin_xy.2.2.2]
  by_cases hdisj : Disjoint (G.neighborFinset x) (G.neighborFinset y)
  · -- Case 2: disjoint neighbors
    have hunion : (G.neighborFinset x ∪ G.neighborFinset y).card = G.degree x + G.degree y := by
      rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    have hsub : G.neighborFinset x ∪ G.neighborFinset y ⊆ Finset.univ := Finset.subset_univ _
    have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Finset.card_univ, hcard, hunion] at hle
    have hS0_ge : 1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) + 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ)) ≤ S0 := by
      have hpair := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_sum_pair_le_S0 G x y hne
      dsimp [μ, ν, S0] at hpair
      rw [hmin_xy.1, hmin_xy.2.1] at hpair
      exact hpair
    have h2S0 : 1 / (G.degree y : ℝ) + 1 / (G.degree x : ℝ) ≤ 2 * S0 := by
      have : 1 / (G.degree y : ℝ) + 1 / (G.degree x : ℝ) =
          2 * (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) + 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) := by ring
      linarith
    have hbound := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_case2_arith (G.degree x) (G.degree y) hdegx_ge2 hdegy_ge2 hle
    dsimp at hbound
    rw [hm_xy_eq]
    linarith
  · -- Case 1: common neighbor exists
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] at hdisj
    have hnonempty : (G.neighborFinset x ∩ G.neighborFinset y).Nonempty :=
      Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hdisj
    rcases hnonempty with ⟨z, hz⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_inter, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset, SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset] at hz
    have hxz : G.Adj x z := hz.1
    have hyz : G.Adj y z := hz.2
    have hzx : z ≠ x := hxz.ne.symm
    have hzy : z ≠ y := hyz.ne.symm
    have hx_ne_z : x ≠ z := hxz.ne
    have hy_ne_z : y ≠ z := hyz.ne
    have hcommon := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_idle_eval_common G x y z hxz hyz
    have hS0_ge : 1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) + 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ)) +
        min (1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ))) ≤ S0 := by
      have htriple := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_sum_triple_le_S0 G x y z hne hx_ne_z hy_ne_z
      dsimp [μ, ν, S0] at htriple
      rw [hmin_xy.1, hmin_xy.2.1, hcommon.1, hcommon.2] at htriple
      exact htriple
    have h2S0 : 1 / (G.degree y : ℝ) + 1 / (G.degree x : ℝ) +
        2 * min (1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ))) ≤ 2 * S0 := by
      have : 1 / (G.degree y : ℝ) + 1 / (G.degree x : ℝ) +
          2 * min (1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ))) =
          2 * (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)) + 1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ)) +
               min (1 / (2 * (G.degree x : ℝ))) (1 / (2 * (G.degree y : ℝ)))) := by ring
      linarith
    have hbound := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound_case1_arith (G.degree x : ℝ) (G.degree y : ℝ)
        hdx2_r hdx4_r hdy2_r hdy4_r
    rw [hm_xy_eq]
    linarith

declarations.name: graph_min_degree_edge_partition_b_card_le
declarations.informal: If the minimum degree is at least 2n/3 − 1 and the edge partition has deg x = a + c + 1, deg y = b + c + 1, n = 2 + a + b + c + p, then b ≤ c + 2.
declarations.statement:
theorem graph_min_degree_edge_partition_b_card_le {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hδ : (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) / 3 - 1 ≤ (G.minDegree : ℝ))
    (x y : V) (A B C P : Finset V)
    (hdx : G.degree x = A.card + C.card + 1)
    (hdy : G.degree y = B.card + C.card + 1)
    (hn : Fintype.card V = 2 + A.card + B.card + C.card + P.card) :
    B.card ≤ C.card + 2
declarations.source:
/-- The minimum-degree hypothesis forces at most two more y-private than common neighbours. -/
theorem graph_min_degree_edge_partition_b_card_le {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hδ : (2 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) / 3 - 1 ≤ (G.minDegree : ℝ))
    (x y : V) (A B C P : Finset V)
    (hdx : G.degree x = A.card + C.card + 1)
    (hdy : G.degree y = B.card + C.card + 1)
    (hn : Fintype.card V = 2 + A.card + B.card + C.card + P.card) :
    B.card ≤ C.card + 2 := by
  have hminx : (G.minDegree : ℝ) ≤ (G.degree x : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree G x
  have hminy : (G.minDegree : ℝ) ≤ (G.degree y : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree G y
  have hdxR : (G.degree x : ℝ) = (A.card : ℝ) + (C.card : ℝ) + 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast hdx
  have hdyR : (G.degree y : ℝ) = (B.card : ℝ) + (C.card : ℝ) + 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast hdy
  have hnR : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) =
      2 + (A.card : ℝ) + (B.card : ℝ) + (C.card : ℝ) + (P.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hn
  have hx : 2 * (B.card : ℝ) + 2 * (P.card : ℝ) ≤
      (A.card : ℝ) + (C.card : ℝ) + 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have hy : 2 * (A.card : ℝ) + 2 * (P.card : ℝ) ≤
      (B.card : ℝ) + (C.card : ℝ) + 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have hb : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (C.card : ℝ) + 2 := by
    nlinarith
  exact_mod_cast hb

explanation.summary: The theorem is proved by real linear arithmetic on the degrees of $x$ and $y$. First, the assumption that the minimum degree is at least $2n/3 - 1$, combined with the partition expressions for $\deg(x)$, $\deg(y)$, and $n = |V|$, yields two linear inequalities: $2|B| + 2|P| \le |A| + |C| + 2$ and $2|A| + 2|P| \le |B| + |C| + 2$. Eliminating $|A|$ from these bounds and using the non-negativity of $|P|$ gives $|B| \le |C| + 2$ in $\mathbb{R}$. Finally, this inequality is cast back to $\mathbb{N}$.

steps.claim: The minimum degree of $G$ is at most the degrees of $x$ and $y$, when cast to the real numbers.
steps.explanation: In any finite graph, the minimum degree is at most the degree of any vertex (`SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree`). Applying this to $x$ and $y$ and casting to $\mathbb{R}$ establishes $\delta(G) \le \deg(x)$ and $\delta(G) \le \deg(y)$.
steps.code:
have hminx : (G.minDegree : ℝ) ≤ (G.degree x : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree G x
  have hminy : (G.minDegree : ℝ) ≤ (G.degree y : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast SimpleGraph.minDegree_le_degree G y

steps.claim: The degree formulas for $x$ and $y$ and the vertex count formula hold as equalities in $\mathbb{R}$.
steps.explanation: The given hypotheses $\deg(x) = |A| + |C| + 1$, $\deg(y) = |B| + |C| + 1$, and $|V| = 2 + |A| + |B| + |C| + |P|$ are cast from the natural numbers into the real numbers to prepare for linear arithmetic.
steps.code:
have hdxR : (G.degree x : ℝ) = (A.card : ℝ) + (C.card : ℝ) + 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast hdx
  have hdyR : (G.degree y : ℝ) = (B.card : ℝ) + (C.card : ℝ) + 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast hdy
  have hnR : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) =
      2 + (A.card : ℝ) + (B.card : ℝ) + (C.card : ℝ) + (P.card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hn

steps.explanation: Combining the lower bound $\deg(x) \ge \delta(G) \ge \frac{2|V|}{3} - 1$ with $\deg(x) = |A| + |C| + 1$ and $|V| = 2 + |A| + |B| + |C| + |P|$ gives $|A| + |C| + 1 \ge \frac{2(2 + |A| + |B| + |C| + |P|)}{3} - 1$. Multiplying by 3 and rearranging the terms yields $2|B| + 2|P| \le |A| + |C| + 2$, which is verified by linear arithmetic (`nlinarith`).
steps.code:
have hx : 2 * (B.card : ℝ) + 2 * (P.card : ℝ) ≤
      (A.card : ℝ) + (C.card : ℝ) + 2 := by
    nlinarith

steps.explanation: Symmetrically, substituting the formulas for $\deg(y)$ and $|V|$ into $\deg(y) \ge \delta(G) \ge \frac{2|V|}{3} - 1$ yields $2|A| + 2|P| \le |B| + |C| + 2$, verified by linear arithmetic (`nlinarith`).
steps.code:
have hy : 2 * (A.card : ℝ) + 2 * (P.card : ℝ) ≤
      (B.card : ℝ) + (C.card : ℝ) + 2 := by
    nlinarith

steps.claim: $|B| \le |C| + 2$ in $\mathbb{R}$.
steps.explanation: Multiplying the first inequality by 2 and using the second to eliminate $|A|$ gives $4|B| + 4|P| \le 2|A| + 2|C| + 4 \le (|B| + |C| + 2 - 2|P|) + 2|C| + 4$, which simplifies to $3|B| + 6|P| \le 3|C| + 6$. Since $|P| \ge 0$, this implies $3|B| \le 3|C| + 6$, so $|B| \le |C| + 2$. The linear arithmetic solver (`nlinarith`) closes this goal.
steps.code:
have hb : (B.card : ℝ) ≤ (C.card : ℝ) + 2 := by
    nlinarith

steps.claim: $|B| \le |C| + 2$ in the natural numbers.
steps.explanation: The real inequality $|B| \le |C| + 2$ is cast back to the natural numbers to establish the final goal.
steps.code: exact_mod_cast hb

declarations.name: five_vertex_min_degree_two_wasserstein_lt_one
declarations.informal: Every connected graph on 5 vertices with minimum degree at least 2 has, for each edge xy, some α ∈ (0, 1) with W(μ_x^α, μ_y^α) < 1.
declarations.statement:
theorem five_vertex_min_degree_two_wasserstein_lt_one {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hcard : Fintype.card V = 5) (hG : G.Connected)
    (hδ : 2 ≤ G.minDegree) (x y : V) (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧
      graph_wasserstein_dist G (graph_idle_measure G α x) (graph_idle_measure G α y) < 1
declarations.source:
/-- The geometric core of part (i): on 5 vertices with δ ≥ 2, every edge admits some α ∈ (0,1) where the two lazy measures are closer than 1 in W. Uses δ ≥ 2 = (n−1)/2 hence ediam ≤ 2, so all non-neighbour pairs are at distance exactly 2. -/
theorem five_vertex_min_degree_two_wasserstein_lt_one {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hcard : Fintype.card V = 5) (hG : G.Connected)
    (hδ : 2 ≤ G.minDegree) (x y : V) (hxy : G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧
      graph_wasserstein_dist G (graph_idle_measure G α x) (graph_idle_measure G α y) < 1 := by
  have _ := hG
  use 1 / 2
  refine ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  have hdeg_x : 0 < G.degree x := by
    have := G.minDegree_le_degree x
    omega
  have hdeg_y : 0 < G.degree y := by
    have := G.minDegree_le_degree y
    omega
  have hμ_nonneg : ∀ a, 0 ≤ graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x a := by
    intro a
    exact graph_idle_measure_nonneg G (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x a
  have hν_nonneg : ∀ b, 0 ≤ graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y b := by
    intro b
    exact graph_idle_measure_nonneg G (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) y b
  have hμ_sum : ∑ a, graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x a = 1 :=
    graph_idle_measure_sum_eq_one G (1 / 2) x hdeg_x
  have hν_sum : ∑ b, graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y b = 1 :=
    graph_idle_measure_sum_eq_one G (1 / 2) y hdeg_y
  have hediam : G.ediam ≤ 2 := five_vertex_min_degree_two_ediam_le_two G hcard hδ
  have hdist2 : ∀ a b : V, (G.dist a b : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by
    intro a b
    have hle : G.edist a b ≤ 2 := le_trans SimpleGraph.edist_le_ediam hediam
    have hnat : G.dist a b ≤ 2 := ENat.toNat_le_of_le_natCast hle
    exact Nat.cast_le.mpr hnat
  have hxy_dist : (G.dist x y : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [G.dist_eq_one_iff_adj.mpr hxy]
    norm_num
  have h_bound := wasserstein_dist_le_of_diameter_two G hdist2
    (graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x) (graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y)
    hμ_nonneg hν_nonneg hμ_sum hν_sum x y hxy_dist
  have h_comb := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound G hcard hδ x y hxy
  linarith

explanation.summary: To show that every edge $xy$ admits some laziness parameter $\alpha \in (0,1)$ with $W(\mu_x^\alpha, \mu_y^\alpha) < 1$, the proof fixes $\alpha = 1/2$. On any 5-vertex graph with minimum degree at least 2, the diameter is at most 2, allowing the Wasserstein distance between probability measures on an edge to be bounded by $2 - 2S_0 - m_{xy}$, where $S_0$ is the shared probability mass and $m_{xy}$ is the unshared mass at the endpoints. A combinatorial bound specialized to 5-vertex graphs with $\delta \ge 2$ guarantees that $2S_0 + m_{xy} > 1$, which immediately implies $W(\mu_x^{1/2}, \mu_y^{1/2}) < 1$.

steps.claim: It suffices to show that for the choice $\alpha = 1/2$, the Wasserstein distance between the lazy walk measures is strictly less than 1.
steps.explanation: The theorem asserts the existence of $\alpha \in (0, 1)$ such that $W(\mu_x^\alpha, \mu_y^\alpha) < 1$. The proof fixes $\alpha = 1/2$, checks $0 < 1/2$ and $1/2 < 1$ by numerical evaluation (`norm_num`), leaving the distance bound as the remaining goal.
steps.code:
have _ := hG
  use 1 / 2
  refine ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_⟩

steps.claim: The degrees of $x$ and $y$ are strictly positive.
steps.explanation: Because the minimum degree $\delta$ of $G$ is at least 2, and the degree of every vertex is at least the minimum degree (`G.minDegree_le_degree`), both $\deg(x)$ and $\deg(y)$ are at least 2, hence strictly positive by linear integer arithmetic (`omega`).
steps.code:
have hdeg_x : 0 < G.degree x := by
    have := G.minDegree_le_degree x
    omega
  have hdeg_y : 0 < G.degree y := by
    have := G.minDegree_le_degree y
    omega

steps.claim: The lazy walk measures $\mu_x^{1/2}$ and $\mu_y^{1/2}$ are probability distributions on $V$.
steps.explanation: Since $0 \le 1/2 \le 1$, `graph_idle_measure_nonneg` ensures that both measures take non-negative values at every vertex. Since $\deg(x) > 0$ and $\deg(y) > 0$, `graph_idle_measure_sum_eq_one` shows that the probabilities of each measure sum to 1.
steps.code:
have hμ_nonneg : ∀ a, 0 ≤ graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x a := by
    intro a
    exact graph_idle_measure_nonneg G (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x a
  have hν_nonneg : ∀ b, 0 ≤ graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y b := by
    intro b
    exact graph_idle_measure_nonneg G (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) y b
  have hμ_sum : ∑ a, graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x a = 1 :=
    graph_idle_measure_sum_eq_one G (1 / 2) x hdeg_x
  have hν_sum : ∑ b, graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y b = 1 :=
    graph_idle_measure_sum_eq_one G (1 / 2) y hdeg_y

steps.claim: The graph has diameter at most 2, so all pairwise distances are at most 2.
steps.explanation: By `five_vertex_min_degree_two_ediam_le_two`, any 5-vertex graph with minimum degree at least 2 has extended diameter at most 2. For any pair of vertices $a, b \in V$, the extended distance between them is bounded by the diameter (`SimpleGraph.edist_le_ediam`). Using `le_trans`, `ENat.toNat_le_of_le_natCast`, and `Nat.cast_le.mpr`, this converts to the real inequality $\operatorname{dist}(a, b) \le 2$.
steps.code:
have hediam : G.ediam ≤ 2 := five_vertex_min_degree_two_ediam_le_two G hcard hδ
  have hdist2 : ∀ a b : V, (G.dist a b : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by
    intro a b
    have hle : G.edist a b ≤ 2 := le_trans SimpleGraph.edist_le_ediam hediam
    have hnat : G.dist a b ≤ 2 := ENat.toNat_le_of_le_natCast hle
    exact Nat.cast_le.mpr hnat

steps.claim: The distance between the adjacent vertices $x$ and $y$ is 1.
steps.explanation: Because $x$ and $y$ are adjacent, the graph distance $\operatorname{dist}(x, y)$ equals 1 by `G.dist_eq_one_iff_adj.mpr`.
steps.code:
have hxy_dist : (G.dist x y : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [G.dist_eq_one_iff_adj.mpr hxy]
    norm_num

steps.claim: The Wasserstein distance satisfies $W(\mu_x^{1/2}, \mu_y^{1/2}) \le 2 - 2S_0 - m_{xy}$.
steps.explanation: Applying `wasserstein_dist_le_of_diameter_two` using the verified probability measure properties and the diameter-2 bound yields the coupling upper bound $W(\mu_x^{1/2}, \mu_y^{1/2}) \le 2 - 2S_0 - m_{xy}$, where $S_0$ is the total overlapping mass $\sum_v \min(\mu_x^{1/2}(v), \mu_y^{1/2}(v))$ and $m_{xy} = \min(\mu_1(x), \nu_1(y))$ is the unshared mass at the edge endpoints.
steps.code:
have h_bound := wasserstein_dist_le_of_diameter_two G hdist2
    (graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) x) (graph_idle_measure G (1 / 2) y)
    hμ_nonneg hν_nonneg hμ_sum hν_sum x y hxy_dist

steps.claim: The Wasserstein distance $W(\mu_x^{1/2}, \mu_y^{1/2})$ is strictly less than 1.
steps.explanation: The combinatorial lemma `five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound` establishes that $1 < 2S_0 + m_{xy}$. Linear arithmetic (`linarith`) combines this with the coupling upper bound $W(\mu_x^{1/2}, \mu_y^{1/2}) \le 2 - (2S_0 + m_{xy})$ to conclude $W(\mu_x^{1/2}, \mu_y^{1/2}) < 1$.
steps.code:
have h_comb := five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling_bound G hcard hδ x y hxy
  linarith

glossary.G.minDegree_le_degree: In any graph, the degree of each vertex is bounded below by the minimum degree.
glossary.G.dist_eq_one_iff_adj.mpr: If two vertices in a simple graph are adjacent, the graph distance between them is 1.
glossary.SimpleGraph.edist_le_ediam: The extended distance between any pair of vertices is at most the extended diameter of the graph.
glossary.le_trans: The ordering relation $\le$ is transitive ($a \le b$ and $b \le c$ imply $a \le c$).
glossary.ENat.toNat_le_of_le_natCast: If an extended natural number $m \le n$ (with $n \in \mathbb{N}$), then $m$ converts to a natural number satisfying $m.\mathrm{toNat} \le n$.
glossary.Nat.cast_le.mpr: An inequality $m \le n$ between natural numbers implies the corresponding inequality $\uparrow m \le \uparrow n$ in the real numbers.
glossary.graph_idle_measure_nonneg: For any parameter $\alpha \in [0, 1]$, the lazy walk measure $\mu_x^\alpha$ takes non-negative values on all vertices.
glossary.graph_idle_measure_sum_eq_one: When a vertex $x$ has strictly positive degree, its lazy walk measure $\mu_x^\alpha$ sums to 1 over all vertices.
glossary.five_vertex_min_degree_two_ediam_le_two: Every simple graph on 5 vertices with minimum degree at least 2 has extended diameter at most 2.
glossary.wasserstein_dist_le_of_diameter_two: On a graph of diameter at most 2, the Wasserstein distance between probability measures $\mu$ and $\nu$ on an edge $xy$ is at most $2 - 2S_0 - m_{xy}$, where $S_0$ is the total overlapping mass and $m_{xy}$ is the minimum unshared mass at $x$ and $y$.
glossary.five_vertex_min_degree_two_idle_coupling: In any 5-vertex graph with minimum degree at least 2, the idle measures with $\alpha = 1/2$ at adjacent vertices satisfy $2S_0 + m_{xy} > 1$.

declarations.name: lly_five_vertex_pos_of_min_degree_two
declarations.informal: Every connected graph on 5 vertices with minimum degree at least 2 has positive Lin–Lu–Yau curvature on every edge.
declarations.statement:
theorem lly_five_vertex_pos_of_min_degree_two {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hcard : Fintype.card V = 5) (hG : G.Connected)
    (hδ : 2 ≤ G.minDegree) (x y : V) (hxy : G.Adj x y) : 0 < graph_lly_curvature G x y
declarations.source:
/-- Every connected graph on 5 vertices with minimum degree at least 2 has positive Lin–Lu–Yau curvature on every edge: apply the Wasserstein < 1 criterion at the α produced by the diameter-2 plan argument. This is the `2 ∈ S` half of the parent. -/
theorem lly_five_vertex_pos_of_min_degree_two {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hcard : Fintype.card V = 5) (hG : G.Connected)
    (hδ : 2 ≤ G.minDegree) (x y : V) (hxy : G.Adj x y) : 0 < graph_lly_curvature G x y := by
  obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα1, hW⟩ := five_vertex_min_degree_two_wasserstein_lt_one G hcard hG hδ x y hxy
  exact graph_lly_curvature_pos_of_wasserstein_lt_one G hG x y hxy α hα0 hα1 hW

explanation.summary: The proof establishes positive Lin–Lu–Yau curvature by reducing it to a Wasserstein distance condition. For any connected graph on 5 vertices with minimum degree at least 2, a diameter-based transport plan argument produces an idleness parameter α ∈ (0, 1) whose lazy random walk measures have Wasserstein distance strictly less than 1. Positivity of the curvature then follows immediately from the general criterion relating Wasserstein distance to Lin–Lu–Yau curvature.

steps.claim: There exists an idleness parameter α ∈ (0, 1) such that the Wasserstein distance between the idle measures at x and y is strictly less than 1.
steps.explanation: By `five_vertex_min_degree_two_wasserstein_lt_one`, the hypotheses that G is connected, has 5 vertices, and has minimum degree at least 2 guarantee the existence of a parameter α ∈ (0, 1) for which the Wasserstein distance between the lazy random walk (idle) measures at adjacent vertices x and y is strictly less than 1.
steps.code: obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα1, hW⟩ := five_vertex_min_degree_two_wasserstein_lt_one G hcard hG hδ x y hxy

steps.claim: The Lin–Lu–Yau curvature on the edge xy is strictly positive.
steps.explanation: Applying the general criterion `graph_lly_curvature_pos_of_wasserstein_lt_one`, the existence of an α ∈ (0, 1) with Wasserstein distance strictly less than 1 implies that the Lin–Lu–Yau curvature on the edge xy is strictly positive.
steps.code: exact graph_lly_curvature_pos_of_wasserstein_lt_one G hG x y hxy α hα0 hα1 hW

glossary.five_vertex_min_degree_two_wasserstein_l: in any connected graph on 5 vertices with minimum degree at least 2, for any two adjacent vertices x and y, there exists an idleness parameter α ∈ (0, 1) such that the Wasserstein distance between the idle measures at x and y is strictly less than 1
glossary.graph_lly_curvature_pos_of_wasserstein_l: for any connected graph and adjacent vertices x and y, if the Wasserstein distance between the idle measures at x and y is strictly less than 1 for some α ∈ (0, 1), then the Lin–Lu–Yau curvature on the edge xy is strictly positive

declarations.name: lly_positive_edge_connectivity_threshold_five
declarations.informal: c(5) = 2: every connected graph on 5 vertices with edge-connectivity at least 2 has positive Lin–Lu–Yau curvature on every edge, while the path-like tree with a vertex of degree 3 (edges 01, 03, 04, 12) has κ' = 1 and κ_LLY(0,1) = −1/3. So c(5) < ⌈2·5/3 − 1⌉ = 3: the threshold of OP-165 fails at n = 5 for a non-degenerate reason.
declarations.statement:
theorem lly_positive_edge_connectivity_threshold_five :
    lly_positive_edge_connectivity_threshold 5 = 2
declarations.source:
theorem lly_positive_edge_connectivity_threshold_five :
    lly_positive_edge_connectivity_threshold 5 = 2 := by
  unfold lly_positive_edge_connectivity_threshold
  set S : Set ℕ := {k : ℕ | ∀ (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)) [DecidableRel G.Adj],
    G.Connected → k ≤ graph_edge_connectivity G →
      ∀ (x y : Fin 5), G.Adj x y → 0 < graph_lly_curvature G x y}
  have h2S : 2 ∈ S := by
    intro G inst hconn hk x y hxy
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin 5) = 5 := Fintype.card_fin 5
    have hmin : 2 ≤ G.minDegree := by
      have hle := graph_edge_connectivity_le_minDegree G
      omega
    exact lly_five_vertex_pos_of_min_degree_two G hcard hconn hmin x y hxy
  have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨2, h2S⟩
  have hmem : sInf S ∈ S := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  have hle2 : sInf S ≤ 2 := Nat.sInf_le h2S
  have hnot_le1 : ¬ (sInf S ≤ 1) := by
    intro hle1
    have hT_conn := five_vertex_t_star_connected_edge_connectivity.1
    have hT_ec := five_vertex_t_star_connected_edge_connectivity.2
    have hT_adj : five_vertex_t_star.Adj 0 1 := by decide
    have hcurv := hmem five_vertex_t_star hT_conn (by omega) 0 1 hT_adj
    have hval := lly_five_vertex_t_star_curvature
    linarith
  omega
declarations.citation: Partial result on OP-165 (arXiv:2610.10559, after Theorem 1.4); found by exact computation over all graphs on 5 vertices (curvatures via the paper's Theorem 2.2 and min-cost flow).

explanation.summary: The threshold c(5) is the minimal edge-connectivity k guaranteeing that every connected 5-vertex graph has strictly positive Lin–Lu–Yau curvature on every edge. The upper bound c(5) ≤ 2 holds because edge-connectivity at least 2 forces minimum degree at least 2, which suffices for positive curvature on all edges of any connected 5-vertex graph. The lower bound c(5) > 1 is witnessed by the tree on 5 vertices with a degree-3 vertex and a single edge-connectivity cut, where the central edge has negative curvature -1/3. Together, these bounds establish c(5) = 2.

steps.claim: Define S as the set of edge-connectivity thresholds that ensure positive Lin–Lu–Yau curvature on all edges for connected 5-vertex graphs.
steps.explanation: Unfolding the definition of lly_positive_edge_connectivity_threshold 5 sets up the problem as finding the infimum of the set S ⊆ ℕ of bounds k such that any connected 5-vertex graph with edge-connectivity at least k has strictly positive Lin–Lu–Yau curvature on all edges. The goal is to prove sInf S = 2.
steps.code:
unfold lly_positive_edge_connectivity_threshold
  set S : Set ℕ := {k : ℕ | ∀ (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)) [DecidableRel G.Adj],
    G.Connected → k ≤ graph_edge_connectivity G →
      ∀ (x y : Fin 5), G.Adj x y → 0 < graph_lly_curvature G x y}

steps.explanation: Let G be a connected graph on Fin 5 with edge-connectivity at least 2. By graph_edge_connectivity_le_minDegree, the minimum degree δ(G) is at least the edge-connectivity, so δ(G) ≥ 2. By lly_five_vertex_pos_of_min_degree_two, every connected 5-vertex graph with minimum degree at least 2 has strictly positive Lin–Lu–Yau curvature on all edges, so 2 satisfies the condition defining S.
steps.code:
have h2S : 2 ∈ S := by
    intro G inst hconn hk x y hxy
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin 5) = 5 := Fintype.card_fin 5
    have hmin : 2 ≤ G.minDegree := by
      have hle := graph_edge_connectivity_le_minDegree G
      omega
    exact lly_five_vertex_pos_of_min_degree_two G hcard hconn hmin x y hxy

steps.claim: sInf S ∈ S and sInf S ≤ 2
steps.explanation: Since 2 ∈ S, the set S is nonempty. In ℕ, every nonempty set contains its infimum (Nat.sInf_mem), and the infimum is bounded above by any element of the set, here 2 (Nat.sInf_le).
steps.code:
have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨2, h2S⟩
  have hmem : sInf S ∈ S := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  have hle2 : sInf S ≤ 2 := Nat.sInf_le h2S

steps.claim: ¬ (sInf S ≤ 1)
steps.explanation: Assume for contradiction that sInf S ≤ 1. The counterexample tree five_vertex_t_star is connected and has edge-connectivity 1 by five_vertex_t_star_connected_edge_connectivity.1 and five_vertex_t_star_connected_edge_connectivity.2. Since sInf S ≤ 1, the definition of S implies that every edge of this tree must have positive curvature, so the edge (0, 1) satisfies κ_LLY(0, 1) > 0. However, lly_five_vertex_t_star_curvature computes that κ_LLY(0, 1) = -1/3. This contradiction (0 < -1/3) refutes sInf S ≤ 1.
steps.code:
have hnot_le1 : ¬ (sInf S ≤ 1) := by
    intro hle1
    have hT_conn := five_vertex_t_star_connected_edge_connectivity.1
    have hT_ec := five_vertex_t_star_connected_edge_connectivity.2
    have hT_adj : five_vertex_t_star.Adj 0 1 := by decide
    have hcurv := hmem five_vertex_t_star hT_conn (by omega) 0 1 hT_adj
    have hval := lly_five_vertex_t_star_curvature
    linarith

steps.claim: sInf S = 2
steps.explanation: Linear arithmetic over the natural numbers combines sInf S ≤ 2 and ¬(sInf S ≤ 1) to conclude that sInf S = 2.
steps.code: omega
