declarations.name: scheduleCost
declarations.informal: The total fetch cost of a cache schedule up to time T, defined as the sum over time steps of the number of newly fetched pages.
declarations.statement: def scheduleCost {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (sched : ℕ → Finset α) (T : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.reading: Given a type `α` with decidable equality, a schedule `sched : ℕ → Finset α`, and a time bound `T : ℕ`, `scheduleCost sched T` is defined as the sum over `t ∈ Finset.range T` (i.e., `t` from `0` to `T - 1`) of the cardinality of the set difference `(sched (t + 1)) \ (sched t)`.

declarations.name: tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving
declarations.informal: One dimension costs a factor log₂ n: from a box-search algorithm in dimension k with q queries one gets one in dimension k+1 with at most 3·(k+1)·(log₂ n + 2)·(q+1) + 2^(k+1) queries.
declarations.statement:
theorem tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving (n k q : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (h : tarski_box_query_le n k q) :
    tarski_box_query_le n (k+1) (3 * (k+1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 2) * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1))
declarations.source:
open Finset
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

/-- Potential of a box: the sum over coordinates of `clog 2` of the coordinate gap. -/
def tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot (n K : ℕ) (a b : Fin K → Fin n) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j : Fin K, Nat.clog 2 ((b j : ℕ) - (a j))

/-- A box that shrinks in every coordinate has no larger potential. -/
theorem tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot_lt (n K : ℕ) {u u' v v' : Fin K → Fin n}
    (huu' : u ≤ u') (hvv' : v' ≤ v) (i : Fin K)
    (hi : Nat.clog 2 ((v' i : ℕ) - (u' i)) < Nat.clog 2 ((v i : ℕ) - (u i))) :
    tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n K u' v' <
      tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n K u v := by
  unfold tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot
  apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
  · intro j _
    refine Nat.clog_mono (b := 2) (c := 2) (by norm_num) (le_refl 2) ?_
    have h1 : (u j : ℕ) ≤ (u' j : ℕ) := huu' j
    have h2 : (v' j : ℕ) ≤ (v j : ℕ) := hvv' j
    omega
  · exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩

/-- Halving strictly decreases `clog 2` for gaps of size at least two. -/
theorem tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_clog_half_lt {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    Nat.clog 2 (d / 2) < Nat.clog 2 d := by
  have hb : 1 < 2 := by norm_num
  set m := Nat.clog 2 d with hm
  have hmpos : 0 < m := Nat.clog_pos hb (by omega)
  have hd2 : d ≤ 2 ^ m := (Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow hb).mp (le_refl m)
  have hpow : 2 ^ m = 2 ^ (m - 1) * 2 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show m = (m - 1) + 1 by omega]
    rw [Nat.pow_succ]
  have hle : d / 2 ≤ 2 ^ (m - 1) := by
    rw [hpow] at hd2
    omega
  have := (Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow hb).mpr hle
  omega

/-- The complementary half also strictly decreases `clog 2` for gaps of size at least two. -/
theorem tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_clog_sub_half_lt {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    Nat.clog 2 (d - d / 2) < Nat.clog 2 d := by
  have hb : 1 < 2 := by norm_num
  set m := Nat.clog 2 d with hm
  have hmpos : 0 < m := Nat.clog_pos hb (by omega)
  have hd2 : d ≤ 2 ^ m := (Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow hb).mp (le_refl m)
  have hpow : 2 ^ m = 2 ^ (m - 1) * 2 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show m = (m - 1) + 1 by omega]
    rw [Nat.pow_succ]
  have hle : d - d / 2 ≤ 2 ^ (m - 1) := by
    rw [hpow] at hd2
    omega
  have := (Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow hb).mpr hle
  omega

/-- An `insertNth` point stays inside the box when the slice and the cut do. -/
theorem tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_insertNth_mem (n k : ℕ) (a b : Fin (k+1) → Fin n)
    (i : Fin (k+1)) (c : Fin n) (hac : a i ≤ c) (hcb : c ≤ b i)
    (y : Fin k → Fin n) (ha'y : (a ∘ i.succAbove) ≤ y) (hyb' : y ≤ (b ∘ i.succAbove)) :
    a ≤ i.insertNth c y ∧ i.insertNth c y ≤ b := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Fin.le_insertNth_iff]
    exact ⟨hac, ha'y⟩
  · rw [Fin.insertNth_le_iff]
    exact ⟨hcb, hyb'⟩

/-- A bisection step strictly decreases the potential in both resulting sub-boxes. -/
theorem tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot_step (n k : ℕ) (a b : Fin (k+1) → Fin n)
    (i : Fin (k+1)) (c : Fin n)
    (hac : a i ≤ c) (hcb : c ≤ b i)
    (hstep : 2 ≤ (b i : ℕ) - (a i))
    (hc : (c : ℕ) - (a i : ℕ) = ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2)
    (y : Fin k → Fin n) (ha'y : (a ∘ i.succAbove) ≤ y) (hyb' : y ≤ (b ∘ i.succAbove)) :
    tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) (i.insertNth c y) b <
      tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b ∧
    tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a (i.insertNth c y) <
      tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b := by
  obtain ⟨hax, hxb⟩ := tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_insertNth_mem n k a b i c hac hcb y ha'y hyb'
  have hxi : (i.insertNth c y : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) i = c := by simp
  have hd : 2 ≤ (b i : ℕ) - (a i) := hstep
  constructor
  · refine tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot_lt n (k+1) (u := a) (u' := i.insertNth c y)
      (v := b) (v' := b) hax (le_refl b) i ?_
    rw [hxi]
    have hb1 : (c : ℕ) ≤ (b i : ℕ) := hcb
    have hb2 : (a i : ℕ) ≤ (c : ℕ) := hac
    have : (b i : ℕ) - (c : ℕ) = ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) - ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2 := by omega
    rw [this]
    exact tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_clog_sub_half_lt hd
  · refine tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot_lt n (k+1) (u := a) (u' := a) (v := b)
      (v' := i.insertNth c y) (le_refl a) hxb i ?_
    rw [hxi]
    have : (c : ℕ) - (a i : ℕ) = ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2 := hc
    rw [this]
    exact tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_clog_half_lt hd

/-- Brute-force query tree: query the listed points in order, output the first fixed point. -/
def tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute {n K : ℕ} (dflt : Fin K → Fin n) :
    List (Fin K → Fin n) → TarskiQueryTree n K
  | [] => TarskiQueryTree.output dflt
  | x :: xs =>
    TarskiQueryTree.query x (fun v => if v = x then TarskiQueryTree.output x else
      tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute dflt xs)

/-- The brute-force tree finds a fixed point contained in the list, within `length` queries. -/
theorem tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute_spec {n K : ℕ} (dflt : Fin K → Fin n)
    (L : List (Fin K → Fin n))
    (f : (Fin K → Fin n) → Fin K → Fin n) (hL : ∃ x ∈ L, f x = x) :
    TarskiQueryTree.run f (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute dflt L) ∈ L ∧
    f (TarskiQueryTree.run f (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute dflt L)) =
      TarskiQueryTree.run f (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute dflt L) ∧
    TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute dflt L) ≤ L.length := by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp at hL
  | cons x xs ih =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hfw⟩ := hL
    rw [List.mem_cons] at hw
    simp only [tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_2,
      TarskiQueryTree.cost.eq_2]
    by_cases hfx : f x = x
    · rw [if_pos hfx, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_1, TarskiQueryTree.cost.eq_1]
      exact ⟨List.mem_cons_self, hfx, by simp⟩
    · rw [if_neg hfx]
      have hL' : ∃ y ∈ xs, f y = y := by
        rcases hw with rfl | hw
        · exact absurd hfw hfx
        · exact ⟨w, hw, hfw⟩
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih hL'
      refine ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h1, h2, ?_⟩
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega

/-- One bisection step: slice, lift, query the lifted point, and dispatch to the
sub-box promised by monotonicity, giving the potential-decrease cost bound. -/
theorem tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_step (n k q m : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (h : tarski_box_query_le n k q)
    (ih : ∀ m' < m, ∀ (a b : Fin (k+1) → Fin n), a ≤ b →
      tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b ≤ m' →
      ∃ t : TarskiQueryTree n (k+1),
        ∀ f : (Fin (k+1) → Fin n) → Fin (k+1) → Fin n,
          Monotone f → a ≤ f a → f b ≤ b →
            a ≤ TarskiQueryTree.run f t ∧ TarskiQueryTree.run f t ≤ b ∧
            f (TarskiQueryTree.run f t) = TarskiQueryTree.run f t ∧
            TarskiQueryTree.cost f t ≤
              tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1))
    (a b : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hpot : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b ≤ m)
    (i : Fin (k+1)) (hstep : 2 ≤ (b i : ℕ) - (a i)) :
    ∃ t : TarskiQueryTree n (k+1),
      ∀ f : (Fin (k+1) → Fin n) → Fin (k+1) → Fin n,
        Monotone f → a ≤ f a → f b ≤ b →
          a ≤ TarskiQueryTree.run f t ∧ TarskiQueryTree.run f t ≤ b ∧
          f (TarskiQueryTree.run f t) = TarskiQueryTree.run f t ∧
          TarskiQueryTree.cost f t ≤
            tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
  classical
  have hcval_lt : (a i : ℕ) + ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2 < n := by
    have hbn : (b i : ℕ) < n := Fin.is_lt (b i)
    have hdle : ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2 ≤ (b i : ℕ) - (a i) := Nat.div_le_self _ _
    omega
  set c : Fin n := ⟨(a i : ℕ) + ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2, hcval_lt⟩ with hcdef
  have hcval : (c : ℕ) = (a i : ℕ) + ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2 := by rw [hcdef]
  have hac : a i ≤ c := by rw [Fin.le_def, hcval]; omega
  have hcb : c ≤ b i := by rw [Fin.le_def, hcval]; omega
  obtain ⟨tq, htq⟩ := h (a ∘ i.succAbove) (b ∘ i.succAbove) (fun j => hab (i.succAbove j))
  let T : ∀ (u v : Fin (k+1) → Fin n), u ≤ v →
      tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) u v < m → TarskiQueryTree n (k+1) :=
    fun u v huv hp => Classical.choose
      (ih (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) u v) hp u v huv (le_refl _))
  have hTspec : ∀ (u v : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (huv : u ≤ v)
      (hp : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) u v < m),
      ∀ f : (Fin (k+1) → Fin n) → Fin (k+1) → Fin n, Monotone f → u ≤ f u → f v ≤ v →
        u ≤ TarskiQueryTree.run f (T u v huv hp) ∧
        TarskiQueryTree.run f (T u v huv hp) ≤ v ∧
        f (TarskiQueryTree.run f (T u v huv hp)) = TarskiQueryTree.run f (T u v huv hp) ∧
        TarskiQueryTree.cost f (T u v huv hp) ≤
          tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) u v * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
    intro u v huv hp f hf hu hv
    exact Classical.choose_spec
      (ih (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) u v) hp u v huv (le_refl _)) f hf hu hv
  let g : (Fin (k+1) → Fin n) → TarskiQueryTree n (k+1) := fun w =>
    if hw : a ≤ w ∧ w ≤ b ∧ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) w b < m ∧
        tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a w < m then
      TarskiQueryTree.query w (fun v =>
        if v i = w i then TarskiQueryTree.output w
        else if w i < v i then T w b hw.2.1 hw.2.2.1
        else T a w hw.1 hw.2.2.2)
    else TarskiQueryTree.output w
  refine ⟨tarski_query_tree_bind g (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq), ?_⟩
  intro f hf ha hb
  obtain ⟨hg_mono, hga, hgb, hglift⟩ :=
    tarski_slice_subbox_monotone_and_fixed n k f hf a b ha hb i c hac hcb
  obtain ⟨hya, hyb, hyfix, hycost⟩ :=
    htq (fun y j => f (i.insertNth c y) (i.succAbove j)) hg_mono hga hgb
  set y : Fin k → Fin n := TarskiQueryTree.run (fun y j => f (i.insertNth c y) (i.succAbove j)) tq
    with hydef
  set x : Fin (k+1) → Fin n := i.insertNth c y with hxdef
  obtain ⟨hax, hxb, hxsliced⟩ := hglift y hya hyb hyfix
  have hrun_lift : TarskiQueryTree.run f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) = x := by
    rw [(tarski_query_tree_slice_lift_spec i c f tq).1]
  have hcost_lift : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) =
      TarskiQueryTree.cost (fun y j => f (i.insertNth c y) (i.succAbove j)) tq :=
    (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift_spec i c f tq).2
  have hlq : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) ≤ q := by
    rw [hcost_lift]; exact hycost
  have hpstep := tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot_step n k a b i c hac hcb hstep
    (by rw [hcval]; omega) y hya hyb
  have hpotx1 : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) x b < m :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hpstep.1 hpot
  have hpotx2 : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a x < m :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hpstep.2 hpot
  have hguard : a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b ∧ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) x b < m ∧
      tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a x < m := ⟨hax, hxb, hpotx1, hpotx2⟩
  have hgx : g x = TarskiQueryTree.query x (fun v =>
      if v i = x i then TarskiQueryTree.output x
      else if x i < v i then T x b hguard.2.1 hguard.2.2.1
      else T a x hguard.1 hguard.2.2.2) := by
    simp only [g]
    rw [dif_pos hguard]
  have hpotpos : 1 ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b := by
    have hpos : 0 < Nat.clog 2 ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) := Nat.clog_pos (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have := Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun j : Fin (k+1) => Nat.clog 2 ((b j : ℕ) - (a j)))
      (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    unfold tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot
    omega
  have hbs := tarski_query_tree_bind_spec g f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq)
  have key : a ≤ TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) ∧ TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) ≤ b ∧
      f (TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x)) = TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) ∧
      TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) + TarskiQueryTree.cost f (g x)
        ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
    by_cases h1 : f x i = x i
    · have hrun1 : TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) = x := by
        rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_2, if_pos h1, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_1]
      have hcost1 : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (g x) = 1 := by
        rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.cost.eq_2, if_pos h1, TarskiQueryTree.cost.eq_1]
      have hfixx : f x = x := by
        funext j
        rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove i j with hji | ⟨t, ht⟩
        · rw [hji]; exact h1
        · rw [ht]
          exact hxsliced _ (Fin.succAbove_ne i t)
      refine ⟨by rw [hrun1]; exact hax, by rw [hrun1]; exact hxb, by rw [hrun1]; exact hfixx, ?_⟩
      rw [hcost1]
      have h1' : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) + 1 ≤ q + 1 := by omega
      have h2' : q + 1 ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) := by
        calc q + 1 = 1 * (q + 1) := by ring
          _ ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) :=
              Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hpotpos
      exact le_trans h1' (le_trans h2' (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
    · by_cases h2 : x i < f x i
      · have hrun2 : TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) =
            TarskiQueryTree.run f (T x b hguard.2.1 hguard.2.2.1) := by
          rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_2, if_neg h1, if_pos h2]
        have hcost2 : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (g x) =
            TarskiQueryTree.cost f (T x b hguard.2.1 hguard.2.2.1) + 1 := by
          rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.cost.eq_2, if_neg h1, if_pos h2]
        have hxfx : x ≤ f x := by
          intro j
          rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove i j with hji | ⟨t, ht⟩
          · rw [hji]; exact le_of_lt h2
          · rw [ht]; rw [hxsliced _ (Fin.succAbove_ne i t)]
        obtain ⟨hT1, hT2, hT3, hT4⟩ := hTspec x b hxb hpotx1 f hf hxfx hb
        refine ⟨by rw [hrun2]; exact le_trans hax hT1, by rw [hrun2]; exact hT2,
          by rw [hrun2]; exact hT3, ?_⟩
        rw [hcost2]
        have hp3 : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) x b + 1 ≤
            tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b := by
          rw [hxdef]; exact hpstep.1
        calc TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) +
              (TarskiQueryTree.cost f (T x b hguard.2.1 hguard.2.2.1) + 1)
            ≤ q + ((tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) x b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1))
                + 1) := by omega
          _ = (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) x b + 1) * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
              ring
          _ ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
              apply Nat.add_le_add_right
              exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hp3
      · have h3 : f x i < x i := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h2) h1
        have hrun3 : TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) =
            TarskiQueryTree.run f (T a x hguard.1 hguard.2.2.2) := by
          rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_2, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
        have hcost3 : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (g x) =
            TarskiQueryTree.cost f (T a x hguard.1 hguard.2.2.2) + 1 := by
          rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.cost.eq_2, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
        have hfxx : f x ≤ x := by
          intro j
          rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove i j with hji | ⟨t, ht⟩
          · rw [hji]; exact le_of_lt h3
          · rw [ht]; rw [hxsliced _ (Fin.succAbove_ne i t)]
        obtain ⟨hT1, hT2, hT3, hT4⟩ := hTspec a x hax hpotx2 f hf ha hfxx
        refine ⟨by rw [hrun3]; exact hT1, by rw [hrun3]; exact le_trans hT2 hxb,
          by rw [hrun3]; exact hT3, ?_⟩
        rw [hcost3]
        have hp3 : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a x + 1 ≤
            tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b := by
          rw [hxdef]; exact hpstep.2
        calc TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) +
              (TarskiQueryTree.cost f (T a x hguard.1 hguard.2.2.2) + 1)
            ≤ q + ((tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a x * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1))
                + 1) := by omega
          _ = (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a x + 1) * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
              ring
          _ ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
              apply Nat.add_le_add_right
              exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hp3
  obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, k4⟩ := key
  exact ⟨by rw [hbs.1, hrun_lift]; exact k1,
         by rw [hbs.1, hrun_lift]; exact k2,
         by rw [hbs.1, hrun_lift]; exact k3,
         by rw [hbs.2, hrun_lift]; exact k4⟩

/-- Main induction: every box admits a tree with cost at most `Φ · (q+1) + 2^(k+1)`. -/
theorem tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_aux (n k q : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (h : tarski_box_query_le n k q) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (a b : Fin (k+1) → Fin n), a ≤ b →
      tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b ≤ m →
      ∃ t : TarskiQueryTree n (k+1),
        ∀ f : (Fin (k+1) → Fin n) → Fin (k+1) → Fin n,
          Monotone f → a ≤ f a → f b ≤ b →
            a ≤ TarskiQueryTree.run f t ∧ TarskiQueryTree.run f t ≤ b ∧
            f (TarskiQueryTree.run f t) = TarskiQueryTree.run f t ∧
            TarskiQueryTree.cost f t ≤
              tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h m ih =>
    intro a b hab hpot
    by_cases hsmall : ∀ i : Fin (k+1), (b i : ℕ) - (a i) ≤ 1
    · refine ⟨tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute a (Finset.Icc a b).toList, ?_⟩
      intro f hf ha hb
      obtain ⟨x0, hx0a, hx0b, hx0f⟩ := tarski_subinterval_fixed_point n (k+1) f hf a b hab ha hb
      have hL : ∃ y ∈ (Finset.Icc a b).toList, f y = y :=
        ⟨x0, by rw [Finset.mem_toList, Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨hx0a, hx0b⟩, hx0f⟩
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute_spec a
        (Finset.Icc a b).toList f hL
      rw [Finset.mem_toList, Finset.mem_Icc] at h1
      refine ⟨h1.1, h1.2, h2, ?_⟩
      have hcard : (Finset.Icc a b).card ≤ 2 ^ (k+1) := by
        rw [Pi.card_Icc]
        calc ∏ i : Fin (k+1), (Finset.Icc (a i) (b i)).card ≤ ∏ _i : Fin (k+1), 2 := by
              apply Finset.prod_le_prod
              · intro i _; simp
              · intro i _
                rw [Fin.card_Icc]
                have h2' := hab i
                have h3' := hsmall i
                omega
          _ = 2 ^ (k+1) := by simp
      rw [Finset.length_toList] at h3
      exact le_trans h3 (le_trans hcard (Nat.le_add_left _ _))
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_forall.mp hsmall
      exact tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_step n k q m h ih a b hab hpot i (by omega)

/-- Halving recursion: one extra dimension costs a multiplicative factor log₂ n. -/
theorem tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving (n k q : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (h : tarski_box_query_le n k q) :
    tarski_box_query_le n (k+1) (3 * (k+1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 2) * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1)) := by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_aux n k q h
    (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b) a b hab (le_refl _)
  refine ⟨t, fun f hf ha hb => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ht f hf ha hb
  refine ⟨h1, h2, h3, le_trans h4 ?_⟩
  have hpot1 : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b ≤ (k+1) * Nat.clog 2 n := by
    unfold tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot
    calc ∑ j : Fin (k+1), Nat.clog 2 ((b j : ℕ) - (a j)) ≤ ∑ _j : Fin (k+1), Nat.clog 2 n := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j _
          refine Nat.clog_mono (b := 2) (c := 2) (by norm_num) (le_refl 2) ?_
          have h1' : (b j : ℕ) < n := Fin.is_lt (b j)
          omega
      _ = (k+1) * Nat.clog 2 n := by simp
  have hclog : Nat.clog 2 n ≤ Nat.log 2 n + 1 := by
    have hb : 1 < 2 := by norm_num
    rw [Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow hb]
    exact Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self hb n)
  have hL : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b ≤
      3 * (k+1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 2) := by
    have hstep1 : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b ≤
        (k+1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) := le_trans hpot1 (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hclog)
    have hstep2 : (k+1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) ≤ 3 * (k+1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 2) := by
      have h1' : Nat.log 2 n + 1 ≤ 3 * (Nat.log 2 n + 2) := by omega
      calc (k+1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 1) ≤ (k+1) * (3 * (Nat.log 2 n + 2)) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h1'
        _ = 3 * (k+1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 2) := by ring
    exact le_trans hstep1 hstep2
  have hmul : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) ≤
      3 * (k+1) * (Nat.log 2 n + 2) * (q + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hL
  exact Nat.add_le_add_right hmul _

explanation.summary: This proof establishes the logarithmic-overhead dimension reduction for Tarski fixed-point search on a discrete box. By defining a potential function measuring the sum of log-lengths of the coordinate intervals, each bisection step along a coordinate of length at least 2 strictly reduces the potential while slicing onto a (k)-dimensional problem. Strong induction on the potential then bounds the total query complexity to (3(k+1)(\log_2 n + 2)(q+1) + 2^{k+1}).

  set m := Nat.clog 2 d with hm
  have hmpos : 0 < m := Nat.clog_pos hb (by omega)

    rw [Nat.pow_succ]

    omega
  have := (Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow hb).mpr hle
  omega

  | cons x xs ih =>
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hfw⟩ := hL
    rw [List.mem_cons] at hw
    simp only [tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_brute, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_2,

      refine ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h1, h2, ?_⟩
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega

steps.explanation: step
steps.code:
classical
  have hcval_lt : (a i : ℕ) + ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2 < n := by
    have hbn : (b i : ℕ) < n := Fin.is_lt (b i)
    have hdle : ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2 ≤ (b i : ℕ) - (a i) := Nat.div_le_self _ _
    omega
  set c : Fin n := ⟨(a i : ℕ) + ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2, hcval_lt⟩ with hcdef
  have hcval : (c : ℕ) = (a i : ℕ) + ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) / 2 := by rw [hcdef]
  have hac : a i ≤ c := by rw [Fin.le_def, hcval]; omega
  have hcb : c ≤ b i := by rw [Fin.le_def, hcval]; omega
  obtain ⟨tq, htq⟩ := h (a ∘ i.succAbove) (b ∘ i.succAbove) (fun j => hab (i.succAbove j))
  let T : ∀ (u v : Fin (k+1) → Fin n), u ≤ v →
      tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) u v < m → TarskiQueryTree n (k+1) :=
    fun u v huv hp => Classical.choose
      (ih (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) u v) hp u v huv (le_refl _))
  have hTspec : ∀ (u v : Fin (k+1) → Fin n) (huv : u ≤ v)
      (hp : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) u v < m),
      ∀ f : (Fin (k+1) → Fin n) → Fin (k+1) → Fin n, Monotone f → u ≤ f u → f v ≤ v →
        u ≤ TarskiQueryTree.run f (T u v huv hp) ∧
        TarskiQueryTree.run f (T u v huv hp) ≤ v ∧
        f (TarskiQueryTree.run f (T u v huv hp)) = TarskiQueryTree.run f (T u v huv hp) ∧
        TarskiQueryTree.cost f (T u v huv hp) ≤
          tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) u v * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
    intro u v huv hp f hf hu hv
    exact Classical.choose_spec
      (ih (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) u v) hp u v huv (le_refl _)) f hf hu hv
  let g : (Fin (k+1) → Fin n) → TarskiQueryTree n (k+1) := fun w =>
    if hw : a ≤ w ∧ w ≤ b ∧ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) w b < m ∧
        tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a w < m then
      TarskiQueryTree.query w (fun v =>
        if v i = w i then TarskiQueryTree.output w
        else if w i < v i then T w b hw.2.1 hw.2.2.1
        else T a w hw.1 hw.2.2.2)
    else TarskiQueryTree.output w
  refine ⟨tarski_query_tree_bind g (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq), ?_⟩
  intro f hf ha hb
  obtain ⟨hg_mono, hga, hgb, hglift⟩ :=
    tarski_slice_subbox_monotone_and_fixed n k f hf a b ha hb i c hac hcb
  obtain ⟨hya, hyb, hyfix, hycost⟩ :=
    htq (fun y j => f (i.insertNth c y) (i.succAbove j)) hg_mono hga hgb
  set y : Fin k → Fin n := TarskiQueryTree.run (fun y j => f (i.insertNth c y) (i.succAbove j)) tq
    with hydef
  set x : Fin (k+1) → Fin n := i.insertNth c y with hxdef
  obtain ⟨hax, hxb, hxsliced⟩ := hglift y hya hyb hyfix
  have hrun_lift : TarskiQueryTree.run f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) = x := by
    rw [(tarski_query_tree_slice_lift_spec i c f tq).1]
  have hcost_lift : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) =
      TarskiQueryTree.cost (fun y j => f (i.insertNth c y) (i.succAbove j)) tq :=
    (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift_spec i c f tq).2
  have hlq : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) ≤ q := by
    rw [hcost_lift]; exact hycost
  have hpstep := tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot_step n k a b i c hac hcb hstep
    (by rw [hcval]; omega) y hya hyb
  have hpotx1 : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) x b < m :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hpstep.1 hpot
  have hpotx2 : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a x < m :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hpstep.2 hpot
  have hguard : a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ b ∧ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) x b < m ∧
      tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a x < m := ⟨hax, hxb, hpotx1, hpotx2⟩
  have hgx : g x = TarskiQueryTree.query x (fun v =>
      if v i = x i then TarskiQueryTree.output x
      else if x i < v i then T x b hguard.2.1 hguard.2.2.1
      else T a x hguard.1 hguard.2.2.2) := by
    simp only [g]
    rw [dif_pos hguard]
  have hpotpos : 1 ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b := by
    have hpos : 0 < Nat.clog 2 ((b i : ℕ) - (a i)) := Nat.clog_pos (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have := Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun j : Fin (k+1) => Nat.clog 2 ((b j : ℕ) - (a j)))
      (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    unfold tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot
    omega
  have hbs := tarski_query_tree_bind_spec g f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq)
  have key : a ≤ TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) ∧ TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) ≤ b ∧
      f (TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x)) = TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) ∧
      TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) + TarskiQueryTree.cost f (g x)
        ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
    by_cases h1 : f x i = x i
    · have hrun1 : TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) = x := by
        rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_2, if_pos h1, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_1]
      have hcost1 : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (g x) = 1 := by
        rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.cost.eq_2, if_pos h1, TarskiQueryTree.cost.eq_1]
      have hfixx : f x = x := by
        funext j
        rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove i j with hji | ⟨t, ht⟩
        · rw [hji]; exact h1
        · rw [ht]
          exact hxsliced _ (Fin.succAbove_ne i t)
      refine ⟨by rw [hrun1]; exact hax, by rw [hrun1]; exact hxb, by rw [hrun1]; exact hfixx, ?_⟩
      rw [hcost1]
      have h1' : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) + 1 ≤ q + 1 := by omega
      have h2' : q + 1 ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) := by
        calc q + 1 = 1 * (q + 1) := by ring
          _ ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) :=
              Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hpotpos
      exact le_trans h1' (le_trans h2' (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
    · by_cases h2 : x i < f x i
      · have hrun2 : TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) =
            TarskiQueryTree.run f (T x b hguard.2.1 hguard.2.2.1) := by
          rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_2, if_neg h1, if_pos h2]
        have hcost2 : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (g x) =
            TarskiQueryTree.cost f (T x b hguard.2.1 hguard.2.2.1) + 1 := by
          rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.cost.eq_2, if_neg h1, if_pos h2]
        have hxfx : x ≤ f x := by
          intro j
          rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove i j with hji | ⟨t, ht⟩
          · rw [hji]; exact le_of_lt h2
          · rw [ht]; rw [hxsliced _ (Fin.succAbove_ne i t)]
        obtain ⟨hT1, hT2, hT3, hT4⟩ := hTspec x b hxb hpotx1 f hf hxfx hb
        refine ⟨by rw [hrun2]; exact le_trans hax hT1, by rw [hrun2]; exact hT2,
          by rw [hrun2]; exact hT3, ?_⟩

        have hp3 : tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) x b + 1 ≤
            tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b := by
          rw [hxdef]; exact hpstep.1
        calc TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) +

            ≤ q + ((tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) x b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1))
                + 1) := by omega
          _ = (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) x b + 1) * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
              ring
          _ ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
              apply Nat.add_le_add_right
              exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hp3

        have hrun3 : TarskiQueryTree.run f (g x) =
            TarskiQueryTree.run f (T a x hguard.1 hguard.2.2.2) := by
          rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.run.eq_2, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
        have hcost3 : TarskiQueryTree.cost f (g x) =
            TarskiQueryTree.cost f (T a x hguard.1 hguard.2.2.2) + 1 := by
          rw [hgx, TarskiQueryTree.cost.eq_2, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]

        calc TarskiQueryTree.cost f (tarski_query_tree_slice_lift i c tq) +
              (TarskiQueryTree.cost f (T a x hguard.1 hguard.2.2.2) + 1)
            ≤ q + ((tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a x * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1))
                + 1) := by omega
          _ = (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a x + 1) * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
              ring
          _ ≤ tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving_pot n (k+1) a b * (q + 1) + 2 ^ (k+1) := by
              apply Nat.add_le_add_right
              exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hp3
  obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3, k4⟩ := key
  exact ⟨by rw [hbs.1, hrun_lift]; exact k1,
         by rw [hbs.1, hrun_lift]; exact k2,
         by rw [hbs.1, hrun_lift]; exact k3,
         by rw [hbs.2, hrun_lift]; exact k4⟩

intro m

              · intro i _; simp
              · intro i _
                rw [Fin.card_Icc]

declarations.name: tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog
declarations.informal: Multidimensional Tarski search is polylogarithmic: for every fixed k there is a constant C with Tarski(n,k) ≤ C·(log₂ n + 2)^k for all n ≥ 1. In particular Tarski(n,5) = O(log⁵ n).
declarations.statement:
theorem tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      tarski_query_complexity_le n k (C * (Nat.log 2 n + 2) ^ k)
declarations.source:
lemma tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_mono (n k q q' : ℕ)
    (h : tarski_box_query_le n k q) (hqq' : q ≤ q') : tarski_box_query_le n k q' := by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h a b hab
  exact ⟨t, fun f hf ha hb => ⟨(ht f hf ha hb).1, (ht f hf ha hb).2.1,
    (ht f hf ha hb).2.2.1, (ht f hf ha hb).2.2.2.trans hqq'⟩⟩

lemma tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_arith (k C p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    3 * (k + 1) * p * (C * p^k + 1) + 2^(k+1) ≤ (3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1) + 1) * p^(k+1) := by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ p^k := Nat.one_le_pow k p (by omega)
  have h2 : 2^(k+1) ≤ p^(k+1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hp (k+1)
  have h3 : p^(k+1) = p^k * p := Nat.pow_succ p k
  have h4 : C * p^k + 1 ≤ (C + 1) * p^k := by nlinarith
  have hA : 3 * (k + 1) * p * (C * p^k + 1) ≤ 3 * (k + 1) * p * ((C + 1) * p^k) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left (3 * (k + 1) * p) h4
  have hB : 3 * (k + 1) * p * ((C + 1) * p^k) = (3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1)) * p^(k+1) := by
    rw [h3]; ring
  have hA' : 3 * (k + 1) * p * (C * p^k + 1) ≤ (3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1)) * p^(k+1) := by
    rw [← hB]; exact hA
  have hC := Nat.add_le_add hA' h2
  have hD : (3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1)) * p^(k+1) + p^(k+1) = (3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1) + 1) * p^(k+1) := by ring
  exact hC.trans_eq hD

lemma tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_box (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      tarski_box_query_le n k (C * (Nat.log 2 n + 2)^k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    haveI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
    have h : tarski_box_query_le n 0 1 :=
      tarski_box_query_le_small n 0 1 (fun a b hab => by simp)
    simpa using h
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1) + 1, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    haveI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
    have hb := hC n hn
    have hs := tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving n k (C * (Nat.log 2 n + 2)^k) hb
    refine tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_mono n (k+1) _ _ hs ?_
    exact tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_arith k C (Nat.log 2 n + 2) (by omega)

/-- Multidimensional Tarski search is polylogarithmic with exponent k; in particular Tarski(n,5) = O(log⁵ n). -/
theorem tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      tarski_query_complexity_le n k (C * (Nat.log 2 n + 2) ^ k) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_box k
  exact ⟨C, fun n hn => tarski_box_query_le_imp_query_complexity n k
    (C * (Nat.log 2 n + 2)^k) hn (hC n hn)⟩

explanation.summary: The theorem is proved by induction on the dimension k, establishing that fixed-point search in any sub-box of [n]^k takes at most C·(log₂ n + 2)^k queries. In the base case k = 0, the domain is a singleton, so 1 query suffices. For the induction step, dimension halving reduces search in dimension k + 1 to dimension k at cost 3(k+1)p(q + 1) + 2^(k+1) with p = log₂ n + 2, which an algebraic lemma bounds by C'·p^(k+1). Finally, global Tarski search is a special case of sub-box search on the full domain, yielding the polylogarithmic query bound.

steps.claim: Sub-box query complexity is monotone in the query bound: if tarski_box_query_le n k q holds and q ≤ q', then tarski_box_query_le n k q' holds.
steps.explanation: Given any sub-box [a, b], the hypothesis provides a query tree t that finds a fixed point in at most q queries. By transitivity of ≤, its cost is also bounded by q'.
steps.code:
lemma tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_mono (n k q q' : ℕ)
    (h : tarski_box_query_le n k q) (hqq' : q ≤ q') : tarski_box_query_le n k q' := by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h a b hab
  exact ⟨t, fun f hf ha hb => ⟨(ht f hf ha hb).1, (ht f hf ha hb).2.1,
    (ht f hf ha hb).2.2.1, (ht f hf ha hb).2.2.2.trans hqq'⟩⟩

steps.explanation: Since p ≥ 2, we have p^k ≥ 1 and 2^(k+1) ≤ p^(k+1). From p^k ≥ 1, it follows that C p^k + 1 ≤ (C + 1)p^k. Multiplying both sides by 3(k+1)p and rewriting p^k * p as p^(k+1) yields 3(k+1)p(C p^k + 1) ≤ 3(k+1)(C+1)p^(k+1). Adding 2^(k+1) ≤ p^(k+1) to both sides gives the desired upper bound (3(k+1)(C+1) + 1)p^(k+1).
steps.code:
lemma tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_arith (k C p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    3 * (k + 1) * p * (C * p^k + 1) + 2^(k+1) ≤ (3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1) + 1) * p^(k+1) := by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ p^k := Nat.one_le_pow k p (by omega)
  have h2 : 2^(k+1) ≤ p^(k+1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hp (k+1)
  have h3 : p^(k+1) = p^k * p := Nat.pow_succ p k
  have h4 : C * p^k + 1 ≤ (C + 1) * p^k := by nlinarith
  have hA : 3 * (k + 1) * p * (C * p^k + 1) ≤ 3 * (k + 1) * p * ((C + 1) * p^k) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left (3 * (k + 1) * p) h4
  have hB : 3 * (k + 1) * p * ((C + 1) * p^k) = (3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1)) * p^(k+1) := by
    rw [h3]; ring
  have hA' : 3 * (k + 1) * p * (C * p^k + 1) ≤ (3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1)) * p^(k+1) := by
    rw [← hB]; exact hA
  have hC := Nat.add_le_add hA' h2
  have hD : (3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1)) * p^(k+1) + p^(k+1) = (3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1) + 1) * p^(k+1) := by ring
  exact hC.trans_eq hD

steps.claim: Base case k = 0: for any n ≥ 1, sub-box search in dimension 0 requires at most 1 · (log₂ n + 2)⁰ = 1 query.
steps.explanation: We proceed by induction on k. In dimension 0, any sub-box has volume equal to the empty product ∏_{j ∈ Fin 0} (b_j - a_j + 1) = 1. By tarski_box_query_le_small, at most 1 query is required, matching C · (log₂ n + 2)⁰ with C = 1.
steps.code:
lemma tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_box (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      tarski_box_query_le n k (C * (Nat.log 2 n + 2)^k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    haveI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
    have h : tarski_box_query_le n 0 1 :=
      tarski_box_query_le_small n 0 1 (fun a b hab => by simp)
    simpa using h

steps.claim: Inductive step: if dimension k has sub-box query bound C(log₂ n + 2)^k, then dimension k + 1 has bound C'(log₂ n + 2)^(k+1) with C' = 3(k+1)(C+1) + 1.
steps.explanation: Given the bound q = C(log₂ n + 2)^k in dimension k, domain halving (tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving) bounds the search cost in dimension k + 1 by 3(k+1)p(q + 1) + 2^(k+1), where p = log₂ n + 2. Since n ≥ 1, p ≥ 2, so the arithmetic lemma tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_arith bounds this by C' p^(k+1). Monotonicity (tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_mono) completes the step.
steps.code:
| succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨3 * (k + 1) * (C + 1) + 1, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    haveI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
    have hb := hC n hn
    have hs := tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving n k (C * (Nat.log 2 n + 2)^k) hb
    refine tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_mono n (k+1) _ _ hs ?_
    exact tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_arith k C (Nat.log 2 n + 2) (by omega)

steps.claim: Multidimensional Tarski search on [n]^k has query complexity bounded by C(log₂ n + 2)^k for all n ≥ 1.
steps.explanation: We obtain the constant C from the sub-box query bound tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_box. Finding a fixed point on the entire domain [n]^k is the special case of sub-box search on [(0,…,0), (n-1,…,n-1)], so tarski_box_query_le_imp_query_complexity implies the global query complexity bound.
steps.code:
theorem tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      tarski_query_complexity_le n k (C * (Nat.log 2 n + 2) ^ k) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_box k
  exact ⟨C, fun n hn => tarski_box_query_le_imp_query_complexity n k
    (C * (Nat.log 2 n + 2)^k) hn (hC n hn)⟩

glossary.Nat.add_le_add: If a + c ≤ b + d whenever a ≤ b and c ≤ d.
glossary.Nat.mul_le_mul_left: Multiplication on the left preserves order: if n ≤ m, then k * n ≤ k * m.
glossary.Nat.one_le_pow: A positive natural number raised to any power is at least 1.
glossary.Nat.pow_le_pow_left: Exponentiation preserves order in the base: if n ≤ m, then n^i ≤ m^i.
glossary.Nat.pow_succ: Power recurrence for natural numbers: n^(m+1) = n^m * n.
glossary.tarski_box_query_le_imp_query_complexity: A query bound for sub-box fixed-point search implies the same query bound for global fixed-point search on [n]^k.
glossary.tarski_box_query_le_small: If every sub-box in [n]^k has volume at most M, then fixed-point search in any sub-box requires at most M queries.
glossary.tarski_box_query_le_succ_halving: Domain halving reduces fixed-point search in dimension k + 1 to dimension k, with query bound 3(k+1)(log₂ n + 2)(q + 1) + 2^(k+1) given a bound of q in dimension k.
glossary.tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_arith: For any k, C and any p ≥ 2, the inequality 3(k+1)p(C p^k + 1) + 2^(k+1) ≤ (3(k+1)(C+1) + 1)p^(k+1) holds.
glossary.tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_box: For every dimension k, there exists a constant C such that sub-box fixed-point search on [n]^k requires at most C(log₂ n + 2)^k queries for all n ≥ 1.
glossary.tarski_query_complexity_le_polylog_mono: Sub-box query complexity is monotone in the query bound: if q ≤ q', any search tree with cost at most q also has cost at most q'.

caveats: The inductive step uses an offset p = log₂ n + 2 so that p ≥ 2 holds unconditionally for all n ≥ 1 (even when log₂ 1 = 0), ensuring the arithmetic inequality applies.
The base case instantiates the typeclass NeZero n via omega from 1 ≤ n, which is required by tarski_box_query_le_small.
The arithmetic step relies on nlinarith and ring for intermediate polynomial simplifications.

declarations.name: instanceHorizon
declarations.informal: The finite time horizon of a list of deadline requests, defined as one more than the maximum deadline, or zero if empty.
declarations.statement: def instanceHorizon {α : Type*} (reqs : List (DeadlineRequest α)) : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- The time horizon of a list of deadline requests. -/
def instanceHorizon {α : Type*} (reqs : List (DeadlineRequest α)) : ℕ := reqs.foldr (fun r m => max (r.deadline + 1) m) 0
declarations.reading: For a type `α` and a list `reqs` of `DeadlineRequest α`, `instanceHorizon reqs` is the natural number defined as the right fold over `reqs` starting from `0` with the operation `fun r m => max (r.deadline + 1) m`. In other words, it is `0` if `reqs` is empty, and `max_{r ∈ reqs} (r.deadline + 1)` (one greater than the maximum deadline among all requests in `reqs`) if `reqs` is non-empty.

declarations.name: simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order_eq_half_add_of_leaf_neighbor
declarations.informal: Leaf recursion: if ℓ is a leaf neighbour of v (G.Adj v ℓ and deg ℓ = 1), then avd_v(G) = 1/2 + avd_v(G - ℓ), where G - ℓ is the subgraph induced on V \ {ℓ} (which still contains v). Equivalently, the paper's identity (6) with l = 1.
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order_eq_half_add_of_leaf_neighbor {V : Type*}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {v ℓ : V}
    (hadj : G.Adj v ℓ) (hdeg : G.degree ℓ = 1) :
    simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order G v =
      1 / 2 + simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order
        (G.induce ((Finset.univ.erase ℓ : Finset V) : Set V))
        ⟨v, by simpa using G.ne_of_adj hadj⟩
declarations.source:
/-- Deleting a leaf neighbour of v costs exactly 1/2 in the local average order: avd_v(G) = 1/2 + avd_v(G - ℓ). -/
theorem simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order_eq_half_add_of_leaf_neighbor {V : Type*}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {v ℓ : V}
    (hadj : G.Adj v ℓ) (hdeg : G.degree ℓ = 1) :
    simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order G v =
      1 / 2 + simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order
        (G.induce ((Finset.univ.erase ℓ : Finset V) : Set V))
        ⟨v, by simpa using G.ne_of_adj hadj⟩ := by
  classical
  set A : Finset V := Finset.univ.erase ℓ with hA
  have hmemv : v ∈ A := by simp [hA, G.ne_of_adj hadj]
  set H : SimpleGraph ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V) := G.induce ((A : Finset V) : Set V) with hH
  set D : Finset (Finset V) := simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing G v with hD
  set D' : Finset (Finset ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V)) :=
    simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing H ⟨v, hmemv⟩ with hD'
  set D₀ : Finset (Finset V) := D.filter (fun S : Finset V => ℓ ∉ S) with hD₀
  set D₁ : Finset (Finset V) := D.filter (fun S : Finset V => ℓ ∈ S) with hD₁
  show simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order G v =
    1 / 2 + simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order H ⟨v, hmemv⟩
  have memD : ∀ S : Finset V, S ∈ D ↔ v ∈ S ∧ ∀ w : V, w ∈ S ∨ ∃ u ∈ S, G.Adj u w := by
    intro S; rw [hD]; simp [simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing]
  have memD' : ∀ T : Finset ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V),
      T ∈ D' ↔ ⟨v, hmemv⟩ ∈ T ∧
        ∀ w : ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V), w ∈ T ∨ ∃ u ∈ T, H.Adj u w := by
    intro T; rw [hD']; simp [simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing]
  have memD₀ : ∀ S : Finset V, S ∈ D₀ ↔ S ∈ D ∧ ℓ ∉ S := by
    intro S; rw [hD₀]; simp
  have memD₁ : ∀ S : Finset V, S ∈ D₁ ↔ S ∈ D ∧ ℓ ∈ S := by
    intro S; rw [hD₁]; simp
  have huniq : ∀ w : V, G.Adj ℓ w → w = v := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxu⟩ := (SimpleGraph.degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj (G := G) (v := ℓ)).mp hdeg
    have hvx : v = x := hxu v hadj.symm
    have hwx : w = x := hxu w hw
    rw [hwx, ← hvx]
  have hadjH : ∀ u w : ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V), H.Adj u w ↔ G.Adj u.1 w.1 := by
    intro u w; rw [hH]; exact SimpleGraph.induce_adj
  have erase_mem : ∀ S ∈ D, S.erase ℓ ∈ D := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hvS, hdom⟩ := (memD S).mp hS
    rw [memD]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨G.ne_of_adj hadj, hvS⟩, ?_⟩
    intro w
    by_cases hw : w = ℓ
    · subst hw
      exact Or.inr ⟨v, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨G.ne_of_adj hadj, hvS⟩, hadj⟩
    · by_cases hwS : w ∈ S
      · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hw, hwS⟩)
      · rcases hdom w with h | ⟨u, huS, huadj⟩
        · exact absurd h hwS
        · refine Or.inr ⟨u, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, huS⟩, huadj⟩
          rintro rfl
          exact hwS (by rw [huniq w huadj]; exact hvS)
  have insert_mem : ∀ S ∈ D, insert ℓ S ∈ D := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hvS, hdom⟩ := (memD S).mp hS
    rw [memD]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hvS, ?_⟩
    intro w
    rcases hdom w with h | ⟨u, huS, huadj⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨u, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem huS, huadj⟩
  have hi : ∀ S ∈ D₀, insert ℓ S ∈ D₁ := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hSD, hℓS⟩ := (memD₀ S).mp hS
    rw [memD₁]
    exact ⟨insert_mem S hSD, Finset.mem_insert_self ℓ S⟩
  have hj : ∀ S ∈ D₁, S.erase ℓ ∈ D₀ := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hSD, hℓS⟩ := (memD₁ S).mp hS
    rw [memD₀]
    exact ⟨erase_mem S hSD, by simp⟩
  have hleft : ∀ S ∈ D₀, (insert ℓ S).erase ℓ = S := by
    intro S hS; exact Finset.erase_insert ((memD₀ S).mp hS).2
  have hright : ∀ S ∈ D₁, insert ℓ (S.erase ℓ) = S := by
    intro S hS; exact Finset.insert_erase ((memD₁ S).mp hS).2
  have hcard_eq : D₀.card = D₁.card :=
    Finset.card_nbij' (fun S : Finset V => insert ℓ S) (fun S : Finset V => S.erase ℓ) hi hj hleft hright
  have hunion : D₁ ∪ D₀ = D := by
    rw [hD₁, hD₀, hD]
    exact Finset.filter_union_filter_not_eq (fun S : Finset V => ℓ ∈ S) D
  have hdisj : Disjoint D₁ D₀ := by
    rw [hD₁, hD₀]
    exact Finset.disjoint_filter_filter_not D D (fun S : Finset V => ℓ ∈ S)
  have hsum_split : (∑ S ∈ D, (S.card : ℚ)) = (∑ S ∈ D₀, (S.card : ℚ)) + (∑ S ∈ D₁, (S.card : ℚ)) := by
    rw [← hunion, Finset.sum_union hdisj, add_comm]
  have hcard_split : D.card = D₀.card + D₁.card := by
    rw [← hunion, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, add_comm]
  have hcard : D.card = 2 * D₀.card := by omega
  have hshift : (∑ S ∈ D₁, (S.card : ℚ)) = (∑ S ∈ D₀, (S.card : ℚ)) + (D₀.card : ℚ) := by
    have h := Finset.sum_nbij' (s := D₀) (t := D₁)
      (f := fun S : Finset V => (S.card : ℚ) + 1) (g := fun S : Finset V => (S.card : ℚ))
      (fun S : Finset V => insert ℓ S) (fun S : Finset V => S.erase ℓ) hi hj hleft hright
      (fun S hS => by rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ((memD₀ S).mp hS).2]; push_cast; ring)
    rw [← h, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hfil : ∀ S ∈ D₀, S.filter (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) = S := by
    intro S hS
    rw [Finset.filter_eq_self]
    intro x hx
    have hℓS : ℓ ∉ S := ((memD₀ S).mp hS).2
    simp only [hA, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Finset.mem_coe]
    intro hxℓ
    exact hℓS (hxℓ ▸ hx)
  have hcomp1 : ∀ S ∈ D₀, Finset.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)))
      (Finset.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) S) = S := by
    intro S hS
    rw [Finset.subtype_map]
    exact hfil S hS
  have hcomp2 : ∀ T ∈ D', Finset.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V))
      (Finset.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V))) T) = T := by
    intro T _
    ext a
    simp [Finset.mem_subtype]
  have hsub : ∀ S ∈ D₀, Finset.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) S ∈ D' := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hSD, hℓS⟩ := (memD₀ S).mp hS
    obtain ⟨hvS, hdom⟩ := (memD S).mp hSD
    rw [memD']
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_subtype.mpr hvS, ?_⟩
    intro w
    by_cases hwS : w.1 ∈ S
    · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_subtype.mpr hwS)
    · rcases hdom w.1 with h | ⟨u, huS, huadj⟩
      · exact absurd h hwS
      · have huℓ : u ≠ ℓ := by
          rintro rfl
          exact hwS (by rw [huniq w.1 huadj]; exact hvS)
        refine Or.inr ⟨⟨u, ?_⟩, Finset.mem_subtype.mpr huS, ?_⟩
        · simp only [hA, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Finset.mem_coe]
          exact huℓ
        · rw [hadjH]; exact huadj
  have hmap : ∀ T ∈ D', Finset.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V))) T ∈ D₀ := by
    intro T hT
    obtain ⟨hv'T, hdom⟩ := (memD' T).mp hT
    rw [memD₀, memD]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨v, hmemv⟩, hv'T, rfl⟩
    · intro w
      by_cases hw : w = ℓ
      · subst hw
        exact Or.inr ⟨v, Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨v, hmemv⟩, hv'T, rfl⟩, hadj⟩
      · have hwA : w ∈ A := by simp [hA, hw]
        rcases hdom ⟨w, hwA⟩ with h | ⟨u, huT, huadj⟩
        · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨w, hwA⟩, h, rfl⟩)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨u.1, Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨u, huT, rfl⟩, (hadjH u ⟨w, hwA⟩).mp huadj⟩
    · intro hℓ
      obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hℓ
      have haA : a.1 ∈ A := a.2
      have h1 : a.1 = ℓ := by simpa using ha
      rw [h1] at haA
      simp [hA] at haA
  have hsum_trans : (∑ S ∈ D₀, (S.card : ℚ)) = (∑ T ∈ D', (T.card : ℚ)) := by
    refine Finset.sum_nbij' (s := D₀) (t := D')
      (f := fun S : Finset V => (S.card : ℚ)) (g := fun T : Finset ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V) => (T.card : ℚ))
      (fun S : Finset V => Finset.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) S)
      (fun T => Finset.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V))) T)
      hsub hmap hcomp1 hcomp2 ?_
    intro S hS
    rw [Finset.card_subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) S, hfil S hS]
  have hcard_trans : D₀.card = D'.card :=
    Finset.card_nbij' (fun S : Finset V => Finset.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) S)
      (fun T => Finset.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V))) T)
      hsub hmap hcomp1 hcomp2
  have hD₀ne : D₀.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨Finset.univ.erase ℓ, ?_⟩
    rw [memD₀]
    refine ⟨erase_mem Finset.univ ?_, by simp⟩
    rw [memD]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ v, fun w => Or.inl (Finset.mem_univ w)⟩
  have hG : simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order G v = (∑ S ∈ D, (S.card : ℚ)) / (D.card : ℚ) := by
    rw [simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order, ← hD]
  have hH' : simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order H ⟨v, hmemv⟩ =
      (∑ T ∈ D', (T.card : ℚ)) / (D'.card : ℚ) := by
    rw [simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order, ← hD']
  rw [hG, hH']
  have hmain : (∑ S ∈ D, (S.card : ℚ)) = 2 * (∑ S ∈ D₀, (S.card : ℚ)) + (D₀.card : ℚ) := by
    rw [hsum_split, hshift]; ring
  have hcardq : (D.card : ℚ) = 2 * (D₀.card : ℚ) := by rw [hcard]; push_cast; ring
  have hcardq' : (D'.card : ℚ) = (D₀.card : ℚ) := by rw [← hcard_trans]
  have hn : (D₀.card : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have h : 0 < D₀.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hD₀ne
    exact_mod_cast h.ne'
  rw [hmain, hcardq, ← hsum_trans, hcardq']
  field_simp
  ring

explanation.summary: The theorem establishes the leaf recursion for the local average dominating order: deleting a leaf neighbor ℓ of v reduces the local average order avd_v(G) by exactly 1/2. Because v is the unique neighbor of ℓ and every dominating set under consideration contains v, ℓ is automatically dominated, and ℓ can only dominate v; consequently, adding or removing ℓ is a bijection between dominating sets containing v that avoid ℓ (D₀) and those that contain ℓ (D₁). Domination sets avoiding ℓ correspond bijectively to dominating sets of the induced subgraph G - ℓ containing v, and since exactly half of the dominating sets in G contain ℓ (increasing their size by 1), the average size increases by exactly 1/2.

steps.claim: The vertex v belongs to A = V \ {ℓ}, and the dominating sets of G containing v are partitioned into sets D₀ (not containing ℓ) and D₁ (containing ℓ).
steps.explanation: Because v is adjacent to ℓ, v ≠ ℓ (by G.ne_of_adj), so v remains a valid vertex in the induced subgraph H = G - ℓ on A = V \ {ℓ}. We let D be the collection of dominating sets of G containing v, D' the dominating sets of H containing v, and partition D into D₀ (those avoiding ℓ) and D₁ (those containing ℓ).
steps.code:
⟨v, by simpa using G.ne_of_adj hadj⟩ := by
  classical
  set A : Finset V := Finset.univ.erase ℓ with hA
  have hmemv : v ∈ A := by simp [hA, G.ne_of_adj hadj]
  set H : SimpleGraph ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V) := G.induce ((A : Finset V) : Set V) with hH
  set D : Finset (Finset V) := simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing G v with hD
  set D' : Finset (Finset ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V)) :=
    simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing H ⟨v, hmemv⟩ with hD'
  set D₀ : Finset (Finset V) := D.filter (fun S : Finset V => ℓ ∉ S) with hD₀
  set D₁ : Finset (Finset V) := D.filter (fun S : Finset V => ℓ ∈ S) with hD₁
  show simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order G v =
    1 / 2 + simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order H ⟨v, hmemv⟩

steps.claim: The membership criteria for D, D', D₀, and D₁ are explicitly stated in terms of domination and vertex inclusion.
steps.explanation: By definition of simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing, a set S belongs to D if and only if v ∈ S and every vertex w is either in S or adjacent to some vertex in S. The identical condition characterizes D' in H, while D₀ and D₁ additionally require ℓ ∉ S and ℓ ∈ S, respectively.
steps.code:
have memD : ∀ S : Finset V, S ∈ D ↔ v ∈ S ∧ ∀ w : V, w ∈ S ∨ ∃ u ∈ S, G.Adj u w := by
    intro S; rw [hD]; simp [simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing]
  have memD' : ∀ T : Finset ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V),
      T ∈ D' ↔ ⟨v, hmemv⟩ ∈ T ∧
        ∀ w : ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V), w ∈ T ∨ ∃ u ∈ T, H.Adj u w := by
    intro T; rw [hD']; simp [simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing]
  have memD₀ : ∀ S : Finset V, S ∈ D₀ ↔ S ∈ D ∧ ℓ ∉ S := by
    intro S; rw [hD₀]; simp
  have memD₁ : ∀ S : Finset V, S ∈ D₁ ↔ S ∈ D ∧ ℓ ∈ S := by
    intro S; rw [hD₁]; simp

steps.claim: The vertex v is the unique neighbor of ℓ in G.
steps.explanation: Because the degree of ℓ is 1, ℓ has a unique neighbor (SimpleGraph.degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj). Since ℓ is adjacent to v, any neighbor w of ℓ must equal v.
steps.code:
have huniq : ∀ w : V, G.Adj ℓ w → w = v := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxu⟩ := (SimpleGraph.degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj (G := G) (v := ℓ)).mp hdeg
    have hvx : v = x := hxu v hadj.symm
    have hwx : w = x := hxu w hw
    rw [hwx, ← hvx]

steps.claim: Adjacency in the induced subgraph H is equivalent to adjacency in G.
steps.explanation: By definition of an induced subgraph, two vertices of H are adjacent if and only if their underlying vertices in V are adjacent in G (SimpleGraph.induce_adj).
steps.code:
have hadjH : ∀ u w : ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V), H.Adj u w ↔ G.Adj u.1 w.1 := by
    intro u w; rw [hH]; exact SimpleGraph.induce_adj

steps.claim: If S is a dominating set of G containing v, then both S \ {ℓ} and S ∪ {ℓ} are also dominating sets containing v.
steps.explanation: Since v ≠ ℓ, removing ℓ from S does not remove v. The vertex ℓ itself is dominated by v ∈ S \ {ℓ} because v is adjacent to ℓ. Any other vertex w ≠ ℓ that relied on ℓ for domination must be adjacent to ℓ, hence w = v by uniqueness of the neighbor of ℓ; but v is already in S \ {ℓ}. Thus S \ {ℓ} is still a dominating set containing v (Finset.mem_erase.mpr). Conversely, inserting ℓ into S trivially preserves domination and keeps v (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem).
steps.code:
have erase_mem : ∀ S ∈ D, S.erase ℓ ∈ D := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hvS, hdom⟩ := (memD S).mp hS
    rw [memD]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨G.ne_of_adj hadj, hvS⟩, ?_⟩
    intro w
    by_cases hw : w = ℓ
    · subst hw
      exact Or.inr ⟨v, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨G.ne_of_adj hadj, hvS⟩, hadj⟩
    · by_cases hwS : w ∈ S
      · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hw, hwS⟩)
      · rcases hdom w with h | ⟨u, huS, huadj⟩
        · exact absurd h hwS
        · refine Or.inr ⟨u, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, huS⟩, huadj⟩
          rintro rfl
          exact hwS (by rw [huniq w huadj]; exact hvS)
  have insert_mem : ∀ S ∈ D, insert ℓ S ∈ D := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hvS, hdom⟩ := (memD S).mp hS
    rw [memD]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hvS, ?_⟩
    intro w
    rcases hdom w with h | ⟨u, huS, huadj⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨u, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem huS, huadj⟩

steps.claim: The operation of inserting ℓ gives a bijection from D₀ to D₁ with inverse erasing ℓ, so |D₀| = |D₁|.
steps.explanation: Adding ℓ to any S ∈ D₀ yields an element of D₁ (Finset.mem_insert_self), and erasing ℓ from any S ∈ D₁ yields an element of D₀. These maps are two-sided inverses on their respective domains (Finset.erase_insert, Finset.insert_erase). By Finset.card_nbij', D₀ and D₁ have the same cardinality.
steps.code:
have hi : ∀ S ∈ D₀, insert ℓ S ∈ D₁ := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hSD, hℓS⟩ := (memD₀ S).mp hS
    rw [memD₁]
    exact ⟨insert_mem S hSD, Finset.mem_insert_self ℓ S⟩
  have hj : ∀ S ∈ D₁, S.erase ℓ ∈ D₀ := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hSD, hℓS⟩ := (memD₁ S).mp hS
    rw [memD₀]
    exact ⟨erase_mem S hSD, by simp⟩
  have hleft : ∀ S ∈ D₀, (insert ℓ S).erase ℓ = S := by
    intro S hS; exact Finset.erase_insert ((memD₀ S).mp hS).2
  have hright : ∀ S ∈ D₁, insert ℓ (S.erase ℓ) = S := by
    intro S hS; exact Finset.insert_erase ((memD₁ S).mp hS).2
  have hcard_eq : D₀.card = D₁.card :=
    Finset.card_nbij' (fun S : Finset V => insert ℓ S) (fun S : Finset V => S.erase ℓ) hi hj hleft hright

steps.claim: The total count of dominating sets satisfies |D| = 2 |D₀|, and the sum of their sizes satisfies ∑_{S ∈ D} |S| = 2 ∑_{S ∈ D₀} |S| + |D₀|.
steps.explanation: The set D is the disjoint union of D₁ and D₀ (Finset.filter_union_filter_not_eq, Finset.disjoint_filter_filter_not), so |D| = |D₀| + |D₁| = 2 |D₀| (Finset.card_union_of_disjoint, add_comm). Under the bijection S ↦ S ∪ {ℓ}, each element of D₁ has cardinality |S| + 1 (Finset.card_insert_of_notMem). Summing over the bijection gives ∑_{S ∈ D₁} |S| = ∑_{S ∈ D₀} |S| + |D₀| (Finset.sum_nbij', Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one). Splitting the sum over D into the sums over D₀ and D₁ (Finset.sum_union) yields the claim.
steps.code:
have hunion : D₁ ∪ D₀ = D := by
    rw [hD₁, hD₀, hD]
    exact Finset.filter_union_filter_not_eq (fun S : Finset V => ℓ ∈ S) D
  have hdisj : Disjoint D₁ D₀ := by
    rw [hD₁, hD₀]
    exact Finset.disjoint_filter_filter_not D D (fun S : Finset V => ℓ ∈ S)
  have hsum_split : (∑ S ∈ D, (S.card : ℚ)) = (∑ S ∈ D₀, (S.card : ℚ)) + (∑ S ∈ D₁, (S.card : ℚ)) := by
    rw [← hunion, Finset.sum_union hdisj, add_comm]
  have hcard_split : D.card = D₀.card + D₁.card := by
    rw [← hunion, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, add_comm]
  have hcard : D.card = 2 * D₀.card := by omega
  have hshift : (∑ S ∈ D₁, (S.card : ℚ)) = (∑ S ∈ D₀, (S.card : ℚ)) + (D₀.card : ℚ) := by
    have h := Finset.sum_nbij' (s := D₀) (t := D₁)
      (f := fun S : Finset V => (S.card : ℚ) + 1) (g := fun S : Finset V => (S.card : ℚ))
      (fun S : Finset V => insert ℓ S) (fun S : Finset V => S.erase ℓ) hi hj hleft hright
      (fun S hS => by rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ((memD₀ S).mp hS).2]; push_cast; ring)
    rw [← h, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]

steps.claim: The canonical restriction to the subtype A = V \ {ℓ} defines a bijection between D₀ and D'.
steps.explanation: Any S ∈ D₀ does not contain ℓ, so filtering S by A leaves S unchanged (Finset.filter_eq_self, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true). Restricting S to the subtype A yields a dominating set in H containing v (Finset.mem_subtype.mpr) because any vertex dominated in G must be dominated by a vertex other than ℓ. In the other direction, mapping a dominating set T of H into V yields a dominating set in G containing v and avoiding ℓ (Finset.mem_map.mpr, Finset.mem_map.mp), since v ∈ T dominates ℓ. These maps are mutual inverses (Finset.subtype_map, Finset.mem_subtype).
steps.code:
have hfil : ∀ S ∈ D₀, S.filter (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) = S := by
    intro S hS
    rw [Finset.filter_eq_self]
    intro x hx
    have hℓS : ℓ ∉ S := ((memD₀ S).mp hS).2
    simp only [hA, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Finset.mem_coe]
    intro hxℓ
    exact hℓS (hxℓ ▸ hx)
  have hcomp1 : ∀ S ∈ D₀, Finset.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)))
      (Finset.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) S) = S := by
    intro S hS
    rw [Finset.subtype_map]
    exact hfil S hS
  have hcomp2 : ∀ T ∈ D', Finset.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V))
      (Finset.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V))) T) = T := by
    intro T _
    ext a
    simp [Finset.mem_subtype]
  have hsub : ∀ S ∈ D₀, Finset.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) S ∈ D' := by
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨hSD, hℓS⟩ := (memD₀ S).mp hS
    obtain ⟨hvS, hdom⟩ := (memD S).mp hSD
    rw [memD']
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_subtype.mpr hvS, ?_⟩
    intro w
    by_cases hwS : w.1 ∈ S
    · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_subtype.mpr hwS)
    · rcases hdom w.1 with h | ⟨u, huS, huadj⟩
      · exact absurd h hwS
      · have huℓ : u ≠ ℓ := by
          rintro rfl
          exact hwS (by rw [huniq w.1 huadj]; exact hvS)
        refine Or.inr ⟨⟨u, ?_⟩, Finset.mem_subtype.mpr huS, ?_⟩
        · simp only [hA, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Finset.mem_coe]
          exact huℓ
        · rw [hadjH]; exact huadj
  have hmap : ∀ T ∈ D', Finset.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V))) T ∈ D₀ := by
    intro T hT
    obtain ⟨hv'T, hdom⟩ := (memD' T).mp hT
    rw [memD₀, memD]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨v, hmemv⟩, hv'T, rfl⟩
    · intro w
      by_cases hw : w = ℓ
      · subst hw
        exact Or.inr ⟨v, Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨v, hmemv⟩, hv'T, rfl⟩, hadj⟩
      · have hwA : w ∈ A := by simp [hA, hw]
        rcases hdom ⟨w, hwA⟩ with h | ⟨u, huT, huadj⟩
        · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨w, hwA⟩, h, rfl⟩)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨u.1, Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨u, huT, rfl⟩, (hadjH u ⟨w, hwA⟩).mp huadj⟩
    · intro hℓ
      obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hℓ
      have haA : a.1 ∈ A := a.2
      have h1 : a.1 = ℓ := by simpa using ha
      rw [h1] at haA
      simp [hA] at haA

steps.claim: The cardinality and sum of orders for D₀ match those for D', and D₀ is nonempty.
steps.explanation: The subtype bijection preserves set cardinalities (Finset.card_subtype), so the sum of cardinalities and the total count of sets are preserved: ∑_{S ∈ D₀} |S| = ∑_{T ∈ D'} |T| and |D₀| = |D'| (Finset.sum_nbij', Finset.card_nbij'). Furthermore, D₀ is nonempty because V \ {ℓ} contains v and dominates G (Finset.mem_univ), providing an explicit witness in D₀.
steps.code:
have hsum_trans : (∑ S ∈ D₀, (S.card : ℚ)) = (∑ T ∈ D', (T.card : ℚ)) := by
    refine Finset.sum_nbij' (s := D₀) (t := D')
      (f := fun S : Finset V => (S.card : ℚ)) (g := fun T : Finset ↥((A : Finset V) : Set V) => (T.card : ℚ))
      (fun S : Finset V => Finset.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) S)
      (fun T => Finset.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V))) T)
      hsub hmap hcomp1 hcomp2 ?_
    intro S hS
    rw [Finset.card_subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) S, hfil S hS]
  have hcard_trans : D₀.card = D'.card :=
    Finset.card_nbij' (fun S : Finset V => Finset.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V)) S)
      (fun T => Finset.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (fun x : V => x ∈ ((A : Finset V) : Set V))) T)
      hsub hmap hcomp1 hcomp2
  have hD₀ne : D₀.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨Finset.univ.erase ℓ, ?_⟩
    rw [memD₀]
    refine ⟨erase_mem Finset.univ ?_, by simp⟩
    rw [memD]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ v, fun w => Or.inl (Finset.mem_univ w)⟩

steps.claim: The local average dominating order satisfies avd_v(G) = 1/2 + avd_v(H).
steps.explanation: By definition (simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order), the local average dominating order is the sum of set cardinalities divided by the number of sets. Substituting |D| = 2 |D'| and ∑_{S ∈ D} |S| = 2 ∑_{T ∈ D'} |T| + |D'| expresses avd_v(G) as (2 ∑ |T| + |D'|) / (2 |D'|) = 1/2 + (∑ |T|) / |D'| = 1/2 + avd_v(H). Since |D₀| > 0 (Finset.card_pos.mpr), denominators are nonzero, and clearing denominators with ring arithmetic confirms the identity.
steps.code:
have hG : simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order G v = (∑ S ∈ D, (S.card : ℚ)) / (D.card : ℚ) := by
    rw [simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order, ← hD]
  have hH' : simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order H ⟨v, hmemv⟩ =
      (∑ T ∈ D', (T.card : ℚ)) / (D'.card : ℚ) := by
    rw [simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order, ← hD']
  rw [hG, hH']
  have hmain : (∑ S ∈ D, (S.card : ℚ)) = 2 * (∑ S ∈ D₀, (S.card : ℚ)) + (D₀.card : ℚ) := by
    rw [hsum_split, hshift]; ring
  have hcardq : (D.card : ℚ) = 2 * (D₀.card : ℚ) := by rw [hcard]; push_cast; ring
  have hcardq' : (D'.card : ℚ) = (D₀.card : ℚ) := by rw [← hcard_trans]
  have hn : (D₀.card : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    have h : 0 < D₀.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hD₀ne
    exact_mod_cast h.ne'
  rw [hmain, hcardq, ← hsum_trans, hcardq']
  field_simp
  ring

glossary.G.ne_of_adj: Adjacent vertices in a simple graph are distinct: if G.Adj v w, then v ≠ w.
glossary.simple_graph_dominating_sets_containing: The set of dominating sets containing a given vertex v consists of all subsets S containing v such that every vertex is in S or adjacent to some vertex in S.
glossary.SimpleGraph.degree_eq_one_iff_existsUniq: A vertex has degree 1 if and only if it has a unique adjacent neighbor.
glossary.SimpleGraph.induce_adj: In an induced subgraph, two vertices are adjacent if and only if their underlying vertices are adjacent in the original graph.
glossary.Finset.mem_erase.mpr: An element belongs to S.erase b if it is distinct from b and belongs to S.
glossary.Finset.mem_insert_of_mem: If an element belongs to S, it also belongs to insert b S.
glossary.Finset.mem_insert_self: An element a always belongs to insert a S.
glossary.Finset.erase_insert: Erasing a from insert a S yields S, provided a ∉ S.
glossary.Finset.insert_erase: Inserting a into S.erase a yields S, provided a ∈ S.
glossary.Finset.card_nbij': Two finite sets have the same cardinality if there exist maps between them that are two-sided inverses on the sets.
glossary.Finset.filter_union_filter_not_eq: The union of elements of a finite set satisfying a predicate and those not satisfying it equals the original finite set.
glossary.Finset.disjoint_filter_filter_not: The subset of elements satisfying a predicate and the subset of elements not satisfying it are disjoint.
glossary.Finset.sum_union: The sum of a function over the union of two disjoint finite sets is the sum of the sums over each set.
glossary.add_comm: Addition in an additive magma is commutative: a + b = b + a.
glossary.Finset.card_union_of_disjoint: The cardinality of the union of two disjoint finite sets is the sum of their cardinalities.
glossary.Finset.sum_nbij': The sum of a function over a finite set equals the sum of another function over another finite set if there is a bijection between the sets that preserves the function values.
glossary.Finset.card_insert_of_notMem: Inserting an element not in a finite set increases its cardinality by 1.
glossary.Finset.sum_add_distrib: The sum of f(x) + g(x) over a finite set equals the sum of f(x) plus the sum of g(x).
glossary.Finset.sum_const: Summing a constant c over a finite set S equals |S| • c.
glossary.nsmul_eq_mul: Natural number scalar multiplication n • a equals n * a in a semiring.
glossary.mul_one: Multiplying by 1 leaves an element unchanged: a * 1 = a.
glossary.Finset.filter_eq_self: Filtering a finite set by a predicate yields the original set if and only if every element satisfies the predicate.
glossary.Finset.mem_erase: An element belongs to S.erase b if and only if it is not equal to b and belongs to S.
glossary.Finset.mem_univ: Every element of a finite type belongs to the universal finite set Finset.univ.
glossary.and_true: Conjunction of a proposition with True is equivalent to the proposition itself: p ∧ True = p.
glossary.Finset.subtype_map: Mapping a subtype finset back to the ambient type equals filtering the ambient set by the subtype predicate.
glossary.Finset.mem_subtype: A subtype element belongs to Finset.subtype p S if and only if its underlying value belongs to S.
glossary.Finset.mem_subtype.mpr: If the underlying value of a subtype element belongs to S, then the subtype element belongs to Finset.subtype p S.
glossary.Finset.mem_map.mpr: An element belongs to Finset.map f S if it is the image under f of some element in S.
glossary.Finset.mem_map.mp: If an element belongs to Finset.map f S, then it is the image under f of some element in S.
glossary.Finset.card_subtype: The cardinality of Finset.subtype p S equals the cardinality of the filtered finset Finset.filter p S.
glossary.simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order: The local average dominating order at v is the sum of the cardinalities of all dominating sets containing v, divided by the number of such dominating sets.
glossary.Finset.card_pos.mpr: A finite set has strictly positive cardinality if it is nonempty.

theorem simple_graph_local_avg_dominating_order_stem_le_of_card_le_two_mul_degree

  have h2 : (Fintype.card V : ℚ) ≤ 2 * (G.degree v : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hdeg
