declarations.statement: theorem glove_number_k3 : glove_number (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) = 2
declarations.source:
lemma glove_number_k3_cover (a b : Fin 1 × Bool) : b = a ∨ b = opp_glove_side a := by
  obtain ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, bb⟩ := a
  obtain ⟨⟨u', hu'⟩, bb'⟩ := b
  have hu2 : u = u' := by omega
  subst hu2
  rcases bb with _ | _ <;> rcases bb' with _ | _ <;> simp [opp_glove_side]

lemma glove_number_k3_opp_ne (a : Fin 1 × Bool) : opp_glove_side a ≠ a := by
  intro h1
  have := congrArg Prod.snd h1
  simp [opp_glove_side] at this

lemma glove_number_k3_opp_opp (a : Fin 1 × Bool) : opp_glove_side (opp_glove_side a) = a := by
  simp [opp_glove_side]

lemma glove_number_k3_clean_step {V : Type*} (a : Fin 1 × Bool) (p q : V)
    (t : Fin 1 × Bool → Set V)
    (ha : t a = {p}) (hb : t (opp_glove_side a) = {q})
    (h : Handshake V (Fin 1)) (hc : handshake_is_clean h t) :
    handshake_edge h = s(p, q) ∧
      (handshake_update_contam h t) a = {p} ∧
      (handshake_update_contam h t) (opp_glove_side a) = {q} := by
  have hoo := glove_number_k3_opp_opp a
  have hone := glove_number_k3_opp_ne a
  cases h with
  | single x b y =>
    rcases glove_number_k3_cover a b with rfl | rfl
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
      rw [ha, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at h1
      rw [hb, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at h2
      subst h1; subst h2
      exact ⟨rfl, by simp [handshake_update_contam, ha],
        by simp [handshake_update_contam, hb, hone]⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
      rw [hb, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at h1
      rw [hoo, ha, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at h2
      subst h1; subst h2
      exact ⟨Sym2.eq_swap, by simp [handshake_update_contam, ha, hoo, Ne.symm hone],
        by simp [handshake_update_contam, hb]⟩
  | double x b1 b2 y =>
    exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim b1.1 b2.1) hc.1

lemma glove_number_k3_edges_eq {V : Type*} (a : Fin 1 × Bool) (p q : V) :
    ∀ (seq : List (Handshake V (Fin 1))) (t : Fin 1 × Bool → Set V),
      t a = {p} → t (opp_glove_side a) = {q} → CleanHandshakeSeq seq t →
      ∀ h ∈ seq, handshake_edge h = s(p, q) := by
  intro seq
  induction seq with
  | nil => intro t ha hb hc h hh; exact absurd hh List.not_mem_nil
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    intro t ha hb hc
    cases hc with
    | cons _ _ t' hcle hrest =>
      have hstep := glove_number_k3_clean_step a p q t ha hb hd hcle
      intro h hh
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hh with rfl | hh
      · exact hstep.1
      · exact ih (handshake_update_contam hd t) hstep.2.1 hstep.2.2 hrest h hh

lemma glove_number_k3_all_edges_same :
    ∀ seq : List (Handshake (Fin 3) (Fin 1)),
      CleanHandshakeSeq seq (fun _ => (∅ : Set (Fin 3))) →
      ∃ e : Sym2 (Fin 3), ∀ h ∈ seq, handshake_edge h = e := by
  intro seq hclean
  rcases seq with _ | ⟨hd, tl⟩
  · exact ⟨s(0, 1), by intro h hh; exact absurd hh List.not_mem_nil⟩
  · cases hclean with
    | cons _ _ _ hc hrest =>
      cases hd with
      | single x a y =>
        refine ⟨s(x, y), ?_⟩
        have hone := glove_number_k3_opp_ne a
        have ht1 : (handshake_update_contam (Handshake.single x a y)
            (fun _ => (∅ : Set (Fin 3)))) a = {x} := by
          simp [handshake_update_contam]
        have ht2 : (handshake_update_contam (Handshake.single x a y)
            (fun _ => (∅ : Set (Fin 3)))) (opp_glove_side a) = {y} := by
          simp [handshake_update_contam, hone]
        intro h hh
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hh with rfl | hh
        · rfl
        · exact glove_number_k3_edges_eq a x y tl _ ht1 ht2 hrest h hh
      | double x b1 b2 y =>
        exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim b1.1 b2.1) hc.1

lemma glove_number_k3_no_one :
    ¬ has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) 1 := by
  rintro ⟨seq, hclean, hcover⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := glove_number_k3_all_edges_same seq hclean
  have hedge1 : s((0:Fin 3), (1:Fin 3)) ∈ (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)).edgeSet := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet]; simp
  have hedge2 : s((1:Fin 3), (2:Fin 3)) ∈ (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)).edgeSet := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet]; simp
  obtain ⟨h1, h1mem, h1e⟩ := hcover _ hedge1
  obtain ⟨h2, h2mem, h2e⟩ := hcover _ hedge2
  have he1 : s(0, 1) = e := by rw [← h1e, he h1 h1mem]
  have he2 : s(1, 2) = e := by rw [← h2e, he h2 h2mem]
  exact absurd (he1.trans he2.symm) (by decide)

lemma glove_number_k3_no_zero :
    ¬ has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) 0 := by
  rintro ⟨seq, hclean, hcover⟩
  have hempty : seq = [] := by
    rcases seq with _ | ⟨hd, tl⟩
    · rfl
    · exfalso
      cases hd with
      | single x a y => exact a.1.elim0
      | double x a b y => exact a.1.elim0
  have hedge1 : s((0:Fin 3), (1:Fin 3)) ∈ (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)).edgeSet := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet]; simp
  obtain ⟨h, hh, -⟩ := hcover _ hedge1
  rw [hempty] at hh
  exact absurd hh List.not_mem_nil

/-- The glove number of K_3 is 2. -/
theorem glove_number_k3 : glove_number (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) = 2 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa using glove_number_complete_graph_upper_bound 3 (by norm_num)
  · unfold glove_number
    have h2 : has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) 2 :=
      glove_number_complete_graph_upper_bound_has_clean_seq 2
    have hmem : sInf {k : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) k} ∈
        {k : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) k} :=
      Nat.sInf_mem ⟨2, h2⟩
    have h0 : sInf {k : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) k} ≠ 0 :=
      fun hc => glove_number_k3_no_zero (hc ▸ hmem)
    have h1 : sInf {k : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) k} ≠ 1 :=
      fun hc => glove_number_k3_no_one (hc ▸ hmem)
    omega
declarations.reading: The glove number of the complete graph on 3 vertices (`SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)`) is equal to 2; that is, the minimum number of gloves `k : ℕ` needed to execute a clean sequence of handshakes covering every edge of K₃ is 2.

explanation.summary: The glove number of the complete graph K₃ is proved to be 2 by establishing matching upper and lower bounds. The upper bound follows from the general bound for complete graphs, giving glove_number(K₃) ≤ 3 - 1 = 2. For the lower bound, 0 gloves is impossible because no handshakes can be formed to cover any edges. With 1 glove, double handshakes are impossible because only one glove exists, and once the sole glove is used in the first handshake, both sides are contaminated with distinct vertices; every subsequent clean handshake is forced to reuse the exact same edge, making it impossible to cover more than one of the three edges of K₃.

steps.claim: For any two glove sides a, b ∈ Fin 1 × Bool, either b = a or b = opp_glove_side a.
steps.explanation: Since Fin 1 has a single element 0, the glove indices of a and b are necessarily equal. A case analysis on the boolean components of a and b then shows that b is either identical to a or is its boolean flip, which by definition is opp_glove_side a.
steps.code:
obtain ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, bb⟩ := a
  obtain ⟨⟨u', hu'⟩, bb'⟩ := b
  have hu2 : u = u' := by omega
  subst hu2
  rcases bb with _ | _ <;> rcases bb' with _ | _ <;> simp [opp_glove_side]

steps.claim: A glove side a is never equal to its opposite side opp_glove_side a.
steps.explanation: Assuming opp_glove_side a = a, applying Prod.snd via congrArg yields that the boolean component equals its own negation, which is a contradiction.
steps.code:
intro h1
  have := congrArg Prod.snd h1
  simp [opp_glove_side] at this

steps.claim: Inverting the glove side twice returns the original side: opp_glove_side (opp_glove_side a) = a.
steps.explanation: By definition of opp_glove_side, the glove index is unchanged and the boolean component is negated twice, which simplifies to the original pair.
steps.code: simp [opp_glove_side]

steps.claim: In a 1-glove system where side a is contaminated by {p} and its opposite by {q}, any clean handshake covers edge s(p, q) and preserves these contaminations.
steps.explanation: First, double handshakes are impossible because Fin 1 has only one glove index, so the two distinct glove indices required by a double handshake cannot exist (Subsingleton.elim). For a single handshake using side b, by glove_number_k3_cover, either b = a or b = opp_glove_side a. In the first case, the cleanliness condition implies the participants must be p and q, so the edge is s(p, q), and updating the contaminations leaves {p} and {q} unchanged. In the second case, the participants are q and p, producing the symmetric edge s(q, p) = s(p, q) by Sym2.eq_swap, and updating again leaves the contaminations as {p} and {q}.
steps.code:
have hoo := glove_number_k3_opp_opp a
  have hone := glove_number_k3_opp_ne a
  cases h with
  | single x b y =>
    rcases glove_number_k3_cover a b with rfl | rfl
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
      rw [ha, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at h1
      rw [hb, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at h2
      subst h1; subst h2
      exact ⟨rfl, by simp [handshake_update_contam, ha],
        by simp [handshake_update_contam, hb, hone]⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
      rw [hb, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at h1
      rw [hoo, ha, Set.singleton_subset_iff] at h2
      subst h1; subst h2
      exact ⟨Sym2.eq_swap, by simp [handshake_update_contam, ha, hoo, Ne.symm hone],
        by simp [handshake_update_contam, hb]⟩
  | double x b1 b2 y =>
    exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim b1.1 b2.1) hc.1

steps.claim: If side a has contamination {p} and its opposite has {q}, every handshake in a clean sequence covers edge s(p, q).
steps.explanation: By induction on the handshake sequence. The base case of an empty sequence is vacuous. For the inductive step, glove_number_k3_clean_step shows that the head handshake covers edge s(p, q) and preserves the contamination state {p} and {q}. The induction hypothesis then applies to the rest of the sequence.
steps.code:
intro seq
  induction seq with
  | nil => intro t ha hb hc h hh; exact absurd hh List.not_mem_nil
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    intro t ha hb hc
    cases hc with
    | cons _ _ t' hcle hrest =>
      have hstep := glove_number_k3_clean_step a p q t ha hb hd hcle
      intro h hh
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hh with rfl | hh
      · exact hstep.1
      · exact ih (handshake_update_contam hd t) hstep.2.1 hstep.2.2 hrest h hh

steps.claim: In any clean handshake sequence on Fin 3 with 1 glove starting from clean gloves, all handshakes cover the exact same edge e.
steps.explanation: If the sequence is empty, the claim holds vacuously. If non-empty, the first handshake cannot be double (by Subsingleton.elim) and must therefore be a single handshake on some edge s(x, y). This initial handshake contaminates side a with {x} and its opposite with {y}. By glove_number_k3_edges_eq, all subsequent handshakes in the sequence must also cover the edge s(x, y).
steps.code:
intro seq hclean
  rcases seq with _ | ⟨hd, tl⟩
  · exact ⟨s(0, 1), by intro h hh; exact absurd hh List.not_mem_nil⟩
  · cases hclean with
    | cons _ _ _ hc hrest =>
      cases hd with
      | single x a y =>
        refine ⟨s(x, y), ?_⟩
        have hone := glove_number_k3_opp_ne a
        have ht1 : (handshake_update_contam (Handshake.single x a y)
            (fun _ => (∅ : Set (Fin 3)))) a = {x} := by
          simp [handshake_update_contam]
        have ht2 : (handshake_update_contam (Handshake.single x a y)
            (fun _ => (∅ : Set (Fin 3)))) (opp_glove_side a) = {y} := by
          simp [handshake_update_contam, hone]
        intro h hh
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hh with rfl | hh
        · rfl
        · exact glove_number_k3_edges_eq a x y tl _ ht1 ht2 hrest h hh
      | double x b1 b2 y =>
        exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim b1.1 b2.1) hc.1

steps.claim: The complete graph K₃ does not admit a clean handshake sequence using 1 glove.
steps.explanation: Suppose for contradiction that such a sequence exists. By glove_number_k3_all_edges_same, every handshake in the sequence must cover the same edge e. However, the sequence must cover all edges of K₃, including s(0, 1) and s(1, 2). Hence both s(0, 1) = e and s(1, 2) = e, implying s(0, 1) = s(1, 2), which is false.
steps.code:
rintro ⟨seq, hclean, hcover⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := glove_number_k3_all_edges_same seq hclean
  have hedge1 : s((0:Fin 3), (1:Fin 3)) ∈ (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)).edgeSet := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet]; simp
  have hedge2 : s((1:Fin 3), (2:Fin 3)) ∈ (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)).edgeSet := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet]; simp
  obtain ⟨h1, h1mem, h1e⟩ := hcover _ hedge1
  obtain ⟨h2, h2mem, h2e⟩ := hcover _ hedge2
  have he1 : s(0, 1) = e := by rw [← h1e, he h1 h1mem]
  have he2 : s(1, 2) = e := by rw [← h2e, he h2 h2mem]
  exact absurd (he1.trans he2.symm) (by decide)

steps.claim: The complete graph K₃ does not admit a clean handshake sequence using 0 gloves.
steps.explanation: With 0 gloves, no handshakes can be formed because Fin 0 is empty, so any sequence must be empty. But an empty sequence cannot cover the edge s(0, 1) of K₃.
steps.code:
rintro ⟨seq, hclean, hcover⟩
  have hempty : seq = [] := by
    rcases seq with _ | ⟨hd, tl⟩
    · rfl
    · exfalso
      cases hd with
      | single x a y => exact a.1.elim0
      | double x a b y => exact a.1.elim0
  have hedge1 : s((0:Fin 3), (1:Fin 3)) ∈ (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)).edgeSet := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet]; simp
  obtain ⟨h, hh, -⟩ := hcover _ hedge1
  rw [hempty] at hh
  exact absurd hh List.not_mem_nil

steps.claim: The glove number of K₃ is at most 2.
steps.explanation: By glove_number_complete_graph_upper_bound applied with n = 3, since 2 ≤ 3, the glove number of the complete graph on 3 vertices is at most 3 - 1 = 2.
steps.code:
apply le_antisymm
  · simpa using glove_number_complete_graph_upper_bound 3 (by norm_num)

steps.claim: The glove number of K₃ is equal to 2.
steps.explanation: Unfolding the definition of glove_number as the infimum of glove counts admitting a clean handshake sequence, the set is non-empty because k = 2 admits such a sequence (by glove_number_complete_graph_upper_bound_has_clean_seq). Thus the infimum belongs to the set by Nat.sInf_mem. But the infimum cannot be 0 (by glove_number_k3_no_zero) nor 1 (by glove_number_k3_no_one). Since the infimum is at most 2 and not 0 or 1, it must be 2 by linear integer arithmetic (omega).
steps.code:
· unfold glove_number
    have h2 : has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) 2 :=
      glove_number_complete_graph_upper_bound_has_clean_seq 2
    have hmem : sInf {k : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) k} ∈
        {k : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) k} :=
      Nat.sInf_mem ⟨2, h2⟩
    have h0 : sInf {k : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) k} ≠ 0 :=
      fun hc => glove_number_k3_no_zero (hc ▸ hmem)
    have h1 : sInf {k : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 3)) k} ≠ 1 :=
      fun hc => glove_number_k3_no_one (hc ▸ hmem)
    omega

glossary.congrArg: If a₁ = a₂, then f a₁ = f a₂ for any function f.
glossary.Prod.snd: The projection mapping an ordered pair to its second component.
glossary.glove_number_k3_cover: For any two glove sides a, b in Fin 1 × Bool, either b = a or b is the opposite side opp_glove_side a.
glossary.glove_number_k3_opp_ne: A glove side a in Fin 1 × Bool is never equal to its opposite side opp_glove_side a.
glossary.glove_number_k3_opp_opp: Inverting the glove side twice returns the original side: opp_glove_side (opp_glove_side a) = a.
glossary.glove_number_k3_clean_step: In a 1-glove system where side a has contamination {p} and its opposite has {q}, any clean handshake covers edge s(p, q) and preserves both contaminations.
glossary.Set.singleton_subset_iff: A singleton set {a} is a subset of s if and only if a ∈ s.
glossary.Sym2.eq_swap: The unordered pair s(a, b) equals s(b, a).
glossary.Ne.symm: Inequality is symmetric: if a ≠ b, then b ≠ a.
glossary.Subsingleton.elim: Any two elements of a subsingleton type are equal.
glossary.glove_number_k3_edges_eq: If a 1-glove system has side a contaminated by {p} and its opposite by {q}, then every handshake in a clean handshake sequence covers edge s(p, q).
glossary.List.not_mem_nil: No element belongs to the empty list.
glossary.List.mem_cons.mp: If an element is in hd :: tl, then it equals hd or belongs to tl.
glossary.glove_number_k3_all_edges_same: In any clean handshake sequence on Fin 3 with 1 glove starting from clean gloves, all handshakes cover the exact same edge.
glossary.SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet: An unordered pair s(v, w) is in the edge set of graph G if and only if v and w are adjacent in G.
glossary.glove_number_k3_no_one: The complete graph K₃ has no clean handshake sequence using 1 glove.
glossary.glove_number_k3_no_zero: The complete graph K₃ has no clean handshake sequence using 0 gloves.
glossary.le_antisymm: If a ≤ b and b ≤ a, then a = b in a partial order.
glossary.glove_number_complete_graph_upper_bound: For any n ≥ 2, the glove number of the complete graph K_n is at most n - 1.
glossary.glove_number_complete_graph_upper_bound_: For any natural number m, the complete graph K_{m+1} admits a clean handshake sequence using m gloves.
glossary.Nat.sInf_mem: If a set of natural numbers is non-empty, its infimum belongs to the set.

caveats: In Step 7, the inequality of edges s(0, 1) ≠ s(1, 2) in Sym2 (Fin 3) is discharged by computational reflection (`decide`).
In Step 8, the impossibility of any handshake with 0 gloves is formalized by `elim0` on the empty type Fin 0.

declarations.name: simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_le
declarations.informal: Let n ≥ 22 and let c label the vertices of C_n^7 so that every label class is a clique. Then Σ_i (2·[i ~ i+7] + [i ~ i+6] + [i ~ i+4]) ≤ n, where i ~ j means same class: each class K contributes 2·(pairs at distance 7) + (pairs at distance 6) + (pairs at distance 4) ≤ |K|.
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_le (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 22 ≤ n)
    (c : ZMod n → ZMod n)
    (hc : ∀ u v, u ≠ v → c u = c v → (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v) :
    ∑ i : ZMod n, (2 * (if c i = c (i + 7) then 1 else 0) + (if c i = c (i + 6) then 1 else 0)
      + (if c i = c (i + 4) then 1 else 0)) ≤ n
declarations.source:
open Finset

def simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight (T : Finset ℤ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ e ∈ T, (2 * (if e + 7 ∈ T then 1 else 0) + (if e + 6 ∈ T then 1 else 0) + (if e + 4 ∈ T then 1 else 0))

theorem simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_decide_256 :
    ∀ S ∈ (Icc (0 : ℤ) 7).powerset, simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight S ≤ #S := by
  decide

lemma simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight_map_add (T : Finset ℤ) (d : ℤ) :
    simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight (T.map (addRightEmbedding d)) =
      simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight T := by
  unfold simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight
  rw [sum_map]
  simp only [addRightEmbedding_apply]
  congr 1
  ext e
  have h1 : e + d + 7 ∈ T.map (addRightEmbedding d) ↔ e + 7 ∈ T := by
    rw [mem_map]
    simp only [addRightEmbedding_apply]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, h⟩
      have : a = e + 7 := by omega
      subst this; exact ha
    · intro h; exact ⟨e + 7, h, by omega⟩
  have h2 : e + d + 6 ∈ T.map (addRightEmbedding d) ↔ e + 6 ∈ T := by
    rw [mem_map]
    simp only [addRightEmbedding_apply]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, h⟩
      have : a = e + 6 := by omega
      subst this; exact ha
    · intro h; exact ⟨e + 6, h, by omega⟩
  have h3 : e + d + 4 ∈ T.map (addRightEmbedding d) ↔ e + 4 ∈ T := by
    rw [mem_map]
    simp only [addRightEmbedding_apply]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, h⟩
      have : a = e + 4 := by omega
      subst this; exact ha
    · intro h; exact ⟨e + 4, h, by omega⟩
  simp only [h1, h2, h3]

lemma simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_le_card_of_diam (S : Finset ℤ)
    (hdiam : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, |a - b| ≤ 7) :
    simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight S ≤ #S := by
  by_cases hne : S.Nonempty
  · set m := S.min' hne
    have hm : m ∈ S := min'_mem S hne
    set S' := S.map (addRightEmbedding (-m))
    have hS' : S' ⊆ Icc 0 7 := by
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_map] at hx
      rcases hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      simp only [addRightEmbedding_apply, mem_Icc]
      have h1 : m ≤ y := min'_le S y hy
      have h2 : |y - m| ≤ 7 := hdiam y hy m hm
      constructor
      · omega
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by omega)] at h2
        omega
    have h_le := simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_decide_256 S' (mem_powerset.mpr hS')
    rw [simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight_map_add S (-m)] at h_le
    rw [card_map] at h_le
    exact h_le
  · rw [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
    subst hne
    unfold simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight
    simp

lemma simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_fiber_le (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 22 ≤ n)
    (c : ZMod n → ZMod n)
    (hc : ∀ u v, u ≠ v → c u = c v → (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v)
    (ℓ : ZMod n) :
    ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun x => c x = ℓ),
      (2 * (if c i = c (i + 7) then 1 else 0) + (if c i = c (i + 6) then 1 else 0)
        + (if c i = c (i + 4) then 1 else 0)) ≤
      #(univ.filter (fun x => c x = ℓ)) := by

declarations.informal: In any cover of C_n^7 (n ≥ 22) by 4 equivalence subgraphs, every pair at distance 7, 6 or 4 is covered by exactly one layer, and every class of every layer contains a pair at distance 7 (so it is spanned by an 8-arc).
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 22 ≤ n)
    (c : Fin 4 → ZMod n → ZMod n)
    (hc : ∀ s u v, u ≠ v → c s u = c s v → (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v)
    (hcov : ∀ u v, (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v → ∃ s, c s u = c s v) :
    (∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 7)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 6)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 4)) ∧
      ∀ s i, ∃ d : ℕ, d ≤ 7 ∧ c s (i - d) = c s (i - d + 7) ∧ c s (i - d) = c s i
declarations.source:
open BigOperators Finset

lemma simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_decide_tight :
    ∀ S ∈ (Icc (0 : ℤ) 7).powerset,
      S.Nonempty →
      simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight S = S.card →
      (0 : ℤ) ∈ S ∧ (7 : ℤ) ∈ S := by
  decide

lemma simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_eq_diam_tight
    (S : Finset ℤ) (hdiam : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, |a - b| ≤ 7)
    (h_weight_eq : simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight S = S.card)
    (hne : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃ a ∈ S, a + 7 ∈ S ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ a + 7 := by
  let m := S.min' hne
  have hm := S.min'_mem hne
  let S' := Finset.map (addRightEmbedding (-m)) S
  have hS' : S' ⊆ Icc (0 : ℤ) 7 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_map] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    simp only [addRightEmbedding_apply, mem_Icc]
    have h1 := S.min'_le y hy
    have h2 := hdiam y hy m hm
    rw [abs_le] at h2
    omega
  have hne' : S'.Nonempty := hne.map
  have h_weight_eq' : simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight S' = S'.card := by
    rw [simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight_map_add, card_map, h_weight_eq]
  have h07 := simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_decide_tight S'
    (Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hS') hne' h_weight_eq'
  refine ⟨m, hm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h7 := h07.2
    rw [mem_map] at h7
    rcases h7 with ⟨y, hy, hy_eq⟩
    simp only [addRightEmbedding_apply] at hy_eq
    have : y = m + 7 := by omega
    subst this
    exact hy
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : x + -m ∈ S' := by
      rw [mem_map]
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have h_icc := hS' hx'
    rw [mem_Icc] at h_icc
    omega

lemma simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_layer_weight_eq_imp (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 22 ≤ n)
    (c : ZMod n → ZMod n)
    (hc : ∀ u v, u ≠ v → c u = c v → (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v)
    (heq : ∑ i : ZMod n,
      (2 * (if c i = c (i + 7) then 1 else 0) + (if c i = c (i + 6) then 1 else 0)
        + (if c i = c (i + 4) then 1 else 0)) = n) :
    ∀ i : ZMod n, ∃ d : ℕ, d ≤ 7 ∧ c (i - d) = c (i - d + 7) ∧ c (i - d) = c i := by
  intro i
  let W : ZMod n → ℕ := fun i => 2 * (if c i = c (i + 7) then 1 else 0) + (if c i = c (i + 6) then 1 else 0)
    + (if c i = c (i + 4) then 1 else 0)
  have h_fiber := sum_fiberwise (s := univ) c W
  have h_card : (∑ j : ZMod n, #{x | c x = j}) = n := by
    have := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (s := univ) (t := univ) (f := c) (fun _ _ => mem_univ _)
    rw [← this, card_univ, ZMod.card]
  have h_le : ∀ j, ∑ x with c x = j, W x ≤ #{x | c x = j} := by
    intro j
    exact simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_fiber_le n hn c hc j
  have h_sum_W : (∑ j : ZMod n, ∑ x with c x = j, W x) = ∑ j : ZMod n, #{x | c x = j} := by
    rw [h_fiber, heq, h_card]
  have h_fiber_eq : ∀ ℓ, ∑ x with c x = ℓ, W x = #{x | c x = ℓ} := by
    intro ℓ
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : (∑ x with c x = ℓ, W x) < #{x | c x = ℓ} := lt_of_le_of_ne (h_le ℓ) hne
    have h_sum_lt := sum_lt_sum (s := univ) (fun j _ => h_le j) ⟨ℓ, mem_univ ℓ, hlt⟩
    omega
  let K := univ.filter (fun x => c x = c i)
  let S : Finset ℤ := (Icc (-7 : ℤ) 7).filter (fun (e : ℤ) => c (i + (e : ZMod n)) = c i)
  have hS_sub : S ⊆ Icc (-7 : ℤ) 7 := filter_subset _ _
  have h_card_eq : #S = #K := by
    apply Finset.card_bij (s := S) (t := K) (fun e _ => i + (e : ZMod n))
    · intro e he
      rw [mem_filter]
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp he).2⟩
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      have ha_icc := (mem_filter.mp ha).1
      have hb_icc := (mem_filter.mp hb).1
      rw [mem_Icc] at ha_icc hb_icc
      have hab_eq : (a : ZMod n) = (b : ZMod n) := add_left_cancel hab
      have h_diff : |a - b| < n := by
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
      exact (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n a b h_diff).mp hab_eq
    · intro y hy
      have hy_c : c y = c i := (mem_filter.mp hy).2
      by_cases hyi : y = i
      · subst hyi; refine ⟨0, ?_, by simp⟩
        rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]; refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by simp⟩
      · have hadj := hc i y (Ne.symm hyi) (hy_c.symm)
        rcases (simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn i y).mp hadj with ⟨e, he0, he7, rfl⟩
        rw [abs_le] at he7
        refine ⟨e, ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]; refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hy_c⟩
  have hdiam : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, |a - b| ≤ 7 := by
    intro a ha b hb
    have ha_icc := (mem_filter.mp ha).1
    have hb_icc := (mem_filter.mp hb).1
    have ha_c := (mem_filter.mp ha).2
    have hb_c := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    rw [mem_Icc] at ha_icc hb_icc
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst hab; simp
    · have hne : (i + (a : ZMod n)) ≠ (i + (b : ZMod n)) := by
        intro heq'
        have hab_eq : (a : ZMod n) = (b : ZMod n) := add_left_cancel heq'
        have h_diff : |a - b| < n := by
          rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
        exact hab ((zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n a b h_diff).mp hab_eq)
      have hadj := hc (i + (a : ZMod n)) (i + (b : ZMod n)) hne (ha_c.trans hb_c.symm)
      rcases (simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn (i + (a : ZMod n)) (i + (b : ZMod n))).mp hadj with ⟨d, hd0, hd7, hdeq⟩
      rw [abs_le] at hd7
      have h_diff : |b - (a + d)| < n := by
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
      have h_eq' : ((b : ZMod n) = ((a + d : ℤ) : ZMod n)) := by
        have : i + (b : ZMod n) = i + ((a + d : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by
          rw [hdeq]; push_cast; ring
        exact add_left_cancel this
      have h_bd := (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n b (a + d) h_diff).mp h_eq'
      subst h_bd
      have : a - (a + d) = -d := by ring
      rw [this, abs_neg, abs_le]
      constructor <;> omega
  have h_mem : ∀ z ∈ K, ∃ e ∈ Icc (-7 : ℤ) 7, z = i + (e : ZMod n) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_filter] at hz
    by_cases hzi : z = i
    · subst hzi; refine ⟨0, by simp [mem_Icc], by simp⟩
    · have hadj := hc i z (Ne.symm hzi) (hz.2.symm)
      rcases (simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn i z).mp hadj with ⟨e, he0, he7, rfl⟩
      rw [abs_le] at he7
      refine ⟨e, by rw [mem_Icc]; constructor <;> omega, rfl⟩
  have h_shift : ∀ e ∈ S, ∀ (k : ℤ), k = 4 ∨ k = 6 ∨ k = 7 →
      (c (i + (e : ZMod n) + (k : ZMod n)) = c i ↔ e + k ∈ S) := by
    intro e he k hk
    have he_icc := (mem_filter.mp he).1
    rw [mem_Icc] at he_icc
    rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    have hk_cast : i + (e : ZMod n) + (k : ZMod n) = i + ((e + k : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hk_cast]
    constructor
    · intro hc_shift
      have hz_mem : i + ((e + k : ℤ) : ZMod n) ∈ K := by
        rw [mem_filter]; exact ⟨mem_univ _, hc_shift⟩
      rcases h_mem _ hz_mem with ⟨e', he', he'_eq⟩
      have he_eq' : ((e + k : ℤ) : ZMod n) = (e' : ZMod n) := add_left_cancel he'_eq
      rw [mem_Icc] at he'
      have hdiff : |(e + k) - e'| < n := by
        rw [abs_lt]
        rcases hk with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> constructor <;> omega
      have h_eq : e + k = e' := (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n (e + k) e' hdiff).mp he_eq'
      subst h_eq
      exact ⟨he', hc_shift⟩
    · intro h
      exact h.2
  have h_sum : ∑ x ∈ K, W x = simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight S := by
    unfold simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight
    symm
    apply sum_bij (s := S) (t := K) (fun e _ => i + (e : ZMod n))
    · intro e he
      rw [mem_filter]
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp he).2⟩
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      have ha_icc := (mem_filter.mp ha).1
      have hb_icc := (mem_filter.mp hb).1
      rw [mem_Icc] at ha_icc hb_icc
      have hab_eq : (a : ZMod n) = (b : ZMod n) := add_left_cancel hab
      have h_diff : |a - b| < n := by
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
      exact (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n a b h_diff).mp hab_eq
    · intro y hy
      have hy_c := (mem_filter.mp hy).2
      by_cases hyi : y = i
      · subst hyi; refine ⟨0, ?_, by simp⟩
        rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]; refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by simp⟩
      · have hadj := hc i y (Ne.symm hyi) (hy_c.symm)
        rcases (simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn i y).mp hadj with ⟨e, he0, he7, rfl⟩
        rw [abs_le] at he7
        refine ⟨e, ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]; refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hy_c⟩
    · intro e he
      have he_c : c (i + (e : ZMod n)) = c i := (mem_filter.mp he).2
      have h7 := h_shift e he 7 (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
      have h6 := h_shift e he 6 (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
      have h4 := h_shift e he 4 (Or.inl rfl)
      have h7_eq : (c (i + (e : ZMod n)) = c (i + (e : ZMod n) + 7)) ↔ (e + 7 ∈ S) := by
        rw [he_c]
        have : (7 : ZMod n) = ((7 : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by push_cast; rfl
        rw [this, eq_comm]
        exact h7
      have h6_eq : (c (i + (e : ZMod n)) = c (i + (e : ZMod n) + 6)) ↔ (e + 6 ∈ S) := by
        rw [he_c]
        have : (6 : ZMod n) = ((6 : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by push_cast; rfl
        rw [this, eq_comm]
        exact h6
      have h4_eq : (c (i + (e : ZMod n)) = c (i + (e : ZMod n) + 4)) ↔ (e + 4 ∈ S) := by
        rw [he_c]
        have : (4 : ZMod n) = ((4 : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by push_cast; rfl
        rw [this, eq_comm]
        exact h4
      dsimp [W]
      rw [if_congr h7_eq rfl rfl, if_congr h6_eq rfl rfl, if_congr h4_eq rfl rfl]
  have h_weight_eq : simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight S = #S := by
    rw [← h_sum, h_card_eq]
    exact h_fiber_eq (c i)
  have h0_in_S : (0 : ℤ) ∈ S := by
    rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by simp⟩
  have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨0, h0_in_S⟩
  rcases simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_eq_diam_tight S hdiam h_weight_eq hne
    with ⟨a, ha, ha7, h_bounds⟩
  have ha_bounds := h_bounds 0 h0_in_S
  have ha_le_0 : a ≤ 0 := ha_bounds.1
  have h_0_le_a7 : 0 ≤ a + 7 := ha_bounds.2
  have h_d_le_7 : (-a).toNat ≤ 7 := by omega
  refine ⟨(-a).toNat, h_d_le_7, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have ha_eq : ((-a).toNat : ℤ) = -a := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    have ha_cast : (((-a).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod n) = - (a : ZMod n) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, ha_eq, Int.cast_neg]
    have ha_mem : c (i + (a : ZMod n)) = c i := (mem_filter.mp ha).2
    have ha7_mem : c (i + ((a + 7 : ℤ) : ZMod n)) = c i := (mem_filter.mp ha7).2
    have h1 : i - (((-a).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i + (a : ZMod n) := by
      rw [ha_cast, sub_neg_eq_add]
    have h2 : i - (((-a).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod n) + 7 = i + ((a + 7 : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by
      rw [h1]; push_cast; ring
    rw [h2, h1, ha_mem, ha7_mem]
  · have ha_eq : ((-a).toNat : ℤ) = -a := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    have ha_cast : (((-a).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod n) = - (a : ZMod n) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, ha_eq, Int.cast_neg]
    have ha_mem : c (i + (a : ZMod n)) = c i := (mem_filter.mp ha).2
    have h1 : i - (((-a).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i + (a : ZMod n) := by
      rw [ha_cast, sub_neg_eq_add]
    rw [h1, ha_mem]

theorem simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 22 ≤ n)
    (c : Fin 4 → ZMod n → ZMod n)
    (hc : ∀ s u v, u ≠ v → c s u = c s v → (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v)
    (hcov : ∀ u v, (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v → ∃ s, c s u = c s v) :
    (∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 7)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 6)) ∧ (∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 4)) ∧
      ∀ s i, ∃ d : ℕ, d ≤ 7 ∧ c s (i - d) = c s (i - d + 7) ∧ c s (i - d) = c s i := by
  open BigOperators Finset in
  have hadj7 : ∀ i : ZMod n, (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj i (i + 7) := by
    intro i
    rw [simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn]
    exact ⟨7, by decide, by decide, by push_cast; rfl⟩
  have hadj6 : ∀ i : ZMod n, (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj i (i + 6) := by
    intro i
    rw [simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn]
    exact ⟨6, by decide, by decide, by push_cast; rfl⟩
  have hadj4 : ∀ i : ZMod n, (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj i (i + 4) := by
    intro i
    rw [simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn]
    exact ⟨4, by decide, by decide, by push_cast; rfl⟩
  have hcov7 : ∀ i : ZMod n, ∃ s : Fin 4, c s i = c s (i + 7) := fun i => hcov i (i + 7) (hadj7 i)
  have hcov6 : ∀ i : ZMod n, ∃ s : Fin 4, c s i = c s (i + 6) := fun i => hcov i (i + 6) (hadj6 i)
  have hcov4 : ∀ i : ZMod n, ∃ s : Fin 4, c s i = c s (i + 4) := fun i => hcov i (i + 4) (hadj4 i)

  let W : Fin 4 → ℕ := fun s =>
    ∑ i : ZMod n, (2 * (if c s i = c s (i + 7) then 1 else 0) + (if c s i = c s (i + 6) then 1 else 0)
      + (if c s i = c s (i + 4) then 1 else 0))
  have hW_le : ∀ s : Fin 4, W s ≤ n := fun s =>
    simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_le n hn (c s) (hc s)

  have hsum_le : ∑ s : Fin 4, W s ≤ 4 * n := by
    have h := sum_le_card_nsmul (univ : Finset (Fin 4)) W n (fun s _ => hW_le s)
    simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h
    rw [Nat.nsmul_eq_mul] at h
    exact h

  let N7 : ZMod n → ℕ := fun i => ∑ s : Fin 4, if c s i = c s (i + 7) then 1 else 0
  let N6 : ZMod n → ℕ := fun i => ∑ s : Fin 4, if c s i = c s (i + 6) then 1 else 0
  let N4 : ZMod n → ℕ := fun i => ∑ s : Fin 4, if c s i = c s (i + 4) then 1 else 0

  have hN7_ge : ∀ i : ZMod n, 1 ≤ N7 i := by
    intro i
    rcases hcov7 i with ⟨s, hs⟩
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun x => if c x i = c x (i + 7) then 1 else 0)
      (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (mem_univ s)
    rwa [if_pos hs] at hle

  have hN6_ge : ∀ i : ZMod n, 1 ≤ N6 i := by
    intro i
    rcases hcov6 i with ⟨s, hs⟩
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun x => if c x i = c x (i + 6) then 1 else 0)
      (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (mem_univ s)
    rwa [if_pos hs] at hle

  have hN4_ge : ∀ i : ZMod n, 1 ≤ N4 i := by
    intro i
    rcases hcov4 i with ⟨s, hs⟩
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun x => if c x i = c x (i + 4) then 1 else 0)
      (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (mem_univ s)
    rwa [if_pos hs] at hle

  have h_term_ge : ∀ i : ZMod n, 4 ≤ 2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i := fun i => by
    have := hN7_ge i
    have := hN6_ge i
    have := hN4_ge i
    omega

  have hsum_comm : ∑ s : Fin 4, W s = ∑ i : ZMod n, (2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i) := by
    dsimp [W, N7, N6, N4]
    rw [sum_comm]
    congr 1
    ext i
    rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum]

  have hsum_ge : 4 * n ≤ ∑ s : Fin 4, W s := by
    rw [hsum_comm]
    have h := card_nsmul_le_sum (univ : Finset (ZMod n)) (fun i => 2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i) 4 (fun i _ => h_term_ge i)
    have hc : card (univ : Finset (ZMod n)) = n := ZMod.card n
    rw [hc, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul] at h
    omega

  have hsum_eq : ∑ s : Fin 4, W s = 4 * n := by omega
  have hsum_term_eq : ∑ i : ZMod n, (2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i) = 4 * n := by omega

  have hW_eq : ∀ s : Fin 4, W s = n := by
    intro s
    have hsum_const : ∑ _s : Fin 4, n = 4 * n := by
      simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hle' : ∀ s ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin 4)), W s ≤ (fun _ => n) s := fun s _ => hW_le s
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : W s < n := lt_of_le_of_ne (hW_le s) hne
    have : ∑ x : Fin 4, W x < ∑ _x : Fin 4, n := Finset.sum_lt_sum hle' ⟨s, mem_univ s, hlt⟩
    omega

  have h_term_eq : ∀ i : ZMod n, 2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i = 4 := by
    intro i
    have hsum_const : ∑ _i : ZMod n, 4 = 4 * n := by
      have hc : card (univ : Finset (ZMod n)) = n := ZMod.card n
      simp only [sum_const, hc, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]
      omega
    have hle' : ∀ j ∈ (univ : Finset (ZMod n)), (fun _ => 4) j ≤ 2 * N7 j + N6 j + N4 j := fun j _ => h_term_ge j
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : 4 < 2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i := lt_of_le_of_ne (h_term_ge i) (Ne.symm hne)
    have : ∑ _x : ZMod n, 4 < ∑ x : ZMod n, (2 * N7 x + N6 x + N4 x) := Finset.sum_lt_sum hle' ⟨i, mem_univ i, hlt⟩
    omega

  have hN7_eq : ∀ i : ZMod n, N7 i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have := h_term_eq i
    have := hN7_ge i
    have := hN6_ge i
    have := hN4_ge i
    omega

  have hN6_eq : ∀ i : ZMod n, N6 i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have := h_term_eq i
    have := hN7_ge i
    have := hN6_ge i
    have := hN4_ge i
    omega

  have hN4_eq : ∀ i : ZMod n, N4 i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have := h_term_eq i
    have := hN7_ge i
    have := hN6_ge i
    have := hN4_ge i
    omega

  have h_exists_unique : ∀ (P : Fin 4 → Prop) [DecidablePred P],
      (∑ s : Fin 4, (if P s then 1 else 0)) = 1 → ∃! s, P s := by
    intro P _ h
    have hcard : card (filter P univ) = 1 := by
      have h1 : (∑ s : Fin 4, if P s then 1 else 0 : ℕ) = card (filter P univ) := sum_boole (R := ℕ) P univ
      rwa [← h1]
    rw [card_eq_one] at hcard
    rcases hcard with ⟨s, hs⟩
    use s
    have hp : ∀ x, P x ↔ x = s := by
      intro x
      have := Finset.ext_iff.mp hs x
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_singleton] at this
      exact this
    exact ⟨(hp s).mpr rfl, fun x hx => (hp x).mp hx⟩

  refine ⟨fun i => h_exists_unique (fun s => c s i = c s (i + 7)) (hN7_eq i),
          fun i => h_exists_unique (fun s => c s i = c s (i + 6)) (hN6_eq i),
          fun i => h_exists_unique (fun s => c s i = c s (i + 4)) (hN4_eq i),
          fun s i => ?_⟩
  exact simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_layer_weight_eq_imp n hn (c s) (hc s) (hW_eq s) i

explanation.summary: The proof establishes tightness of 4-layer covers of C_n^7 (n ≥ 22) through a double-counting argument on a weighted sum of monochromatic chords of lengths 7, 6, and 4 (with weights 2, 1, 1). Each layer has weight at most n, while covering all edges forces each vertex to contribute at least 4 to the total weight, so the total weight is at least 4n. This sandwich forces equality everywhere: every chord of length 7, 6, and 4 is covered by exactly one layer, and every layer achieves the maximum weight n. Applying a local translation argument and a finite computational check then shows that every color class in each layer spans an 8-arc containing a distance 7 chord.

steps.claim: Every non-empty subset S ⊆ {0, ..., 7} whose integer weight equals |S| contains both 0 and 7.
steps.explanation: This is a finite combinatorial verification over all 2^8 - 1 = 255 non-empty subsets of {0, ..., 7}, checked automatically by `decide`.
steps.code: decide

steps.claim: Translating S by -m, where m = min S, embeds S into the integer interval [0, 7].
steps.explanation: Let m = min S. Every y ∈ S satisfies y ≥ m by definition of minimum, and y - m ≤ 7 because any two elements of S have distance at most 7 (diameter ≤ 7). Thus S' = S - m ⊆ [0, 7].
steps.code:
let m := S.min' hne
  have hm := S.min'_mem hne
  let S' := Finset.map (addRightEmbedding (-m)) S
  have hS' : S' ⊆ Icc (0 : ℤ) 7 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_map] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    simp only [addRightEmbedding_apply, mem_Icc]
    have h1 := S.min'_le y hy
    have h2 := hdiam y hy m hm
    rw [abs_le] at h2
    omega

steps.claim: The set S contains both m and m + 7, and every element of S lies between m and m + 7.
steps.explanation: Because integer weight is translation-invariant and translation preserves cardinality, S' = S - m has weight equal to |S'|. By the finite verification lemma, 0 ∈ S' and 7 ∈ S', which translates back to m ∈ S and m + 7 ∈ S. Since S' ⊆ [0, 7], all elements of S lie in [m, m + 7].
steps.code:
have hne' : S'.Nonempty := hne.map
  have h_weight_eq' : simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight S' = S'.card := by
    rw [simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight_map_add, card_map, h_weight_eq]
  have h07 := simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_decide_tight S'
    (Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hS') hne' h_weight_eq'
  refine ⟨m, hm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h7 := h07.2
    rw [mem_map] at h7
    rcases h7 with ⟨y, hy, hy_eq⟩
    simp only [addRightEmbedding_apply] at hy_eq
    have : y = m + 7 := by omega
    subst this
    exact hy
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : x + -m ∈ S' := by
      rw [mem_map]
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have h_icc := hS' hx'
    rw [mem_Icc] at h_icc
    omega

steps.claim: If the total weight of a layer equals n, then every color class achieves equality between its weight and its size.
steps.explanation: The sum of weights over all vertices decomposes as the sum of weights over the color classes (fibers of c). Each fiber weight is at most the fiber size, and the sum of fiber sizes is n. If any fiber had weight strictly less than its size, the total weight would be strictly less than n, contradicting the hypothesis that it equals n.
steps.code:
intro i
  let W : ZMod n → ℕ := fun i => 2 * (if c i = c (i + 7) then 1 else 0) + (if c i = c (i + 6) then 1 else 0)
    + (if c i = c (i + 4) then 1 else 0)
  have h_fiber := sum_fiberwise (s := univ) c W
  have h_card : (∑ j : ZMod n, #{x | c x = j}) = n := by
    have := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (s := univ) (t := univ) (f := c) (fun _ _ => mem_univ _)
    rw [← this, card_univ, ZMod.card]
  have h_le : ∀ j, ∑ x with c x = j, W x ≤ #{x | c x = j} := by
    intro j
    exact simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_fiber_le n hn c hc j
  have h_sum_W : (∑ j : ZMod n, ∑ x with c x = j, W x) = ∑ j : ZMod n, #{x | c x = j} := by
    rw [h_fiber, heq, h_card]
  have h_fiber_eq : ∀ ℓ, ∑ x with c x = ℓ, W x = #{x | c x = ℓ} := by
    intro ℓ
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : (∑ x with c x = ℓ, W x) < #{x | c x = ℓ} := lt_of_le_of_ne (h_le ℓ) hne
    have h_sum_lt := sum_lt_sum (s := univ) (fun j _ => h_le j) ⟨ℓ, mem_univ ℓ, hlt⟩
    omega

steps.claim: The color class K of vertex i is in bijection with an integer set S ⊆ [-7, 7] under e ↦ i + e.
steps.explanation: Every vertex in the color class K is monochromatic with i, hence adjacent to i in C_n^7 (or equal to i). Since n ≥ 22, the adjacency condition implies that each vertex in K is uniquely represented as i + e for e ∈ [-7, 7].
steps.code:
let K := univ.filter (fun x => c x = c i)
  let S : Finset ℤ := (Icc (-7 : ℤ) 7).filter (fun (e : ℤ) => c (i + (e : ZMod n)) = c i)
  have hS_sub : S ⊆ Icc (-7 : ℤ) 7 := filter_subset _ _
  have h_card_eq : #S = #K := by
    apply Finset.card_bij (s := S) (t := K) (fun e _ => i + (e : ZMod n))
    · intro e he
      rw [mem_filter]
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp he).2⟩
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      have ha_icc := (mem_filter.mp ha).1
      have hb_icc := (mem_filter.mp hb).1
      rw [mem_Icc] at ha_icc hb_icc
      have hab_eq : (a : ZMod n) = (b : ZMod n) := add_left_cancel hab
      have h_diff : |a - b| < n := by
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
      exact (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n a b h_diff).mp hab_eq
    · intro y hy
      have hy_c : c y = c i := (mem_filter.mp hy).2
      by_cases hyi : y = i
      · subst hyi; refine ⟨0, ?_, by simp⟩
        rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]; refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by simp⟩
      · have hadj := hc i y (Ne.symm hyi) (hy_c.symm)
        rcases (simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn i y).mp hadj with ⟨e, he0, he7, rfl⟩
        rw [abs_le] at he7
        refine ⟨e, ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]; refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hy_c⟩

steps.claim: The integer set S has diameter at most 7: |a - b| ≤ 7 for all a, b ∈ S.
steps.explanation: Any two distinct elements a, b ∈ S correspond to vertices i + a and i + b in the same color class K, so they are adjacent in C_n^7. Because n ≥ 22, their difference in ZMod n corresponds to a unique integer d with |d| ≤ 7, which forces |a - b| ≤ 7.
steps.code:
have hdiam : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, |a - b| ≤ 7 := by
    intro a ha b hb
    have ha_icc := (mem_filter.mp ha).1
    have hb_icc := (mem_filter.mp hb).1
    have ha_c := (mem_filter.mp ha).2
    have hb_c := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    rw [mem_Icc] at ha_icc hb_icc
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst hab; simp
    · have hne : (i + (a : ZMod n)) ≠ (i + (b : ZMod n)) := by
        intro heq'
        have hab_eq : (a : ZMod n) = (b : ZMod n) := add_left_cancel heq'
        have h_diff : |a - b| < n := by
          rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
        exact hab ((zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n a b h_diff).mp hab_eq)
      have hadj := hc (i + (a : ZMod n)) (i + (b : ZMod n)) hne (ha_c.trans hb_c.symm)
      rcases (simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn (i + (a : ZMod n)) (i + (b : ZMod n))).mp hadj with ⟨d, hd0, hd7, hdeq⟩
      rw [abs_le] at hd7
      have h_diff : |b - (a + d)| < n := by
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
      have h_eq' : ((b : ZMod n) = ((a + d : ℤ) : ZMod n)) := by
        have : i + (b : ZMod n) = i + ((a + d : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by
          rw [hdeq]; push_cast; ring
        exact add_left_cancel this
      have h_bd := (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n b (a + d) h_diff).mp h_eq'
      subst h_bd
      have : a - (a + d) = -d := by ring
      rw [this, abs_neg, abs_le]
      constructor <;> omega

steps.claim: The weight of the color class K in ZMod n equals the integer weight of S, so S satisfies weight(S) = |S|.
steps.explanation: For any e ∈ S and k ∈ {4, 6, 7}, i + e + k is monochromatic with i if and only if e + k ∈ S, because S contains all elements in [-7, 7] with that color. The bijection e ↦ i + e therefore preserves all weight indicator terms, equating the fiber weight to the integer weight of S.
steps.code:
have h_mem : ∀ z ∈ K, ∃ e ∈ Icc (-7 : ℤ) 7, z = i + (e : ZMod n) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_filter] at hz
    by_cases hzi : z = i
    · subst hzi; refine ⟨0, by simp [mem_Icc], by simp⟩
    · have hadj := hc i z (Ne.symm hzi) (hz.2.symm)
      rcases (simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn i z).mp hadj with ⟨e, he0, he7, rfl⟩
      rw [abs_le] at he7
      refine ⟨e, by rw [mem_Icc]; constructor <;> omega, rfl⟩
  have h_shift : ∀ e ∈ S, ∀ (k : ℤ), k = 4 ∨ k = 6 ∨ k = 7 →
      (c (i + (e : ZMod n) + (k : ZMod n)) = c i ↔ e + k ∈ S) := by
    intro e he k hk
    have he_icc := (mem_filter.mp he).1
    rw [mem_Icc] at he_icc
    rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    have hk_cast : i + (e : ZMod n) + (k : ZMod n) = i + ((e + k : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hk_cast]
    constructor
    · intro hc_shift
      have hz_mem : i + ((e + k : ℤ) : ZMod n) ∈ K := by
        rw [mem_filter]; exact ⟨mem_univ _, hc_shift⟩
      rcases h_mem _ hz_mem with ⟨e', he', he'_eq⟩
      have he_eq' : ((e + k : ℤ) : ZMod n) = (e' : ZMod n) := add_left_cancel he'_eq
      rw [mem_Icc] at he'
      have hdiff : |(e + k) - e'| < n := by
        rw [abs_lt]
        rcases hk with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> constructor <;> omega
      have h_eq : e + k = e' := (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n (e + k) e' hdiff).mp he_eq'
      subst h_eq
      exact ⟨he', hc_shift⟩
    · intro h
      exact h.2
  have h_sum : ∑ x ∈ K, W x = simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight S := by
    unfold simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight
    symm
    apply sum_bij (s := S) (t := K) (fun e _ => i + (e : ZMod n))
    · intro e he
      rw [mem_filter]
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp he).2⟩
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      have ha_icc := (mem_filter.mp ha).1
      have hb_icc := (mem_filter.mp hb).1
      rw [mem_Icc] at ha_icc hb_icc
      have hab_eq : (a : ZMod n) = (b : ZMod n) := add_left_cancel hab
      have h_diff : |a - b| < n := by
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
      exact (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n a b h_diff).mp hab_eq
    · intro y hy
      have hy_c := (mem_filter.mp hy).2
      by_cases hyi : y = i
      · subst hyi; refine ⟨0, ?_, by simp⟩
        rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]; refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by simp⟩
      · have hadj := hc i y (Ne.symm hyi) (hy_c.symm)
        rcases (simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn i y).mp hadj with ⟨e, he0, he7, rfl⟩
        rw [abs_le] at he7
        refine ⟨e, ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]; refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, hy_c⟩
    · intro e he
      have he_c : c (i + (e : ZMod n)) = c i := (mem_filter.mp he).2
      have h7 := h_shift e he 7 (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
      have h6 := h_shift e he 6 (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
      have h4 := h_shift e he 4 (Or.inl rfl)
      have h7_eq : (c (i + (e : ZMod n)) = c (i + (e : ZMod n) + 7)) ↔ (e + 7 ∈ S) := by
        rw [he_c]
        have : (7 : ZMod n) = ((7 : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by push_cast; rfl
        rw [this, eq_comm]
        exact h7
      have h6_eq : (c (i + (e : ZMod n)) = c (i + (e : ZMod n) + 6)) ↔ (e + 6 ∈ S) := by
        rw [he_c]
        have : (6 : ZMod n) = ((6 : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by push_cast; rfl
        rw [this, eq_comm]
        exact h6
      have h4_eq : (c (i + (e : ZMod n)) = c (i + (e : ZMod n) + 4)) ↔ (e + 4 ∈ S) := by
        rw [he_c]
        have : (4 : ZMod n) = ((4 : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by push_cast; rfl
        rw [this, eq_comm]
        exact h4
      dsimp [W]
      rw [if_congr h7_eq rfl rfl, if_congr h6_eq rfl rfl, if_congr h4_eq rfl rfl]
  have h_weight_eq : simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_int_weight S = #S := by
    rw [← h_sum, h_card_eq]
    exact h_fiber_eq (c i)

steps.claim: Vertex i belongs to an 8-arc [i - d, i - d + 7] with d ≤ 7 monochromatic in the layer.
steps.explanation: Applying the diameter-tightness lemma to S, there is an integer a ∈ S such that a + 7 ∈ S and S ⊆ [a, a + 7]. Since 0 ∈ S, we have a ≤ 0 ≤ a + 7. Setting d = -a yields d ≤ 7 with i - d = i + a and i - d + 7 = i + a + 7 both in the color class of i.
steps.code:
have h0_in_S : (0 : ℤ) ∈ S := by
    rw [mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, by simp⟩
  have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨0, h0_in_S⟩
  rcases simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_eq_diam_tight S hdiam h_weight_eq hne
    with ⟨a, ha, ha7, h_bounds⟩
  have ha_bounds := h_bounds 0 h0_in_S
  have ha_le_0 : a ≤ 0 := ha_bounds.1
  have h_0_le_a7 : 0 ≤ a + 7 := ha_bounds.2
  have h_d_le_7 : (-a).toNat ≤ 7 := by omega
  refine ⟨(-a).toNat, h_d_le_7, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have ha_eq : ((-a).toNat : ℤ) = -a := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    have ha_cast : (((-a).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod n) = - (a : ZMod n) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, ha_eq, Int.cast_neg]
    have ha_mem : c (i + (a : ZMod n)) = c i := (mem_filter.mp ha).2
    have ha7_mem : c (i + ((a + 7 : ℤ) : ZMod n)) = c i := (mem_filter.mp ha7).2
    have h1 : i - (((-a).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i + (a : ZMod n) := by
      rw [ha_cast, sub_neg_eq_add]
    have h2 : i - (((-a).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod n) + 7 = i + ((a + 7 : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by
      rw [h1]; push_cast; ring
    rw [h2, h1, ha_mem, ha7_mem]
  · have ha_eq : ((-a).toNat : ℤ) = -a := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
    have ha_cast : (((-a).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod n) = - (a : ZMod n) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_natCast, ha_eq, Int.cast_neg]
    have ha_mem : c (i + (a : ZMod n)) = c i := (mem_filter.mp ha).2
    have h1 : i - (((-a).toNat : ℕ) : ZMod n) = i + (a : ZMod n) := by
      rw [ha_cast, sub_neg_eq_add]
    rw [h1, ha_mem]

steps.claim: The sum of the weights of the 4 layers is at most 4n.
steps.explanation: Pairs at distances 7, 6, and 4 are adjacent in C_n^7, so the cover condition guarantees that each such pair is monochromatic in at least one layer. Furthermore, each individual layer weight is bounded by n, so the sum over the 4 layers is at most 4 * n.
steps.code:
open BigOperators Finset in
  have hadj7 : ∀ i : ZMod n, (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj i (i + 7) := by
    intro i
    rw [simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn]
    exact ⟨7, by decide, by decide, by push_cast; rfl⟩
  have hadj6 : ∀ i : ZMod n, (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj i (i + 6) := by
    intro i
    rw [simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn]
    exact ⟨6, by decide, by decide, by push_cast; rfl⟩
  have hadj4 : ∀ i : ZMod n, (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj i (i + 4) := by
    intro i
    rw [simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn]
    exact ⟨4, by decide, by decide, by push_cast; rfl⟩
  have hcov7 : ∀ i : ZMod n, ∃ s : Fin 4, c s i = c s (i + 7) := fun i => hcov i (i + 7) (hadj7 i)
  have hcov6 : ∀ i : ZMod n, ∃ s : Fin 4, c s i = c s (i + 6) := fun i => hcov i (i + 6) (hadj6 i)
  have hcov4 : ∀ i : ZMod n, ∃ s : Fin 4, c s i = c s (i + 4) := fun i => hcov i (i + 4) (hadj4 i)

  let W : Fin 4 → ℕ := fun s =>
    ∑ i : ZMod n, (2 * (if c s i = c s (i + 7) then 1 else 0) + (if c s i = c s (i + 6) then 1 else 0)
      + (if c s i = c s (i + 4) then 1 else 0))
  have hW_le : ∀ s : Fin 4, W s ≤ n := fun s =>
    simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_layer_weight_le n hn (c s) (hc s)

  have hsum_le : ∑ s : Fin 4, W s ≤ 4 * n := by
    have h := sum_le_card_nsmul (univ : Finset (Fin 4)) W n (fun s _ => hW_le s)
    simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h
    rw [Nat.nsmul_eq_mul] at h
    exact h

steps.claim: Double counting shows that the sum of layer weights is at least 4n, so it must equal 4n.
steps.explanation: Interchanging the summation order expresses the sum of layer weights as the sum over all vertices i of 2 * N_7(i) + N_6(i) + N_4(i), where N_k(i) is the number of layers covering {i, i + k}. Since every edge is covered, each N_k(i) ≥ 1, making each vertex's contribution at least 2(1) + 1 + 1 = 4. Summing over all n vertices yields at least 4n, forcing the total sum to equal 4n.
steps.code:
let N7 : ZMod n → ℕ := fun i => ∑ s : Fin 4, if c s i = c s (i + 7) then 1 else 0
  let N6 : ZMod n → ℕ := fun i => ∑ s : Fin 4, if c s i = c s (i + 6) then 1 else 0
  let N4 : ZMod n → ℕ := fun i => ∑ s : Fin 4, if c s i = c s (i + 4) then 1 else 0

  have hN7_ge : ∀ i : ZMod n, 1 ≤ N7 i := by
    intro i
    rcases hcov7 i with ⟨s, hs⟩
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun x => if c x i = c x (i + 7) then 1 else 0)
      (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (mem_univ s)
    rwa [if_pos hs] at hle

  have hN6_ge : ∀ i : ZMod n, 1 ≤ N6 i := by
    intro i
    rcases hcov6 i with ⟨s, hs⟩
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun x => if c x i = c x (i + 6) then 1 else 0)
      (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (mem_univ s)
    rwa [if_pos hs] at hle

  have hN4_ge : ∀ i : ZMod n, 1 ≤ N4 i := by
    intro i
    rcases hcov4 i with ⟨s, hs⟩
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun x => if c x i = c x (i + 4) then 1 else 0)
      (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (mem_univ s)
    rwa [if_pos hs] at hle

  have h_term_ge : ∀ i : ZMod n, 4 ≤ 2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i := fun i => by
    have := hN7_ge i
    have := hN6_ge i
    have := hN4_ge i
    omega

  have hsum_comm : ∑ s : Fin 4, W s = ∑ i : ZMod n, (2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i) := by
    dsimp [W, N7, N6, N4]
    rw [sum_comm]
    congr 1
    ext i
    rw [sum_add_distrib, sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum]

  have hsum_ge : 4 * n ≤ ∑ s : Fin 4, W s := by
    rw [hsum_comm]
    have h := card_nsmul_le_sum (univ : Finset (ZMod n)) (fun i => 2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i) 4 (fun i _ => h_term_ge i)
    have hc : card (univ : Finset (ZMod n)) = n := ZMod.card n
    rw [hc, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul] at h
    omega

  have hsum_eq : ∑ s : Fin 4, W s = 4 * n := by omega
  have hsum_term_eq : ∑ i : ZMod n, (2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i) = 4 * n := by omega

steps.claim: Every layer achieves the maximum possible weight n.
steps.explanation: Each of the 4 layer weights is at most n, and their sum equals 4n. If any layer weight were strictly less than n, the sum would be strictly less than 4n, a contradiction.
steps.code:
have hW_eq : ∀ s : Fin 4, W s = n := by
    intro s
    have hsum_const : ∑ _s : Fin 4, n = 4 * n := by
      simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hle' : ∀ s ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin 4)), W s ≤ (fun _ => n) s := fun s _ => hW_le s
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : W s < n := lt_of_le_of_ne (hW_le s) hne
    have : ∑ x : Fin 4, W x < ∑ _x : Fin 4, n := Finset.sum_lt_sum hle' ⟨s, mem_univ s, hlt⟩
    omega

steps.claim: Every pair at distance 7, 6, and 4 is covered by exactly one layer: N_7(i) = N_6(i) = N_4(i) = 1.
steps.explanation: Since the sum of 2 * N_7(i) + N_6(i) + N_4(i) over all n vertices equals 4n and each term is at least 4, each term must equal 4. Combined with N_7(i) ≥ 1, N_6(i) ≥ 1, N_4(i) ≥ 1, this forces N_7(i) = N_6(i) = N_4(i) = 1 for every vertex i.
steps.code:
have h_term_eq : ∀ i : ZMod n, 2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i = 4 := by
    intro i
    have hsum_const : ∑ _i : ZMod n, 4 = 4 * n := by
      have hc : card (univ : Finset (ZMod n)) = n := ZMod.card n
      simp only [sum_const, hc, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]
      omega
    have hle' : ∀ j ∈ (univ : Finset (ZMod n)), (fun _ => 4) j ≤ 2 * N7 j + N6 j + N4 j := fun j _ => h_term_ge j
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : 4 < 2 * N7 i + N6 i + N4 i := lt_of_le_of_ne (h_term_ge i) (Ne.symm hne)
    have : ∑ _x : ZMod n, 4 < ∑ x : ZMod n, (2 * N7 x + N6 x + N4 x) := Finset.sum_lt_sum hle' ⟨i, mem_univ i, hlt⟩
    omega

  have hN7_eq : ∀ i : ZMod n, N7 i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have := h_term_eq i
    have := hN7_ge i
    have := hN6_ge i
    have := hN4_ge i
    omega

  have hN6_eq : ∀ i : ZMod n, N6 i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have := h_term_eq i
    have := hN7_ge i
    have := hN6_ge i
    have := hN4_ge i
    omega

  have hN4_eq : ∀ i : ZMod n, N4 i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have := h_term_eq i
    have := hN7_ge i
    have := hN6_ge i
    have := hN4_ge i
    omega

steps.claim: Unique layer coverage holds for chords of length 7, 6, and 4, and every class contains a distance 7 pair.
steps.explanation: Because the indicator sum over the 4 layers equals 1 for each distance, exactly one layer covers each pair. Finally, because each layer achieves weight n, the previous lemma applies to guarantee that every vertex belongs to a class spanned by an 8-arc with a pair at distance 7.
steps.code:
have h_exists_unique : ∀ (P : Fin 4 → Prop) [DecidablePred P],
      (∑ s : Fin 4, (if P s then 1 else 0)) = 1 → ∃! s, P s := by
    intro P _ h
    have hcard : card (filter P univ) = 1 := by
      have h1 : (∑ s : Fin 4, if P s then 1 else 0 : ℕ) = card (filter P univ) := sum_boole (R := ℕ) P univ
      rwa [← h1]
    rw [card_eq_one] at hcard
    rcases hcard with ⟨s, hs⟩
    use s
    have hp : ∀ x, P x ↔ x = s := by
      intro x
      have := Finset.ext_iff.mp hs x
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_singleton] at this
      exact this
    exact ⟨(hp s).mpr rfl, fun x hx => (hp x).mp hx⟩

  refine ⟨fun i => h_exists_unique (fun s => c s i = c s (i + 7)) (hN7_eq i),
          fun i => h_exists_unique (fun s => c s i = c s (i + 6)) (hN6_eq i),
          fun i => h_exists_unique (fun s => c s i = c s (i + 4)) (hN4_eq i),
          fun s i => ?_⟩
  exact simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_layer_weight_eq_imp n hn (c s) (hc s) (hW_eq s) i

declarations.name: handshake_touchers
declarations.informal: The set of vertices that directly touch the glove side `s` during the handshake `h`: for a single handshake `x|a opp(a)|y` the vertex `x` touches `a` and `y` touches the opposite side; for a double handshake `x|a|b|y` the vertex `x` touches `a` and `y` touches `b`; every other side is untouched. (In a double handshake the two outer sides merely exchange contamination, they are not touched.)
declarations.statement: def handshake_touchers {V : Type*} {Γ : Type*} [DecidableEq Γ] (h : Handshake V Γ) (s : Γ × Bool) : Set V
declarations.source:
/-- The vertices that directly touch the glove side `s` during the handshake `h`. -/
def handshake_touchers {V : Type*} {Γ : Type*} [DecidableEq Γ] (h : Handshake V Γ) (s : Γ × Bool) : Set V := match h with
  | .single x a y => if s = a then {x} else if s = opp_glove_side a then {y} else ∅
  | .double x a b y => if s = a then {x} else if s = b then {y} else ∅

declarations.name: seq_contam
declarations.informal: The contamination map obtained by running the handshake sequence `seq` starting from the contamination map `t`. (This is the index-free version of the paper's contamination sequence `t_a(i)`.)
declarations.statement: def seq_contam {V : Type*} {Γ : Type*} [DecidableEq Γ] (seq : List (Handshake V Γ)) (t : Γ × Bool → Set V) : Γ × Bool → Set V
declarations.source:
/-- The contamination map after executing the sequence `seq`, starting from `t`. -/
def seq_contam {V : Type*} {Γ : Type*} [DecidableEq Γ] (seq : List (Handshake V Γ)) (t : Γ × Bool → Set V) : Γ × Bool → Set V := seq.foldl (fun t h => handshake_update_contam h t) t

declarations.name: seq_touchers
declarations.informal: The set of vertices that directly touch the glove side `s` at some handshake of the sequence `seq` (the union of the touch sets of the individual handshakes).
declarations.statement: def seq_touchers {V : Type*} {Γ : Type*} [DecidableEq Γ] (seq : List (Handshake V Γ)) (s : Γ × Bool) : Set V
declarations.source:
/-- The set of all vertices that directly touch the glove side `s` somewhere in `seq`. -/
def seq_touchers {V : Type*} {Γ : Type*} [DecidableEq Γ] (seq : List (Handshake V Γ)) (s : Γ × Bool) : Set V := seq.foldr (fun h acc => handshake_touchers h s ∪ acc) ∅

declarations.name: deadline_paging_min_cost_schedule_exists
declarations.informal: Every feasible deadline-paging instance admits a feasible schedule whose fetch cost over the instance horizon is minimal among all feasible schedules (the offline optimum, made concrete).
declarations.statement:
theorem deadline_paging_min_cost_schedule_exists
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (k : ℕ) (C₀ : Finset α) (reqs : List (DeadlineRequest α))
    (h : ∃ sched : ℕ → Finset α, IsFeasibleSchedule k C₀ sched reqs) :
    ∃ sched : ℕ → Finset α, IsFeasibleSchedule k C₀ sched reqs ∧
      ∀ sched' : ℕ → Finset α, IsFeasibleSchedule k C₀ sched' reqs →
        scheduleCost sched (instanceHorizon reqs) ≤ scheduleCost sched' (instanceHorizon reqs)
declarations.source:
/-- A feasible instance has a feasible schedule of minimum fetch cost over its horizon; turns the offline optimum into a concrete schedule. -/
theorem deadline_paging_min_cost_schedule_exists
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (k : ℕ) (C₀ : Finset α) (reqs : List (DeadlineRequest α))
    (h : ∃ sched : ℕ → Finset α, IsFeasibleSchedule k C₀ sched reqs) :
    ∃ sched : ℕ → Finset α, IsFeasibleSchedule k C₀ sched reqs ∧
      ∀ sched' : ℕ → Finset α, IsFeasibleSchedule k C₀ sched' reqs →
        scheduleCost sched (instanceHorizon reqs) ≤ scheduleCost sched' (instanceHorizon reqs) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ := h
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n => ∃ sched : ℕ → Finset α, IsFeasibleSchedule k C₀ sched reqs ∧ scheduleCost sched (instanceHorizon reqs) = n
  have h_ex : ∃ n, P n := ⟨scheduleCost s₀ (instanceHorizon reqs), s₀, hs₀, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨sched, hsched_feas, hsched_cost⟩ := Nat.find_spec h_ex
  refine ⟨sched, hsched_feas, fun sched' hsched' => ?_⟩
  rw [hsched_cost]
  exact Nat.find_min' h_ex ⟨sched', hsched', rfl⟩

explanation.summary: The theorem establishes the existence of a cost-minimizing feasible schedule using the well-ordering principle of the natural numbers. Because a feasible schedule exists by hypothesis, the set of costs achievable by feasible schedules over the instance horizon is a non-empty subset of ℕ. The schedule attaining the minimum element of this set is therefore an optimal feasible schedule.

steps.claim: The set of fetch costs realized by feasible schedules over the horizon is non-empty.
steps.explanation: Under classical logic, we extract a witness feasible schedule $s_0$ from the feasibility hypothesis $h$. We define the predicate $P(n)$ stating that $n$ is the horizon schedule cost of some feasible schedule, and witness that $P$ is non-empty using the cost of $s_0$.
steps.code:
classical
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ := h
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n => ∃ sched : ℕ → Finset α, IsFeasibleSchedule k C₀ sched reqs ∧ scheduleCost sched (instanceHorizon reqs) = n
  have h_ex : ∃ n, P n := ⟨scheduleCost s₀ (instanceHorizon reqs), s₀, hs₀, rfl⟩

steps.claim: There exists a feasible schedule `sched` achieving the minimal cost `Nat.find h_ex`.
steps.explanation: By the well-ordering principle of the natural numbers (`Nat.find_spec`), the non-empty predicate $P$ has a least element $\operatorname{Nat.find}(h\_ex)$. We unpack the specification to obtain a concrete schedule `sched` that is feasible and achieves this minimal cost.
steps.code: obtain ⟨sched, hsched_feas, hsched_cost⟩ := Nat.find_spec h_ex

steps.claim: The schedule `sched` is feasible and its cost is at most the cost of any feasible schedule `sched'`.
steps.explanation: We propose `sched` as the desired schedule and provide its feasibility. For any other feasible schedule `sched'`, we rewrite the cost of `sched` to $\operatorname{Nat.find}(h\_ex)$, and conclude using `Nat.find_min'` since `sched'` demonstrates that its own cost satisfies $P$.
steps.code:
refine ⟨sched, hsched_feas, fun sched' hsched' => ?_⟩
  rw [hsched_cost]
  exact Nat.find_min' h_ex ⟨sched', hsched', rfl⟩

glossary.Nat.find_spec: If a predicate on natural numbers is satisfied by some natural number, then `Nat.find` produces a witness that satisfies the predicate.
glossary.Nat.find_min': The witness `Nat.find H` is less than or equal to any natural number that satisfies the predicate.

caveats: Classical logic (`classical`) is invoked to treat the existential predicate `P` as decidable, which Mathlib's `Nat.find` requires to construct the minimal natural number.

declarations.name: deadline_paging_feasible_iff_exists_service_time
declarations.informal: An instance is feasible iff one can assign every request a service time inside its window so that each non-zero time slot sees at most k distinct pages and slot 0 sees only pages of the initial cache C₀.
declarations.statement:
theorem deadline_paging_feasible_iff_exists_service_time
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (k : ℕ) (C₀ : Finset α) (hC₀ : C₀.card = k)
    (reqs : List (DeadlineRequest α)) :
    (∃ sched : ℕ → Finset α, IsFeasibleSchedule k C₀ sched reqs) ↔
      ∃ f : Fin reqs.length → ℕ,
        (∀ i, (reqs.get i).arrival ≤ f i ∧ f i ≤ (reqs.get i).deadline) ∧
        (∀ t, t ≠ 0 →
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f i = t)).image (fun i => (reqs.get i).page)).card ≤ k) ∧
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f i = 0)).image (fun i => (reqs.get i).page)) ⊆ C₀
declarations.source:
/-- Feasibility is equivalent to an assignment of service times with a per-slot capacity condition (≤ k distinct pages off slot 0, only C₀ at slot 0); caching is a cost matter, never a feasibility blocker. -/
theorem deadline_paging_feasible_iff_exists_service_time
    {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (k : ℕ) (C₀ : Finset α) (hC₀ : C₀.card = k)
    (reqs : List (DeadlineRequest α)) :
    (∃ sched : ℕ → Finset α, IsFeasibleSchedule k C₀ sched reqs) ↔
      ∃ f : Fin reqs.length → ℕ,
        (∀ i, (reqs.get i).arrival ≤ f i ∧ f i ≤ (reqs.get i).deadline) ∧
        (∀ t, t ≠ 0 →
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f i = t)).image (fun i => (reqs.get i).page)).card ≤ k) ∧
        ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f i = 0)).image (fun i => (reqs.get i).page)) ⊆ C₀ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨sched, hsched⟩
    rcases hsched with ⟨h0, hcard, hserve⟩
    have h_each : ∀ i : Fin reqs.length, ∃ t, (reqs.get i).arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ (reqs.get i).deadline ∧ (reqs.get i).page ∈ sched t := by
      intro i
      exact hserve (reqs.get i) (List.get_mem reqs i)
    choose f hf using h_each
    refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      exact ⟨(hf i).1, (hf i).2.1⟩
    · intro t ht
      have hsub : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f i = t)).image (fun i => (reqs.get i).page)) ⊆ sched t := by
        intro p hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
        rcases hp with ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
        have := (hf i).2.2
        rw [hi] at this
        exact this
      exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (hcard t)
    · intro p hp
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
      rcases hp with ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      have := (hf i).2.2
      rw [hi, h0] at this
      exact this
  · rintro ⟨f, hwin, hcap, hC0_sub⟩
    let sched : ℕ → Finset α := fun t =>
      if t = 0 then C₀ else ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f i = t)).image (fun i => (reqs.get i).page))
    refine ⟨sched, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show sched 0 = C₀
      dsimp [sched]
    · intro t
      dsimp [sched]
      split_ifs with ht
      · rw [hC₀]
      · exact hcap t ht
    · intro r hr
      rcases List.mem_iff_get.mp hr with ⟨i, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨f i, (hwin i).1, (hwin i).2, ?_⟩
      dsimp [sched]
      split_ifs with ht
      · apply hC0_sub
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact ⟨i, ht, rfl⟩
      · simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩

explanation.summary: Feasibility of a deadline-paging instance is shown to be equivalent to the existence of an assignment of service times `f(i)` for each request `i` within its arrival-deadline window such that at most `k` distinct pages are served at any time slot `t > 0`, and only pages from the initial cache `C₀` are served at slot `0`. In the forward direction, given a feasible schedule, the axiom of choice extracts for each request a time slot in its window where its page is present in the cache; cache capacity bounds immediately transfer to the set of served pages. In the reverse direction, we simply set `sched 0 = C₀` and set `sched t` for `t > 0` to be exactly the set of pages assigned to `t`, which trivially satisfies the capacity bound and serves every request.

steps.claim: The equivalence between the existence of a feasible schedule and the existence of a valid service-time assignment splits into two implications.
steps.explanation: The `constructor` tactic breaks the `↔` statement into the forward direction (extracting a service-time function from a feasible schedule) and the reverse direction (constructing a feasible schedule from a service-time function).
steps.code: constructor

steps.claim: From a feasible schedule, there exists a function `f` mapping each request index `i` to a time in its arrival-deadline window at which its requested page is in the cache.
steps.explanation: Unpacking the assumption that the schedule is feasible gives the initial cache condition `sched 0 = C₀`, the capacity bound `|sched t| ≤ k` for all `t`, and the guarantee that every request in `reqs` is present in the cache at some time within its window. Applying this guarantee to the `i`-th request of the list (using `List.get_mem`) ensures such a time exists for each index `i`. By the axiom of choice (`choose`), we obtain a service-time function `f` selecting such a time `f(i)` for each request.
steps.code:
· rintro ⟨sched, hsched⟩
    rcases hsched with ⟨h0, hcard, hserve⟩
    have h_each : ∀ i : Fin reqs.length, ∃ t, (reqs.get i).arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ (reqs.get i).deadline ∧ (reqs.get i).page ∈ sched t := by
      intro i
      exact hserve (reqs.get i) (List.get_mem reqs i)
    choose f hf using h_each

steps.claim: For every request index `i`, the assigned service time `f(i)` lies in the window [arrival, deadline].
steps.explanation: We provide `f` as the witness. The arrival lower bound and deadline upper bound hold immediately from the properties of `f` established during its selection.
steps.code:
refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      exact ⟨(hf i).1, (hf i).2.1⟩

steps.claim: For any time slot `t ≠ 0`, at most `k` distinct pages are served at time `t`.
steps.explanation: Any page served at time `t` is requested by some index `i` with `f(i) = t`. By definition of `f`, this page belongs to `sched (f(i)) = sched t`. Thus the set of pages served at time `t` is a subset of `sched t`. Since `|sched t| ≤ k`, by monotonicity of cardinality (`Finset.card_le_card`) and transitivity of inequality (`le_trans`), the number of distinct pages served at time `t` is at most `k`.
steps.code:
· intro t ht
      have hsub : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f i = t)).image (fun i => (reqs.get i).page)) ⊆ sched t := by
        intro p hp
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
        rcases hp with ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
        have := (hf i).2.2
        rw [hi] at this
        exact this
      exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) (hcard t)

steps.claim: All pages served at time `0` belong to the initial cache `C₀`.
steps.explanation: If a page is served at time `0`, it is requested by some index `i` with `f(i) = 0`. By definition of `f`, the page belongs to `sched (f(i)) = sched 0`. Since `sched 0 = C₀`, the page belongs to `C₀`.
steps.code:
· intro p hp
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hp
      rcases hp with ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      have := (hf i).2.2
      rw [hi, h0] at this
      exact this

steps.claim: Given a service-time assignment `f`, we define a candidate schedule `sched` where `sched 0 = C₀` and for `t ≠ 0`, `sched t` is the set of pages served at time `t`.
steps.explanation: Assuming `f` satisfies the window, capacity, and initial cache conditions, we define `sched` by case distinction: `sched 0 = C₀`, and for `t ≠ 0`, `sched t` consists precisely of the pages requested with `f(i) = t`. It remains to show that `sched` satisfies the three feasibility conditions.
steps.code:
· rintro ⟨f, hwin, hcap, hC0_sub⟩
    let sched : ℕ → Finset α := fun t =>
      if t = 0 then C₀ else ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => f i = t)).image (fun i => (reqs.get i).page))
    refine ⟨sched, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

steps.claim: The schedule satisfies the initial cache condition `sched 0 = C₀`.
steps.explanation: By definition, `sched 0` evaluates directly to `C₀`.
steps.code:
· show sched 0 = C₀
      dsimp [sched]

steps.claim: For every time `t`, the cache size satisfies `|sched t| ≤ k`.
steps.explanation: For `t = 0`, `sched 0 = C₀`, which has cardinality `k` by the hypothesis `hC₀`. For `t ≠ 0`, `sched t` is the set of pages assigned to `t`, which has cardinality at most `k` by the capacity condition on `f`.
steps.code:
· intro t
      dsimp [sched]
      split_ifs with ht
      · rw [hC₀]
      · exact hcap t ht

steps.claim: Every request in `reqs` is served within its arrival-deadline window.
steps.explanation: For any request `r ∈ reqs`, we express `r` as the `i`-th element of `reqs` using `List.mem_iff_get.mp`. We serve request `r` at time `f(i)`, which lies in its window by assumption. If `f(i) = 0`, the page is served at time 0 and therefore belongs to `C₀ = sched 0` by the initial condition on `f`. If `f(i) ≠ 0`, the page belongs to `sched (f(i))` by definition of `sched`.
steps.code:
· intro r hr
      rcases List.mem_iff_get.mp hr with ⟨i, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨f i, (hwin i).1, (hwin i).2, ?_⟩
      dsimp [sched]
      split_ifs with ht
      · apply hC0_sub
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact ⟨i, ht, rfl⟩
      · simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        exact ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩

glossary.List.get_mem: For any list `l` and index `n : Fin l.length`, the element `l.get n` belongs to `l`.
glossary.Finset.mem_image: An element `b` belongs to the image of a finite set `s` under `f` if and only if there exists `a ∈ s` with `f a = b`.
glossary.Finset.mem_filter: An element `a` belongs to `s.filter p` if and only if `a ∈ s` and `p a` holds.
glossary.Finset.mem_univ: Every element of a finite type belongs to the universal finite set `Finset.univ`.
glossary.true_and: The conjunction `True ∧ p` is logically equivalent to `p`.
glossary.Finset.card_le_card: If `s ⊆ t` for finite sets `s` and `t`, then the cardinality of `s` is at most the cardinality of `t`.
glossary.le_trans: The inequality relation `≤` is transitive: if `a ≤ b` and `b ≤ c`, then `a ≤ c`.
glossary.List.mem_iff_get.mp: If an element belongs to a list `l`, then it equals `l.get n` for some index `n : Fin l.length`.

caveats: Requests in the list `reqs` are formally indexed by `Fin reqs.length`, so service times are assigned via a function `f : Fin reqs.length → ℕ` rather than indexing by request objects directly.

The schedule constructed in the reverse direction simply sets the cache at each non-zero slot `t` to be precisely the set of pages requested at slot `t`. It does not simulate cache retention across consecutive time steps because feasibility only requires that each requested page is present at its service time and that each slot does not exceed capacity `k` (cache persistence affects paging cost, but not feasibility).
