declarations.name: seq_touchers_subsingleton
declarations.informal: In a clean handshake sequence, each glove side is directly touched by at most one vertex: the set of touching vertices of a side is a subsingleton.
declarations.statement:
theorem seq_touchers_subsingleton {V : Type*} {Γ : Type*} [DecidableEq Γ]
    (seq : List (Handshake V Γ)) (t : Γ × Bool → Set V) (h : CleanHandshakeSeq seq t)
    (s : Γ × Bool) : (seq_touchers seq s).Subsingleton
declarations.source:
theorem seq_touchers_subsingleton_handshake_clean_contam_subset_toucher {V : Type*} {Γ : Type*} [DecidableEq Γ]
    {h : Handshake V Γ} {t : Γ × Bool → Set V} (hc : handshake_is_clean h t)
    {s : Γ × Bool} {w : V} (hw : w ∈ handshake_touchers h s) :
    t s ⊆ {w} := by
  cases h with
  | single x a y =>
    simp only [handshake_is_clean] at hc
    rcases hc with ⟨hxa, hya⟩
    simp only [handshake_touchers] at hw
    by_cases hsa : s = a
    · subst hsa
      simp only [if_true] at hw
      have : w = x := hw
      subst this
      exact hxa
    · simp only [if_neg hsa] at hw
      by_cases hso : s = opp_glove_side a
      · subst hso
        simp only [if_true] at hw
        have : w = y := hw
        subst this
        exact hya
      · simp only [if_neg hso] at hw
        cases hw
  | double x a b y =>
    simp only [handshake_is_clean] at hc
    rcases hc with ⟨hne, hxa, hyb⟩
    simp only [handshake_touchers] at hw
    by_cases hsa : s = a
    · subst hsa
      simp only [if_true] at hw
      have : w = x := hw
      subst this
      exact hxa
    · simp only [if_neg hsa] at hw
      by_cases hsb : s = b
      · subst hsb
        simp only [if_true] at hw
        have : w = y := hw
        subst this
        exact hyb
      · simp only [if_neg hsb] at hw
        cases hw

theorem seq_touchers_subsingleton_eq_of_mem_contam {V : Type*} {Γ : Type*} [DecidableEq Γ]
    {seq : List (Handshake V Γ)} {t : Γ × Bool → Set V} (h : CleanHandshakeSeq seq t)
    {s : Γ × Bool} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ t s) {w : V} (hw : w ∈ seq_touchers seq s) :
    w = v := by
  induction h with
  | nil =>
    cases hw
  | cons head tl t_init hc htl ih =>
    cases hw with
    | inl htouch =>
      have ht_sub : t_init s ⊆ {w} := seq_touchers_subsingleton_handshake_clean_contam_subset_toucher hc htouch
      have : v ∈ ({w} : Set V) := ht_sub hv
      exact this.symm
    | inr hrest =>
      have hv' : v ∈ handshake_update_contam head t_init s :=
        seq_touchers_subset_contam_contam_mono_step head t_init s hv
      exact ih hv' hrest

/-- A single glove side is touched by at most one vertex over a clean sequence. -/
theorem seq_touchers_subsingleton {V : Type*} {Γ : Type*} [DecidableEq Γ]
    (seq : List (Handshake V Γ)) (t : Γ × Bool → Set V) (h : CleanHandshakeSeq seq t)
    (s : Γ × Bool) : (seq_touchers seq s).Subsingleton := by
  induction h with
  | nil =>
    intro a ha
    cases ha
  | cons head tl t_init hc htl ih =>
    intro a ha b hb
    cases ha with
    | inl ha_head =>
      cases hb with
      | inl hb_head =>
        have h_up : handshake_update_contam head t_init s ⊆ {a} :=
          handshake_clean_update_contam_subset_toucher hc ha_head
        have hb_in_up : b ∈ handshake_update_contam head t_init s :=
          seq_touchers_subset_contam_handshake_touchers_subset_contam_step head t_init s hb_head
        have : b ∈ ({a} : Set V) := h_up hb_in_up
        exact this.symm
      | inr hb_tl =>
        have ha_in_up : a ∈ handshake_update_contam head t_init s :=
          seq_touchers_subset_contam_handshake_touchers_subset_contam_step head t_init s ha_head
        have hb_eq_a : b = a := seq_touchers_subsingleton_eq_of_mem_contam htl ha_in_up hb_tl
        exact hb_eq_a.symm
    | inr ha_tl =>
      cases hb with
      | inl hb_head =>
        have hb_in_up : b ∈ handshake_update_contam head t_init s :=
          seq_touchers_subset_contam_handshake_touchers_subset_contam_step head t_init s hb_head
        exact seq_touchers_subsingleton_eq_of_mem_contam htl hb_in_up ha_tl
      | inr hb_tl =>
        exact ih ha_tl hb_tl

explanation.summary: The theorem is proved by induction on the derivation of a clean handshake sequence. The base case of an empty sequence is vacuous because there are no touchers. In the inductive step, any two touchers a and b of the same glove side s either both touch in the head handshake, both touch in the tail sequence, or one touches in the head and one in the tail. Cleanliness forces the updated contamination of a touched side to be a singleton, and the helper lemma seq_touchers_subsingleton_eq_of_mem_contam shows that any subsequent toucher in the tail must match any vertex already in the contamination, yielding a = b in every case.

steps.claim: For a single handshake h, if vertex w touches glove side s in h, then the prior contamination at s satisfies t(s) ⊆ {w}.
steps.explanation: We analyze the case of a single handshake h = single(x, a, y). Cleanliness of h with respect to t means t(a) ⊆ {x} and t(opp_glove_side(a)) ⊆ {y}. By definition, the touchers of s are {x} if s = a, {y} if s = opp_glove_side(a), and empty otherwise. If s = a, then w = x, so t(s) = t(a) ⊆ {x} = {w}. If s = opp_glove_side(a), then w = y, so t(s) = t(opp_glove_side(a)) ⊆ {y} = {w}. If s is neither, w ∈ ∅, which is impossible.
steps.code:
cases h with
  | single x a y =>
    simp only [handshake_is_clean] at hc
    rcases hc with ⟨hxa, hya⟩
    simp only [handshake_touchers] at hw
    by_cases hsa : s = a
    · subst hsa
      simp only [if_true] at hw
      have : w = x := hw
      subst this
      exact hxa
    · simp only [if_neg hsa] at hw
      by_cases hso : s = opp_glove_side a
      · subst hso
        simp only [if_true] at hw
        have : w = y := hw
        subst this
        exact hya
      · simp only [if_neg hso] at hw
        cases hw

steps.claim: For a double handshake h, if vertex w touches glove side s in h, then t(s) ⊆ {w}.
steps.explanation: We analyze the case of a double handshake h = double(x, a, b, y). Cleanliness gives a.1 ≠ b.1, t(a) ⊆ {x}, and t(b) ⊆ {y}. The touchers of s are {x} if s = a, {y} if s = b, and empty otherwise. If s = a, then w = x and t(s) = t(a) ⊆ {w}. If s = b, then w = y and t(s) = t(b) ⊆ {w}. If s is neither, w ∈ ∅, a contradiction.
steps.code:
| double x a b y =>
    simp only [handshake_is_clean] at hc
    rcases hc with ⟨hne, hxa, hyb⟩
    simp only [handshake_touchers] at hw
    by_cases hsa : s = a
    · subst hsa
      simp only [if_true] at hw
      have : w = x := hw
      subst this
      exact hxa
    · simp only [if_neg hsa] at hw
      by_cases hsb : s = b
      · subst hsb
        simp only [if_true] at hw
        have : w = y := hw
        subst this
        exact hyb
      · simp only [if_neg hsb] at hw
        cases hw

steps.claim: In an empty handshake sequence, the premise that vertex w touches side s is impossible.
steps.explanation: We proceed by induction on the clean sequence derivation CleanHandshakeSeq seq t. For the empty sequence (nil), seq_touchers([], s) is empty by definition, so the assumption w ∈ seq_touchers([], s) leads to an immediate contradiction.
steps.code:
induction h with
  | nil =>
    cases hw

steps.claim: In the inductive step of the helper lemma, if w touches side s during the head handshake, then w = v.
steps.explanation: For a sequence head :: tl with initial contamination t_init, if w touches s during the head handshake, the single-handshake lemma shows t_init(s) ⊆ {w}. Since v ∈ t_init(s) by hypothesis, we have v ∈ {w}, which means v = w, so w = v.
steps.code:
| cons head tl t_init hc htl ih =>
    cases hw with
    | inl htouch =>
      have ht_sub : t_init s ⊆ {w} := seq_touchers_subsingleton_handshake_clean_contam_subset_toucher hc htouch
      have : v ∈ ({w} : Set V) := ht_sub hv
      exact this.symm

steps.claim: In the inductive step of the helper lemma, if w touches side s in the tail sequence, then w = v.
steps.explanation: If w touches s in the tail sequence, the monotonicity of contamination under handshake updates ensures that v ∈ t_init(s) remains in the updated contamination handshake_update_contam(head, t_init, s). The induction hypothesis on the tail sequence then gives w = v.
steps.code:
| inr hrest =>
      have hv' : v ∈ handshake_update_contam head t_init s :=
        seq_touchers_subset_contam_contam_mono_step head t_init s hv
      exact ih hv' hrest

steps.claim: For an empty handshake sequence, the set of touchers of side s is a subsingleton.
steps.explanation: We prove the main theorem by induction on the clean sequence derivation CleanHandshakeSeq seq t. For the empty list (nil), seq_touchers([], s) is empty, so there are no elements to compare and the subsingleton condition holds vacuously.
steps.code:
induction h with
  | nil =>
    intro a ha
    cases ha

steps.claim: In a compound sequence, if two vertices a and b both touch side s during the head handshake, then a = b.
steps.explanation: Consider two vertices a, b ∈ seq_touchers(head :: tl, s). If both touch s during head, lemma handshake_clean_update_contam_subset_toucher shows that the updated contamination at s is contained in {a}. Since b also touches s in head, lemma seq_touchers_subset_contam_handshake_touchers_subset_contam_step places b in that same updated contamination. Therefore b ∈ {a}, which means b = a, so a = b.
steps.code:
| cons head tl t_init hc htl ih =>
    intro a ha b hb
    cases ha with
    | inl ha_head =>
      cases hb with
      | inl hb_head =>
        have h_up : handshake_update_contam head t_init s ⊆ {a} :=
          handshake_clean_update_contam_subset_toucher hc ha_head
        have hb_in_up : b ∈ handshake_update_contam head t_init s :=
          seq_touchers_subset_contam_handshake_touchers_subset_contam_step head t_init s hb_head
        have : b ∈ ({a} : Set V) := h_up hb_in_up
        exact this.symm

steps.claim: If vertex a touches side s during the head handshake and vertex b touches side s in the tail sequence, then a = b.
steps.explanation: Vertex a belongs to the updated contamination at s after the head handshake by seq_touchers_subset_contam_handshake_touchers_subset_contam_step. Because b touches side s in the remaining sequence tl, the helper lemma seq_touchers_subsingleton_eq_of_mem_contam applies to the clean tail sequence to yield b = a, so a = b.
steps.code:
| inr hb_tl =>
        have ha_in_up : a ∈ handshake_update_contam head t_init s :=
          seq_touchers_subset_contam_handshake_touchers_subset_contam_step head t_init s ha_head
        have hb_eq_a : b = a := seq_touchers_subsingleton_eq_of_mem_contam htl ha_in_up hb_tl
        exact hb_eq_a.symm

steps.claim: If vertex a touches side s in the tail sequence and vertex b touches side s during the head handshake, then a = b.
steps.explanation: Symmetrically, vertex b enters the updated contamination at s after the head handshake. The helper lemma seq_touchers_subsingleton_eq_of_mem_contam on the tail sequence then establishes that the tail toucher a equals b.
steps.code:
| inr ha_tl =>
      cases hb with
      | inl hb_head =>
        have hb_in_up : b ∈ handshake_update_contam head t_init s :=
          seq_touchers_subset_contam_handshake_touchers_subset_contam_step head t_init s hb_head
        exact seq_touchers_subsingleton_eq_of_mem_contam htl hb_in_up ha_tl

steps.claim: If both vertices a and b touch side s in the tail sequence, then a = b.
steps.explanation: When both touchers come from the tail sequence tl, the induction hypothesis for tl directly implies that a = b.
steps.code:
| inr hb_tl =>
        exact ih ha_tl hb_tl

glossary.if_true: An if-then-else expression whose condition is True evaluates to the then branch.
glossary.if_neg: An if-then-else expression whose condition is False evaluates to the else branch.
glossary.seq_touchers_subsingleton_handshake_clea: In a clean handshake with contamination map t, if vertex w touches side s, then the prior contamination at that side satisfies t(s) ⊆ {w}.
glossary.seq_touchers_subset_contam_contam_mono_s: Contamination increases monotonically with each handshake: t(s) ⊆ handshake_update_contam(h, t, s).
glossary.handshake_clean_update_contam_subset_tou: For a clean handshake, the updated contamination at a side touched by v is a subset of the singleton {v}.
glossary.seq_touchers_subset_contam_handshake_tou: Any vertex touching a glove side during a handshake belongs to the updated contamination of that side.
glossary.seq_touchers_subsingleton_eq_of_mem_cont: In a clean handshake sequence, if v is in the contamination of side s and w touches s anywhere in the sequence, then w = v.

declarations.name: has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective
declarations.informal: Relabelling colours by an injective map does not change the existence of a monochromatic induced j-diamond: if ψ = f ∘ χ with f injective, then χ has a mono j-diamond in colour col iff ψ has one in colour f col.
declarations.statement:
theorem has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective {j d k k' : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Fin k')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (ψ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k') (h : ∀ A, ψ A = f (χ A)) :
    has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (f col) ψ ↔ has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d col χ
declarations.source:
/-- Diamond copies transfer along an injective relabelling of the colour type. -/
theorem has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective {j d k k' : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Fin k')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (ψ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k') (h : ∀ A, ψ A = f (χ A)) :
    has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (f col) ψ ↔ has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d col χ := by
  simp only [has_monochromatic_diamond_copy, h, hf.eq_iff]

explanation.summary: The theorem states that relabelling colours via an injective map f preserves the existence of a monochromatic j-diamond copy. Because the definition of a monochromatic diamond copy only references the colouring via equalities of the form colour(A) = col, substituting ψ(A) = f(χ(A)) and applying the injectivity of f (f(χ(A)) = f(col) ↔ χ(A) = col) makes the definition for ψ and f(col) logically equivalent to the definition for χ and col. A single simplification step unfolds the definition, rewrites along the colouring identity, and cancels f.

steps.claim: The coloring ψ has a monochromatic j-diamond in colour f col if and only if χ has one in colour col.
steps.explanation: Unfolding the definition of has_monochromatic_diamond_copy, the condition for ψ to have a monochromatic j-diamond in colour f col is identical to that for χ in colour col, except that each colour requirement ψ(A) = f col is replaced by f(χ A) = f col via hypothesis h. By injectivity of f (hf.eq_iff), f(χ A) = f col is equivalent to χ A = col. Since the containment relations and incomparability of the subsets do not involve colours, both sides simplify to the exact same existential statement.
steps.code: simp only [has_monochromatic_diamond_copy, h, hf.eq_iff]

glossary.has_monochromatic_diamond_copy: The definition stating that under coloring χ, there exists a monochromatic j-diamond in colour col: a bottom element bot, a top element top with bot ⊂ top, and j pairwise incomparable intermediate elements mid i with bot ⊂ mid i ⊂ top, all assigned colour col.
glossary.hf.eq_iff: For an injective function f, f a = f b if and only if a = b.

declarations.name: has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_injective
declarations.informal: Relabelling colours by an injective map does not change the existence of a monochromatic induced F_j: if ψ = f ∘ χ with f injective, then χ has a mono F_j in colour col iff ψ has one in colour f col.
declarations.statement:
theorem has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_injective {j d k k' : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Fin k')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (ψ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k') (h : ∀ A, ψ A = f (χ A)) :
    has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d (f col) ψ ↔ has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d col χ
declarations.source:
/-- Fan copies transfer along an injective relabelling of the colour type. -/
theorem has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_injective {j d k k' : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Fin k')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (ψ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k') (h : ∀ A, ψ A = f (χ A)) :
    has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d (f col) ψ ↔ has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d col χ := by
  unfold has_monochromatic_fan_copy
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hinc⟩
    refine ⟨top, hf ?_, mid, ?_, hinc⟩
    · rw [h top] at htop; exact htop
    · intro i
      exact ⟨(hmid i).1, hf (by rw [← h (mid i)]; exact (hmid i).2)⟩
  · rintro ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hinc⟩
    refine ⟨top, ?_, mid, ?_, hinc⟩
    · rw [h top, htop]
    · intro i
      exact ⟨(hmid i).1, by rw [h (mid i), (hmid i).2]⟩

explanation.summary: A monochromatic fan copy consists of a top vertex and a family of pairwise incomparable petals strictly contained in it, all sharing the same colour. Because containment and incomparability depend solely on the vertices and not on the colouring, any configuration witnessing a fan copy under one colouring serves as the witness under the other. Injectivity of f allows pulling back the colour equalities from f col under ψ to col under χ, while the converse holds by evaluating f on the colours assigned by χ.

steps.claim: The equivalence between the existence of monochromatic fan copies under ψ and χ reduces to proving both directions separately.
steps.explanation: Unfolding the definition of a monochromatic fan copy, the goal is to show that there exist a top vertex and a family of pairwise incomparable petals strictly contained in it, all of a given colour. The if-and-only-if statement is then split into the forward and backward implications.
steps.code:
unfold has_monochromatic_fan_copy
  constructor

steps.claim: If ψ has a monochromatic fan copy of colour f col, then χ has one of colour col.
steps.explanation: Given a fan copy under ψ with top vertex `top` and petals `mid`, we take the exact same sets as the witness for χ. The strict containment `mid i ⊂ top` and pairwise incomparability of the petals are purely set-theoretic properties, so they carry over unchanged. For the colour conditions, the assumption ψ(A) = f(χ(A)) turns ψ(top) = f col into f(χ(top)) = f col, which by injectivity of f implies χ(top) = col. Applying the same argument to each petal gives f(χ(mid i)) = ψ(mid i) = f col, and injectivity of f yields χ(mid i) = col.
steps.code:
· rintro ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hinc⟩
    refine ⟨top, hf ?_, mid, ?_, hinc⟩
    · rw [h top] at htop; exact htop
    · intro i
      exact ⟨(hmid i).1, hf (by rw [← h (mid i)]; exact (hmid i).2)⟩

steps.claim: If χ has a monochromatic fan copy of colour col, then ψ has one of colour f col.
steps.explanation: Conversely, given a monochromatic fan copy (top, mid) of colour col under χ, the same sets serve as the witness for ψ. The inclusion and incomparability conditions hold as before. The colour conditions follow directly by substitution: ψ(top) = f(χ(top)) = f col, and for each petal, ψ(mid i) = f(χ(mid i)) = f col.
steps.code:
· rintro ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hinc⟩
    refine ⟨top, ?_, mid, ?_, hinc⟩
    · rw [h top, htop]
    · intro i
      exact ⟨(hmid i).1, by rw [h (mid i), (hmid i).2]⟩

declarations.name: mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_base_zero_diamond_colours
declarations.informal: Base case a = 0 (b ≥ 1): if d ≥ (j-1)*b + 1 then every colouring of the subsets of Fin d with 0 + b colours has a monochromatic induced F_j in one of the b colours.
declarations.statement:
theorem mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_base_zero_diamond_colours (j b d : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : (j - 1) * b + 1 ≤ d) : mixed_ramsey_property j 0 b d
declarations.source:
/-- Base case a = 0: only fan colours, so this is fan_ramsey_bound up to the Fin (0+b) ≃ Fin b reindexing. -/
theorem mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_base_zero_diamond_colours (j b d : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : (j - 1) * b + 1 ≤ d) : mixed_ramsey_property j 0 b d := by
  intro χ
  right
  have hk : 1 ≤ 0 + b := by omega
  have hcard : (0 + b) * (j - 1) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card (Fin d) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.zero_add, Nat.mul_comm]
    exact hd
  have h := fan_ramsey_bound_general j hj (0 + b) hk (Fin d) hcard χ
  rcases h with ⟨col, top, htop, mid, hmid, hinc⟩
  have hcol : ∃ col' : Fin b, Fin.natAdd 0 col' = col := by
    use ⟨col.val, by omega⟩
    ext
    simp
  rcases hcol with ⟨col', rfl⟩
  refine ⟨col', top, htop, mid, hmid, hinc⟩

explanation.summary: This theorem establishes the base case a = 0 of the mixed diamond-fan Ramsey bound, where no colours are reserved for diamonds and all b colours are fan colours. Because the dimension d satisfies d ≥ (j - 1) * b + 1, the general fan Ramsey theorem (`fan_ramsey_bound_general`) applies directly to any colouring with 0 + b colours. Identifying the resulting monochromatic colour with a colour in Fin b via `Fin.natAdd 0` produces the desired monochromatic fan.

steps.claim: To establish `mixed_ramsey_property j 0 b d`, it suffices to find a monochromatic fan copy for any (0 + b)-colouring χ.
steps.explanation: Given an arbitrary colouring χ of the subsets of `Fin d` using 0 + b colours, the definition of `mixed_ramsey_property` offers a disjunction: either a monochromatic diamond in one of the first 0 colours, or a monochromatic fan in one of the b fan colours. Since there are 0 diamond colours, the tactic `right` selects the second alternative, leaving the goal of finding a monochromatic fan in some colour `Fin.natAdd 0 col'`.
steps.code:
intro χ
  right

steps.claim: The number of colours 0 + b is at least 1, and the cardinality condition (0 + b) * (j - 1) + 1 ≤ |Fin d| holds.
steps.explanation: Since b ≥ 1, linear arithmetic (`omega`) shows 1 ≤ 0 + b. Furthermore, using |Fin d| = d (`Fintype.card_fin`), simplifying 0 + b to b (`Nat.zero_add`), and commutativity of multiplication (`Nat.mul_comm`), the cardinality requirement (0 + b) * (j - 1) + 1 ≤ |Fin d| reduces to (j - 1) * b + 1 ≤ d, which is exactly the hypothesis `hd`.
steps.code:
have hk : 1 ≤ 0 + b := by omega
  have hcard : (0 + b) * (j - 1) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card (Fin d) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.zero_add, Nat.mul_comm]
    exact hd

steps.claim: There exists a monochromatic fan copy of size j in some colour col ∈ Fin (0 + b).
steps.explanation: Applying the general fan Ramsey theorem `fan_ramsey_bound_general` with k = 0 + b colours on the universe `Fin d` produces a colour `col : Fin (0 + b)`, a top subset `top`, and j pairwise incomparable subsets `mid i ⊂ top` that all share the colour `col`.
steps.code:
have h := fan_ramsey_bound_general j hj (0 + b) hk (Fin d) hcard χ
  rcases h with ⟨col, top, htop, mid, hmid, hinc⟩

steps.claim: The colour col ∈ Fin (0 + b) is equal to Fin.natAdd 0 col' for some col' ∈ Fin b.
steps.explanation: Since `col.val < 0 + b = b`, the underlying integer value of `col` defines a valid element `col' : Fin b`. Shifting this index by 0 via `Fin.natAdd 0` produces `col`, so we can substitute `col` with `Fin.natAdd 0 col'`.
steps.code:
have hcol : ∃ col' : Fin b, Fin.natAdd 0 col' = col := by
    use ⟨col.val, by omega⟩
    ext
    simp
  rcases hcol with ⟨col', rfl⟩

steps.claim: The monochromatic fan copy witnessed by col', top, and mid satisfies the goal.
steps.explanation: Supplying the re-indexed colour `col'`, the top set `top`, and the collection of subsets `mid` witnesses `has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d (Fin.natAdd 0 col') χ`, completing the proof.
steps.code: refine ⟨col', top, htop, mid, hmid, hinc⟩

glossary.Fintype.card_fin: The cardinality of the standard finite type `Fin n` with n elements is n.
glossary.Nat.zero_add: Adding zero on the left is the identity: `0 + n = n`.
glossary.Nat.mul_comm: Multiplication of natural numbers is commutative: `n * m = m * n`.
glossary.fan_ramsey_bound_general: For any finite set α with |α| ≥ k * (j - 1) + 1 and j ≥ 2, k ≥ 1, any k-colouring of the subsets of α contains a monochromatic induced fan copy of size j.

caveats: Lines 12–16 perform a purely formal re-indexing between `Fin (0 + b)` and `Fin b` using `Fin.natAdd 0`, which has no mathematical content beyond 0 + b = b but is required by Lean's dependent type system to match the signature of `mixed_ramsey_property`.

declarations.name: mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_last_colour_step
declarations.informal: Case b = 0, a ≥ 1: if d ≥ j*a and the statement holds at (a-1, 1) in the same dimension, then every colouring with a colours has a monochromatic induced j-diamond in one of them.
declarations.statement:
theorem mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_last_colour_step (j a d : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j) (ha : 1 ≤ a)
    (hd : j * a ≤ d) (ih : mixed_ramsey_property j (a - 1) 1 d) : mixed_ramsey_property j a 0 d
declarations.source:
theorem mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_last_colour_step_fan_to_diamond
    (j d : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j) {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k)
    (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k) (h0 : χ ∅ = c)
    (hfan : has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d c χ) :
    has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d c χ := by
  have : NeZero j := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hpair⟩ := hfan
  have key : ∀ i : Fin j, mid i ≠ ∅ := by
    intro i hi
    have hne : ∃ i' : Fin j, i' ≠ i := by
      rcases eq_or_ne i 0 with h | h
      · refine ⟨⟨1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [h]
        intro hh
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val hh
        simp at hv
      · exact ⟨0, fun hh => h hh.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ := hne
    exact hpair i i' (Ne.symm hi') (by rw [hi]; exact Finset.empty_subset _)
  refine ⟨∅, top, ?_, h0, htop, mid, ?_, hpair⟩
  · exact lt_trans (Finset.empty_ssubset.mpr (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (key 0)))
      (hmid 0).1
  · intro i
    exact ⟨Finset.empty_ssubset.mpr (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (key i)),
      (hmid i).1, (hmid i).2⟩

/-- b = 0 step: recolour the colour of ∅ as the single fan colour and apply the (a-1, 1) instance; a fan in that colour plus ∅ as bottom is a diamond. -/
theorem mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_last_colour_step (j a d : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j) (ha : 1 ≤ a)
    (hd : j * a ≤ d) (ih : mixed_ramsey_property j (a - 1) 1 d) : mixed_ramsey_property j a 0 d := by
  intro χ
  have ha' : a = (a - 1) + 1 := by omega
  let c₀ : Fin a := χ ∅
  let e₀ : Fin a ≃ Fin ((a - 1) + 1) := (Fin.castOrderIso ha').toEquiv
  let e : Fin a ≃ Fin ((a - 1) + 1) := e₀.trans (Equiv.swap (e₀ c₀) (Fin.last (a - 1)))
  have he_c₀ : e c₀ = Fin.last (a - 1) := by
    show (Equiv.swap (e₀ c₀) (Fin.last (a - 1))) (e₀ c₀) = Fin.last (a - 1)
    exact Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _
  let κ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin ((a - 1) + 1) := fun A => e (χ A)
  have hκ : ∀ A, κ A = e (χ A) := fun A => rfl
  rcases ih κ with ⟨col, hcol⟩ | ⟨col, hcol⟩
  · left
    have hdiam : has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col)) χ := by
      refine (has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective (j := j) e e.injective
        (e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col)) χ κ hκ).mp ?_
      rwa [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    refine ⟨e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col), ?_⟩
    have heq : Fin.castAdd 0 (e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col))
        = e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col) := rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact hdiam
  · left
    have hcol0 : (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col) = e c₀ := by
      have hc : col = 0 := by ext; omega
      rw [hc, he_c₀]
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [Fin.last]
    have hfan : has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d c₀ χ := by
      refine (has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_injective (j := j) e e.injective c₀ χ κ hκ).mp ?_
      rw [← hcol0]
      exact hcol
    exact ⟨c₀, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_last_colour_step_fan_to_diamond j d hj c₀ χ rfl hfan⟩

explanation.summary: To establish the base case b = 0 with a ≥ 1 colours, we evaluate the colouring on the empty set, c₀ = χ(∅). We construct a bijection on colours that maps c₀ to the designated single fan colour and the remaining a - 1 colours to diamond colours, then apply the (a-1, 1) induction hypothesis to the recoloured hypercube. If this yields a diamond in one of the first a - 1 colours, it pulls back directly to a monochromatic diamond for χ. If it yields a fan in colour c₀, adjoining ∅ as the bottom element turns the fan into a monochromatic diamond in colour c₀, because incomparability of the fan branches guarantees no branch is empty.

steps.claim: Unpack the monochromatic fan into its apex and branches.
steps.explanation: From the assumption that χ contains a monochromatic j-fan in colour c, we obtain its apex top with χ(top) = c and j branches mid(i) such that each branch is strictly contained in top, has colour c, and no branch is a subset of another. Since j ≥ 2, the index type Fin j is non-empty.
steps.code:
have : NeZero j := ⟨by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hpair⟩ := hfan

steps.claim: Every branch of the fan is non-empty.
steps.explanation: Suppose for contradiction that some branch mid(i) is empty. Since j ≥ 2, there exists a distinct index i' ≠ i (either 1 if i = 0, or 0 if i ≠ 0). But the empty set is a subset of every set, so mid(i) = ∅ ⊆ mid(i'), contradicting the requirement that fan branches are pairwise incomparable.
steps.code:
have key : ∀ i : Fin j, mid i ≠ ∅ := by
    intro i hi
    have hne : ∃ i' : Fin j, i' ≠ i := by
      rcases eq_or_ne i 0 with h | h
      · refine ⟨⟨1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [h]
        intro hh
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val hh
        simp at hv
      · exact ⟨0, fun hh => h hh.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ := hne
    exact hpair i i' (Ne.symm hi') (by rw [hi]; exact Finset.empty_subset _)

steps.claim: The fan together with the empty set as the bottom element forms a monochromatic diamond.
steps.explanation: We construct a monochromatic diamond copy using ∅ as the bottom element, top as the apex, and mid as the branches. By hypothesis, χ(∅) = c. Because each branch is non-empty, ∅ ⊂ mid(i). By transitivity through branch 0, ∅ ⊂ mid(0) ⊂ top, so ∅ ⊂ top. Each branch mid(i) retains colour c, is strictly contained in top, and the branches remain pairwise incomparable.
steps.code:
refine ⟨∅, top, ?_, h0, htop, mid, ?_, hpair⟩
  · exact lt_trans (Finset.empty_ssubset.mpr (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (key 0)))
      (hmid 0).1
  · intro i
    exact ⟨Finset.empty_ssubset.mpr (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (key i)),
      (hmid i).1, (hmid i).2⟩

steps.claim: Construct a colour bijection sending the colour of the empty set to the designated fan colour.
steps.explanation: Let c₀ = χ(∅). Since a ≥ 1, we write a = (a - 1) + 1. Identifying Fin a with Fin ((a - 1) + 1) via the canonical order isomorphism, we swap the image of c₀ with the final colour Fin.last (a - 1). This produces an equivalence e : Fin a ≃ Fin ((a - 1) + 1) that maps c₀ to Fin.last (a - 1).
steps.code:
intro χ
  have ha' : a = (a - 1) + 1 := by omega
  let c₀ : Fin a := χ ∅
  let e₀ : Fin a ≃ Fin ((a - 1) + 1) := (Fin.castOrderIso ha').toEquiv
  let e : Fin a ≃ Fin ((a - 1) + 1) := e₀.trans (Equiv.swap (e₀ c₀) (Fin.last (a - 1)))
  have he_c₀ : e c₀ = Fin.last (a - 1) := by
    show (Equiv.swap (e₀ c₀) (Fin.last (a - 1))) (e₀ c₀) = Fin.last (a - 1)
    exact Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _

steps.claim: Apply the (a-1, 1) induction hypothesis to the recoloured hypercube.
steps.explanation: Define the recoloured colouring κ(A) = e(χ(A)). Applying the induction hypothesis ih to κ with a - 1 diamond colours and 1 fan colour yields either a monochromatic diamond in one of the first a - 1 colours, or a monochromatic fan in the final colour.

steps.claim: If the induction hypothesis yields a diamond, pull it back to a monochromatic diamond for χ.
steps.explanation: In the first case, κ contains a monochromatic diamond in colour Fin.castAdd 1 col for some col ∈ Fin (a - 1). Because e is bijective, the lemma has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective pulls this diamond back to a monochromatic diamond for χ in colour e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col), which is one of the a colours.
steps.code:
· left
    have hdiam : has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col)) χ := by
      refine (has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective (j := j) e e.injective
        (e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col)) χ κ hκ).mp ?_
      rwa [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    refine ⟨e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col), ?_⟩
    have heq : Fin.castAdd 0 (e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col))
        = e.symm (Fin.castAdd 1 col) := rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact hdiam

steps.claim: If the induction hypothesis yields a fan, its colour corresponds to c₀ under the bijection.
steps.explanation: In the second case, κ contains a monochromatic fan in colour Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col where col ∈ Fin 1. Since Fin 1 contains only 0, col = 0. The fan colour thus simplifies to Fin.last (a - 1), which equals e(c₀) by the construction of e.
steps.code:
· left
    have hcol0 : (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col) = e c₀ := by
      have hc : col = 0 := by ext; omega
      rw [hc, he_c₀]
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [Fin.last]

steps.claim: Pull back the fan to χ and extend it to a monochromatic diamond in colour c₀.
steps.explanation: By injectivity of e, the monochromatic fan for κ in colour e(c₀) pulls back to a monochromatic fan for χ in colour c₀. Since χ(∅) = c₀, the helper lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_last_colour_step_fan_to_diamond adjoins ∅ as the bottom element to turn this fan into a monochromatic diamond for χ in colour c₀, completing the proof.
steps.code:
have hfan : has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d c₀ χ := by
      refine (has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_injective (j := j) e e.injective c₀ χ κ hκ).mp ?_
      rw [← hcol0]
      exact hcol
    exact ⟨c₀, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_last_colour_step_fan_to_diamond j d hj c₀ χ rfl hfan⟩

glossary.eq_or_ne: Any two elements x and y are either equal or not equal.
glossary.congrArg: Applying a function to equal arguments yields equal results.
glossary.Fin.val: The underlying natural number value of an element of Fin n.
glossary.Ne.symm: Inequality is symmetric: if a ≠ b, then b ≠ a.
glossary.Finset.empty_subset: The empty set is a subset of every finite set.
glossary.lt_trans: Strict inequality (and strict subset inclusion) is transitive: a < b and b < c imply a < c.
glossary.Finset.empty_ssubset.mpr: A finite set is a strict superset of the empty set if it is nonempty.
glossary.Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr: A finite set is nonempty if it is not equal to the empty set.
glossary.Fin.castOrderIso: An equality of bounds n = m induces an order-preserving isomorphism between Fin n and Fin m.
glossary.Equiv.swap: The permutation that swaps two elements and fixes every other element.
glossary.Fin.last: The maximum element of Fin (n + 1), having numerical value n.
glossary.Equiv.swap_apply_left: The transposition of a and b maps a to b.
glossary.has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_in: Injective colour maps preserve and reflect the property of having a monochromatic diamond copy.
glossary.Fin.castAdd: Embeds Fin n into Fin (n + m) by preserving the numerical value.
glossary.Equiv.apply_symm_apply: Applying an equivalence to the image of its inverse is the identity.
glossary.Fin.natAdd: Embeds Fin m into Fin (n + m) by adding n to the numerical value.
glossary.Fin.ext: Two elements of Fin n are equal if their underlying natural values are equal.
glossary.has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_inject: Injective colour maps preserve and reflect the property of having a monochromatic fan copy.
glossary.mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_last_colo: In dimension d with j ≥ 2, if the empty set has colour c, any monochromatic j-fan in colour c extends to a monochromatic j-diamond in colour c with bottom element ∅.

caveats: The induction hypothesis operates on colourings into Fin ((a - 1) + 1). In the formal proof, aligning the colour of the empty set with the designated fan colour requires explicitly constructing an order isomorphism and transposing two elements via Equiv.swap, whereas on paper this is treated as a routine relabelling of colours.

declarations.name: has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective_nonempty
declarations.informal: If ψ = f ∘ χ on nonempty sets (f injective) and ψ ∅ ≠ f col, then a monochromatic induced j-diamond in ψ of colour f col yields one in χ of colour col.
declarations.statement:
theorem has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective_nonempty {j d k k' : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Fin k')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (ψ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k') (h : ∀ A, A.Nonempty → ψ A = f (χ A))
    (hempty : ψ ∅ ≠ f col) :
    has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (f col) ψ → has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d col χ
declarations.source:
/-- Diamond copies transfer along an injective relabelling of colours that is honest only off the empty set, given that the empty set carries a different colour. -/
theorem has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective_nonempty {j d k k' : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Fin k')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (ψ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k') (h : ∀ A, A.Nonempty → ψ A = f (χ A))
    (hempty : ψ ∅ ≠ f col) :
    has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (f col) ψ → has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d col χ := by
  rintro ⟨bot, top, hbot_top, hψ_bot, hψ_top, mid, hmid, hmid_inc⟩
  have hbot_ne : bot ≠ ∅ := fun he => hempty (he ▸ hψ_bot)
  have hbot_nonempty : bot.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hbot_ne
  have htop_nonempty : top.Nonempty := hbot_nonempty.mono hbot_top.1
  have hcol : ∀ {A}, A.Nonempty → ψ A = f col → χ A = col :=
    fun hA hψ => hf ((h _ hA).symm.trans hψ)
  refine ⟨bot, top, hbot_top, hcol hbot_nonempty hψ_bot, hcol htop_nonempty hψ_top, mid, fun i => ?_, hmid_inc⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hmid i
  exact ⟨h1, h2, hcol (hbot_nonempty.mono h1.1) h3⟩

explanation.summary: Given a monochromatic diamond copy of colour f col in ψ, the proof shows that the exact same configuration of sets forms a monochromatic diamond copy of colour col in χ. Because ψ ∅ ≠ f col, the bottom set of the diamond cannot be empty, which implies that the bottom, top, and all middle sets are nonempty. Since ψ = f ∘ χ on nonempty sets and f is injective, every set in the diamond carrying colour f col under ψ must carry colour col under χ.

steps.claim: Let bot, top, and mid be the components of the monochromatic diamond copy for ψ of colour f col.
steps.explanation: We unpack the assumption that ψ contains a monochromatic diamond copy of colour f col. This yields a bottom set bot ⊂ top, both coloured f col by ψ, together with a family of j pairwise incomparable middle sets mid i strictly between bot and top, each also having colour f col under ψ.
steps.code: rintro ⟨bot, top, hbot_top, hψ_bot, hψ_top, mid, hmid, hmid_inc⟩

steps.claim: The sets bot and top are nonempty.
steps.explanation: If bot were empty, then ψ ∅ = ψ bot = f col, which contradicts the hypothesis hempty that ψ ∅ ≠ f col. Thus bot ≠ ∅, which implies that bot is nonempty by Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr. Because bot ⊂ top, top contains bot and is therefore nonempty as well.
steps.code:
have hbot_ne : bot ≠ ∅ := fun he => hempty (he ▸ hψ_bot)
  have hbot_nonempty : bot.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hbot_ne
  have htop_nonempty : top.Nonempty := hbot_nonempty.mono hbot_top.1

steps.claim: For any nonempty set A, if ψ A = f col, then χ A = col.
steps.explanation: On any nonempty set A, the hypothesis h guarantees ψ A = f (χ A). If ψ A = f col, then f (χ A) = f col, and since f is injective, it follows that χ A = col.
steps.code:
have hcol : ∀ {A}, A.Nonempty → ψ A = f col → χ A = col :=
    fun hA hψ => hf ((h _ hA).symm.trans hψ)

steps.claim: The sets bot, top, and mid satisfy the conditions of a monochromatic diamond copy for χ of colour col, provided each middle set has colour col under χ.
steps.explanation: We provide bot, top, and mid as the witnesses for a diamond copy in χ. The strict inclusion bot ⊂ top and the incomparability of distinct middle sets hold automatically since they depend only on set inclusion, not on the colouring. Since bot and top are nonempty and coloured f col under ψ, the inversion property shows χ bot = col and χ top = col.
steps.code: refine ⟨bot, top, hbot_top, hcol hbot_nonempty hψ_bot, hcol htop_nonempty hψ_top, mid, fun i => ?_, hmid_inc⟩

steps.claim: Each middle set mid i strictly lies between bot and top and has colour col under χ, completing the proof.
steps.explanation: For each index i, we unpack the given inclusions bot ⊂ mid i and mid i ⊂ top, along with ψ (mid i) = f col. Because bot ⊂ mid i and bot is nonempty, mid i is nonempty. Applying the inversion property yields χ (mid i) = col.
steps.code:
obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hmid i
  exact ⟨h1, h2, hcol (hbot_nonempty.mono h1.1) h3⟩

declarations.name: has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_injective_nonempty
declarations.informal: For j ≥ 2, if ψ = f ∘ χ on nonempty sets (f injective), then a monochromatic induced F_j in ψ of colour f col yields one in χ of colour col.
declarations.statement:
theorem has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_injective_nonempty {j d k k' : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (f : Fin k → Fin k') (hf : Function.Injective f) (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (ψ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k') (h : ∀ A, A.Nonempty → ψ A = f (χ A)) :
    has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d (f col) ψ → has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d col χ
declarations.source:
/-- Fan copies transfer along an injective relabelling of colours that is honest only off the empty set; fan copies use only nonempty sets when j ≥ 2. -/
theorem has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_injective_nonempty {j d k k' : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (f : Fin k → Fin k') (hf : Function.Injective f) (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (ψ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k') (h : ∀ A, A.Nonempty → ψ A = f (χ A)) :
    has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d (f col) ψ → has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d col χ := by
  intro hψ
  unfold has_monochromatic_fan_copy at hψ ⊢
  rcases hψ with ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hinc⟩
  have htop_ne : top.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hne
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
    have hsub : mid ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⊆ top := (hmid ⟨0, by omega⟩).1.1
    rw [hne] at hsub
    have heq : mid ⟨0, by omega⟩ = ∅ := Finset.subset_empty.mp hsub
    exact (hmid ⟨0, by omega⟩).1.2 (by rw [hne, heq])
  have hmid_ne : ∀ i, (mid i).Nonempty := by
    intro i
    by_contra hne
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
    obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ : ∃ i' : Fin j, i' ≠ i := by
      by_cases hi0 : i = ⟨0, by omega⟩
      · refine ⟨⟨1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [hi0]
        simp [Fin.ext_iff]
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, fun hh => hi0 hh.symm⟩
    have hsub : mid i ⊆ mid i' := by rw [hne]; exact Finset.empty_subset _
    exact hinc i i' hi'.symm hsub
  refine ⟨top, ?_, mid, ?_, hinc⟩
  · have h1 : ψ top = f (χ top) := h top htop_ne
    rw [h1] at htop
    exact hf htop
  · intro i
    refine ⟨(hmid i).1, ?_⟩
    have h1 : ψ (mid i) = f (χ (mid i)) := h (mid i) (hmid_ne i)
    have h2 : ψ (mid i) = f col := (hmid i).2
    rw [h1] at h2
    exact hf h2

explanation.summary: The proof transfers a monochromatic fan copy F_j from the colouring ψ to the colouring χ along an injective map f. Because j ≥ 2, neither the root set top (which strictly contains a blade) nor any blade mid i (which cannot be contained in another blade) can be empty. Since all sets in the fan are nonempty, their colours under ψ and χ are related by ψ(A) = f(χ(A)), allowing the injectivity of f to reflect monochromaticity at colour f(col) back to colour col under χ.

steps.claim: We obtain a monochromatic fan copy under ψ consisting of a root set top and j blades mid i.
steps.explanation: Assume ψ contains a monochromatic fan copy of colour f(col). Unfolding the definition provides a root set top of colour f(col) and a family of j blades mid i strictly contained in top, each of colour f(col), such that no blade is contained in any other.
steps.code:
intro hψ
  unfold has_monochromatic_fan_copy at hψ ⊢
  rcases hψ with ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hinc⟩

steps.claim: The root set top is nonempty.
steps.explanation: Suppose for contradiction that top is empty. Since j ≥ 2, the index 0 exists, so blade mid 0 is strictly contained in top. But mid 0 ⊆ top = ∅ forces mid 0 = ∅, contradicting the strict inclusion mid 0 ⊂ top (which requires top ⊈ mid 0).
steps.code:
have htop_ne : top.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hne
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
    have hsub : mid ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⊆ top := (hmid ⟨0, by omega⟩).1.1
    rw [hne] at hsub
    have heq : mid ⟨0, by omega⟩ = ∅ := Finset.subset_empty.mp hsub
    exact (hmid ⟨0, by omega⟩).1.2 (by rw [hne, heq])

steps.claim: Every blade mid i is nonempty.
steps.explanation: Suppose for contradiction that some blade mid i is empty. Since j ≥ 2, there exists another index i' ≠ i (we can pick i' = 1 if i = 0, and i' = 0 otherwise). But then the empty set mid i is a subset of mid i', contradicting the pairwise incomparability of distinct blades.
steps.code:
have hmid_ne : ∀ i, (mid i).Nonempty := by
    intro i
    by_contra hne
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
    obtain ⟨i', hi'⟩ : ∃ i' : Fin j, i' ≠ i := by
      by_cases hi0 : i = ⟨0, by omega⟩
      · refine ⟨⟨1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [hi0]
        simp [Fin.ext_iff]
      · exact ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, fun hh => hi0 hh.symm⟩
    have hsub : mid i ⊆ mid i' := by rw [hne]; exact Finset.empty_subset _
    exact hinc i i' hi'.symm hsub

steps.claim: The set top and the blades mid i form a candidate fan copy whose root has colour col under χ.
steps.explanation: We use the same root top and blades mid i as the fan copy for χ. Because top is nonempty, ψ(top) = f(χ(top)). Since ψ(top) = f(col), the injectivity of f implies χ(top) = col.
steps.code:
refine ⟨top, ?_, mid, ?_, hinc⟩
  · have h1 : ψ top = f (χ top) := h top htop_ne
    rw [h1] at htop
    exact hf htop

steps.claim: Each blade mid i is strictly contained in top and has colour col under χ, completing the fan copy.
steps.explanation: Strict inclusion mid i ⊂ top and pairwise blade incomparability are preserved directly from ψ. Since each mid i is nonempty, ψ(mid i) = f(χ(mid i)). Combining this with ψ(mid i) = f(col) gives f(χ(mid i)) = f(col), which implies χ(mid i) = col by the injectivity of f.
steps.code:
· intro i
    refine ⟨(hmid i).1, ?_⟩
    have h1 : ψ (mid i) = f (χ (mid i)) := h (mid i) (hmid_ne i)
    have h2 : ψ (mid i) = f col := (hmid i).2
    rw [h1] at h2
    exact hf h2

glossary.Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty: A finite set is not nonempty if and only if it is empty.
glossary.Finset.subset_empty.mp: If a finite set is a subset of the empty set, then it is empty.
glossary.Fin.ext_iff: Two elements of Fin n are equal if and only if their underlying natural numbers are equal.
glossary.Finset.empty_subset: The empty set is a subset of any finite set.

declarations.name: mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step
declarations.informal: Case b ≥ 1 with a singleton {x} whose colour is the diamond colour c: if d ≥ j*a + (j-1)*b + 1 and the statement holds at (a-1, b+1) in dimension d-1, then χ already has a monochromatic diamond in one of the a diamond colours or a monochromatic F_j in one of the b fan colours.
declarations.statement:
theorem mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step (j a b d : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : j * a + (j - 1) * b + 1 ≤ d)
    (ih : mixed_ramsey_property j (a - 1) (b + 1) (d - 1))
    (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin (a + b)) (x : Fin d) (c : Fin a) (hx : χ {x} = Fin.castAdd b c) :
    (∃ col : Fin a, has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (Fin.castAdd b col) χ) ∨
      ∃ col : Fin b, has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d (Fin.natAdd a col) χ
declarations.source:
open Finset

def mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val (a b : ℕ) (c_val : ℕ) (v : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if v < a - 1 then
    if v < c_val then v else v + 1
  else
    if v - (a - 1) < b then a + (v - (a - 1))
    else c_val

def mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_val (a b : ℕ) (c_val : ℕ) (v : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if v < a then
    if v < c_val then v
    else if v = c_val then (a - 1) + b
    else v - 1
  else (a - 1) + (v - a)

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val_lt (a b : ℕ) (c_val : ℕ) (v : ℕ)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hc : c_val < a) (hv : v < (a - 1) + (b + 1)) :
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val a b c_val v < a + b := by
  dsimp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val]
  split_ifs <;> omega

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_val_lt (a b : ℕ) (c_val : ℕ) (v : ℕ)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (_hb : 1 ≤ b) (_hc : c_val < a) (hv : v < a + b) :
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_val a b c_val v < (a - 1) + (b + 1) := by
  dsimp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_val]
  split_ifs <;> omega

def mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col (a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (c : Fin a) (i : Fin ((a - 1) + (b + 1))) : Fin (a + b) :=
  ⟨mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val a b c.val i.val,
   mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val_lt a b c.val i.val ha hb c.isLt i.isLt⟩

def mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_col (a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (c : Fin a) (i : Fin (a + b)) : Fin ((a - 1) + (b + 1)) :=
  ⟨mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_val a b c.val i.val,
   mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_val_lt a b c.val i.val ha hb c.isLt i.isLt⟩

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_g_col (a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (c : Fin a) (i : Fin (a + b)) :
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c
      (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_col a b ha hb c i) = i := by
  ext
  dsimp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col,
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_col,
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val,
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_val]
  split_ifs <;> omega

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_f_col (a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (c : Fin a) (i : Fin ((a - 1) + (b + 1))) :
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_col a b ha hb c
      (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c i) = i := by
  ext
  dsimp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col,
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_col,
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val,
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_val]
  split_ifs <;> omega

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_inj (a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (c : Fin a) :
    Function.Injective (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c) := by
  intro y1 y2 h
  have h1 := congrArg (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_col a b ha hb c) h
  rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_f_col,
      mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_f_col] at h1
  exact h1

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_diamond (a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (c : Fin a) (col : Fin (a - 1)) :
    ∃ col' : Fin a, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c
      (Fin.castAdd (b + 1) col) = Fin.castAdd b col' := by
  have hv : mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val a b c.val (Fin.castAdd (b + 1) col).val < a := by
    dsimp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  refine ⟨⟨mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val a b c.val (Fin.castAdd (b + 1) col).val, hv⟩, ?_⟩
  ext
  rfl

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_fan (a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (c : Fin a) (col : Fin (b + 1)) :
    (∃ col' : Fin b, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c
      (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col) = Fin.natAdd a col') ∨
    (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c
      (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col) = Fin.castAdd b c) := by
  by_cases hcol : col.val < b
  · left
    have hv : a ≤ mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val a b c.val (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col).val := by

    have hv2 : mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val a b c.val (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col).val - a < b := by
      dsimp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    refine ⟨⟨mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val a b c.val (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col).val - a, hv2⟩, ?_⟩
    ext
    dsimp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col,
      mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · right
    ext
    dsimp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col,
      mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_val]
    split_ifs <;> omega

def mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d) : Fin (d - 1) ↪ Fin d :=
  let hd' : d - 1 + 1 = d := Nat.sub_add_cancel hd
  let e : Fin d ≃ Fin (d - 1 + 1) := (Fin.castOrderIso hd'.symm).toEquiv
  let x' : Fin (d - 1 + 1) := e x
  { toFun := fun i => e.symm (x'.succAbove i)
    inj' := fun _ _ h => by
      have h1 := e.symm.injective h
      exact Fin.succAbove_right_injective h1 }

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb_ne (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d) (i : Fin (d - 1)) :
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb d hd x i ≠ x := by
  have hd' : d - 1 + 1 = d := Nat.sub_add_cancel hd
  let e : Fin d ≃ Fin (d - 1 + 1) := (Fin.castOrderIso hd'.symm).toEquiv
  let x' : Fin (d - 1 + 1) := e x
  intro h
  have h1 : e (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb d hd x i) = e x := congrArg e h
  have h2 : e (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb d hd x i) = x'.succAbove i := by
    change e (e.symm (x'.succAbove i)) = _
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [h2] at h1
  exact Fin.succAbove_ne x' i h1

def mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d)

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_subset_iff_S_subset_S {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d)
    (B B' : Finset (Fin (d - 1))) :
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B ⊆
      mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B' ↔ B ⊆ B' := by
  constructor
  · intro h y hy
    have hymem : mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb d hd x y ∈
        mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B := by
      simp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S, hy]
    have hx' := h hymem
    simp only [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S, mem_union, mem_map, mem_singleton] at hx'
    rcases hx' with ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ | hzx
    · exact (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb d hd x).injective hz' ▸ hz
    · exact False.elim (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb_ne d hd x y hzx)
  · intro h
    simp only [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S, union_subset_iff]
    constructor
    · intro z hz
      simp only [mem_map] at hz
      rcases hz with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      simp only [mem_union, mem_map]
      left
      exact ⟨w, h hw, rfl⟩
    · simp

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d)
    (B B' : Finset (Fin (d - 1))) :

      mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B' ↔ B ⊂ B' := by

          ¬ mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B' ⊆
            mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B) ↔ (B ⊆ B' ∧ ¬ B' ⊆ B)

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S_empty {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d) :

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fin_ne_of_two_le {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (i : Fin j) :
    ∃ i' : Fin j, i' ≠ i := by

  · refine ⟨⟨1, hj⟩, ?_⟩
    intro h
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
    dsimp at hval
    omega
  · refine ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    intro h
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
    dsimp at hval
    omega

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_diamond_transfer {j d k : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d)
    (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (h : has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j (d - 1) col
      (fun B => χ (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B))) :
    has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d col χ := by
  rcases h with ⟨bot, top, hbot_top, hbot, htop, mid, hmid, hpair⟩
  refine ⟨mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x bot,
          mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x top, ?_, hbot, htop,
          fun i => mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x (mid i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]; exact hbot_top
  · intro i
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, (hmid i).2.2⟩
    · rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]; exact (hmid i).1
    · rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]; exact (hmid i).2.1
  · intro i i' hne
    rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_subset_iff_S_subset_S]
    exact hpair i i' hne

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fan_transfer {j d k : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d)
    (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (h : has_monochromatic_fan_copy j (d - 1) col
      (fun B => χ (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B))) :
    has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d col χ := by
  rcases h with ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hpair⟩
  refine ⟨mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x top, htop,
          fun i => mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x (mid i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine ⟨?_, (hmid i).2⟩
    rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]; exact (hmid i).1
  · intro i i' hne

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fan_to_diamond_transfer {j d k : ℕ}
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d) (col : Fin k)
    (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (hx : χ {x} = col)
    (h : has_monochromatic_fan_copy j (d - 1) col
      (fun B => χ (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B))) :
    has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d col χ := by
  rcases h with ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hpair⟩
  have hmid_ne_empty (i : Fin j) : mid i ≠ ∅ := by
    intro hempty
    rcases mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fin_ne_of_two_le hj i with ⟨i', hne⟩
    have hsub : mid i ⊆ mid i' := hempty.symm ▸ empty_subset (mid i')
    exact hpair i i' (Ne.symm hne) hsub
  have hbot_mid (i : Fin j) : ∅ ⊂ mid i :=
    Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨empty_subset (mid i), Ne.symm (hmid_ne_empty i)⟩
  have hbot_top : ∅ ⊂ top := ssubset_trans (hbot_mid ⟨0, by omega⟩) (hmid ⟨0, by omega⟩).1
  have hS_empty : mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x ∅ = {x} :=
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S_empty hd x
  refine ⟨{x}, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x top, ?_, hx, htop,
          fun i => mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x (mid i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hS_empty, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]
    exact hbot_top
  · intro i
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, (hmid i).2⟩
    · rw [← hS_empty, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]
      exact hbot_mid i
    · rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]
      exact (hmid i).1
  · intro i i' hne
    rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_subset_iff_S_subset_S]
    exact hpair i i' hne

/-- b ≥ 1 step with a diamond-coloured singleton {x}: colour A by χ(A ∪ {x}) on the other d-1 points and apply the (a-1, b+1) instance; the colour of {x} becomes the extra fan colour. -/
theorem mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step (j a b d : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : j * a + (j - 1) * b + 1 ≤ d)
    (ih : mixed_ramsey_property j (a - 1) (b + 1) (d - 1))
    (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin (a + b)) (x : Fin d) (c : Fin a) (hx : χ {x} = Fin.castAdd b c) :
    (∃ col : Fin a, has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (Fin.castAdd b col) χ) ∨
      ∃ col : Fin b, has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d (Fin.natAdd a col) χ := by
  have hd_ge_1 : 1 ≤ d := by omega
  let χ' : Finset (Fin (d - 1)) → Fin (a + b) :=
    fun B => χ (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd_ge_1 x B)
  let ψ : Finset (Fin (d - 1)) → Fin ((a - 1) + (b + 1)) :=
    fun B => mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_col a b ha hb c (χ' B)
  have hχ'ψ : ∀ B, χ' B = mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c (ψ B) :=
    fun B => (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_g_col a b ha hb c (χ' B)).symm
  rcases ih ψ with ⟨col, hcol⟩ | ⟨col, hcol⟩
  · left
    have hχ' : has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j (d - 1)
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c (Fin.castAdd (b + 1) col)) χ' := by
      refine (has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c)
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_inj a b ha hb c)
        (Fin.castAdd (b + 1) col) ψ χ' hχ'ψ).mpr hcol
    rcases mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_diamond a b ha hb c col with ⟨col', hcol'⟩
    rw [hcol'] at hχ'
    refine ⟨col', mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_diamond_transfer hd_ge_1 x (Fin.castAdd b col') χ hχ'⟩
  · have hχ' : has_monochromatic_fan_copy j (d - 1)
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col)) χ' := by
      refine (has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_injective
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c)
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_inj a b ha hb c)
        (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col) ψ χ' hχ'ψ).mpr hcol
    rcases mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_fan a b ha hb c col with ⟨col', hcol'⟩ | hc_eq
    · right
      rw [hcol'] at hχ'
      refine ⟨col', mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fan_transfer hd_ge_1 x (Fin.natAdd a col') χ hχ'⟩
    · left
      rw [hc_eq] at hχ'
      refine ⟨c, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fan_to_diamond_transfer
        hj hd_ge_1 x (Fin.castAdd b c) χ hx hχ'⟩

explanation.summary: To prove the induction step when a singleton {x} has diamond colour c, we restrict to the remaining d - 1 coordinates and lift sets via B ↦ B ∪ {x}. By reallocating the colour c from diamond colours to fan colours, we obtain a colouring with a - 1 diamond colours and b + 1 fan colours. The induction hypothesis guarantees either a monochromatic diamond (which lifts directly) or a monochromatic fan: if the fan is in an original fan colour it lifts directly, and if it is in colour c, the singleton {x} acts as its bottom element, completing it into a monochromatic diamond in colour c.

lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb_ne (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d) (i : Fin (d - 1)) :
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb d hd x i ≠ x := by
  have hd' : d - 1 + 1 = d := Nat.sub_add_cancel hd
  let e : Fin d ≃ Fin (d - 1 + 1) := (Fin.castOrderIso hd'.symm).toEquiv
  let x' : Fin (d - 1 + 1) := e x
  intro h
  have h1 : e (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb d hd x i) = e x := congrArg e h
  have h2 : e (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb d hd x i) = x'.succAbove i := by
    change e (e.symm (x'.succAbove i)) = _
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [h2] at h1
  exact Fin.succAbove_ne x' i h1

steps.claim: S preserves and reflects subsets
steps.explanation: S(B) ⊆ S(B') if and only if B ⊆ B', using injectivity of the embedding and that x is not in the image.
steps.code:
lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_subset_iff_S_subset_S {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d)
    (B B' : Finset (Fin (d - 1))) :
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B ⊆
      mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B' ↔ B ⊆ B' := by
  constructor
  · intro h y hy
    have hymem : mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb d hd x y ∈
        mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B := by
      simp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S, hy]
    have hx' := h hymem
    simp only [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S, mem_union, mem_map, mem_singleton] at hx'
    rcases hx' with ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ | hzx
    · exact (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb d hd x).injective hz' ▸ hz
    · exact False.elim (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_emb_ne d hd x y hzx)
  · intro h
    simp only [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S, union_subset_iff]
    constructor
    · intro z hz
      simp only [mem_map] at hz
      rcases hz with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      simp only [mem_union, mem_map]
      left
      exact ⟨w, h hw, rfl⟩
    · simp

steps.claim: S preserves and reflects strict subsets
steps.explanation: Strict subset is defined by subset and not superset, both of which are preserved and reflected by S.
steps.code:
lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d)
    (B B' : Finset (Fin (d - 1))) :
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B ⊂
      mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B' ↔ B ⊂ B' := by
  change (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B ⊆
            mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B' ∧
          ¬ mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B' ⊆
            mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B) ↔ (B ⊆ B' ∧ ¬ B' ⊆ B)
  rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_subset_iff_S_subset_S,
      mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_subset_iff_S_subset_S]

steps.claim: S of the empty set is the singleton {x}
steps.explanation: Mapping the empty set yields the empty set, whose union with {x} is {x}.
steps.code:
lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S_empty {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d) :
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x ∅ = {x} := by
  simp [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S]

steps.claim: In Fin j with j ≥ 2, every element has a distinct element
steps.explanation: If the element is 0, choose 1; otherwise choose 0. Both are distinct from the element.
steps.code:
lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fin_ne_of_two_le {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (i : Fin j) :
    ∃ i' : Fin j, i' ≠ i := by
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · refine ⟨⟨1, hj⟩, ?_⟩
    intro h
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
    dsimp at hval
    omega
  · refine ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    intro h
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
    dsimp at hval
    omega

steps.claim: A monochromatic diamond transfers along S
steps.explanation: Applying S to the top, bottom, and middle elements preserves all strict inclusions and incomparabilities.
steps.code:
lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_diamond_transfer {j d k : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d)
    (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (h : has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j (d - 1) col
      (fun B => χ (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B))) :
    has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d col χ := by
  rcases h with ⟨bot, top, hbot_top, hbot, htop, mid, hmid, hpair⟩
  refine ⟨mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x bot,
          mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x top, ?_, hbot, htop,
          fun i => mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x (mid i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]; exact hbot_top
  · intro i
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, (hmid i).2.2⟩
    · rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]; exact (hmid i).1
    · rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]; exact (hmid i).2.1
  · intro i i' hne
    rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_subset_iff_S_subset_S]
    exact hpair i i' hne

steps.claim: A monochromatic fan transfers along S
steps.explanation: Applying S to the top and middle elements preserves strict inclusions into the top element and pairwise incomparabilities.
steps.code:
lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fan_transfer {j d k : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d)
    (col : Fin k) (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (h : has_monochromatic_fan_copy j (d - 1) col
      (fun B => χ (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B))) :
    has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d col χ := by
  rcases h with ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hpair⟩
  refine ⟨mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x top, htop,
          fun i => mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x (mid i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine ⟨?_, (hmid i).2⟩
    rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]; exact (hmid i).1
  · intro i i' hne
    rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_subset_iff_S_subset_S]
    exact hpair i i' hne

steps.claim: A monochromatic fan in color c extends to a monochromatic diamond in color c
steps.explanation: The middle elements are non-empty because j ≥ 2 and they are incomparable, so the empty set is strictly contained in each middle element. Applying S, {x} = S(∅) serves as the bottom element, which has color c by hypothesis, forming a complete diamond.
steps.code:
lemma mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fan_to_diamond_transfer {j d k : ℕ}
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : Fin d) (col : Fin k)
    (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k)
    (hx : χ {x} = col)
    (h : has_monochromatic_fan_copy j (d - 1) col
      (fun B => χ (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x B))) :
    has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d col χ := by
  rcases h with ⟨top, htop, mid, hmid, hpair⟩
  have hmid_ne_empty (i : Fin j) : mid i ≠ ∅ := by
    intro hempty
    rcases mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fin_ne_of_two_le hj i with ⟨i', hne⟩
    have hsub : mid i ⊆ mid i' := hempty.symm ▸ empty_subset (mid i')
    exact hpair i i' (Ne.symm hne) hsub
  have hbot_mid (i : Fin j) : ∅ ⊂ mid i :=
    Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨empty_subset (mid i), Ne.symm (hmid_ne_empty i)⟩
  have hbot_top : ∅ ⊂ top := ssubset_trans (hbot_mid ⟨0, by omega⟩) (hmid ⟨0, by omega⟩).1
  have hS_empty : mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x ∅ = {x} :=
    mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S_empty hd x
  refine ⟨{x}, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x top, ?_, hx, htop,
          fun i => mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd x (mid i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hS_empty, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]
    exact hbot_top
  · intro i
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, (hmid i).2⟩
    · rw [← hS_empty, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]
      exact hbot_mid i
    · rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_ssubset_iff_S_ssubset_S]
      exact (hmid i).1
  · intro i i' hne
    rw [mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_subset_iff_S_subset_S]
    exact hpair i i' hne

/-- b ≥ 1 step with a diamond-coloured singleton {x}: colour A by χ(A ∪ {x}) on the other d-1 points and apply the (a-1, b+1) instance; the colour of {x} becomes the extra fan colour. -/

steps.claim: Define the induced coloring on dimension d - 1
steps.explanation: Define χ'(B) = χ(S(B)) and compose with g to get a coloring ψ with a - 1 diamond colors and b + 1 fan colors. Apply the induction hypothesis to ψ.
steps.code:
theorem mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step (j a b d : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : j * a + (j - 1) * b + 1 ≤ d)
    (ih : mixed_ramsey_property j (a - 1) (b + 1) (d - 1))
    (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin (a + b)) (x : Fin d) (c : Fin a) (hx : χ {x} = Fin.castAdd b c) :
    (∃ col : Fin a, has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (Fin.castAdd b col) χ) ∨
      ∃ col : Fin b, has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d (Fin.natAdd a col) χ := by
  have hd_ge_1 : 1 ≤ d := by omega
  let χ' : Finset (Fin (d - 1)) → Fin (a + b) :=
    fun B => χ (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_S d hd_ge_1 x B)
  let ψ : Finset (Fin (d - 1)) → Fin ((a - 1) + (b + 1)) :=
    fun B => mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_g_col a b ha hb c (χ' B)
  have hχ'ψ : ∀ B, χ' B = mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c (ψ B) :=
    fun B => (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_g_col a b ha hb c (χ' B)).symm
  rcases ih ψ with ⟨col, hcol⟩ | ⟨col, hcol⟩

steps.claim: If ψ has a monochromatic diamond, χ has a monochromatic diamond
steps.explanation: The diamond in ψ maps via f to a diamond in χ' of one of the original diamond colors, which then transfers via S to a diamond for χ.
steps.code:
· left
    have hχ' : has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j (d - 1)
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c (Fin.castAdd (b + 1) col)) χ' := by
      refine (has_monochromatic_diamond_copy_colour_injective
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c)
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_inj a b ha hb c)
        (Fin.castAdd (b + 1) col) ψ χ' hχ'ψ).mpr hcol
    rcases mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_diamond a b ha hb c col with ⟨col', hcol'⟩
    rw [hcol'] at hχ'
    refine ⟨col', mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_diamond_transfer hd_ge_1 x (Fin.castAdd b col') χ hχ'⟩

steps.claim: If ψ has a monochromatic fan in one of the first b fan colors, χ has a monochromatic fan
steps.explanation: The fan in ψ maps via f to a fan in χ' of one of the original fan colors, which transfers via S to a fan for χ.
steps.code:
· have hχ' : has_monochromatic_fan_copy j (d - 1)
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col)) χ' := by
      refine (has_monochromatic_fan_copy_colour_injective
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col a b ha hb c)
        (mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_inj a b ha hb c)
        (Fin.natAdd (a - 1) col) ψ χ' hχ'ψ).mpr hcol
    rcases mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_f_col_fan a b ha hb c col with ⟨col', hcol'⟩ | hc_eq
    · right
      rw [hcol'] at hχ'
      refine ⟨col', mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fan_transfer hd_ge_1 x (Fin.natAdd a col') χ hχ'⟩

steps.claim: If ψ has a monochromatic fan in the extra fan color, χ has a monochromatic diamond in color c
steps.explanation: The extra fan color maps to c under f, so χ' has a fan of color c, which extends using the singleton {x} of color c to a full monochromatic diamond for χ.
steps.code:
· left
      rw [hc_eq] at hχ'
      refine ⟨c, mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_singleton_diamond_step_fan_to_diamond_transfer
        hj hd_ge_1 x (Fin.castAdd b c) χ hx hχ'⟩
