declarations.name: adjacency_spectral_radius
declarations.informal: The adjacency spectral radius of a simple graph G on a finite vertex set is the spectral radius of its real adjacency matrix.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def adjacency_spectral_radius {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) : ENNReal
declarations.source:
/-- The adjacency spectral radius of a simple graph on a finite vertex set. -/
noncomputable def adjacency_spectral_radius {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) : ENNReal := open scoped Classical in spectralRadius ℝ (G.adjMatrix ℝ)
declarations.reading: For any type `V` with `[Fintype V]` and `[DecidableEq V]`, and any simple graph `G : SimpleGraph V`, `adjacency_spectral_radius G` is defined as the spectral radius over `ℝ` of the real adjacency matrix `G.adjMatrix ℝ`, valued in `ENNReal`.

declarations.name: glove_number_complete_graph_pos
declarations.informal: For every integer $n \ge 2$, the glove number of the complete graph $K_n$ is at least 1.
declarations.statement:
theorem glove_number_complete_graph_pos (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    1 ≤ glove_number (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n))
declarations.source:
/-- A double handshake in which the first vertex wears the `false` side of glove `2 * φ p` and the
second vertex wears the `false` side of glove `2 * φ p + 1`. -/
def glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs {ι V : Type*} (K : ℕ) (φ : ι → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ p, 2 * φ p + 1 < K) (e : ι → V × V) (p : ι) : Handshake V (Fin K) :=
  Handshake.double (e p).1 (⟨2 * φ p, by have := hb p; omega⟩, false)
    (⟨2 * φ p + 1, by have := hb p; omega⟩, false) (e p).2

/-- The edge covered by such a double handshake. -/
lemma glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs_edge {ι V : Type*} (K : ℕ) (φ : ι → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ p, 2 * φ p + 1 < K) (e : ι → V × V) (p : ι) :
    handshake_edge (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e p) = Sym2.mk (e p).1 (e p).2 :=
  rfl

/-- The contamination update of such a handshake leaves untouched every glove side whose glove
index differs from `2 * φ p` and `2 * φ p + 1`. -/
lemma glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs_update {ι V : Type*} (K : ℕ) (φ : ι → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ p, 2 * φ p + 1 < K) (e : ι → V × V) (p : ι)
    (t : Fin K × Bool → Set V) (s : Fin K × Bool)
    (h1 : s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ p) (h2 : s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ p + 1) :
    handshake_update_contam (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e p) t s = t s := by
  simp only [glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs, handshake_update_contam]
  split_ifs with h h' h''
  · exact absurd (by rw [h]) h1
  · exact absurd (by rw [h']) h2
  · rcases h'' with h'' | h''
    · exact absurd (by rw [h'']; rfl) h1
    · exact absurd (by rw [h'']; rfl) h2
  · rfl

/-- If the glove index map `φ` is injective and every glove side whose index is not among the
already processed indices `P` is uncontaminated, then the sequence of fresh double handshakes
along a duplicate-free list `L` disjoint from `P` is clean. -/
lemma glove_number_complete_graph_pos_clean {ι V : Type*} (K : ℕ) (φ : ι → ℕ)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) (hb : ∀ p, 2 * φ p + 1 < K) (e : ι → V × V)
    (L P : List ι) (t : Fin K × Bool → Set V)
    (hL : L.Nodup) (hdisj : ∀ p ∈ L, p ∉ P)
    (hinv : ∀ s : Fin K × Bool, (∀ q ∈ P, s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ q ∧ s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ q + 1) → t s = ∅) :
    CleanHandshakeSeq (L.map (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e)) t := by
  induction L generalizing P t with
  | nil => exact CleanHandshakeSeq.nil t
  | cons p L ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpL, hL'⟩ := List.nodup_cons.mp hL
    have hpP : p ∉ P := hdisj p (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hkey : ∀ q ∈ P, 2 * φ p ≠ 2 * φ q ∧ 2 * φ p ≠ 2 * φ q + 1 := by
      intro q hq
      refine ⟨fun h => hpP ?_, fun h => by omega⟩
      have hpq : φ p = φ q := by omega
      rw [hφ hpq]; exact hq
    have hempty1 : t ((⟨2 * φ p, by have := hb p; omega⟩ : Fin K), false) = ∅ :=
      hinv _ hkey
    have hempty2 : t ((⟨2 * φ p + 1, by have := hb p; omega⟩ : Fin K), false) = ∅ := by
      refine hinv _ ?_
      intro q hq
      have hk := hkey q hq
      constructor
      · show 2 * φ p + 1 ≠ 2 * φ q
        omega
      · show 2 * φ p + 1 ≠ 2 * φ q + 1
        omega
    have hclean : handshake_is_clean (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e p) t := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h
        have hv : (2 : ℕ) * φ p = 2 * φ p + 1 := congrArg Fin.val h
        omega
      · rw [hempty1]; exact Set.empty_subset _
      · rw [hempty2]; exact Set.empty_subset _
    have hinv' : ∀ s : Fin K × Bool, (∀ q ∈ p :: P, s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ q ∧ s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ q + 1) →
        handshake_update_contam (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e p) t s = ∅ := by
      intro s hs
      rw [glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs_update K φ hb e p t s (hs p (List.mem_cons_self ..)).1
        (hs p (List.mem_cons_self ..)).2]
      exact hinv s (fun q hq => hs q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq))
    refine CleanHandshakeSeq.cons _ _ _ hclean ?_
    exact ih (p :: P) (handshake_update_contam (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e p) t) hL'
      (fun q hq => by
        intro hq2
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq2 with rfl | hq2'
        · exact hpL hq
        · exact hdisj q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq) hq2') hinv'

/-- For n ≥ 2, the glove number of K_n is at least 1. -/
theorem glove_number_complete_graph_pos (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    1 ≤ glove_number (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hex : ∃ k, has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k := by
    let φ : Fin (n * n) → ℕ := fun k => k.val
    have hφ : Function.Injective φ := fun a b h => Fin.ext h
    have hb : ∀ k : Fin (n * n), 2 * φ k + 1 < 2 * (n * n) := by
      intro k
      have := k.isLt
      simp only [φ]
      omega
    let e : Fin (n * n) → Fin n × Fin n := fun k =>
      (⟨k.val / n, (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn0).mpr k.isLt⟩, ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn0⟩)
    have hclean := glove_number_complete_graph_pos_clean (K := 2 * (n * n)) (φ := φ) hφ hb e
      (List.finRange (n * n)) [] (fun _ => ∅) (List.nodup_finRange _) (by simp) (by simp)
    refine ⟨2 * (n * n), List.map (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs (2 * (n * n)) φ hb e)
      (List.finRange (n * n)), hclean, ?_⟩
    have hk' : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val * n + j.val < n * n := by
      intro i j
      have h1 : i.val * n + j.val < (i.val + 1) * n := by
        rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
        omega
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Nat.mul_le_mul_right n (Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt))
    have key : ∀ i j : Fin n, Sym2.mk i j ∈ (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet →
        ∃ h ∈ List.map (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs (2 * (n * n)) φ hb e)
          (List.finRange (n * n)), handshake_edge h = Sym2.mk i j := by
      intro i j _
      have hdiv : (i.val * n + j.val) / n = i.val := by
        have h1 : i.val * n + j.val = j.val + n * i.val := by rw [Nat.mul_comm i.val n]; omega
        rw [h1, Nat.add_mul_div_left j.val i.val hn0, Nat.div_eq_of_lt j.isLt, Nat.zero_add]
      have hmod : (i.val * n + j.val) % n = j.val := by
        rw [Nat.mul_comm i.val n, Nat.mul_add_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt]
      have hek : e ⟨i.val * n + j.val, hk' i j⟩ = (i, j) := by
        simp only [e, hdiv, hmod]
      refine ⟨glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs (2 * (n * n)) φ hb e ⟨i.val * n + j.val, hk' i j⟩,
        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, List.mem_finRange _, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs_edge, hek]
    intro edge hedge
    exact Sym2.ind key edge hedge
  have hne : {k | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k}.Nonempty := hex
  have hpos : sInf {k | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k} ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rcases Nat.sInf_eq_zero.mp h with h0 | hemp
    · exact glove_number_complete_graph_no_zero_gloves n hn h0
    · rw [hemp] at hne
      exact Set.not_nonempty_empty hne
  show 1 ≤ sInf {k | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k}
  omega

/-- A double handshake in which the first vertex wears the `false` side of glove `2 * φ p` and the
second vertex wears the `false` side of glove `2 * φ p + 1`. -/
def glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs {ι V : Type*} (K : ℕ) (φ : ι → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ p, 2 * φ p + 1 < K) (e : ι → V × V) (p : ι) : Handshake V (Fin K) :=
  Handshake.double (e p).1 (⟨2 * φ p, by have := hb p; omega⟩, false)
    (⟨2 * φ p + 1, by have := hb p; omega⟩, false) (e p).2

/-- The edge covered by such a double handshake. -/
lemma glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs_edge {ι V : Type*} (K : ℕ) (φ : ι → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ p, 2 * φ p + 1 < K) (e : ι → V × V) (p : ι) :
    handshake_edge (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e p) = Sym2.mk (e p).1 (e p).2 :=
  rfl

/-- The contamination update of such a handshake leaves untouched every glove side whose glove
index differs from `2 * φ p` and `2 * φ p + 1`. -/
lemma glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs_update {ι V : Type*} (K : ℕ) (φ : ι → ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ p, 2 * φ p + 1 < K) (e : ι → V × V) (p : ι)
    (t : Fin K × Bool → Set V) (s : Fin K × Bool)
    (h1 : s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ p) (h2 : s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ p + 1) :
    handshake_update_contam (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e p) t s = t s := by
  simp only [glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs, handshake_update_contam]
  split_ifs with h h' h''
  · exact absurd (by rw [h]) h1
  · exact absurd (by rw [h']) h2
  · rcases h'' with h'' | h''
    · exact absurd (by rw [h'']; rfl) h1
    · exact absurd (by rw [h'']; rfl) h2
  · rfl

/-- If the glove index map `φ` is injective and every glove side whose index is not among the
already processed indices `P` is uncontaminated, then the sequence of fresh double handshakes
along a duplicate-free list `L` disjoint from `P` is clean. -/
lemma glove_number_complete_graph_pos_clean {ι V : Type*} (K : ℕ) (φ : ι → ℕ)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) (hb : ∀ p, 2 * φ p + 1 < K) (e : ι → V × V)
    (L P : List ι) (t : Fin K × Bool → Set V)
    (hL : L.Nodup) (hdisj : ∀ p ∈ L, p ∉ P)
    (hinv : ∀ s : Fin K × Bool, (∀ q ∈ P, s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ q ∧ s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ q + 1) → t s = ∅) :
    CleanHandshakeSeq (L.map (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e)) t := by
  induction L generalizing P t with
  | nil => exact CleanHandshakeSeq.nil t
  | cons p L ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpL, hL'⟩ := List.nodup_cons.mp hL
    have hpP : p ∉ P := hdisj p (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hkey : ∀ q ∈ P, 2 * φ p ≠ 2 * φ q ∧ 2 * φ p ≠ 2 * φ q + 1 := by
      intro q hq
      refine ⟨fun h => hpP ?_, fun h => by omega⟩
      have hpq : φ p = φ q := by omega
      rw [hφ hpq]; exact hq
    have hempty1 : t ((⟨2 * φ p, by have := hb p; omega⟩ : Fin K), false) = ∅ :=
      hinv _ hkey
    have hempty2 : t ((⟨2 * φ p + 1, by have := hb p; omega⟩ : Fin K), false) = ∅ := by
      refine hinv _ ?_
      intro q hq
      have hk := hkey q hq
      constructor
      · show 2 * φ p + 1 ≠ 2 * φ q
        omega
      · show 2 * φ p + 1 ≠ 2 * φ q + 1
        omega
    have hclean : handshake_is_clean (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e p) t := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h
        have hv : (2 : ℕ) * φ p = 2 * φ p + 1 := congrArg Fin.val h
        omega
      · rw [hempty1]; exact Set.empty_subset _
      · rw [hempty2]; exact Set.empty_subset _
    have hinv' : ∀ s : Fin K × Bool, (∀ q ∈ p :: P, s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ q ∧ s.1.val ≠ 2 * φ q + 1) →
        handshake_update_contam (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e p) t s = ∅ := by
      intro s hs
      rw [glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs_update K φ hb e p t s (hs p (List.mem_cons_self ..)).1
        (hs p (List.mem_cons_self ..)).2]
      exact hinv s (fun q hq => hs q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq))
    refine CleanHandshakeSeq.cons _ _ _ hclean ?_
    exact ih (p :: P) (handshake_update_contam (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs K φ hb e p) t) hL'
      (fun q hq => by
        intro hq2
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq2 with rfl | hq2'
        · exact hpL hq
        · exact hdisj q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq) hq2') hinv'

/-- For n ≥ 2, the glove number of K_n is at least 1. -/
theorem glove_number_complete_graph_pos (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    1 ≤ glove_number (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) := by
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hex : ∃ k, has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k := by
    let φ : Fin (n * n) → ℕ := fun k => k.val
    have hφ : Function.Injective φ := fun a b h => Fin.ext h
    have hb : ∀ k : Fin (n * n), 2 * φ k + 1 < 2 * (n * n) := by
      intro k
      have := k.isLt
      simp only [φ]
      omega
    let e : Fin (n * n) → Fin n × Fin n := fun k =>
      (⟨k.val / n, (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn0).mpr k.isLt⟩, ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn0⟩)
    have hclean := glove_number_complete_graph_pos_clean (K := 2 * (n * n)) (φ := φ) hφ hb e
      (List.finRange (n * n)) [] (fun _ => ∅) (List.nodup_finRange _) (by simp) (by simp)
    refine ⟨2 * (n * n), List.map (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs (2 * (n * n)) φ hb e)
      (List.finRange (n * n)), hclean, ?_⟩
    have hk' : ∀ i j : Fin n, i.val * n + j.val < n * n := by
      intro i j
      have h1 : i.val * n + j.val < (i.val + 1) * n := by
        rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
        omega
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Nat.mul_le_mul_right n (Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt))
    have key : ∀ i j : Fin n, Sym2.mk i j ∈ (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)).edgeSet →
        ∃ h ∈ List.map (glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs (2 * (n * n)) φ hb e)
          (List.finRange (n * n)), handshake_edge h = Sym2.mk i j := by
      intro i j _
      have hdiv : (i.val * n + j.val) / n = i.val := by
        have h1 : i.val * n + j.val = j.val + n * i.val := by rw [Nat.mul_comm i.val n]; omega
        rw [h1, Nat.add_mul_div_left j.val i.val hn0, Nat.div_eq_of_lt j.isLt, Nat.zero_add]
      have hmod : (i.val * n + j.val) % n = j.val := by
        rw [Nat.mul_comm i.val n, Nat.mul_add_mod_self_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt]
      have hek : e ⟨i.val * n + j.val, hk' i j⟩ = (i, j) := by
        simp only [e, hdiv, hmod]
      refine ⟨glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs (2 * (n * n)) φ hb e ⟨i.val * n + j.val, hk' i j⟩,
        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, List.mem_finRange _, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [glove_number_complete_graph_pos_hs_edge, hek]
    intro edge hedge
    exact Sym2.ind key edge hedge
  have hne : {k | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k}.Nonempty := hex
  have hpos : sInf {k | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k} ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rcases Nat.sInf_eq_zero.mp h with h0 | hemp
    · exact glove_number_complete_graph_no_zero_gloves n hn h0
    · rw [hemp] at hne
      exact Set.not_nonempty_empty hne
  show 1 ≤ sInf {k | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k}

declarations.name: is_sustainable_edge
declarations.informal: An edge e in a tree T is sustainable if there exists a non-edge f such that T - e + f is a tree and the adjacency spectral radius of T - e + f is at least that of T.
declarations.statement: def is_sustainable_edge {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (T : SimpleGraph V) (e : Sym2 V) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- An edge e in a tree T is sustainable if replacing it by some non-edge f yields a tree with spectral radius at least that of T. -/
def is_sustainable_edge {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (T : SimpleGraph V) (e : Sym2 V) : Prop := e ∈ T.edgeSet ∧ ∃ f ∈ Tᶜ.edgeSet,
    (T.deleteEdges {e} ⊔ SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {f}).IsTree ∧
    adjacency_spectral_radius T ≤ adjacency_spectral_radius (T.deleteEdges {e} ⊔ SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {f})
declarations.reading:
For a finite type `V` with decidable equality, a simple graph `T` on `V`, and an edge candidate `e : Sym2 V`, `is_sustainable_edge T e` asserts that:
1. `e` is an edge of `T` (`e ∈ T.edgeSet`), and
2. There exists an edge `f` in the complement graph of `T` (`f ∈ Tᶜ.edgeSet`) such that:
   (a) The graph obtained by deleting edge `e` from `T` and adding edge `f` (namely `T.deleteEdges {e} ⊔ SimpleGraph.fromEdgeSet {f}`) is a tree (`SimpleGraph.IsTree`), and
   (b) The adjacency spectral radius of `T` is less than or equal to the adjacency spectral radius of that modified graph.

declarations.name: is_sustainable_tree
declarations.informal: A tree T is sustainable if every edge of T is sustainable.
declarations.statement: def is_sustainable_tree {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (T : SimpleGraph V) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A tree is sustainable if every edge in it is sustainable. -/
def is_sustainable_tree {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (T : SimpleGraph V) : Prop := T.IsTree ∧ ∀ e ∈ T.edgeSet, is_sustainable_edge T e
declarations.reading: For a finite type `V` with decidable equality and a simple graph `T` on `V`, `is_sustainable_tree T` asserts that `T` is a tree (`T.IsTree`) and that every edge `e` in `T.edgeSet` is a sustainable edge of `T` (`is_sustainable_edge T e`).

declarations.name: is_nonsustainable_tree
declarations.informal: A tree T is non-sustainable if T is a tree and T is not sustainable.
declarations.statement: def is_nonsustainable_tree {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (T : SimpleGraph V) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A tree is non-sustainable if it is a tree and not sustainable. -/
def is_nonsustainable_tree {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (T : SimpleGraph V) : Prop := T.IsTree ∧ ¬ is_sustainable_tree T
declarations.reading:
For a finite type `V` with decidable equality and a simple graph `T` on `V`, `is_nonsustainable_tree T` asserts that:
1. `T` is a tree (`T.IsTree`), and
2. `T` is not a sustainable tree (`¬ is_sustainable_tree T`), which means it is not the case that both `T` is a tree and every edge `e` of `T` is sustainable.

declarations.name: gts_graph
declarations.informal: The graph obtained from T by deleting all edges between candidate v and its neighbours other than w, and inserting edges between beneficiary u and those neighbours.
declarations.statement: def gts_graph {V : Type*} (T : SimpleGraph V) (u v w : V) : SimpleGraph V
declarations.reading:
Given a type `V`, a simple graph `T` on `V`, and vertices `u, v, w : V`, `gts_graph T u v w` defines a new `SimpleGraph V`. It is the join (union, `⊔`) of:
1. `T` with all edges of the form `s(v, z)` deleted, where `z` is a neighbor of `v` in `T` and `z ≠ w`; and
2. The simple graph constructed from the edge set of all pairs `s(u, z)` where `z` is a neighbor of `v` in `T` and `z ≠ w`.

In other words, it performs a generalized tree shift (GTS) on `T`, redirecting all edges incident to `v` (except possibly the edge to `w`) to instead be incident to `u`.

declarations.name: has_clean_handshake_seq_succ
declarations.informal: If a graph $G$ admits a clean handshake sequence with $k$ gloves, then it admits one with $k+1$ gloves: an extra glove can be left unused.
declarations.statement:
theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) :
    has_clean_handshake_seq G k → has_clean_handshake_seq G (k + 1)
declarations.source:
def has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap {Γ Γ' : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ') :
    Γ × Bool → Γ' × Bool := fun s => (f s.1, s.2)

def has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove {V Γ Γ' : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ') :
    Handshake V Γ → Handshake V Γ'
  | Handshake.single x a y => Handshake.single x (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a) y
  | Handshake.double x a b y =>
      Handshake.double x (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a)
        (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f b) y

noncomputable def has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam {V Γ Γ' : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ')
    (t : Γ × Bool → Set V) : Γ' × Bool → Set V := by
  classical
  exact fun s' => if h : ∃ a, has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a = s' then t h.choose else ∅

theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_apply {V Γ Γ' : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (t : Γ × Bool → Set V) (a : Γ × Bool) :
    has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam f t (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a) = t a := by
  classical
  unfold has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam
  split_ifs with h
  · congr 1
    have hspec : (f h.choose.1, h.choose.2) = (f a.1, a.2) := by
      simpa only [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap] using Exists.choose_spec h
    exact Prod.ext (hf (Prod.mk.inj hspec).1) (Prod.mk.inj hspec).2
  · exact absurd ⟨a, rfl⟩ h

theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_of_not_mem {V Γ Γ' : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ')
    (t : Γ × Bool → Set V) (s' : Γ' × Bool)
    (hs' : ¬ ∃ a, has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a = s') :
    has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam f t s' = ∅ := by
  classical
  unfold has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam
  exact dif_neg hs'

theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_empty {V Γ Γ' : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ') :
    has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam (V := V) f (fun _ => ∅) = fun _ => ∅ := by
  classical
  funext s'
  unfold has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam
  by_cases h : ∃ a, has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a = s'
  · rw [dif_pos h]
  · rw [dif_neg h]

theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap_opp {Γ Γ' : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ') (a : Γ × Bool) :
    has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f (opp_glove_side a)
      = opp_glove_side (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a) := rfl

theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap_inj {Γ Γ' : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (x y : Γ × Bool) :
    has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f x = has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f y ↔ x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    exact Prod.ext (hf h.1) h.2
  · intro h; rw [h]

theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_edge_mapGlove {V Γ Γ' : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ')
    (h : Handshake V Γ) :
    handshake_edge (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove f h) = handshake_edge h := by
  cases h <;> rfl

theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_clean_mapGlove {V Γ Γ' : Type*} (f : Γ → Γ')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (h : Handshake V Γ) (t : Γ × Bool → Set V) :
    handshake_is_clean h t →
      handshake_is_clean (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove f h)
        (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam f t) := by
  intro hc
  cases h with
  | single x a y =>
    simp only [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove, handshake_is_clean] at hc ⊢
    rw [← has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap_opp,
      has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_apply f hf,
      has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_apply f hf]
    exact hc
  | double x a b y =>
    simp only [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove, handshake_is_clean] at hc ⊢
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro he; exact hc.1 (hf he)
    · rw [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_apply f hf]; exact hc.2.1
    · rw [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_apply f hf]; exact hc.2.2

theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_update {V Γ Γ' : Type*}
    [DecidableEq Γ] [DecidableEq Γ'] (f : Γ → Γ') (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (h : Handshake V Γ) (t : Γ × Bool → Set V) :
    has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam f (handshake_update_contam h t)
      = handshake_update_contam (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove f h)
          (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam f t) := by
  classical
  cases h with
  | single x a y =>
    funext s'
    by_cases hs' : ∃ a, has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a = s'
    · obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hs'
      rw [← ha']
      simp only [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove, handshake_update_contam,
        ← has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap_opp,
        has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_apply f hf,
        has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap_inj f hf]
    · rw [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_of_not_mem f _ s' hs']
      have h1 : s' ≠ has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a := fun he => hs' ⟨a, he.symm⟩
      have h2 : s' ≠ opp_glove_side (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a) := by
        rw [← has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap_opp]
        exact fun he => hs' ⟨opp_glove_side a, he.symm⟩
      simp only [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove, handshake_update_contam, h1, h2,
        has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_of_not_mem f t s' hs']
      simp
  | double x a b y =>
    funext s'
    by_cases hs' : ∃ a, has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a = s'
    · obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hs'
      rw [← ha']
      simp only [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove, handshake_update_contam,
        ← has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap_opp,
        has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_apply f hf,
        has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap_inj f hf]
    · rw [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_of_not_mem f _ s' hs']
      have h1 : s' ≠ has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a := fun he => hs' ⟨a, he.symm⟩
      have h2 : s' ≠ has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f b := fun he => hs' ⟨b, he.symm⟩
      have h3 : s' ≠ opp_glove_side (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f a) := by
        rw [← has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap_opp]
        exact fun he => hs' ⟨opp_glove_side a, he.symm⟩
      have h4 : s' ≠ opp_glove_side (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap f b) := by
        rw [← has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_sideMap_opp]
        exact fun he => hs' ⟨opp_glove_side b, he.symm⟩
      simp only [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove, handshake_update_contam, h1, h2, h3, h4,
        has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_of_not_mem f t s' hs']
      simp

theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_clean_seq_map {V Γ Γ' : Type*}
    [DecidableEq Γ] [DecidableEq Γ'] (f : Γ → Γ') (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    ∀ (seq : List (Handshake V Γ)) (t : Γ × Bool → Set V),
      CleanHandshakeSeq seq t →
      CleanHandshakeSeq (seq.map (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove f))
        (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam f t) := by
  intro seq t hseq
  induction hseq with
  | nil t => exact CleanHandshakeSeq.nil _
  | cons h seq t hclean htail ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons]
    refine CleanHandshakeSeq.cons (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove f h)
      (seq.map (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove f))
      (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam f t) ?_ ?_
    · exact has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_clean_mapGlove f hf h t hclean
    · rw [← has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_update f hf h t]
      exact ih

/-- An unused glove can always be added: `k` gloves suffice implies `k+1` gloves suffice. -/
theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_succ {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) :
    has_clean_handshake_seq G k → has_clean_handshake_seq G (k + 1) := by
  rintro ⟨seq, hclean, hcover⟩
  refine ⟨seq.map (has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove (Fin.castSucc (n := k))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_clean_seq_map (f := Fin.castSucc (n := k))
        (Fin.castSucc_injective k) seq (fun _ => ∅) hclean
    rw [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_pushContam_empty] at h
    exact h
  · intro e he
    obtain ⟨h, hh, hedge⟩ := hcover e he
    refine ⟨has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_mapGlove (Fin.castSucc (n := k)) h, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [List.mem_map]; exact ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
    · rw [has_clean_handshake_seq_succ_edge_mapGlove]; exact hedge

declarations.name: has_clean_handshake_seq_mono
declarations.informal: If a graph $G$ admits a clean handshake sequence with $k$ gloves and $k \le k'$, then it admits one with $k'$ gloves.
declarations.statement:
theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_mono {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) {k k' : ℕ} (hkk : k ≤ k')
    (h : has_clean_handshake_seq G k) : has_clean_handshake_seq G k'
declarations.source:
/-- Glove counts admitting a covering sequence form an upward closed set. -/
theorem has_clean_handshake_seq_mono {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) {k k' : ℕ} (hkk : k ≤ k')
    (h : has_clean_handshake_seq G k) : has_clean_handshake_seq G k' := by
  induction hkk with
  | refl => exact h
  | step hkk ih => exact has_clean_handshake_seq_succ G _ ih

declarations.name: glove_number_le_iff_has_clean_handshake_seq
declarations.informal: If some number of gloves suffices for a graph $G$, then for every $k$ the glove number of $G$ is at most $k$ if and only if $G$ has a clean handshake sequence with $k$ gloves.
declarations.statement:
theorem glove_number_le_iff_has_clean_handshake_seq {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hne : ∃ j, has_clean_handshake_seq G j) (k : ℕ) :
    glove_number G ≤ k ↔ has_clean_handshake_seq G k
declarations.source:
/-- For a graph some number of gloves suffices for, having at most `k` gloves is the same as having a `k`-glove covering sequence. -/
theorem glove_number_le_iff_has_clean_handshake_seq {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (hne : ∃ j, has_clean_handshake_seq G j) (k : ℕ) :
    glove_number G ≤ k ↔ has_clean_handshake_seq G k := by
  have hS : {j : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq G j} = Set.Ici (glove_number G) := by
    show {j : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq G j} =
      Set.Ici (sInf {j : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq G j})
    exact Nat.eq_Ici_of_nonempty_of_upward_closed hne
      (fun k₁ k₂ hkk hk => has_clean_handshake_seq_mono G hkk hk)
  rw [← Set.mem_Ici, ← hS]
  rfl

explanation.summary: The glove number of G is defined as the infimum of the set of natural numbers j for which G admits a clean handshake sequence with j gloves. Because this property is upward-closed (monotonic) in the number of gloves and the set is nonempty by assumption, the set of admissible glove counts is precisely the closed interval starting at the glove number. Consequently, glove_number G ≤ k is equivalent to k belonging to this set, which means G has a clean handshake sequence with k gloves.

steps.claim: The set of glove counts for which G has a clean handshake sequence is the closed interval [glove_number G, ∞).
steps.explanation: By definition, `glove_number G` is the infimum of the set S = {j : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq G j}. Because S is nonempty by assumption (hne) and upward-closed by the monotonicity lemma `has_clean_handshake_seq_mono`, `Nat.eq_Ici_of_nonempty_of_upward_closed` identifies S with the interval [sInf S, ∞), which is [glove_number G, ∞).
steps.code:
have hS : {j : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq G j} = Set.Ici (glove_number G) := by
    show {j : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq G j} =
      Set.Ici (sInf {j : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq G j})
    exact Nat.eq_Ici_of_nonempty_of_upward_closed hne
      (fun k₁ k₂ hkk hk => has_clean_handshake_seq_mono G hkk hk)

steps.claim: glove_number G ≤ k if and only if G has a clean handshake sequence with k gloves.
steps.explanation: By `Set.mem_Ici`, the condition glove_number G ≤ k is equivalent to k ∈ [glove_number G, ∞). Using the equality hS established in the first step, this interval is rewritten to the set of feasible glove counts {j : ℕ | has_clean_handshake_seq G j}. Finally, testing membership of k in this set is definitionally has_clean_handshake_seq G k, concluding the proof by reflexivity (`rfl`).
steps.code:
rw [← Set.mem_Ici, ← hS]
  rfl

declarations.name: glove_number_complete_graph_le_iff
declarations.informal: For $n \ge 2$ and every $k$, the glove number of $K_n$ is at most $k$ if and only if $K_n$ has a clean handshake sequence with $k$ gloves.
declarations.statement:
theorem glove_number_complete_graph_le_iff (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) :
    glove_number (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) ≤ k ↔
      has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k
declarations.source:
/-- For `K_n`, `gl ≤ k` is equivalent to the existence of a `k`-glove covering sequence: no side condition is needed, because `gl(K_n) > 0` makes the set of admissible glove counts nonempty. -/
theorem glove_number_complete_graph_le_iff (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) :
    glove_number (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) ≤ k ↔
      has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k := by
  apply glove_number_le_iff_has_clean_handshake_seq
  have h1 := glove_number_complete_graph_pos n hn
  simp only [glove_number] at h1 ⊢
  have h : 0 < sInf {k | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k} := by omega
  exact Nat.nonempty_of_pos_sInf h

This nonemptiness condition is discharged by observing that for n ≥ 2, the glove number of K_n is at least 1 (by `glove_number_complete_graph_pos`); because the infimum of admissible glove counts is strictly positive, the set cannot be empty.

steps.claim: The equivalence glove_number(K_n) ≤ k ↔ has_clean_handshake_seq(K_n, k) holds provided that K_n has a clean handshake sequence for some number of gloves.

steps.explanation: Since n ≥ 2, `glove_number_complete_graph_pos` shows that the glove number of K_n is at least 1. Unfolding the definition of `glove_number`, the infimum of the set of admissible glove counts is at least 1, which implies by linear arithmetic (`omega`) that the infimum is strictly positive. Finally, `Nat.nonempty_of_pos_sInf` concludes that this set of natural numbers is nonempty, providing the required witness j.

have h1 := glove_number_complete_graph_pos n hn
  simp only [glove_number] at h1 ⊢
  have h : 0 < sInf {k | has_clean_handshake_seq (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) k} := by omega
  exact Nat.nonempty_of_pos_sInf h

declarations.name: mdfrbf_fan_of_c_subset
declarations.informal: Fan witness from a c-coloured block: if W has j-1 points, each of whose singletons is c-coloured, and B is a nonempty c-coloured subset of a c-coloured set top which contains W and is disjoint from B, then there is a monochromatic F_j in colour c (top, with the j-1 singletons of W plus B as middles).
declarations.statement:
theorem mdfrbf_fan_of_c_subset {j d k : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (W : Finset (Fin d)) (hW : W.card = j - 1)
    (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k) (c : Fin k) (top B : Finset (Fin d))
    (hcol : χ top = c) (hWtop : W ⊆ top) (hWc : ∀ w ∈ W, χ {w} = c)
    (hBne : B.Nonempty) (hBsub : B ⊆ top) (hBcol : χ B = c) (hBdisj : Disjoint B W) :
    has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d c χ
declarations.source:
/-- Builds the monochromatic fan in colour c out of the j-1 c-coloured singletons of W together with one c-coloured nonempty set B inside the c-coloured top. -/
theorem mdfrbf_fan_of_c_subset {j d k : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (W : Finset (Fin d)) (hW : W.card = j - 1)
    (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin k) (c : Fin k) (top B : Finset (Fin d))
    (hcol : χ top = c) (hWtop : W ⊆ top) (hWc : ∀ w ∈ W, χ {w} = c)
    (hBne : B.Nonempty) (hBsub : B ⊆ top) (hBcol : χ B = c) (hBdisj : Disjoint B W) :
    has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d c χ := by
  classical
  let S : Finset (Finset (Fin d)) := insert B (W.image (fun w => ({w} : Finset (Fin d))))
  have hSdef : S = insert B (W.image (fun w => ({w} : Finset (Fin d)))) := rfl
  have hBnotmem : B ∉ W.image (fun w => ({w} : Finset (Fin d))) := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwB⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBne
    have hbw : b = w := by
      rw [← hwB] at hbB
      exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp hbB
    have hbB' : b ∈ B := by
      rw [← hwB]
      exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr hbw
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hBdisj hbB') (hbw ▸ hw)
  have hSimgcard : (W.image (fun w => ({w} : Finset (Fin d)))).card = W.card :=
    Finset.card_image_of_injective W (fun a b h => Finset.singleton_inj.mp h)
  have hScard : S.card = j := by
    rw [hSdef, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hBnotmem, hSimgcard, hW]
    omega
  let e : ↥S ≃ Fin j := (Finset.equivFin S).trans (finCongr hScard)
  have hWne : W.Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro h0
    rw [h0, Finset.card_empty] at hW
    omega
  have hSprop : ∀ X ∈ S, X ⊆ top ∧ χ X = c ∧ X ≠ top := by
    intro X hX
    rw [hSdef, Finset.mem_insert] at hX
    rcases hX with hXB | hX
    · rw [hXB]
      refine ⟨hBsub, hBcol, ?_⟩
      intro hEq
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hWne
      have hwt : w ∈ top := hWtop hw
      rw [← hEq] at hwt
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hBdisj hwt) hw
    · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwX⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hX
      rw [← hwX]
      refine ⟨Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (hWtop hw), hWc w hw, ?_⟩
      intro hEq
      obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBne
      have hbt : b ∈ top := hBsub hbB
      rw [← hEq] at hbt
      have hbw : b = w := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hbt
      have hbW : b ∈ W := hbw ▸ hw
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hBdisj hbB) hbW
  have hanti : ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ Y ∈ S, X ⊆ Y → X = Y := by
    intro X hX Y hY hsub
    rw [hSdef, Finset.mem_insert] at hX hY
    rcases hX with hXB | hX
    · rw [hXB] at hsub ⊢
      rcases hY with hYB | hY
      · rw [hYB]
      · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwY⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hY
        rw [← hwY] at hsub ⊢
        exfalso
        obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBne
        have hbw : b = w := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (hsub hbB)
        exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hBdisj hbB) (hbw ▸ hw)
    · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwX⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hX
      rw [← hwX] at hsub ⊢
      rcases hY with hYB | hY
      · rw [hYB] at hsub ⊢
        exfalso
        have hwB : w ∈ B := hsub (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
        exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hBdisj hwB) hw
      · obtain ⟨w', hw', hwY⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hY
        rw [← hwY] at hsub ⊢
        have hww' : w = w' := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (hsub (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl))
        rw [hww']
  refine ⟨top, hcol, fun i => ((e.symm i : ↥S) : Finset (Fin d)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hmem : ((e.symm i : ↥S) : Finset (Fin d)) ∈ S := (e.symm i).2
    obtain ⟨hsub, hcolmid, hne⟩ := hSprop _ hmem
    exact ⟨Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsub, hne⟩, hcolmid⟩
  · intro i i' hne hsub
    exact hne (e.symm.injective (Subtype.ext (hanti _ (e.symm i).2 _ (e.symm i').2 hsub)))

explanation.summary: To construct a monochromatic fan $F_j$ in colour $c$, the proof defines the collection $S$ of middle sets consisting of $B$ together with the $j - 1$ singletons $\{w\}$ for $w \in W$. Since $B$ is nonempty and disjoint from $W$, $B$ cannot be one of these singletons, so $S$ has cardinality exactly $(j - 1) + 1 = j$. Each member of $S$ is shown to be monochromatic of colour $c$ and a proper subset of $\mathrm{top}$, and the disjointness of $B$ and $W$ prevents any inclusion between distinct elements of $S$. Indexing $S$ by $\mathrm{Fin}\, j$ then provides the desired fan copy.

steps.claim: Let $S$ be the family of sets obtained by adding $B$ to the set of singletons $\{\{w\} : w \in W\}$.
steps.explanation: We enable classical logic and define the candidate family $S = \{B\} \cup \{\{w\} : w \in W\}$ of middle sets for the fan.

steps.claim: $B$ is not among the singletons of elements of $W$.
steps.explanation: Suppose for contradiction that $B = \{w\}$ for some $w \in W$. Since $B$ is nonempty, choose an element $b \in B$. Then $b \in \{w\}$, which implies $b = w$. Thus $b \in W$, which contradicts the assumption that $B$ and $W$ are disjoint.
steps.code:
have hBnotmem : B ∉ W.image (fun w => ({w} : Finset (Fin d))) := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwB⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBne
    have hbw : b = w := by
      rw [← hwB] at hbB
      exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp hbB
    have hbB' : b ∈ B := by
      rw [← hwB]
      exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr hbw
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hBdisj hbB') (hbw ▸ hw)

steps.claim: The family $S$ has cardinality $j$, giving a bijection $e : S \simeq \mathrm{Fin}\, j$.
steps.explanation: Because the singleton map $w \mapsto \{w\}$ is injective, the image of $W$ under this map has cardinality $|W| = j - 1$. Since $B$ is not in this image, inserting $B$ yields $|S| = (j - 1) + 1 = j$ by linear arithmetic using $j \ge 2$. Composing the canonical indexing of $S$ with the equality $|S| = j$ yields a bijection $e : S \simeq \mathrm{Fin}\, j$.
steps.code:
have hSimgcard : (W.image (fun w => ({w} : Finset (Fin d)))).card = W.card :=
    Finset.card_image_of_injective W (fun a b h => Finset.singleton_inj.mp h)
  have hScard : S.card = j := by
    rw [hSdef, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hBnotmem, hSimgcard, hW]
    omega
  let e : ↥S ≃ Fin j := (Finset.equivFin S).trans (finCongr hScard)

steps.claim: $W$ is nonempty.
steps.explanation: If $W$ were empty, its cardinality would be 0. But by assumption $|W| = j - 1$ and $j \ge 2$, so $|W| \ge 1 > 0$, a contradiction.
steps.code:
have hWne : W.Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro h0
    rw [h0, Finset.card_empty] at hW
    omega

steps.claim: Every set $X \in S$ is a subset of $\mathrm{top}$, has colour $c$, and is strictly smaller than $\mathrm{top}$.
steps.explanation: Take any $X \in S$, which is either $B$ or $\{w\}$ for some $w \in W$. If $X = B$, we are given $B \subseteq \mathrm{top}$ and $\chi(B) = c$. If $B = \mathrm{top}$, then since $W$ is nonempty, any $w \in W \subseteq \mathrm{top}$ would belong to $B$, violating the disjointness of $B$ and $W$; hence $B \ne \mathrm{top}$. If $X = \{w\}$ for $w \in W$, then $\{w\} \subseteq \mathrm{top}$ (since $w \in W \subseteq \mathrm{top}$) and $\chi(\{w\}) = c$ by assumption. If $\{w\} = \mathrm{top}$, then since $B$ is nonempty, any $b \in B \subseteq \mathrm{top}$ satisfies $b \in \{w\}$, giving $b = w \in W$, which again contradicts $B \cap W = \emptyset$. Thus $\{w\} \ne \mathrm{top}$.
steps.code:
have hSprop : ∀ X ∈ S, X ⊆ top ∧ χ X = c ∧ X ≠ top := by
    intro X hX
    rw [hSdef, Finset.mem_insert] at hX
    rcases hX with hXB | hX
    · rw [hXB]
      refine ⟨hBsub, hBcol, ?_⟩
      intro hEq
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hWne
      have hwt : w ∈ top := hWtop hw
      rw [← hEq] at hwt
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hBdisj hwt) hw
    · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwX⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hX
      rw [← hwX]
      refine ⟨Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (hWtop hw), hWc w hw, ?_⟩
      intro hEq
      obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBne
      have hbt : b ∈ top := hBsub hbB
      rw [← hEq] at hbt
      have hbw : b = w := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hbt
      have hbW : b ∈ W := hbw ▸ hw
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hBdisj hbB) hbW

steps.claim: The family $S$ forms an antichain under inclusion: if $X, Y \in S$ and $X \subseteq Y$, then $X = Y$.
steps.explanation: Let $X, Y \in S$ with $X \subseteq Y$. If $X = B$, then either $Y = B$ (so $X = Y$), or $Y = \{w\}$ for $w \in W$, in which case $B \subseteq \{w\}$ forces any $b \in B$ to equal $w \in W$, contradicting disjointness. If $X = \{w\}$ for $w \in W$, then either $Y = B$ (so $w \in B$, contradicting disjointness), or $Y = \{w'\}$ for $w' \in W$, in which case $\{w\} \subseteq \{w'\}$ implies $w = w'$ and $X = Y$.
steps.code:
have hanti : ∀ X ∈ S, ∀ Y ∈ S, X ⊆ Y → X = Y := by
    intro X hX Y hY hsub
    rw [hSdef, Finset.mem_insert] at hX hY
    rcases hX with hXB | hX
    · rw [hXB] at hsub ⊢
      rcases hY with hYB | hY
      · rw [hYB]
      · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwY⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hY
        rw [← hwY] at hsub ⊢
        exfalso
        obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBne
        have hbw : b = w := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (hsub hbB)
        exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hBdisj hbB) (hbw ▸ hw)
    · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwX⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hX
      rw [← hwX] at hsub ⊢
      rcases hY with hYB | hY
      · rw [hYB] at hsub ⊢
        exfalso
        have hwB : w ∈ B := hsub (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
        exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hBdisj hwB) hw
      · obtain ⟨w', hw', hwY⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hY
        rw [← hwY] at hsub ⊢
        have hww' : w = w' := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (hsub (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl))
        rw [hww']

steps.claim: The set $\mathrm{top}$ together with the middle sets $\mathrm{mid}_i = e^{-1}(i)$ form a monochromatic fan of colour $c$.
steps.explanation: We witness the fan with $\mathrm{top}$ (which has colour $c$) and the $j$ middle sets $\mathrm{mid}_i = e^{-1}(i) \in S$ for $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\, j$. By Step 5, each $\mathrm{mid}_i$ is a subset of $\mathrm{top}$ not equal to $\mathrm{top}$ (so $\mathrm{mid}_i \subsetneq \mathrm{top}$) and has colour $c$. Furthermore, if $i \ne i'$ but $\mathrm{mid}_i \subseteq \mathrm{mid}_{i'}$, the antichain property of $S$ forces $\mathrm{mid}_i = \mathrm{mid}_{i'}$, which contradicts $i \ne i'$ by injectivity of $e^{-1}$.
steps.code:
refine ⟨top, hcol, fun i => ((e.symm i : ↥S) : Finset (Fin d)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hmem : ((e.symm i : ↥S) : Finset (Fin d)) ∈ S := (e.symm i).2
    obtain ⟨hsub, hcolmid, hne⟩ := hSprop _ hmem
    exact ⟨Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsub, hne⟩, hcolmid⟩
  · intro i i' hne hsub
    exact hne (e.symm.injective (Subtype.ext (hanti _ (e.symm i).2 _ (e.symm i').2 hsub)))

glossary.Finset.card_empty: The empty set has cardinality zero ($|\emptyset| = 0$).
glossary.Finset.card_image_of_injective: If $f$ is an injective function, then the image of a finite set $s$ under $f$ has the same cardinality as $s$.
glossary.Finset.card_insert_of_notMem: Inserting an element $a \notin s$ into a finite set $s$ increases its cardinality by 1.
glossary.Finset.disjoint_left.mp: If two sets $A$ and $B$ are disjoint, then any element in $A$ does not belong to $B$.
glossary.Finset.equivFin: Any finite set $s$ is in bijection with $\mathrm{Fin}(|s|)$.
glossary.Finset.mem_image.mp: An element $y$ belongs to the image of $s$ under $f$ if and only if $y = f(x)$ for some $x \in s$.
glossary.Finset.mem_insert: An element belongs to $\mathrm{insert}(a, s)$ if and only if it equals $a$ or belongs to $s$.
glossary.Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty: A finite set is nonempty if and only if it is not equal to the empty set.
glossary.Finset.singleton_inj.mp: If two singletons $\{a\}$ and $\{b\}$ are equal, then $a = b$.
glossary.Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr: If $a \in s$, then the singleton $\{a\}$ is a subset of $s$.
glossary.Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr: If $A \subseteq B$ and $A \ne B$, then $A$ is a strict subset of $B$ ($A \subsetneq B$).
glossary.Subtype.ext: Two subtype elements are equal if their underlying carrier values are equal.
glossary.finCongr: If $n = m$, then the finite types $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and $\mathrm{Fin}(m)$ are naturally equivalent.

declarations.name: is_generalized_tree_shift
declarations.informal: A simple graph T' on an arbitrary type V is obtained from a tree T by a generalized tree shift if T is a tree, and there exist distinct vertices u and v and a walk p from u to v in T that is a path, such that every vertex x in the support of p other than u and v has degree 2 (Nat.card (T.neighborSet x) = 2), and T' equals gts_graph T u v p.penultimate.
declarations.statement: def is_generalized_tree_shift {V : Type*} (T T' : SimpleGraph V) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A graph T' is obtained from a tree T by a generalized tree shift. -/
def is_generalized_tree_shift {V : Type*} (T T' : SimpleGraph V) : Prop := T.IsTree ∧ ∃ (u v : V) (p : T.Walk u v),
    p.IsPath ∧ u ≠ v ∧
    (∀ x ∈ p.support, x ≠ u → x ≠ v → Nat.card (T.neighborSet x) = 2) ∧
    T' = gts_graph T u v p.penultimate

declarations.name: mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_all_singletons_fan_colours
declarations.informal: Case b ≥ 2 with every singleton fan-coloured: if d ≥ j*a + (j-1)*b + 1 and the statement holds at (a, b-1) in dimension d-(j-1), then χ has a monochromatic diamond in one of the a diamond colours or a monochromatic F_j in one of the b fan colours.
declarations.statement:
theorem mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_all_singletons_fan_colours (j a b d : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hd : j * a + (j - 1) * b + 1 ≤ d)
    (ih : mixed_ramsey_property j a (b - 1) (d - (j - 1)))
    (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin (a + b))
    (hx : ∀ x : Fin d, ∃ c : Fin b, χ {x} = Fin.natAdd a c) :
    (∃ col : Fin a, has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (Fin.castAdd b col) χ) ∨
      ∃ col : Fin b, has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d (Fin.natAdd a col) χ
declarations.source:
/-- b ≥ 2 step with all singletons fan-coloured: pigeonhole a colour c on j-1 singletons, compress away that set W, and apply the (a, b-1) instance; a c-coloured set inside the compressed board is already a fan in colour c. -/
theorem mixed_diamond_fan_ramsey_bound_all_singletons_fan_colours (j a b d : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j)
    (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hd : j * a + (j - 1) * b + 1 ≤ d)
    (ih : mixed_ramsey_property j a (b - 1) (d - (j - 1)))
    (χ : Finset (Fin d) → Fin (a + b))
    (hx : ∀ x : Fin d, ∃ c : Fin b, χ {x} = Fin.natAdd a c) :
    (∃ col : Fin a, has_monochromatic_diamond_copy j d (Fin.castAdd b col) χ) ∨
      ∃ col : Fin b, has_monochromatic_fan_copy j d (Fin.natAdd a col) χ := by
  classical
  let f : Fin d → Fin b := fun x => (hx x).choose
  have hf_spec : ∀ x : Fin d, χ {x} = Fin.natAdd a (f x) := fun x => (hx x).choose_spec
  have hb_gt : b * (j - 2) < d := by
    have hj1 : j - 1 = (j - 2) + 1 := by omega
    have hmul : (j - 1) * b = (j - 2) * b + b := by rw [hj1, Nat.add_mul, one_mul]
    have hja : 1 ≤ j * a := by
      have h : 0 < j * a := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
      omega
    rw [Nat.mul_comm b (j - 2)]
    omega
  obtain ⟨c, W, hWcard, hWf⟩ := mdfrbf_fibre_subset f (j - 2) hb_gt
  have hWcard' : W.card = j - 1 := by omega
  have hWc : ∀ w ∈ W, χ {w} = Fin.natAdd a c := by
    intro w hw; rw [hf_spec w, hWf w hw]
  by_cases hwin : ∃ A : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), A.Nonempty ∧ χ (mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) A) = Fin.natAdd a c
  · right
    set emb : ↥(Finset.univ \ W) ↪ Fin d := Function.Embedding.subtype fun x => x ∈ Finset.univ \ W with hemb
    have hdef : ∀ A : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) A
        = A.map emb ∪ (if (A.Nonempty ∧ ∃ B : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), B.Nonempty ∧ B ⊆ A ∧ χ (B.map emb) = Fin.natAdd a c) then W else ∅) := by
      intro A
      unfold mdfrbf_compress
      simp only [← hemb]
      by_cases h : (A.Nonempty ∧ ∃ B : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), B.Nonempty ∧ B ⊆ A ∧ χ (B.map emb) = Fin.natAdd a c)
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]; simp
    have hnotW : ∀ x : ↥(Finset.univ \ W), (emb x : Fin d) ∉ W := by
      intro x hx'
      have hx2 : (x : Fin d) ∈ Finset.univ \ W := x.2
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hx2
      have hv : (emb x : Fin d) = (x : Fin d) := rfl
      rw [hv] at hx'
      exact hx2.2 hx'
    have hdisj : ∀ A : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), Disjoint (A.map emb) W := by
      intro A
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro y hy hyW
      rw [Finset.mem_map] at hy
      obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact hnotW x hyW
    obtain ⟨A, hAne, hAcol⟩ := hwin
    have hH : A.Nonempty ∧ ∃ B, B.Nonempty ∧ B ⊆ A ∧ χ (B.map emb) = Fin.natAdd a c := by
      by_contra hcon
      have hT : mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) A = A.map emb := by
        rw [hdef A, if_neg hcon]
        simp
      exact hcon ⟨hAne, A, hAne, le_rfl, by rw [← hT]; exact hAcol⟩
    obtain ⟨B, hBne, hBsub, hBcol⟩ := hH.2
    have hT_union : mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) A = A.map emb ∪ W := by
      rw [hdef A, if_pos hH]
    refine ⟨c, mdfrbf_fan_of_c_subset hj W hWcard' χ (Fin.natAdd a c) _ (B.map emb) hAcol ?_ hWc ?_ ?_ hBcol ?_⟩
    · rw [hT_union]; exact Finset.subset_union_right
    · exact hBne.map (f := emb)
    · rw [hT_union]; exact (Finset.map_subset_map.mpr hBsub).trans Finset.subset_union_left
    · exact hdisj B
  · have hnowin : ∀ A : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), A.Nonempty → χ (mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) A) ≠ Fin.natAdd a c := by
      intro A hA hcontra
      exact hwin ⟨A, hA, hcontra⟩
    obtain ⟨f0, hf0_inj, hf0_surj, hf0_cast, hf0_nat, hf0_ne⟩ := mdfrbf_colour_inj a b ha hb c
    let K := d - (j - 1)
    have hKcard : Fintype.card ↥(Finset.univ \ W) = K := mdfrbf_compression_card j d hj W hWcard'
    let e : Fin K ≃ ↥(Finset.univ \ W) :=
      Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; exact hKcard.symm)
    let T' : Finset (Fin K) → Finset (Fin d) := fun A => mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) (A.map e.toEmbedding)
    have hT' : ∀ A A' : Finset (Fin K), T' A ⊆ T' A' ↔ A ⊆ A' := by
      intro A A'
      simp only [T']
      rw [mdfrbf_compress_subset_iff]
      exact Finset.map_subset_map
    let c₀ : Fin (b - 1) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
    let ψ' : Finset (Fin K) → Fin (a + (b - 1)) := fun B =>
      if h : B.Nonempty then
        Classical.choose (hf0_surj (χ (T' B)) (hnowin (B.map e.toEmbedding) (h.map (f := e.toEmbedding))))
      else Fin.natAdd a c₀
    have hpoint : ∀ B : Finset (Fin K), B.Nonempty → χ (T' B) = f0 (ψ' B) := by
      intro B hB
      have hex : ∃ u : Fin (a + (b - 1)), f0 u = χ (T' B) :=
        hf0_surj (χ (T' B)) (hnowin (B.map e.toEmbedding) (hB.map (f := e.toEmbedding)))
      have hψ : ψ' B = Classical.choose hex := by
        simp only [ψ']
        rw [dif_pos hB]
      rw [hψ]
      exact (Classical.choose_spec hex).symm
    have hempty : ∀ col : Fin a, ψ' ∅ ≠ Fin.castAdd (b - 1) col := by
      intro col
      simp only [ψ']
      rw [dif_neg (Finset.not_nonempty_empty)]
      intro h
      have hv : (Fin.natAdd a c₀).val = (Fin.castAdd (b - 1) col).val := by rw [h]
      simp only [Fin.val_natAdd, Fin.val_castAdd] at hv
      have := col.isLt
      omega
    rcases ih ψ' with ⟨col, hcopy⟩ | ⟨col, hcopy⟩
    · left
      have htr := mdfrbf_diamond_transfer f0 T' hT' χ ψ' hpoint (Fin.castAdd (b - 1) col) (hempty col) hcopy
      rw [hf0_cast col] at htr
      exact ⟨col, htr⟩
    · right
      have htr := mdfrbf_fan_transfer hj f0 T' hT' χ ψ' hpoint (Fin.natAdd a col) hcopy
      obtain ⟨col', hcol'⟩ := hf0_nat col
      rw [hcol'] at htr
      exact ⟨col', htr⟩

explanation.summary: The proof proceeds by pigeonholing the singletons into a common fan color, followed by a case analysis on whether board compression preserves this fan color. Since the dimension $d$ exceeds $b(j - 2)$, the pigeonhole principle yields a fan color $c$ and a set $W$ of $j - 1$ singletons that all have color $c$. If some nonempty set $A$ disjoint from $W$ compresses to a set of color $c$, then $A$ contains a nonempty monochromatic subset $B$ of color $c$, which together with the $j - 1$ singletons in $W$ forms a monochromatic fan of size $j$ in color $c$. Otherwise, color $c$ is never achieved by nonempty compressed sets, allowing us to eliminate $c$ and pull back the coloring to dimension $d - (j - 1)$ with $b - 1$ fan colors, where the induction hypothesis guarantees a monochromatic diamond or fan that transfers back to dimension $d$.

steps.claim: Each element $x \in \text{Fin } d$ is assigned a fan color $f(x) \in \text{Fin } b$ such that $\chi(\{x\}) = a + f(x)$.
steps.explanation: The hypothesis $hx$ states that every singleton $\{x\}$ has a fan color, meaning its color is of the form $a + c$ for some $c \in \text{Fin } b$. Using choice, we define $f : \text{Fin } d \to \text{Fin } b$ selecting this color for each $x$, so $\chi(\{x\}) = a + f(x)$.
steps.code:
classical
  let f : Fin d → Fin b := fun x => (hx x).choose
  have hf_spec : ∀ x : Fin d, χ {x} = Fin.natAdd a (f x) := fun x => (hx x).choose_spec

steps.claim: The product $b(j - 2)$ is strictly less than $d$.
steps.explanation: Using $j - 1 = (j - 2) + 1$, the product $(j - 1)b$ expands to $(j - 2)b + b$ by `Nat.add_mul` and `one_mul`. Since $j \ge 2$ and $a \ge 1$, we have $j a \ge 1$ by `Nat.mul_pos`. Using commutativity of multiplication (`Nat.mul_comm`) and the hypothesis $d \ge j a + (j - 1)b + 1$, linear arithmetic (`omega`) confirms $b(j - 2) < d$.
steps.code:
have hb_gt : b * (j - 2) < d := by
    have hj1 : j - 1 = (j - 2) + 1 := by omega
    have hmul : (j - 1) * b = (j - 2) * b + b := by rw [hj1, Nat.add_mul, one_mul]
    have hja : 1 ≤ j * a := by
      have h : 0 < j * a := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
      omega
    rw [Nat.mul_comm b (j - 2)]
    omega

steps.claim: There exist a fan color $c \in \text{Fin } b$ and a subset $W \subseteq \text{Fin } d$ of size $j - 1$ such that $\chi(\{w\}) = a + c$ for all $w \in W$.
steps.explanation: Applying the pigeonhole principle (`mdfrbf_fibre_subset`) to $f$ with threshold $j - 2$ (valid since $b(j - 2) < d$), we obtain a color $c \in \text{Fin } b$ and a set $W$ of $(j - 2) + 1 = j - 1$ elements on which $f$ takes the constant value $c$. By specification of $f$, every $w \in W$ satisfies $\chi(\{w\}) = a + c$.
steps.code:
obtain ⟨c, W, hWcard, hWf⟩ := mdfrbf_fibre_subset f (j - 2) hb_gt
  have hWcard' : W.card = j - 1 := by omega
  have hWc : ∀ w ∈ W, χ {w} = Fin.natAdd a c := by
    intro w hw; rw [hf_spec w, hWf w hw]

steps.claim: It suffices to consider whether there exists a nonempty set $A \subseteq \text{Fin } d \setminus W$ whose compression has color $a + c$.
steps.explanation: We perform a case split on whether there exists a nonempty subset $A$ of the remaining elements $\text{Fin } d \setminus W$ whose compressed image $\text{mdfrbf\_compress } W\ \chi\ (a + c)\ A$ has color $a + c$.
steps.code: by_cases hwin : ∃ A : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), A.Nonempty ∧ χ (mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) A) = Fin.natAdd a c

steps.claim: In the positive case, compression adds $W$ exactly when $A$ contains a nonempty monochromatic subset of color $a + c$, and all subsets of $\text{Fin } d \setminus W$ are disjoint from $W$.
steps.explanation: We define the canonical embedding `emb` of $\text{Fin } d \setminus W$ into $\text{Fin } d$ using `Function.Embedding.subtype`. Unfolding `mdfrbf_compress`, we verify via `if_pos` and `if_neg` that compressing $A$ appends $W$ if and only if $A$ contains a nonempty subset $B$ with $\chi(B) = a + c$. Furthermore, using `Finset.mem_sdiff`, `Finset.disjoint_left`, and `Finset.mem_map`, we verify that the image of any subset of $\text{Fin } d \setminus W$ under `emb` is strictly disjoint from $W$.
steps.code:
· right
    set emb : ↥(Finset.univ \ W) ↪ Fin d := Function.Embedding.subtype fun x => x ∈ Finset.univ \ W with hemb
    have hdef : ∀ A : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) A
        = A.map emb ∪ (if (A.Nonempty ∧ ∃ B : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), B.Nonempty ∧ B ⊆ A ∧ χ (B.map emb) = Fin.natAdd a c) then W else ∅) := by
      intro A
      unfold mdfrbf_compress
      simp only [← hemb]
      by_cases h : (A.Nonempty ∧ ∃ B : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), B.Nonempty ∧ B ⊆ A ∧ χ (B.map emb) = Fin.natAdd a c)
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]; simp
    have hnotW : ∀ x : ↥(Finset.univ \ W), (emb x : Fin d) ∉ W := by
      intro x hx'
      have hx2 : (x : Fin d) ∈ Finset.univ \ W := x.2
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hx2
      have hv : (emb x : Fin d) = (x : Fin d) := rfl
      rw [hv] at hx'
      exact hx2.2 hx'
    have hdisj : ∀ A : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), Disjoint (A.map emb) W := by
      intro A
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro y hy hyW
      rw [Finset.mem_map] at hy
      obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact hnotW x hyW

steps.claim: The winning set $A$ contains a nonempty subset $B \subseteq A$ with $\chi(B) = a + c$, and the compressed set equals $A \cup W$.
steps.explanation: From the case hypothesis, we obtain a nonempty set $A$ whose compression has color $a + c$. If $A$ contained no nonempty subset of color $a + c$, its compression would simply be $A$ itself (by `if_neg`), which leads to a contradiction since $A \subseteq A$ by `le_rfl`. Thus such a nonempty $B \subseteq A$ exists with $\chi(B) = a + c$, and by `if_pos`, the compressed set is indeed $A \cup W$.
steps.code:
obtain ⟨A, hAne, hAcol⟩ := hwin
    have hH : A.Nonempty ∧ ∃ B, B.Nonempty ∧ B ⊆ A ∧ χ (B.map emb) = Fin.natAdd a c := by
      by_contra hcon
      have hT : mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) A = A.map emb := by
        rw [hdef A, if_neg hcon]
        simp
      exact hcon ⟨hAne, A, hAne, le_rfl, by rw [← hT]; exact hAcol⟩
    obtain ⟨B, hBne, hBsub, hBcol⟩ := hH.2
    have hT_union : mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) A = A.map emb ∪ W := by
      rw [hdef A, if_pos hH]

steps.claim: The coloring $\chi$ contains a monochromatic fan copy of size $j$ in fan color $c$.
steps.explanation: We assemble a monochromatic fan in color $c$ using `mdfrbf_fan_of_c_subset`. The top element is the compressed set $A \cup W$, which has color $a + c$. It contains $W$ by `Finset.subset_union_right`, and all $j - 1$ elements of $W$ form singletons of color $a + c$. Furthermore, $B$ is a nonempty subset of $A \cup W$ by `Finset.map_subset_map.mpr` and `Finset.subset_union_left`, has color $a + c$, and is disjoint from $W$. Together, the $j - 1$ singletons from $W$ and the subset $B$ provide $j$ incomparable sub-elements colored $a + c$ below the top set, completing the fan.
steps.code:
refine ⟨c, mdfrbf_fan_of_c_subset hj W hWcard' χ (Fin.natAdd a c) _ (B.map emb) hAcol ?_ hWc ?_ ?_ hBcol ?_⟩
    · rw [hT_union]; exact Finset.subset_union_right
    · exact hBne.map (f := emb)
    · rw [hT_union]; exact (Finset.map_subset_map.mpr hBsub).trans Finset.subset_union_left
    · exact hdisj B

steps.claim: In the negative case, color $a + c$ is never achieved on any nonempty compressed set, yielding an injective re-indexing $f_0$ of the remaining $a + (b - 1)$ colors.
steps.explanation: Since no nonempty set compresses to color $a + c$, all nonempty compressed sets avoid color $a + c$. By `mdfrbf_colour_inj`, there exists an injection $f_0 : \text{Fin }(a + (b - 1)) \to \text{Fin }(a + b)$ whose image avoids $a + c$, fixes the $a$ diamond colors, and maps the remaining $b - 1$ fan colors to fan colors in $\text{Fin } b$.
steps.code:
· have hnowin : ∀ A : Finset ↥(Finset.univ \ W), A.Nonempty → χ (mdfrbf_compress W χ (Fin.natAdd a c) A) ≠ Fin.natAdd a c := by
      intro A hA hcontra
      exact hwin ⟨A, hA, hcontra⟩
    obtain ⟨f0, hf0_inj, hf0_surj, hf0_cast, hf0_nat, hf0_ne⟩ := mdfrbf_colour_inj a b ha hb c

steps.claim: The complement $\text{Fin } d \setminus W$ has cardinality $K = d - (j - 1)$, and identifying it with $\text{Fin } K$ gives an inclusion-preserving compression map $T'$.
steps.explanation: By `mdfrbf_compression_card`, the complement of $W$ has size $K = d - (j - 1)$. We identify $\text{Fin } K$ with $\text{Fin } d \setminus W$ via a bijection `e` given by `Fintype.equivOfCardEq` and `Fintype.card_fin`. Defining $T'(A)$ as the compression of $e(A)$, the lemma `mdfrbf_compress_subset_iff` together with `Finset.map_subset_map` shows that $T'$ is strictly inclusion-preserving ($T'(A) \subseteq T'(A') \iff A \subseteq A'$).

steps.claim: There is a reduced coloring $\psi'$ on subsets of $\text{Fin } K$ using $a + (b - 1)$ colors such that $\chi(T'(B)) = f_0(\psi'(B))$ for every nonempty $B$.
steps.explanation: For each nonempty $B \subseteq \text{Fin } K$, since $\chi(T'(B)) \ne a + c$, the surjectivity property of $f_0$ guarantees a unique pre-image under $f_0$. For the empty set, we assign an arbitrary fan color $a + c_0$. Using `dif_pos` and `Classical.choose_spec`, we verify that $\chi(T'(B)) = f_0(\psi'(B))$ holds for every nonempty $B$.
steps.code:
let c₀ : Fin (b - 1) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
    let ψ' : Finset (Fin K) → Fin (a + (b - 1)) := fun B =>
      if h : B.Nonempty then
        Classical.choose (hf0_surj (χ (T' B)) (hnowin (B.map e.toEmbedding) (h.map (f := e.toEmbedding))))
      else Fin.natAdd a c₀
    have hpoint : ∀ B : Finset (Fin K), B.Nonempty → χ (T' B) = f0 (ψ' B) := by
      intro B hB
      have hex : ∃ u : Fin (a + (b - 1)), f0 u = χ (T' B) :=
        hf0_surj (χ (T' B)) (hnowin (B.map e.toEmbedding) (hB.map (f := e.toEmbedding)))
      have hψ : ψ' B = Classical.choose hex := by
        simp only [ψ']
        rw [dif_pos hB]
      rw [hψ]
      exact (Classical.choose_spec hex).symm

steps.claim: The empty set is not assigned any diamond color under $\psi'$.
steps.explanation: By definition of $\psi'$, since $\emptyset$ is not nonempty (`Finset.not_nonempty_empty`), by `dif_neg` $\psi'(\emptyset)$ equals the fan color $a + c_0$. Numerical evaluation via `Fin.val_natAdd` and `Fin.val_castAdd` shows that its index is at least $a$, whereas any diamond color has index strictly less than $a$. Linear arithmetic (`omega`) confirms that $\psi'(\emptyset)$ cannot equal any diamond color.
steps.code:
have hempty : ∀ col : Fin a, ψ' ∅ ≠ Fin.castAdd (b - 1) col := by
      intro col
      simp only [ψ']
      rw [dif_neg (Finset.not_nonempty_empty)]
      intro h
      have hv : (Fin.natAdd a c₀).val = (Fin.castAdd (b - 1) col).val := by rw [h]
      simp only [Fin.val_natAdd, Fin.val_castAdd] at hv
      have := col.isLt
      omega

steps.claim: Either $\chi$ has a monochromatic diamond copy in one of the $a$ diamond colors, or $\chi$ has a monochromatic fan copy in one of the $b$ fan colors.
steps.explanation: By the induction hypothesis `ih` applied to the coloring $\psi'$ on $\text{Fin } K$, there is either a monochromatic diamond in a diamond color or a monochromatic fan in a fan color. In the diamond case, because $\psi'(\emptyset)$ is not a diamond color, `mdfrbf_diamond_transfer` pulls the diamond forward along $T'$ and $f_0$ to dimension $d$. In the fan case, `mdfrbf_fan_transfer` pulls the fan forward to dimension $d$. In both cases, this establishes the required monochromatic structure for $\chi$.
steps.code:
rcases ih ψ' with ⟨col, hcopy⟩ | ⟨col, hcopy⟩
    · left
      have htr := mdfrbf_diamond_transfer f0 T' hT' χ ψ' hpoint (Fin.castAdd (b - 1) col) (hempty col) hcopy
      rw [hf0_cast col] at htr
      exact ⟨col, htr⟩
    · right
      have htr := mdfrbf_fan_transfer hj f0 T' hT' χ ψ' hpoint (Fin.natAdd a col) hcopy
      obtain ⟨col', hcol'⟩ := hf0_nat col
      rw [hcol'] at htr
      exact ⟨col', htr⟩

glossary.Classical.choose_spec: given an existential proof $\exists x, p(x)$, the chosen witness satisfies $p$
glossary.Fin.val_castAdd: the numerical value of $\text{Fin.castAdd } m\ i$ is $i$
glossary.Fin.val_natAdd: the numerical value of $\text{Fin.natAdd } n\ i$ is $n + i$
glossary.Finset.disjoint_left: two finite sets are disjoint if and only if no element of the first belongs to the second
glossary.Finset.map_subset_map: mapping along an embedding preserves and reflects subset inclusion between finite sets
glossary.Finset.map_subset_map.mpr: if $s_1 \subseteq s_2$, then mapping both sets along an embedding preserves the subset relation
glossary.Finset.mem_map: an element $b$ is in the mapped set $\text{Finset.map } f\ s$ if and only if $b = f(a)$ for some $a \in s$
glossary.Finset.mem_sdiff: an element belongs to the set difference $s \setminus t$ if and only if it belongs to $s$ and not to $t$
glossary.Finset.not_nonempty_empty: the empty set is not nonempty
glossary.Finset.subset_union_left: any set $s_1$ is a subset of the union $s_1 \cup s_2$
glossary.Finset.subset_union_right: any set $s_2$ is a subset of the union $s_1 \cup s_2$
glossary.Fintype.card_fin: the cardinality of the finite type $\text{Fin } n$ is $n$
glossary.Fintype.equivOfCardEq: two finite types with equal cardinality are isomorphic
glossary.Function.Embedding.subtype: the canonical embedding of a subtype into its ambient type
glossary.Nat.add_mul: multiplication distributes over addition on the right: $(n + m) \times k = n \times k + m \times k$
glossary.Nat.mul_comm: multiplication of natural numbers is commutative: $n \times m = m \times n$
glossary.Nat.mul_pos: the product of two strictly positive natural numbers is strictly positive
glossary.dif_neg: dependent if-then-else evaluates to the else branch when the condition is false
glossary.dif_pos: dependent if-then-else evaluates to the then branch when the condition holds
glossary.if_neg: if a condition is false, the if-then-else expression evaluates to the else branch
glossary.if_pos: if a condition holds, the if-then-else expression evaluates to the then branch
glossary.le_rfl: the partial order relation $\le$ is reflexive: $a \le a$
glossary.mdfrbf_colour_inj: there exists an injection from $\text{Fin }(a + (b - 1))$ to $\text{Fin }(a + b)$ that avoids the fan color $c$, preserves diamond colors, and maps fan colors to fan colors
glossary.mdfrbf_compress_subset_iff: the compression map preserves and reflects subset inclusion between sets: $\text{mdfrbf\_compress } W\ \chi\ c\ A \subseteq \text{mdfrbf\_compress } W\ \chi\ c\ A' \iff A \subseteq A'$
glossary.mdfrbf_compression_card: the complement of a subset $W$ of cardinality $j - 1$ in a board of dimension $d$ has cardinality $d - (j - 1)$
glossary.mdfrbf_diamond_transfer: a monochromatic diamond copy transfers from a smaller board under an inclusion-preserving embedding, provided $\psi(\emptyset)$ is not the diamond color
glossary.mdfrbf_fan_of_c_subset: a top set of color $c$ containing a set $W$ of $j - 1$ singletons of color $c$ and a disjoint nonempty set $B$ of color $c$ contains a monochromatic fan of size $j$ in color $c$
glossary.mdfrbf_fan_transfer: a monochromatic fan copy transfers from a smaller board under an inclusion-preserving embedding
glossary.mdfrbf_fibre_subset: if $b \times n < d$, any function $f : \text{Fin } d \to \text{Fin } b$ has a fiber containing a subset of size $n + 1$ on which $f$ is constant
glossary.one_mul: one is the left identity for multiplication: $1 \times a = a$

caveats: The tactic `omega` discharges linear integer arithmetic goals automatically (such as verifying $b(j - 2) < d$ and that $\psi'(\emptyset)$ cannot equal any diamond color).
The proof freely relies on classical choice (`Classical.choose`) to noncomputably define the color choice function $f$ and pre-images under the injection $f_0$.

The board compression `mdfrbf_compress` is a formal construction that adds $W$ to a set $A$ if and only if $A$ contains a monochromatic subset of color $c$, ensuring that in the second case color $c$ never appears on nonempty sets.
