    (L : (Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin u) (Fin v) ℂ) (r : ℕ)
    (T : Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ x y z : Fin n → ℂ, r * (L (tensor3_pure x y z)).rank < (L T).rank)
    (x y z : Fin r → Fin n → ℂ) :
    T ≠ ∑ i, tensor3_pure (x i) (y i) (z i) := by
  intro hsum
  classical
  have hL : L T = ∑ i : Fin r, L (tensor3_pure (x i) (y i) (z i)) := by
    rw [hsum, map_sum]
  have hrank : (L T).rank ≤ ∑ i : Fin r, (L (tensor3_pure (x i) (y i) (z i))).rank := by
    rw [hL]
    exact not_sum_pure_of_linear_flattening_potency_gt_rank_sum_le Finset.univ _
  have hlt : ∀ i : Fin r, r * (L (tensor3_pure (x i) (y i) (z i))).rank < (L T).rank :=
    fun i => hT (x i) (y i) (z i)
  by_cases hr : r = 0
  · subst hr
    have hb : (L T).rank ≤ 0 := by simpa using hrank
    have hpos : 0 < (L T).rank := by
      have := hT (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0)
      simpa using this
    omega
  · have hrpos : 0 < r := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr
    have hmul :
        r * (∑ i : Fin r, (L (tensor3_pure (x i) (y i) (z i))).rank)
          ≤ r * ((L T).rank - 1) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      calc ∑ i : Fin r, r * (L (tensor3_pure (x i) (y i) (z i))).rank
          ≤ ∑ _i : Fin r, ((L T).rank - 1) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (hlt i))
        _ = r * ((L T).rank - 1) := by simp [Finset.sum_const]
    have hle : (∑ i : Fin r, (L (tensor3_pure (x i) (y i) (z i))).rank)
        ≤ (L T).rank - 1 :=
      Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmul hrpos
    have hbpos : 0 < (L T).rank := by
      have h0 := hlt ⟨0, hrpos⟩
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) h0
    omega
declarations.reading:
For any natural numbers $n, u, v$, let $L$ be a $\mathbb{C}$-linear map from order-3 tensors of shape $n \times n \times n$ over $\mathbb{C}$ (functions `Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ`) to $u \times v$ complex matrices (`Matrix (Fin u) (Fin v) ℂ`). Let $r \in \mathbb{N}$, and let $T$ be an order-3 tensor (`Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ`). 

Assume that for all vectors $x', y', z' : \text{Fin } n \to \mathbb{C}$,
$$r \cdot \operatorname{rank}(L(\operatorname{tensor3\_pure}(x', y', z'))) < \operatorname{rank}(L(T))$$
(where $\operatorname{rank}$ is the matrix rank in $\mathbb{N}$).

Then for any three collections of $r$ vectors $x, y, z : \text{Fin } r \to \text{Fin } n \to \mathbb{C}$, $T$ cannot be written as the sum of the corresponding $r$ pure tensors:
$$T \neq \sum_{i : \text{Fin } r} \operatorname{tensor3\_pure}(x(i), y(i), z(i)).$$

declarations.name: linear_flattening_potency_gt_antitone
declarations.informal: If a linear flattening L on (ℂⁿ)⊗³ has potency strictly greater than r, then for any r' ≤ r it also has potency strictly greater than r'.
declarations.statement:
theorem linear_flattening_potency_gt_antitone {n u v : ℕ}
    (L : (Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin u) (Fin v) ℂ)
    {r r' : ℕ} (hr : r' ≤ r) (h : linear_flattening_potency_gt L r) :
    linear_flattening_potency_gt L r'
declarations.source:
/-- If a linear flattening has potency greater than r, it also has potency greater than any r' ≤ r. -/
theorem linear_flattening_potency_gt_antitone {n u v : ℕ}
    (L : (Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin u) (Fin v) ℂ)
    {r r' : ℕ} (hr : r' ≤ r) (h : linear_flattening_potency_gt L r) :
    linear_flattening_potency_gt L r' := by
  rcases h with ⟨T, hT⟩
  refine ⟨T, fun x y z => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hT x y z
  have h2 : r' * (L (tensor3_pure x y z)).rank ≤ r * (L (tensor3_pure x y z)).rank :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hr
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt h2 h1
declarations.reading: For any natural numbers $n, u, v$, any $\mathbb{C}$-linear map $L$ from 3-tensors $(\mathrm{Fin}\ n \to \mathrm{Fin}\ n \to \mathrm{Fin}\ n \to \mathbb{C})$ to matrices $\mathrm{Matrix}\ (\mathrm{Fin}\ u)\ (\mathrm{Fin}\ v)\ \mathbb{C}$, and any natural numbers $r, r'$: if $r' \le r$ and `linear_flattening_potency_gt L r` holds, then `linear_flattening_potency_gt L r'` holds.

declarations.name: spider_blocked_optionvals_lt_mem
declarations.informal: For r ≥ 2 and β inward or outward, every k below spider_blocked_val β r occurs in the explicit options list of (in;{(r,β),(1,free)}).
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_optionvals_lt_mem (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (beta : SpiderLegEnd)
    (hβ : beta = SpiderLegEnd.inward ∨ beta = SpiderLegEnd.outward) :
    ∀ k < spider_blocked_val beta r, k ∈ spider_blocked_optionvals r beta
declarations.source:
/-- Gluing lemma: coverage of every k below the closed-form value, from the initial segment plus the two top values. -/
theorem spider_blocked_optionvals_lt_mem (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (beta : SpiderLegEnd)
    (hβ : beta = SpiderLegEnd.inward ∨ beta = SpiderLegEnd.outward) :
    ∀ k < spider_blocked_val beta r, k ∈ spider_blocked_optionvals r beta := by
  intro k hk
  rcases hβ with rfl | rfl
  · by_cases h : r % 4 = 3
    · simp only [spider_blocked_val, h, if_true] at hk
      exact spider_blocked_optionvals_low_mem r k hr _ (Or.inl rfl) (by omega)
    · simp only [spider_blocked_val, h, if_false] at hk
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k r with hklt | hkge
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (r - 1) with h1 | h1
        · exact spider_blocked_optionvals_low_mem r k hr _ (Or.inl rfl) (by omega)
        · have hk_eq : k = r - 1 := by omega
          rw [hk_eq]
          exact (spider_blocked_optionvals_top_mem r (by omega) _ (Or.inl rfl)).2.1 rfl h
      · have hk_eq : k = r := by omega
        rw [hk_eq]
        exact (spider_blocked_optionvals_top_mem r (by omega) _ (Or.inl rfl)).1
  · by_cases h : r % 4 = 1
    · simp only [spider_blocked_val, h, if_true] at hk
      exact spider_blocked_optionvals_low_mem r k hr _ (Or.inr rfl) (by omega)
    · simp only [spider_blocked_val, h, if_false] at hk
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k r with hklt | hkge
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (r - 1) with h1 | h1
        · exact spider_blocked_optionvals_low_mem r k hr _ (Or.inr rfl) (by omega)
        · have hk_eq : k = r - 1 := by omega
          rw [hk_eq]
          exact (spider_blocked_optionvals_top_mem r (by omega) _ (Or.inr rfl)).2.2 rfl h
      · have hk_eq : k = r := by omega
        rw [hk_eq]
        exact (spider_blocked_optionvals_top_mem r (by omega) _ (Or.inr rfl)).1

declarations.name: spider_two_leg_blocked_incoming_base
declarations.informal: The closed form holds at r = 0 and r = 1: spider_gamma 2 incoming [(0,inward),(1,free)] = 1, spider_gamma 2 incoming [(0,outward),(1,free)] = 1, spider_gamma 3 incoming [(1,inward),(1,free)] = 2 and spider_gamma 3 incoming [(1,outward),(1,free)] = 0, matching spider_blocked_val in each case.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_two_leg_blocked_incoming_base :
    spider_gamma 2 CentreStatus.incoming [(0, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)]
        = spider_blocked_val SpiderLegEnd.inward 0 ∧
    spider_gamma 2 CentreStatus.incoming [(0, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)]
        = spider_blocked_val SpiderLegEnd.outward 0 ∧
    spider_gamma 3 CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)]
        = spider_blocked_val SpiderLegEnd.inward 1 ∧
    spider_gamma 3 CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)]
        = spider_blocked_val SpiderLegEnd.outward 1
declarations.source:
/-- Base cases r = 0 and r = 1 of the blocked two-leg closed form, for both end conditions. -/
theorem spider_two_leg_blocked_incoming_base :
    spider_gamma 2 CentreStatus.incoming [(0, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)]
        = spider_blocked_val SpiderLegEnd.inward 0 ∧
    spider_gamma 2 CentreStatus.incoming [(0, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)]
        = spider_blocked_val SpiderLegEnd.outward 0 ∧
    spider_gamma 3 CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)]
        = spider_blocked_val SpiderLegEnd.inward 1 ∧
    spider_gamma 3 CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)]
        = spider_blocked_val SpiderLegEnd.outward 1 :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

declarations.name: linear_flattening_testable_antitone
declarations.informal: If the secant variety σ_r((ℂⁿ)⊗³) is testable by the linear flattening method, then so is σ_{r'}((ℂⁿ)⊗³) for every r' ≤ r.
declarations.statement:
theorem linear_flattening_testable_antitone {n : ℕ} {r r' : ℕ} (hr : r' ≤ r)
    (h : linear_flattening_testable n r) : linear_flattening_testable n r'
declarations.source:
/-- If order r is testable by linear flattenings on (ℂⁿ)⊗³, then every order r' ≤ r is testable. -/
theorem linear_flattening_testable_antitone {n : ℕ} {r r' : ℕ} (hr : r' ≤ r)
    (h : linear_flattening_testable n r) : linear_flattening_testable n r' := by
  obtain ⟨u, v, L, hL⟩ := h
  exact ⟨u, v, L, linear_flattening_potency_gt_antitone L hr hL⟩
declarations.reading: For any natural numbers $n, r, r'$, if $r' \le r$ and `linear_flattening_testable n r` holds, then `linear_flattening_testable n r'` holds. That is, the property `linear_flattening_testable n r` is antitone (monotonically decreasing) with respect to $r$.

declarations.name: linear_flattening_testable_tensor_rank_gt
declarations.informal: If the secant variety σ_r((ℂⁿ)⊗³) is testable by the linear flattening method, then there exists a tensor in (ℂⁿ)⊗³ that cannot be written as a sum of r pure tensors.
declarations.statement:
theorem linear_flattening_testable_tensor_rank_gt {n r : ℕ}
    (h : linear_flattening_testable n r) :
    ∃ T : Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ,
      ∀ x y z : Fin r → Fin n → ℂ, T ≠ ∑ i, tensor3_pure (x i) (y i) (z i)
declarations.source:
/-- If order r is testable by linear flattenings, there exists a tensor in (ℂⁿ)⊗³ with tensor rank strictly greater than r. -/
theorem linear_flattening_testable_tensor_rank_gt {n r : ℕ}
    (h : linear_flattening_testable n r) :
    ∃ T : Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ,
      ∀ x y z : Fin r → Fin n → ℂ, T ≠ ∑ i, tensor3_pure (x i) (y i) (z i) := by
  rcases h with ⟨u, v, L, T, hT⟩
  exact ⟨T, not_sum_pure_of_linear_flattening_potency_gt L r T hT⟩
declarations.reading: Given natural numbers $n$ and $r$ (implicit), if there exist natural numbers $u$ and $v$ and a $\mathbb{C}$-linear map $L$ from the space of 3-tensors $(\operatorname{Fin} n \to \operatorname{Fin} n \to \operatorname{Fin} n \to \mathbb{C})$ to $u \times v$ complex matrices such that there exists a tensor $T_0$ satisfying $r \cdot \operatorname{rank}(L(x \otimes y \otimes z)) < \operatorname{rank}(L(T_0))$ for all vectors $x, y, z : \operatorname{Fin} n \to \mathbb{C}$, then there exists a 3-tensor $T : \operatorname{Fin} n \to \operatorname{Fin} n \to \operatorname{Fin} n \to \mathbb{C}$ such that for all families of $r$ vectors $x, y, z : \operatorname{Fin} r \to \operatorname{Fin} n \to \mathbb{C}$, $T$ is not equal to $\sum_{i \in \operatorname{Fin} r} (x(i) \otimes y(i) \otimes z(i))$ (i.e., $T$ cannot be decomposed into a sum of $r$ pure rank-1 tensors).

declarations.name: linear_flattening_testable_of_rank_le
declarations.informal: If a linear flattening L on (ℂⁿ)⊗³ satisfies rank L(x ⊗ y ⊗ z) ≤ ρ for all x, y, z and rank L(T) > r * ρ for some tensor T, then the secant variety σ_r((ℂⁿ)⊗³) is testable by the linear flattening method.
declarations.statement:
theorem linear_flattening_testable_of_rank_le (n u v : ℕ)
    (L : (Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin u) (Fin v) ℂ) (r ρ : ℕ)
    (hρ : ∀ x y z : Fin n → ℂ, (L (tensor3_pure x y z)).rank ≤ ρ)
    (T : Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ)
    (hT : r * ρ < (L T).rank) :
    linear_flattening_testable n r
declarations.source:
/-- A sufficient condition for secant variety testability by linear flattenings: if rank L(x ⊗ y ⊗ z) ≤ ρ for all pure tensors and rank L(T) > r * ρ for some tensor T, then σ_r is testable. -/
theorem linear_flattening_testable_of_rank_le (n u v : ℕ)
    (L : (Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] Matrix (Fin u) (Fin v) ℂ) (r ρ : ℕ)
    (hρ : ∀ x y z : Fin n → ℂ, (L (tensor3_pure x y z)).rank ≤ ρ)
    (T : Fin n → Fin n → Fin n → ℂ)
    (hT : r * ρ < (L T).rank) :
    linear_flattening_testable n r := ⟨u, v, L, T, fun x y z => lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mul_le_mul_left r (hρ x y z)) hT⟩

declarations.name: WeightedSetPackingInstance
declarations.informal: For a type α with decidable equality and k : ℕ, an instance of Maximum Weighted k-Set Packing WeightedSetPackingInstance α k consists of a finite set family : Finset (Finset α) of nonempty finite subsets of α of cardinality at most k, and a weight function weight : Finset α → ℚ assigning strictly positive rational weight to every set in family.
declarations.statement: structure WeightedSetPackingInstance (α : Type*) [DecidableEq α] (k : ℕ)
declarations.source:
/-- An instance of Maximum Weighted k-Set Packing over a universe α. -/
structure WeightedSetPackingInstance (α : Type*) [DecidableEq α] (k : ℕ) where
  family : Finset (Finset α)
  card_le : ∀ s ∈ family, s.card ≤ k
  nonempty : ∀ s ∈ family, s.Nonempty
  weight : Finset α → ℚ
  weight_pos : ∀ s ∈ family, 0 < weight s
declarations.reading:
A structure `WeightedSetPackingInstance` parameterized by a type `α` with decidable equality and a natural number `k`, containing:
1. `family`: a finite set of finite subsets of `α` (`Finset (Finset α)`).
2. `card_le`: a proof that for every set `s ∈ family`, the cardinality of `s` is at most `k` (`Finset.card s ≤ k`).
3. `nonempty`: a proof that for every set `s ∈ family`, `s` is nonempty (`Finset.Nonempty s`, i.e. `∃ x, x ∈ s`).
4. `weight`: a function assigning a rational number to each finite subset of `α` (`Finset α → ℚ`).
5. `weight_pos`: a proof that for every set `s ∈ family`, its weight is strictly positive (`0 < weight s`).

declarations.name: linear_flattening_even_potency_induction
declarations.informal: If the secant variety σ_6((ℂ⁴)⊗³) is testable by linear flattenings, and if for all even k ≥ 4 testability of σ_{2k-2}((ℂᵏ)⊗³) implies testability of σ_{2(k+2)-2}((ℂ^{k+2})⊗³), then σ_{2n-2}((ℂⁿ)⊗³) is testable for all even n ≥ 4.
declarations.statement:
theorem linear_flattening_even_potency_induction
    (h4 : linear_flattening_testable 4 6)
    (hstep : ∀ k, 4 ≤ k → Even k → linear_flattening_testable k (2 * k - 2) → linear_flattening_testable (k + 2) (2 * (k + 2) - 2)) :
    ∀ n, 4 ≤ n → Even n → linear_flattening_testable n (2 * n - 2)
declarations.source:
/-- Induction principle for even numbers n ≥ 4 tailored to linear flattening testability: testability at 4 6 and the step from k to k+2 imply testability for all even n ≥ 4. -/
theorem linear_flattening_even_potency_induction
    (h4 : linear_flattening_testable 4 6)
    (hstep : ∀ k, 4 ≤ k → Even k → linear_flattening_testable k (2 * k - 2) → linear_flattening_testable (k + 2) (2 * (k + 2) - 2)) :
    ∀ n, 4 ≤ n → Even n → linear_flattening_testable n (2 * n - 2) := by
  have H : ∀ d : ℕ, linear_flattening_testable (4 + 2 * d) (2 * (4 + 2 * d) - 2) := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
      exact h4
    | succ d ih =>
      have hstep_app := hstep (4 + 2 * d) (by omega) ⟨2 + d, by omega⟩ ih
      exact hstep_app
  intro n hn heven
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := heven
  have : n = 4 + 2 * (r - 2) := by omega
  rw [this]
  exact H (r - 2)

declarations.name: is_packing
declarations.informal: Given an instance inst of weighted k-set packing on a type α with decidable equality, a sub-collection A : Finset (Finset α) is a packing (is_packing inst A) if A ⊆ inst.family and the sets in A are pairwise disjoint.
declarations.statement: def is_packing {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A : Finset (Finset α)) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A packing is a subfamily of pairwise disjoint sets from the instance family. -/
def is_packing {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A : Finset (Finset α)) : Prop := A ⊆ inst.family ∧ (A : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id
declarations.reading:
For a type `α` with decidable equality, an implicit natural number `k`, a weighted set packing instance `inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k`, and a finite collection of finite sets `A : Finset (Finset α)`, `is_packing inst A` asserts that:
1. `A` is a subset of `inst.family`, and
2. the sets in `A` are pairwise disjoint (viewed as a set of finsets under the identity function).

declarations.name: spider_gamma_rotate_three_short_legs
declarations.informal: For any leg p, centre status and fuel, the value of (s;{p,1^in,1^out}) equals the value of (s;{1^in,1^out,p}): the leg p may be moved from the front to the back of the list.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_gamma_rotate_three_short_legs (fuel : ℕ) (s : CentreStatus) (p : ℕ × SpiderLegEnd) :
    spider_gamma fuel s [p, (1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] =
      spider_gamma fuel s [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), p]
declarations.source:
/-- Moving the front leg of {p,1^in,1^out} to the back leaves the value unchanged. -/
theorem spider_gamma_rotate_three_short_legs (fuel : ℕ) (s : CentreStatus) (p : ℕ × SpiderLegEnd) :
    spider_gamma fuel s [p, (1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] =
      spider_gamma fuel s [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), p] := by
  cases fuel with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ f =>
    cases s with
    | free =>
      dsimp [spider_gamma]
      rw [Nat.zero_xor, Nat.zero_xor]
      ac_rfl
    | none | incoming | outgoing =>
      dsimp [spider_gamma]
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil,
                 List.range_one, List.filterMap_cons, List.filterMap_nil,
                 List.eraseIdx_cons_zero, List.eraseIdx_cons_succ]
      rw [nat_mex_list_append_comm, List.append_assoc]
      congr 1
      congr 1
      · simp [spider_gamma_swap_two]
      · congr 1
        · simp [spider_gamma_swap_two]

declarations.name: packing_weight
declarations.informal: Given an instance inst of weighted k-set packing on a type α with decidable equality, the linear weight packing_weight inst A of a sub-collection A : Finset (Finset α) is the sum of inst.weight s over all s ∈ A.
declarations.statement: def packing_weight {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A : Finset (Finset α)) : ℚ
declarations.source:
/-- Linear weight of a subfamily of sets. -/
def packing_weight {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A : Finset (Finset α)) : ℚ := ∑ s ∈ A, inst.weight s
declarations.reading: Given a type `α` with decidable equality, an implicit natural number `k`, a weighted set packing instance `inst` on `α` with parameter `k`, and a finite set `A` of finite subsets of `α`, `packing_weight inst A` is defined as the rational sum of `inst.weight s` over all sets `s ∈ A`.

declarations.name: spider_two_leg_short_short_zero
declarations.informal: At any fuel at least 3, the two-leg state with centre incoming and legs (1,inward),(1,outward) has value 0, and likewise with centre outgoing.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_two_leg_short_short_zero (fuel : ℕ) (hfuel : 3 ≤ fuel) :
    spider_gamma fuel CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] = 0 ∧
      spider_gamma fuel CentreStatus.outgoing [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] = 0
declarations.source:
/-- The two-short-leg sub-state reached by a j = 1 cut of the long leg has value 0 at either centre status. -/
theorem spider_two_leg_short_short_zero (fuel : ℕ) (hfuel : 3 ≤ fuel) :
    spider_gamma fuel CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] = 0 ∧
      spider_gamma fuel CentreStatus.outgoing [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] = 0 := by
  have h : ((List.map Prod.fst [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)]).sum + 1) ≤ fuel := by
    simpa using hfuel
  constructor
  · rw [spider_gamma_fuel_independent fuel _ _ h]
    decide
  · rw [spider_gamma_fuel_independent fuel _ _ h]
    decide

declarations.name: squared_weight
declarations.informal: Given an instance inst of weighted k-set packing on a type α with decidable equality, the squared-weight potential squared_weight inst A of a sub-collection A : Finset (Finset α) is the sum of (inst.weight s)^2 over all s ∈ A.
declarations.statement: def squared_weight {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A : Finset (Finset α)) : ℚ
declarations.source:
/-- Squared-weight potential of a subfamily of sets. -/
def squared_weight {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A : Finset (Finset α)) : ℚ := ∑ s ∈ A, (inst.weight s) ^ 2
declarations.reading: Given a type `α` with decidable equality, an implicit natural number `k`, an instance `inst` of `WeightedSetPackingInstance α k`, and a finite collection of finite subsets of `α` named `A`, `squared_weight inst A` is defined as the rational number obtained by summing `(inst.weight s) ^ 2` over all `s ∈ A`.

declarations.name: spider_blocked_outgoing_one_inward
declarations.informal: For the mirror configuration (out;{(1,inward)}), the blocked family at level r equals r xor 1 for every r ≥ 1 and both far ends φ.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_outgoing_one_inward (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.outgoing [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (r, φ)] = r ^^^ 1
declarations.source:
/-- The reversal of the κ₂ blocked family (out;{(1,inward)}) equals r xor 1. -/
theorem spider_blocked_outgoing_one_inward (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.outgoing [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (r, φ)] = r ^^^ 1 := by
  rw [spider_gamma_reversal]
  simp only [spider_reverse_centre_status, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
  exact spider_blocked_incoming_one_outward r hr (spider_reverse_leg_end φ) (by cases φ <;> simp_all [spider_reverse_leg_end])

declarations.name: conflict_neighborhood
declarations.informal: Given a type α with decidable equality and two finite collections of finite subsets of α, A and X (both of type Finset (Finset α)), conflict_neighborhood A X is the sub-collection of sets a ∈ A that are not disjoint from some set x ∈ X.
declarations.statement: def conflict_neighborhood {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (A X : Finset (Finset α)) : Finset (Finset α)
declarations.source:
/-- The conflict neighborhood of a family X in A: sets in A intersecting some set in X. -/
def conflict_neighborhood {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (A X : Finset (Finset α)) : Finset (Finset α) := A.filter (fun a => ∃ x ∈ X, ¬ Disjoint a x)
declarations.reading: Given a type `α` with decidable equality and two finite sets of finite subsets of `α`, `A` and `X`, `conflict_neighborhood A X` is defined as the sub-finset of `A` consisting of all `a ∈ A` for which there exists some `x ∈ X` such that `a` and `x` are not disjoint (i.e., `¬ Disjoint a x`).

declarations.name: spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_base
declarations.informal: The base case r = 1 of the κ₁ blocked family: for both far ends φ ≠ free, (none;{1^in,1^out,(1,φ)}) at canonical fuel 4 has value 1.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_base (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    spider_gamma 4 CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (1, φ)] = 1
declarations.source:
/-- Base case r = 1 of the κ₁ blocked family. -/
theorem spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_base (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    spider_gamma 4 CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (1, φ)] = 1 := by
  cases φ
  · contradiction
  · rfl
  · rfl

declarations.name: is_square_locally_optimal
declarations.informal: Given an instance inst of weighted k-set packing on a type α with decidable equality, a packing A is square locally optimal with respect to size m exchanges (is_square_locally_optimal inst m A) if A is a packing and for every packing X in inst of cardinality at most m, the squared-weight potential of X is at most the squared-weight potential of the conflict neighborhood of X in A.
declarations.statement: def is_square_locally_optimal {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (m : ℕ) (A : Finset (Finset α)) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A packing is square-locally optimal if no exchange of size up to m increases squared weight. -/
def is_square_locally_optimal {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (m : ℕ) (A : Finset (Finset α)) : Prop := is_packing inst A ∧ ∀ X, is_packing inst X → X.card ≤ m → squared_weight inst X ≤ squared_weight inst (conflict_neighborhood A X)
declarations.reading:
Given a type `α` with decidable equality, a natural number `k`, an instance `inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k`, a natural number `m`, and a finite set of sets `A : Finset (Finset α)`, `is_square_locally_optimal inst m A` asserts that:
1. `A` is a valid packing for `inst` (`is_packing inst A`); and
2. For every finite set of sets `X : Finset (Finset α)`, if `X` is a valid packing for `inst` (`is_packing inst X`) and the cardinality of `X` is at most `m` (`X.card ≤ m`), then the sum of squared weights of the sets in `X` is less than or equal to the sum of squared weights of the sets in the conflict neighborhood of `X` within `A` (`squared_weight inst X ≤ squared_weight inst (conflict_neighborhood A X)`).

declarations.name: linear_gain
declarations.informal: Given an instance inst of weighted k-set packing on a type α with decidable equality, the linear gain linear_gain inst A X of an exchange X with respect to A is packing_weight inst X minus packing_weight inst (conflict_neighborhood A X).
declarations.statement: def linear_gain {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A X : Finset (Finset α)) : ℚ
declarations.source:
/-- Linear gain of replacing the conflict neighborhood of X in A by X. -/
def linear_gain {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A X : Finset (Finset α)) : ℚ := packing_weight inst X - packing_weight inst (conflict_neighborhood A X)
declarations.reading: Given a type `α` with decidable equality, a natural number `k`, a weighted set packing instance `inst` (of type `WeightedSetPackingInstance α k`), and two finite sets of finite sets `A` and `X` (of type `Finset (Finset α)`), `linear_gain inst A X` is the rational number given by the packing weight of `X` minus the packing weight of the conflict neighborhood of `X` in `A` (i.e., `packing_weight inst X - packing_weight inst (conflict_neighborhood A X)`).

declarations.name: spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem
declarations.informal: For r ≥ 2 and φ ≠ free, the level r is not a member of the closed-form option list of the κ₁ family.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    r ∉ spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts r φ
declarations.source:
/-- Xor with 1 changes the lowest bit, so it never fixes a number. -/
lemma spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_xor_one_ne (a : ℕ) : a ^^^ 1 ≠ a := by
  intro h
  have h2 := congrArg (fun n => n.testBit 0) h
  simp only [Nat.testBit_xor] at h2
  simp at h2

/-- For a nonzero leg height and a non-free end, every `spider_rho` value for the two
directions is `0` or `1`. -/
lemma spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_rho_le_one (h : ℕ) (hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) (d : SpiderLegEnd)
    (hd : d = SpiderLegEnd.inward ∨ d = SpiderLegEnd.outward) : spider_rho h d φ ≤ 1 := by
  rcases spider_rho_pair_values h hh φ hφ with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · rcases hd with rfl | rfl <;> omega
  · rcases hd with rfl | rfl <;> omega

/-- Xoring a number at most `1` with `n` increases it by at most one. -/
lemma spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_xor_le_succ (x n : ℕ) (hx : x ≤ 1) :
    x ^^^ n ≤ n + 1 := by
  interval_cases x
  · simp
  · rw [Nat.xor_comm]
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with h | h
    · rw [Nat.xor_one_of_even h]
    · rw [Nat.xor_one_of_odd h]; omega

/-- The value r itself is absent from the closed-form option list. -/
theorem spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    r ∉ spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts r φ := by
  rw [spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts]
  simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range,
    List.not_mem_nil, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
  rintro (h | h | h | h | ⟨a, ha, h | h | h⟩ | h | h)
  · exact spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_xor_one_ne r h.symm
  · exact spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_xor_one_ne r h.symm
  · have := spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_rho_le_one (r - 1) (by omega) φ hφ
      SpiderLegEnd.inward (Or.inl rfl)
    omega
  · have := spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_rho_le_one (r - 1) (by omega) φ hφ
      SpiderLegEnd.outward (Or.inr rfl)
    omega
  · have hb := spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_rho_le_one (r - 2 - a) (by omega) φ hφ
      SpiderLegEnd.inward (Or.inl rfl)
    have := spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_xor_le_succ
      (spider_rho (r - 2 - a) SpiderLegEnd.inward φ) (a + 1) hb
    omega
  · have hb := spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_rho_le_one (r - 2 - a) (by omega) φ hφ
      SpiderLegEnd.outward (Or.inr rfl)
    have := spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem_xor_le_succ
      (spider_rho (r - 2 - a) SpiderLegEnd.outward φ) (a + 1) hb
    omega
  · exact h.elim
  · omega
  · exact h

declarations.name: is_repair
declarations.informal: Given an instance inst of weighted k-set packing on a type α with decidable equality, a sub-collection X : Finset (Finset α) is a repair for A (is_repair inst A X) if X is a packing in inst of cardinality at most k with strictly positive linear gain linear_gain inst A X > 0.
declarations.statement: def is_repair {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A X : Finset (Finset α)) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A repair is an independent set of size at most k with positive linear gain. -/
def is_repair {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A X : Finset (Finset α)) : Prop := is_packing inst X ∧ X.card ≤ k ∧ 0 < linear_gain inst A X
declarations.reading:
For a type `α` with decidable equality, a natural number `k`, an instance `inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k`, and two finite families of finite sets `A, X : Finset (Finset α)`, `is_repair inst A X` asserts that:
1. `X` is a packing for `inst` (that is, `is_packing inst X`),
2. the cardinality of `X` is at most `k` (`X.card ≤ k`), and
3. the linear gain of `X` relative to `A` in `inst` is strictly positive (`0 < linear_gain inst A X`).

declarations.name: spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_all_lt_mem
declarations.informal: For r ≥ 2 and φ ≠ free, every k < r is a member of the closed-form option list of the κ₁ family.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_all_lt_mem (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    ∀ k < r, k ∈ spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts r φ
declarations.source:
/-- Every natural number below r occurs in the closed-form option list. -/
theorem spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_all_lt_mem (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    ∀ k < r, k ∈ spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts r φ := by
  intro k hk
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r - 1 := by omega
  rcases spider_rho_pair_values (r - 1) hr1 φ hφ with ⟨h0, h1⟩ | ⟨h1, h0⟩ <;>
    rw [spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts] <;>
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range,
      List.not_mem_nil, or_false, h0, h1]
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 2 with hlt2 | hge2
    · interval_cases k <;> simp
    · by_cases hkr : k = r - 1
      · exact Or.inr hkr
      · have hle : k ≤ r - 2 := by omega
        rcases spider_rho_pair_values (r - 1 - k) (by omega) φ hφ with ⟨g0, g1⟩ | ⟨g1, g0⟩
        · refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨k - 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩)
          have harg : r - 2 - (k - 1) = r - 1 - k := by omega
          rw [harg, g0, Nat.zero_xor]; omega
        · refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨k - 1, by omega, Or.inr ?_⟩)
          have harg : r - 2 - (k - 1) = r - 1 - k := by omega
          rw [harg, g0, Nat.zero_xor]; omega
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 2 with hlt2 | hge2
    · interval_cases k <;> simp
    · by_cases hkr : k = r - 1
      · exact Or.inr hkr
      · have hle : k ≤ r - 2 := by omega
        rcases spider_rho_pair_values (r - 1 - k) (by omega) φ hφ with ⟨g0, g1⟩ | ⟨g1, g0⟩
        · refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨k - 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩)
          have harg : r - 2 - (k - 1) = r - 1 - k := by omega
          rw [harg, g0, Nat.zero_xor]; omega
        · refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨k - 1, by omega, Or.inr ?_⟩)
          have harg : r - 2 - (k - 1) = r - 1 - k := by omega
          rw [harg, g0, Nat.zero_xor]; omega

declarations.name: spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq
declarations.informal: For r ≥ 2 and φ ≠ free, the value of (none;{(1,inward),(1,outward),(r,φ)}) at fuel r+3 is the mex of the raw option list spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts r φ.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    spider_gamma (r + 3) CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)] =
      nat_mex_list (spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts r φ)
declarations.source:
lemma spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_range_succ_two (n : ℕ) :
    List.range (n + 2) = 0 :: (List.map (· + 1) (List.range n) ++ [n + 1]) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [show k + 1 + 2 = (k + 2) + 1 by ring, List.range_succ, ih]
    rw [show k + 1 + 1 = k + 2 by ring]
    rw [List.range_succ (n := k), List.map_append]
    simp [List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]

lemma spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_range_split (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    List.range r = 0 :: (List.map (· + 1) (List.range (r - 2)) ++ [r - 1]) := by
  conv => lhs; rw [show r = (r - 2) + 2 by omega]
  rw [spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_range_succ_two]
  rw [show r - 2 + 1 = r - 1 by omega]

lemma spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_opt_leg0 (r : ℕ) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) :
    (List.filterMap
        (fun delta =>
          if (0 + 1 == 1) = true ∧ SpiderLegEnd.inward ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free ∧ delta ≠ SpiderLegEnd.inward then none
          else
            if 0 + 1 ≥ 2 then
              some
                (spider_rho (1 - (0 + 1)) delta SpiderLegEnd.inward ^^^
                  spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
                    ((0 + 1 - 1, delta) :: [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx 0))
            else
              some
                (spider_rho (1 - (0 + 1)) delta SpiderLegEnd.inward ^^^
                  spider_gamma (r + 2) (spider_update_centre CentreStatus.none delta)
                    ([(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx 0)))
        [SpiderLegEnd.inward, SpiderLegEnd.outward]) =
    [spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)]] := by
  simp [spider_rho, spider_update_centre]

lemma spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_opt_leg1 (r : ℕ) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) :
    (List.filterMap
        (fun delta =>
          if (0 + 1 == 1) = true ∧ SpiderLegEnd.outward ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free ∧ delta ≠ SpiderLegEnd.outward then none
          else
            if 0 + 1 ≥ 2 then
              some
                (spider_rho (1 - (0 + 1)) delta SpiderLegEnd.outward ^^^
                  spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
                    ((0 + 1 - 1, delta) :: [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx 1))
            else
              some
                (spider_rho (1 - (0 + 1)) delta SpiderLegEnd.outward ^^^
                  spider_gamma (r + 2) (spider_update_centre CentreStatus.none delta)
                    ([(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx 1)))
        [SpiderLegEnd.inward, SpiderLegEnd.outward]) =
    [spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.outgoing [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (r, φ)]] := by
  simp [spider_rho, spider_update_centre]

lemma spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_opt_leg2_zero (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) :
    (List.filterMap
        (fun delta =>
          if (0 + 1 == r) = true ∧ φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free ∧ delta ≠ φ then none
          else
            if 0 + 1 ≥ 2 then
              some
                (spider_rho (r - (0 + 1)) delta φ ^^^
                  spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
                    ((0 + 1 - 1, delta) ::
                      [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx 2))
            else
              some
                (spider_rho (r - (0 + 1)) delta φ ^^^
                  spider_gamma (r + 2) (spider_update_centre CentreStatus.none delta)
                    ([(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx 2)))
        [SpiderLegEnd.inward, SpiderLegEnd.outward]) =
    [spider_rho (r - 1) SpiderLegEnd.inward φ ^^^
        spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)],
      spider_rho (r - 1) SpiderLegEnd.outward φ ^^^
        spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.outgoing [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)]] := by
  have : (0 + 1 == r) = false := beq_false_of_ne (by omega)
  simp [this, spider_update_centre]

lemma spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_opt_leg2_mid (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd)
    (a : ℕ) (ha : a ∈ List.range (r - 2)) :
    (List.filterMap
        (fun delta =>
          if (a + 1 + 1 == r) = true ∧ φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free ∧ delta ≠ φ then none
          else
            if a + 1 + 1 ≥ 2 then
              some
                (spider_rho (r - (a + 1 + 1)) delta φ ^^^
                  spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
                    ((a + 1 + 1 - 1, delta) ::
                      [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx 2))
            else
              some
                (spider_rho (r - (a + 1 + 1)) delta φ ^^^
                  spider_gamma (r + 2) (spider_update_centre CentreStatus.none delta)
                    ([(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx 2)))
        [SpiderLegEnd.inward, SpiderLegEnd.outward]) =
    [spider_rho (r - 2 - a) SpiderLegEnd.inward φ ^^^
        spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
          [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (a + 1, SpiderLegEnd.inward)],
      spider_rho (r - 2 - a) SpiderLegEnd.outward φ ^^^
        spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
          [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (a + 1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)]] := by
  have hlt : a < r - 2 := List.mem_range.mp ha
  have hne : (a + 1 + 1 == r) = false := beq_false_of_ne (by omega)
  have hge : 2 ≤ a + 1 + 1 := by omega
  have harith1 : r - (a + 1 + 1) = r - 2 - a := by omega
  have harith2 : a + 1 + 1 - 1 = a + 1 := by omega
  simp [hne, hge, harith1, harith2, spider_gamma_rotate_three_short_legs]

lemma spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_opt_leg2_last (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd)
    (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    (List.filterMap
        (fun delta =>
          if (r - 1 + 1 == r) = true ∧ φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free ∧ delta ≠ φ then none
          else
            if r - 1 + 1 ≥ 2 then
              some
                (spider_rho (r - (r - 1 + 1)) delta φ ^^^
                  spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
                    ((r - 1 + 1 - 1, delta) ::
                      [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx 2))
            else
              some
                (spider_rho (r - (r - 1 + 1)) delta φ ^^^
                  spider_gamma (r + 2) (spider_update_centre CentreStatus.none delta)
                    ([(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx 2)))
        [SpiderLegEnd.inward, SpiderLegEnd.outward]) =
    [spider_rho 0 φ φ ^^^
        spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r - 1, φ)]] := by
  have heq : (r - 1 + 1 == r) = true := by rw [beq_iff_eq]; omega
  have hge : 2 ≤ r - 1 + 1 := by omega
  have hsub1 : r - (r - 1 + 1) = 0 := by omega
  have hsub2 : r - 1 + 1 - 1 = r - 1 := by omega
  cases φ with
  | free => contradiction
  | inward => simp [heq, hge, hsub1, hsub2, spider_gamma_rotate_three_short_legs]
  | outward => simp [heq, hge, hsub1, hsub2, spider_gamma_rotate_three_short_legs]

/-- One definitional unfolding step of the κ₁ root state, giving the raw option list. -/
theorem spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    spider_gamma (r + 3) CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)] =
      nat_mex_list (spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts r φ) := by
  rw [spider_gamma.eq_def]
  dsimp only
  apply congr_arg nat_mex_list
  change
    List.flatMap _ [((1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), 0), ((1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), 1), ((r, φ), 2)] = _
  rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil]
  dsimp only
  have hr1 : List.range 1 = [0] := rfl
  rw [hr1]
  simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil]
  rw [spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_range_split r hr]
  rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_map, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil]
  unfold spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts
  rw [spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_opt_leg0]
  rw [spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_opt_leg1]
  rw [spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_opt_leg2_zero r hr]
  rw [List.flatMap_congr (spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_opt_leg2_mid r hr φ)]
  rw [spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq_opt_leg2_last r hr φ hφ]
  simp [List.cons_append]

declarations.name: is_compatible_repair_family
declarations.informal: For a type α with decidable equality, a finite collection of repairs R : Finset (Finset (Finset α)) is compatible (is_compatible_repair_family R) if the union of all sets appearing in repairs in R (as a subset of Finset α) is pairwise disjoint.
declarations.statement: def is_compatible_repair_family {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (R : Finset (Finset (Finset α))) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A family of repairs is compatible if their constituent sets are pairwise disjoint. -/
def is_compatible_repair_family {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (R : Finset (Finset (Finset α))) : Prop := (R.biUnion id : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id
declarations.reading: For a type `α` with decidable equality and a finite set `R` of finite sets of finite subsets of `α` (`R : Finset (Finset (Finset α))`), `is_compatible_repair_family R` asserts that the union of all families in `R` (that is, the set of all `A : Finset α` belonging to some `S ∈ R`) is pairwise disjoint: for any two distinct elements `A` and `B` in this union, `A` and `B` are disjoint (`A ∩ B = ∅`).

declarations.name: spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_eq
declarations.informal: For r ≥ 2, φ ≠ free, and assuming the closed form for all smaller levels, the mex of the raw option list equals the mex of the explicit closed-form list spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts r φ.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_eq (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free)
    (ih : ∀ r' < r, 1 ≤ r' → ∀ φ' : SpiderLegEnd, φ' ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free →
      spider_gamma (r' + 3) CentreStatus.none
        [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r', φ')] = r') :
    nat_mex_list (spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts r φ) =
      nat_mex_list (spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts r φ)
declarations.source:
/-- Substituting all sub-state values in the raw option list yields the closed-form option list. -/
theorem spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_eq (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free)
    (ih : ∀ r' < r, 1 ≤ r' → ∀ φ' : SpiderLegEnd, φ' ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free →
      spider_gamma (r' + 3) CentreStatus.none
        [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r', φ')] = r') :
    nat_mex_list (spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts r φ) =
      nat_mex_list (spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts r φ) := by
  have h1 : spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)] = r ^^^ 1 :=
    spider_blocked_incoming_one_outward r (by omega) φ hφ
  have h2 : spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.outgoing [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (r, φ)] = r ^^^ 1 :=
    spider_blocked_outgoing_one_inward r (by omega) φ hφ
  have hshort := spider_two_leg_short_short_zero (r + 2) (by omega)
  have h3 : spider_rho (r - 1) SpiderLegEnd.inward φ ^^^
        spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)]
      = spider_rho (r - 1) SpiderLegEnd.inward φ := by rw [hshort.1, Nat.xor_zero]
  have h4 : spider_rho (r - 1) SpiderLegEnd.outward φ ^^^
        spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.outgoing [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)]
      = spider_rho (r - 1) SpiderLegEnd.outward φ := by rw [hshort.2, Nat.xor_zero]
  have hhead : [spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)],
        spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.outgoing [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (r, φ)],
        spider_rho (r - 1) SpiderLegEnd.inward φ ^^^
          spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)],
        spider_rho (r - 1) SpiderLegEnd.outward φ ^^^
          spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.outgoing [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)]] =
      [r ^^^ 1, r ^^^ 1, spider_rho (r - 1) SpiderLegEnd.inward φ, spider_rho (r - 1) SpiderLegEnd.outward φ] := by
    simp only [h1, h2, h3, h4]
  have hmid : List.flatMap
        (fun i =>
          [spider_rho (r - 2 - i) SpiderLegEnd.inward φ ^^^
              spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
                [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (i + 1, SpiderLegEnd.inward)],
            spider_rho (r - 2 - i) SpiderLegEnd.outward φ ^^^
              spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
                [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (i + 1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)]])
        (List.range (r - 2)) =
      List.flatMap
        (fun i =>
          [spider_rho (r - 2 - i) SpiderLegEnd.inward φ ^^^ i + 1,
            spider_rho (r - 2 - i) SpiderLegEnd.outward φ ^^^ i + 1])
        (List.range (r - 2)) := by
    apply List.flatMap_congr
    intro i hi
    simp only [List.mem_range] at hi
    have hin : spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
        [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (i + 1, SpiderLegEnd.inward)] = i + 1 := by
      rw [spider_gamma_fuel_independent (r + 2) CentreStatus.none _ (by simp; omega)]
      rw [show (([(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (i + 1, SpiderLegEnd.inward)].map Prod.fst).sum + 1) = (i+1)+3 from by simp; omega]
      exact ih (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega) _ (by simp)
    have hout : spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none
        [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (i + 1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] = i + 1 := by
      rw [spider_gamma_fuel_independent (r + 2) CentreStatus.none _ (by simp; omega)]
      rw [show (([(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (i + 1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)].map Prod.fst).sum + 1) = (i+1)+3 from by simp; omega]
      exact ih (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega) _ (by simp)
    simp only [hin, hout]
  have htail : [spider_rho 0 φ φ ^^^
        spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r - 1, φ)]] =
      [r - 1] := by
    simp only [spider_rho_zero_same φ hφ, Nat.zero_xor]
    rw [show r + 2 = (r - 1) + 3 from by omega]
    rw [ih (r - 1) (by omega) (by omega) φ hφ]
  apply congr_arg nat_mex_list
  simp only [spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts, spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts]
  rw [hhead, hmid, htail]

declarations.name: spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_mex
declarations.informal: For r ≥ 2 and φ ≠ free, the mex of the explicit option list of the κ₁ configuration equals r.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_mex (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    nat_mex_list (spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts r φ) = r
declarations.source:
/-- The mex of the closed-form option list of the κ₁ family equals r. -/
theorem spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_mex (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    nat_mex_list (spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts r φ) = r := spider_mex_list_eq_of_not_mem_and_lt_mem _ _
    (spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_not_mem r hr φ hφ)
    (spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_all_lt_mem r hr φ hφ)

declarations.name: apply_repairs
declarations.informal: Given a type α with decidable equality, a family A : Finset (Finset α), and a collection of repairs R : Finset (Finset (Finset α)), apply_repairs A R is the union of A minus the conflict neighborhood of the union of R in A, and the union of all sets in R.
declarations.statement: def apply_repairs {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (A : Finset (Finset α)) (R : Finset (Finset (Finset α))) : Finset (Finset α)
declarations.source:
/-- The packing obtained by applying a compatible family of repairs R to A. -/
def apply_repairs {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (A : Finset (Finset α)) (R : Finset (Finset (Finset α))) : Finset (Finset α) := (A \ conflict_neighborhood A (R.biUnion id)) ∪ (R.biUnion id)
declarations.reading:
Given a type `α` with decidable equality, a finite set `A` of finite subsets of `α`, and a finite set `R` of finite sets of finite subsets of `α`, `apply_repairs A R` is defined as the union of:
1. `A \ conflict_neighborhood A (R.biUnion id)`, and
2. `R.biUnion id`.

declarations.name: spider_blocked_two_three_level_five_sub_long_leg_j34_inward
declarations.informal: With free centre, the state whose legs are a length-2 leg with far end inward, the (5,inward) leg, and the free leg 2 has Grundy value 0 at fuel 10.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_two_three_level_five_sub_long_leg_j34_inward :
    spider_gamma 10 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (5, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 0
declarations.source:
/-- Value 0 at fuel 10 for the state (none; {(2,inward), (5,inward), 2^*}). -/
theorem spider_blocked_two_three_level_five_sub_long_leg_j34_inward :
    spider_gamma 10 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (5, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 0 := by
  decide

declarations.name: spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward
declarations.informal: For the configuration κ₁ = (none;{(1,inward),(1,outward)}), the blocked family V^φ_κ₁(r) equals r for every r ≥ 1 and both φ.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    spider_gamma (r + 3) CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)] = r
declarations.source:
/-- Blocked family of the configuration (n;{1^in,1^out}) (the paper's κ₁): the value at level r is r, for both far ends. -/
theorem spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    spider_gamma (r + 3) CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)] = r := by
  induction' r using Nat.strong_induction_on with r ih generalizing φ
  rcases le_or_gt 2 r with hr2 | hr2
  · rw [spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_raw_opts_eq r hr2 φ hφ]
    rw [spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_eq r hr2 φ hφ]
    · exact spider_none_one_inward_one_outward_opts_mex r hr2 φ hφ
    · intro r' hr' hr'1 φ' hφ'
      exact ih r' hr' hr'1 φ' hφ'
  · have hr1 : r = 1 := by omega
    subst hr1
    exact spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_outward_base φ hφ

declarations.name: spider_blocked_two_three_level_five_sub_long_leg_j34_outward
declarations.informal: With free centre, the state whose legs are a length-2 leg with far end outward, the (5,inward) leg, and the free leg 2 has Grundy value 1 at fuel 10.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_two_three_level_five_sub_long_leg_j34_outward :
    spider_gamma 10 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (5, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 1
declarations.source:
/-- Value 1 at fuel 10 for the state (none; {(2,outward), (5,inward), 2^*}). -/
theorem spider_blocked_two_three_level_five_sub_long_leg_j34_outward :
    spider_gamma 10 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (5, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 1 := by
  decide

declarations.name: claws_from_packing_compatible
declarations.informal: In a weighted k-set packing instance inst over α with decidable equality, any collection of repairs R : Finset (Finset (Finset α)) whose elements are sub-collections of a valid packing O is a compatible repair family.
declarations.statement: theorem claws_from_packing_compatible {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (O : Finset (Finset α)) (hO : is_packing inst O) (R : Finset (Finset (Finset α))) (hR : ∀ X ∈ R, X ⊆ O) : is_compatible_repair_family R
declarations.source:
/-- Claws partitioned from any valid packing form a compatible repair family. -/
theorem claws_from_packing_compatible {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (O : Finset (Finset α)) (hO : is_packing inst O) (R : Finset (Finset (Finset α))) (hR : ∀ X ∈ R, X ⊆ O) : is_compatible_repair_family R := by
  dsimp [is_compatible_repair_family]
  have hO_disj : (↑O : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id := hO.2
  apply Set.PairwiseDisjoint.subset hO_disj
  rw [Finset.coe_subset, Finset.biUnion_subset]
  exact hR
declarations.reading:
For any type `α` with decidable equality and any natural number `k`, given:
- a weighted set packing instance `inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k`,
- a finite set of finite sets `O : Finset (Finset α)` that is a packing in `inst` (`is_packing inst O`), and
- a finite set of finite sets of finite sets `R : Finset (Finset (Finset α))` such that every member `X ∈ R` is a subset of `O` (`X ⊆ O`),

`R` is a compatible repair family (`is_compatible_repair_family R`).

declarations.name: apply_repairs_is_packing
declarations.informal: In a weighted k-set packing instance inst over α with decidable equality, applying a compatible family of repairs R whose sets belong to inst.family to a valid packing A yields a valid packing.
declarations.statement: theorem apply_repairs_is_packing {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A : Finset (Finset α)) (R : Finset (Finset (Finset α))) (hA : is_packing inst A) (hR_sub : ∀ X ∈ R, X ⊆ inst.family) (hR_comp : is_compatible_repair_family R) : is_packing inst (apply_repairs A R)
declarations.source:
/-- Applying a compatible family of repairs from the family yields a valid packing. -/
theorem apply_repairs_is_packing {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {k : ℕ} (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α k) (A : Finset (Finset α)) (R : Finset (Finset (Finset α))) (hA : is_packing inst A) (hR_sub : ∀ X ∈ R, X ⊆ inst.family) (hR_comp : is_compatible_repair_family R) : is_packing inst (apply_repairs A R) := by
  obtain ⟨hAfam, hAdisj⟩ := hA
  have hBfam : R.biUnion id ⊆ inst.family := by
    intro s hs
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion] at hs
    obtain ⟨X, hX, hsX⟩ := hs
    exact hR_sub X hX hsX
  have hBdisj : (↑(R.biUnion id) : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id := hR_comp
  have hA'disj : (↑(A \ conflict_neighborhood A (R.biUnion id)) : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id :=
    hAdisj.subset (by intro x hx; simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_sdiff] at hx ⊢; exact hx.1)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hs
    simp only [apply_repairs, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff] at hs
    rcases hs with ⟨hsA, _⟩ | hsB
    · exact hAfam hsA
    · exact hBfam hsB
  · rw [apply_repairs, Finset.coe_union]
    refine hA'disj.union hBdisj ?_
    intro i hi j hj _
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_sdiff] at hi
    have hnot : ¬ ∃ x ∈ R.biUnion id, ¬ Disjoint i x := by
      intro h
      exact hi.2 (by simp only [conflict_neighborhood, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hi.1, h⟩)
    by_contra hdj
    exact hnot ⟨j, hj, hdj⟩
declarations.reading:
Let α be a type with decidable equality and let k be a natural number. Let inst be a WeightedSetPackingInstance α k, let A be a finite set of finite subsets of α, and let R be a finite set of finite collections of finite subsets of α.

Assume that:
1. A is a packing for inst (meaning A ⊆ inst.family and the elements of A are pairwise disjoint),
2. every collection X ∈ R satisfies X ⊆ inst.family, and
3. R is a compatible repair family (meaning the elements of ⋃ X ∈ R, X are pairwise disjoint).

Then the repaired family `apply_repairs A R`—formed by removing from A every set that intersects some set in ⋃ X ∈ R, X, and then taking the union with ⋃ X ∈ R, X—is also a packing for inst (it is a subset of inst.family and its elements are pairwise disjoint).

declarations.name: apply_repairs_empty
declarations.informal: For any type α with decidable equality and family A : Finset (Finset α), applying the empty repair family to A yields A.
declarations.statement: theorem apply_repairs_empty {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (A : Finset (Finset α)) : apply_repairs A ∅ = A
declarations.source:
/-- Applying the empty repair family leaves the packing unchanged. -/
theorem apply_repairs_empty {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (A : Finset (Finset α)) : apply_repairs A ∅ = A := by
  simp [apply_repairs, conflict_neighborhood]
declarations.reading: For any type `α` with decidable equality and any finite set `A` of finite subsets of `α`, applying the empty set of repairs to `A` yields `A`; that is, `apply_repairs A ∅ = A`.

theorem spider_blocked_two_three_level_five_sub_long_leg_j34 :

    spider_gamma 10 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (5, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 1

/-- Values 0 and 1 of the two j = 3 cuts of the free leg 2, at fuel 10. -/

declarations.name: CapacitatedNetwork
declarations.informal: An undirected capacitated network on a finite vertex set V given by a simple graph G where each edge in G has strictly positive capacity and non-edges have zero capacity.
declarations.statement: structure CapacitatedNetwork (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
declarations.source:
/-- An undirected network with positive edge capacities on the edges of a simple graph. -/
structure CapacitatedNetwork (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] where
  G : SimpleGraph V
  decAdj : DecidableRel G.Adj
  cap : Sym2 V → ℝ
  cap_pos : ∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, 0 < cap e
  cap_zero : ∀ e ∉ G.edgeSet, cap e = 0

declarations.statement:

declarations.source:
/-- The single expensive conjunct of the j = 5 cut of the level-5 long leg: value 5 for the inward continuation. -/
theorem spider_blocked_two_three_level_five_sub_long_leg_j4_inward :

declarations.name: UnicastSessions
declarations.informal: A collection of unicast communication sessions indexed by a type K on an arbitrary vertex type V, consisting of a source map src : K → V, a target map tgt : K → V, and a proof that src k ≠ tgt k for every k : K.
declarations.statement: structure UnicastSessions (V : Type) (K : Type)
declarations.source:
/-- A collection of unicast communication sessions with distinct source and sink vertices. -/
structure UnicastSessions (V : Type) (K : Type) where
  src : K → V
  tgt : K → V
  src_ne_tgt : ∀ k, src k ≠ tgt k
declarations.reading:
The declaration defines a structure `UnicastSessions` parameterized by arbitrary types `V : Type` and `K : Type`. An instance of `UnicastSessions V K` consists of:
1. A function `src : K → V` (the source of each session `k : K`),
2. A function `tgt : K → V` (the target of each session `k : K`),
3. A proof `src_ne_tgt` asserting that for every `k : K`, `src k ≠ tgt k` (the source and target of session `k` are distinct).

declarations.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_two_three_level_five_sub_long_leg_j4 :
