declarations.name: op_98_four_approximation
declarations.informal: Every packing O satisfies packing_weight inst O ≤ 4 * packing_weight inst A under square local optimality with respect to 4-exchanges.
declarations.statement: theorem op_98_four_approximation {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α 4) (A O : Finset (Finset α)) (hA : is_square_locally_optimal inst 4 A) (hO : is_packing inst O) : packing_weight inst O ≤ 4 * packing_weight inst A
declarations.source:
/-- Unconditional factor-4 approximation for 4-set packing under square local optimality, obtained by double counting singleton conflict neighborhoods. -/
theorem op_98_four_approximation {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (inst : WeightedSetPackingInstance α 4) (A O : Finset (Finset α)) (hA : is_square_locally_optimal inst 4 A) (hO : is_packing inst O) : packing_weight inst O ≤ 4 * packing_weight inst A := by
  have h1 : packing_weight inst O ≤ ∑ o ∈ O, packing_weight inst (conflict_neighborhood A {o}) := by
    unfold packing_weight
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro o ho
    have hp : is_packing inst {o} := by
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
        subst hx
        exact hO.1 ho
      · simp
    have hc : ({o} : Finset (Finset α)).card = 1 := Finset.card_singleton o
    have hlg := op_98_no_singleton_repair inst A {o} hA hp hc
    unfold linear_gain at hlg
    simp only [packing_weight, Finset.sum_singleton] at hlg
    exact le_of_sub_nonpos hlg
  have h2 := op_98_sum_conflict_neighborhood_weight inst A O
  have h3 : (∑ a ∈ A, inst.weight a * ↑{o ∈ O | ¬Disjoint a o}.card) ≤ 4 * packing_weight inst A := by
    have h_bound : ∀ a ∈ A, inst.weight a * ↑{o ∈ O | ¬Disjoint a o}.card ≤ inst.weight a * 4 := by
      intro a ha
      have ha_fam : a ∈ inst.family := hA.1.1 ha
      have h_w_pos : 0 ≤ inst.weight a := le_of_lt (inst.weight_pos a ha_fam)
      have h_deg := op_98_conflict_degree_bound inst O a hO
      have h_card := inst.card_le a ha_fam
      have h_deg_le_4 : {o ∈ O | ¬Disjoint a o}.card ≤ 4 := le_trans h_deg h_card
      have h_deg_q : (({o ∈ O | ¬Disjoint a o}.card : ℚ) ≤ 4) := by exact_mod_cast h_deg_le_4
      nlinarith
    have h_sum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_bound
    have h_rw : (∑ a ∈ A, inst.weight a * 4) = 4 * packing_weight inst A := by
      unfold packing_weight
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      ring
    linarith
  linarith

declarations.name: linear_code_supports_rate_mono
declarations.informal: If LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess r holds on net with sessions sess over field F, then for any r' ≤ r, LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess r' also holds.
declarations.statement:
theorem linear_code_supports_rate_mono {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r r' : ℝ}
    (h_supp : LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess r) (h_le : r' ≤ r) :
    LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess r'
declarations.source:
/-- Achievable linear network coding rates are downward-closed. -/
theorem linear_code_supports_rate_mono {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r r' : ℝ}
    (h_supp : LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess r) (h_le : r' ≤ r) :
    LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess r' := by
  obtain ⟨code, hcode⟩ := h_supp
  exact ⟨code, h_le.trans hcode⟩
declarations.reading: Let $V$ and $K$ be finite types with decidable equality, let $F$ be a field, let $net$ be a capacitated network on $V$, and let $sess$ be unicast sessions on $V$ indexed by $K$. Let $r, r' \in \mathbb{R}$. If $net$ and $sess$ support rate $r$ with a causal linear network code over $F$, and $r' \le r$, then $net$ and $sess$ also support rate $r'$ with a causal linear network code over $F$.

declarations.name: spider_eventual_parity_two_three_blocked_small
declarations.informal: For the configuration κ0 = (none;{2^*,3^*}), the blocked family at level t is 2 for t = 1 and 6 for t = 2, for both far ends, and it is at most 7 for t = 3, 4, 5.
declarations.statement:
theorem spider_eventual_parity_two_three_blocked_small :
    spider_gamma 7 CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 2 ∧
    spider_gamma 7 CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 2 ∧
    spider_gamma 8 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 6 ∧
    spider_gamma 8 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 6 ∧
    (∀ t : ℕ, 3 ≤ t → t ≤ 5 →
      spider_gamma (t + 6) CentreStatus.none [(t, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≤ 7) ∧
    (∀ t : ℕ, 3 ≤ t → t ≤ 5 →
      spider_gamma (t + 6) CentreStatus.none [(t, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≤ 7)
declarations.source:
lemma spider_eventual_parity_two_three_blocked_small_level_one :
    spider_gamma 7 CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 2 := by
  decide

lemma spider_eventual_parity_two_three_blocked_small_level_two :
    spider_gamma 8 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 6 := by
  decide

lemma spider_eventual_parity_two_three_blocked_small_level_three :
    spider_gamma 9 CentreStatus.none [(3, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≤ 7 := by
  decide

/-- The two small blocked values of the κ0 family: at levels 1 and 2 the blocked families of κ0 = (none;{2^*,3^*}) take the values 2 and 6 (paper Table 6). -/
theorem spider_eventual_parity_two_three_blocked_small :
    spider_gamma 7 CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 2 ∧
    spider_gamma 7 CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 2 ∧
    spider_gamma 8 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 6 ∧
    spider_gamma 8 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 6 ∧
    (∀ t : ℕ, 3 ≤ t → t ≤ 5 →
      spider_gamma (t + 6) CentreStatus.none [(t, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≤ 7) ∧
    (∀ t : ℕ, 3 ≤ t → t ≤ 5 →
      spider_gamma (t + 6) CentreStatus.none [(t, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≤ 7) := by
  have h1 : spider_gamma 7 CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 2 :=
    spider_eventual_parity_two_three_blocked_small_level_one
  have h1_out : spider_gamma 7 CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 2 := by
    rw [spider_blocked_two_three_reversal, h1]
  have h2 : spider_gamma 8 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 6 :=
    spider_eventual_parity_two_three_blocked_small_level_two
  have h2_out : spider_gamma 8 CentreStatus.none [(2, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 6 := by
    rw [spider_blocked_two_three_reversal, h2]
  have h_in : ∀ t : ℕ, 3 ≤ t → t ≤ 5 →
      spider_gamma (t + 6) CentreStatus.none [(t, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≤ 7 := by
    intro t ht3 ht5
    interval_cases t
    · exact spider_eventual_parity_two_three_blocked_small_level_three
    · exact spider_blocked_two_three_level_four
    · exact spider_blocked_two_three_level_five
  have h_out : ∀ t : ℕ, 3 ≤ t → t ≤ 5 →
      spider_gamma (t + 6) CentreStatus.none [(t, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≤ 7 := by
    intro t ht3 ht5
    rw [spider_blocked_two_three_reversal]
    exact h_in t ht3 ht5
  exact ⟨h1, h1_out, h2, h2_out, h_in, h_out⟩

declarations.name: relu
declarations.informal: The rectified linear unit (ReLU) activation function maps each real number x to max(x, 0).
declarations.statement: def relu (x : ℝ) : ℝ
declarations.source:
/-- The Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) activation function, defined by relu(x) = max(x, 0). -/
def relu (x : ℝ) : ℝ := max x 0
declarations.reading: The function `relu`, taking a real number $x$ and returning a real number, is defined as the maximum of $x$ and $0$ ($\max(x, 0)$).

declarations.name: pell_number_mono_succ
declarations.informal: The Pell numbers are nondecreasing: P(m) ≤ P(m+1).
declarations.statement: theorem pell_number_mono_succ (m : ℕ) : pell_number m ≤ pell_number (m + 1)
declarations.source:
/-- Pell numbers are nondecreasing, `pell_number m ≤ pell_number (m+1)`. -/
theorem pell_number_mono_succ (m : ℕ) : pell_number m ≤ pell_number (m + 1) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => decide
  | succ k =>
    have : pell_number (k + 1 + 1) = pell_number k + 2 * pell_number (k + 1) := rfl
    omega

declarations.name: ReLUHiddenLayer
declarations.informal: A hidden layer of width k consists of a k-by-k rational weight matrix and a rational bias vector of length k.
declarations.statement:
structure ReLUHiddenLayer (k : ℕ) where
  weight : Fin k → Fin k → ℚ
  bias : Fin k → ℚ
declarations.source:
/-- A hidden layer of width k in a ReLU neural network with rational weights and biases. -/
structure ReLUHiddenLayer (k : ℕ) where
  weight : Fin k → Fin k → ℚ
  bias : Fin k → ℚ
declarations.reading:
A structure `ReLUHiddenLayer` parameterized by a natural number `k : ℕ`, with two fields:
1. `weight`: a map of type `Fin k → Fin k → ℚ` (a $k \times k$ matrix of rational weights),
2. `bias`: a map of type `Fin k → ℚ` (a length-$k$ vector of rational biases), with a default value assigned via `sorry`.

declarations.name: relu_nonneg
declarations.informal: For any real number x, relu(x) is greater than or equal to zero.
declarations.statement: theorem relu_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ relu x
declarations.source:
/-- The ReLU activation function is always non-negative. -/
theorem relu_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ relu x := le_max_right x 0
declarations.reading: For every real number $x$, $0 \le \operatorname{relu}(x)$.

declarations.name: ReLUNetwork
declarations.informal: A feedforward ReLU neural network from the real line to the real line with hidden layers of width k, specified by rational affine input and output layers and an arbitrary sequence of width-k hidden layers.
declarations.statement:
structure ReLUNetwork (k : ℕ) where
  in_weight : Fin k → ℚ
  in_bias : Fin k → ℚ
  layers : List (ReLUHiddenLayer k)
  out_weight : Fin k → ℚ
  out_bias : ℚ
declarations.source:
/-- A feedforward ReLU neural network from ℝ to ℝ with hidden layer width k and rational weights and biases. -/
structure ReLUNetwork (k : ℕ) where
  in_weight : Fin k → ℚ
  in_bias : Fin k → ℚ
  layers : List (ReLUHiddenLayer k)
  out_weight : Fin k → ℚ
  out_bias : ℚ
declarations.reading:
A structure `ReLUNetwork` parameterized by a natural number $k$, with fields:
- `in_weight`: a function from `Fin k` to `ℚ` (a rational vector of dimension $k$),
- `in_bias`: a function from `Fin k` to `ℚ` (a rational vector of dimension $k$),
- `layers`: a list of `ReLUHiddenLayer k`,
- `out_weight`: a function from `Fin k` to `ℚ` (a rational vector of dimension $k$),
- `out_bias`: a rational number (`ℚ`), with a default value given by `by sorry`.

declarations.name: finset_sum_eq_three_of_off
declarations.informal: A finite sum of an ℕ-valued function that vanishes off three distinct points equals the sum of the three values f a + f b + f c.
declarations.statement:
theorem finset_sum_eq_three_of_off {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : ι → ℕ) {a b c : ι} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (h : ∀ x, x ≠ a → x ≠ b → x ≠ c → f x = 0) :
    ∑ x, f x = f a + f b + f c
declarations.source:
/-- If `f : ι → ℕ` vanishes off `{a,b,c}` (distinct), then `∑ x, f x = f a + f b + f c`. -/
theorem finset_sum_eq_three_of_off {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : ι → ℕ) {a b c : ι} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (h : ∀ x, x ≠ a → x ≠ b → x ≠ c → f x = 0) :
    ∑ x, f x = f a + f b + f c := by
  have hs : ({a, b, c} : Finset ι) ⊆ Finset.univ := Finset.subset_univ _
  rw [← Finset.sum_subset hs]
  · rw [Finset.sum_insert]
    · rw [Finset.sum_insert]
      · rw [Finset.sum_singleton, add_assoc]
      · simp [hbc]
    · simp [hab, hac]
  · intro x _ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at hx
    exact h x hx.1 hx.2.1 hx.2.2

declarations.name: pell_number_sub_add_left
declarations.statement: theorem pell_number_sub_add_left (m : ℕ) : (pell_number (m + 1) - pell_number m) + 2 * pell_number m = pell_number (m + 2) - pell_number (m + 1)
declarations.source:
/-- Truncated-subtraction identity `(pell_number (m+1) - pell_number m) + 2 * pell_number m = pell_number (m+2) - pell_number (m+1)`. -/
theorem pell_number_sub_add_left (m : ℕ) : (pell_number (m + 1) - pell_number m) + 2 * pell_number m = pell_number (m + 2) - pell_number (m + 1) := by
  have hrec : pell_number (m + 2) = pell_number m + 2 * pell_number (m + 1) := rfl
  have h1 := pell_number_mono_succ m
  omega

declarations.name: pell_number_two_mul_sub_add
declarations.statement: theorem pell_number_two_mul_sub_add (m : ℕ) : 2 * (pell_number (m + 1) - pell_number m) + 2 * pell_number m = 2 * pell_number (m + 1)
declarations.source:
/-- Truncated-subtraction identity `2 * (pell_number (m+1) - pell_number m) + 2 * pell_number m = 2 * pell_number (m+1)`. -/
theorem pell_number_two_mul_sub_add (m : ℕ) : 2 * (pell_number (m + 1) - pell_number m) + 2 * pell_number m = 2 * pell_number (m + 1) := by
  have hle := pell_number_mono_succ m
  omega

declarations.name: segment_crossing
declarations.informal: Two line segments in the plane, represented as unordered pairs of endpoints in Sym2 (ℝ × ℝ), cross if the intersection of their relative interiors (open segments) is nonempty.
declarations.statement: def segment_crossing (e₁ e₂ : Sym2 (ℝ × ℝ)) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- Predicate that two line segments in ℝ² intersect in their relative interiors. -/
def segment_crossing (e₁ e₂ : Sym2 (ℝ × ℝ)) : Prop := ((Sym2.lift ⟨fun u v => openSegment ℝ u v, fun u v => openSegment_symm (𝕜 := ℝ) u v⟩ e₁) ∩
   (Sym2.lift ⟨fun u v => openSegment ℝ u v, fun u v => openSegment_symm (𝕜 := ℝ) u v⟩ e₂)).Nonempty
declarations.reading: `segment_crossing e₁ e₂` defines a proposition for two unordered pairs of points in ℝ², `e₁` and `e₂`. It asserts that the open segment between the two points of `e₁` and the open segment between the two points of `e₂` have a nonempty intersection (i.e., there exists a point in ℝ² that lies strictly between the endpoints of both segments).

declarations.name: cutSeparation
declarations.informal: The number of sessions (out of the unicast session set sess) with exactly one endpoint in the vertex set S, i.e. the number of sessions separated by the cut S.
declarations.statement: def cutSeparation {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] (sess : UnicastSessions V K) (S : Finset V) : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- Number of sessions crossing the cut S. -/
def cutSeparation {V : Type} [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] (sess : UnicastSessions V K) (S : Finset V) : ℕ := (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => (sess.src k ∈ S) ≠ (sess.tgt k ∈ S))).card

declarations.name: pell_prefix_first_letter_vector
declarations.informal: After appending only the letter c_(i+1) to the prefix, the run counts are P(i+1)-P(i) at q_i, 2P(i) at q_(i+1), (P(i+1)-P(i))+2P(i) at q_(i+2), and vanish at every other state.
declarations.statement:
open Classical in
theorem pell_prefix_first_letter_vector (n i : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (h1 : 1 ≤ i) (hi : i + 1 ≤ n - 2)
    (hzero : ∀ s : Fin n, s.val ≠ i → s.val ≠ i + 1 → s.val ≠ i + 2 →
      nfa_run_count_list (pell_nfa n) (pell_word_prefix i) ⟨0, by omega⟩ s = 0)
    (hx : nfa_run_count_list (pell_nfa n) (pell_word_prefix i) ⟨0, by omega⟩
      ⟨i, by omega⟩ = pell_number (i + 1) - pell_number i)
    (hy : nfa_run_count_list (pell_nfa n) (pell_word_prefix i) ⟨0, by omega⟩
      ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ = 2 * pell_number i) (s : Fin n) :
    nfa_run_count_list (pell_nfa n) (pell_word_prefix i ++ [⟨(i + 1) % 5, by omega⟩])
        ⟨0, by omega⟩ s
      = (if s.val = i then (pell_number (i + 1) - pell_number i) else 0)
        + (if s.val = i + 1 then (2 * pell_number i) else 0)
        + (if s.val = i + 2 then ((pell_number (i + 1) - pell_number i) + 2 * pell_number i) else 0)
declarations.source:
open Classical in
/-- One-letter DP step: appending the single letter c_(i+1) to `pell_word_prefix i` maps the vector (x at q_i, y at q_(i+1)), vanishing off q_i,q_(i+1),q_(i+2), to (x at q_i, y at q_(i+1), x+y at q_(i+2)), zero everywhere else. -/
theorem pell_prefix_first_letter_vector (n i : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (h1 : 1 ≤ i) (hi : i + 1 ≤ n - 2)
    (hzero : ∀ s : Fin n, s.val ≠ i → s.val ≠ i + 1 → s.val ≠ i + 2 →
      nfa_run_count_list (pell_nfa n) (pell_word_prefix i) ⟨0, by omega⟩ s = 0)
    (hx : nfa_run_count_list (pell_nfa n) (pell_word_prefix i) ⟨0, by omega⟩
      ⟨i, by omega⟩ = pell_number (i + 1) - pell_number i)
    (hy : nfa_run_count_list (pell_nfa n) (pell_word_prefix i) ⟨0, by omega⟩
      ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ = 2 * pell_number i) (s : Fin n) :
    nfa_run_count_list (pell_nfa n) (pell_word_prefix i ++ [⟨(i + 1) % 5, by omega⟩])
        ⟨0, by omega⟩ s
      = (if s.val = i then (pell_number (i + 1) - pell_number i) else 0)
        + (if s.val = i + 1 then (2 * pell_number i) else 0)
        + (if s.val = i + 2 then ((pell_number (i + 1) - pell_number i) + 2 * pell_number i) else 0) := by
  have h_step_i : s ∈ (pell_nfa n).step ⟨i, by omega⟩ ⟨(i + 1) % 5, by omega⟩ ↔ (s.val = i ∨ s.val = i + 2) := by
    have h := @pell_step_iff n hn ⟨i, by omega⟩ s ⟨(i + 1) % 5, by omega⟩
    dsimp at h
    rw [h]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨hmod, -⟩ | ⟨hmod, -⟩ | ⟨-, -, hq⟩ | ⟨-, h2, -⟩ | ⟨hmod, -⟩)
      · exfalso; omega
      · exfalso; omega
      · exact hq
      · exfalso; omega
      · exfalso; omega
    · intro hq
      right; right; left
      refine ⟨rfl, by omega, hq⟩
  have h_step_ip1 : s ∈ (pell_nfa n).step ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ ⟨(i + 1) % 5, by omega⟩ ↔ (s.val = i + 1 ∨ s.val = i + 2) := by
    have h := @pell_step_iff n hn ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ s ⟨(i + 1) % 5, by omega⟩
    dsimp at h
    rw [h]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨-, -, -, hq⟩ | ⟨-, h2, -⟩ | ⟨hmod, -⟩ | ⟨hmod, -⟩ | ⟨hmod, -⟩)
      · exact hq
      · exfalso; omega
      · exfalso; omega
      · exfalso; omega
      · exfalso; omega
    · intro hq
      left
      refine ⟨rfl, by omega, by omega, hq⟩
  have h_step_ip2 : s ∉ (pell_nfa n).step ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ ⟨(i + 1) % 5, by omega⟩ := by
    have h := @pell_step_iff n hn ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ s ⟨(i + 1) % 5, by omega⟩
    dsimp at h
    rw [h]
    rintro (⟨hmod, -⟩ | ⟨hmod, -⟩ | ⟨hmod, -⟩ | ⟨hmod, -⟩ | ⟨hmod, -⟩) <;> (exfalso; omega)

  rw [nfa_run_count_list_concat]
  let g : Fin n → ℕ := fun t =>
    if s ∈ (pell_nfa n).step t ⟨(i + 1) % 5, by omega⟩
    then nfa_run_count_list (pell_nfa n) (pell_word_prefix i) ⟨0, by omega⟩ t else 0
  change (∑ t : Fin n, g t) = _
  have hab : (⟨i, by omega⟩ : Fin n) ≠ ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ := by intro h; injection h with h; omega
  have hac : (⟨i, by omega⟩ : Fin n) ≠ ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ := by intro h; injection h with h; omega
  have hbc : (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin n) ≠ ⟨i + 2, by omega⟩ := by intro h; injection h with h; omega
  rw [finset_sum_eq_three_of_off g hab hac hbc]
  · dsimp [g]
    rw [hx, hy]
    rw [if_congr h_step_i rfl rfl]
    rw [if_congr h_step_ip1 rfl rfl]
    rw [if_neg h_step_ip2]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · intro t hti htip1 htip2
    dsimp [g]
    have hzt : nfa_run_count_list (pell_nfa n) (pell_word_prefix i) ⟨0, by omega⟩ t = 0 := by
      apply hzero t
      · intro h; apply hti; ext; exact h
      · intro h; apply htip1; ext; exact h
      · intro h; apply htip2; ext; exact h
    rw [hzt]
    split_ifs <;> rfl

declarations.name: segment_crossing_graph
declarations.informal: The crossing graph G(L) of a finite family of line segments L is the simple graph with vertex set L and edges between segments whose relative interiors intersect.
declarations.statement: def segment_crossing_graph (L : Finset (Sym2 (ℝ × ℝ))) : SimpleGraph L
declarations.source:
/-- The crossing graph of a finite family of segments in ℝ². -/
def segment_crossing_graph (L : Finset (Sym2 (ℝ × ℝ))) : SimpleGraph L := SimpleGraph.fromRel (fun e₁ e₂ => segment_crossing e₁.1 e₂.1)
declarations.reading: Given a finite set `L` of unordered pairs of points in `ℝ × ℝ` (elements of `Sym2 (ℝ × ℝ)`), `segment_crossing_graph L` is the `SimpleGraph` on the vertex set `L` (the subtype of elements belonging to `L`) constructed via `SimpleGraph.fromRel` with the relation `fun e₁ e₂ => segment_crossing e₁.1 e₂.1`. Two vertices `e₁, e₂ : L` are adjacent if and only if `e₁ ≠ e₂` and the open segment spanned by the endpoints of `e₁` has a nonempty intersection with the open segment spanned by the endpoints of `e₂`.

declarations.name: cutCapacity
declarations.informal: The total capacity of the edges of the network leaving a vertex set S: the sum over u ∈ S and all v of cap({u,v}), with the terms where v ∈ S set to zero.
declarations.statement: def cutCapacity {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (S : Finset V) : ℝ
declarations.source:
/-- Total capacity leaving the cut S. -/
def cutCapacity {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (S : Finset V) : ℝ := ∑ u ∈ S, ∑ v, if v ∈ S then 0 else net.cap s(u, v)

declarations.name: segments_block_points
declarations.informal: A finite family of segments L blocks a finite point set P under the triangle-free crossing property if for every pair of distinct points u, v in P, adding the segment uv to L creates a triangle in the crossing graph.
declarations.statement: def segments_block_points (L : Finset (Sym2 (ℝ × ℝ))) (P : Finset (ℝ × ℝ)) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A family of segments blocks a point set under the triangle-free crossing property. -/
def segments_block_points (L : Finset (Sym2 (ℝ × ℝ))) (P : Finset (ℝ × ℝ)) : Prop := ∀ ⦃u v : ℝ × ℝ⦄, u ∈ P → v ∈ P → u ≠ v →
    ¬ (segment_crossing_graph (insert s(u, v) L)).CliqueFree 3
declarations.reading: Given a finite set of segments `L` (represented as unordered pairs of points in `ℝ × ℝ`) and a finite set of points `P` in `ℝ × ℝ`, `segments_block_points L P` asserts that for every pair of points `u, v : ℝ × ℝ`, if `u ∈ P`, `v ∈ P`, and `u ≠ v`, then the segment crossing graph on `insert s(u, v) L` is not 3-clique-free (that is, the graph contains a 3-clique: three segments in `insert s(u, v) L` whose open segments pairwise intersect).

declarations.name: IsSingleCounterUpdate
declarations.informal: A pair of integer displacements (w₁, w₂) is a single-counter update if at least one coordinate is zero, that is, w₁ = 0 or w₂ = 0.
declarations.statement: def IsSingleCounterUpdate (w₁ w₂ : ℤ) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- Predicate asserting that a 2-counter displacement vector has at most one non-zero coordinate. -/
def IsSingleCounterUpdate (w₁ w₂ : ℤ) : Prop := w₁ = 0 ∨ w₂ = 0
declarations.reading: The predicate `IsSingleCounterUpdate` takes two integers $w_1$ and $w_2$ and is defined as the proposition that $w_1 = 0$ or $w_2 = 0$.

declarations.name: two_counter_machine_is_single_counter_update
declarations.informal: A 2-counter machine M with state type Q has single-counter updates if for every update transition from q to q' with displacements (w₁, w₂), the displacement vector satisfies IsSingleCounterUpdate w₁ w₂.
declarations.statement: def two_counter_machine_is_single_counter_update {Q : Type*} (M : TwoCounterMachine Q) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A 2-counter machine is single-counter update if every update transition modifies at most one counter. -/
def two_counter_machine_is_single_counter_update {Q : Type*} (M : TwoCounterMachine Q) : Prop := ∀ q q' : Q, ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℤ,
    (q, TwoCounterInstr.update w₁ w₂, q') ∈ M.transitions →
    IsSingleCounterUpdate w₁ w₂
declarations.reading: For a two-counter machine $M$ with state type $Q$, this definition asserts that for all states $q, q' : Q$ and all integers $w_1, w_2 : \mathbb{Z}$, if the transition $(q, \text{TwoCounterInstr.update}(w_1, w_2), q')$ is in $M$'s finite set of transitions, then $(w_1, w_2)$ is a single counter update (at least one of $w_1 = 0$ or $w_2 = 0$).

declarations.name: is_single_counter_update_axis_x
declarations.informal: For any integer displacement w, the vector (w, 0) is a single-counter update.
declarations.statement: lemma is_single_counter_update_axis_x (w : ℤ) : IsSingleCounterUpdate w 0
declarations.source:
/-- An update affecting only the first counter is a single-counter update. -/
lemma is_single_counter_update_axis_x (w : ℤ) : IsSingleCounterUpdate w 0 := Or.inr rfl
declarations.reading: For every integer `w`, `IsSingleCounterUpdate w 0` holds.

declarations.name: not_is_single_counter_update_diagonal
declarations.informal: The simultaneous increment (1, 1) is not a single-counter update.
declarations.statement: lemma not_is_single_counter_update_diagonal : ¬ IsSingleCounterUpdate 1 1
declarations.source:
/-- The diagonal update (1, 1) is not a single-counter update. -/
lemma not_is_single_counter_update_diagonal : ¬ IsSingleCounterUpdate 1 1 := by
  simp [IsSingleCounterUpdate]
declarations.reading: It is not the case that the integer pair $(1, 1)$ satisfies `IsSingleCounterUpdate`.

declarations.name: is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor
declarations.informal: A factor α is guaranteed for n agents under Round-Robin if for every number of goods m, every nonnegative additive valuation profile w, and every pure Nash equilibrium rank under the Round-Robin sequence, the induced allocation is α-EF1.
declarations.statement: def is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (α : ℝ) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A factor α is guaranteed for n agents under Round-Robin if every pure Nash equilibrium of every n-agent additive instance induces an α-EF1 allocation. -/
def is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (α : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ),
    (∀ i g, 0 ≤ w i g) →
    ∀ (rank : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m),
      is_picking_sequence_pne
        (SocialChoice.FairDivision.Indivisible.AdditiveValuation.toValuation ⟨w⟩)
        (round_robin_sequence n m) rank →
      is_alpha_ef1 α
        (SocialChoice.FairDivision.Indivisible.AdditiveValuation.toValuation ⟨w⟩)
        (picking_sequence_outcome (round_robin_sequence n m) rank)
declarations.reading:
Given a number of agents $n \in \mathbb{N}$ with $n \ne 0$ and a factor $\alpha \in \mathbb{R}$, this definition asserts that for every number of items $m \in \mathbb{N}$ and every non-negative additive weight matrix $w : \text{Fin } n \to \text{Fin } m \to \mathbb{R}$ (satisfying $0 \le w(i, g)$ for all $i$ and $g$):

For every ranking profile $\text{rank} : \text{Fin } n \to (\text{Fin } m \simeq \text{Fin } m)$, if $\text{rank}$ is a pure Nash equilibrium (PNE) of the picking sequence game on the round-robin sequence of length $m$ (where at step $t \in \{0, \dots, m-1\}$, agent $t \bmod n$ selects their highest-ranked unpicked item) with respect to the additive valuation induced by $w$—meaning no agent $i$ can unilaterally deviate to another permutation $r$ of $\text{Fin } m$ to strictly increase the additive value of the bundle they receive—then the resulting allocation $A$ is $\alpha$-EF1: for every pair of distinct agents $i \ne j$, if $A(j)$ is non-empty, there exists a good $g \in A(j)$ such that $\alpha \cdot v_i(A(j) \setminus \{g\}) \le v_i(A(i))$.

declarations.name: round_robin_alpha
declarations.informal: The best guaranteed EF1 factor α_RR(n) for n agents under Round-Robin is the supremum of factors α that are guaranteed for n agents under Round-Robin.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def round_robin_alpha (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : ℝ
declarations.reading:
Given a number of agents `n : ℕ` with `[NeZero n]`, `round_robin_alpha n` is defined as the supremum (`sSup`) in ℝ of the set of all real numbers `α` such that `is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor n α` holds.

Here, `is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor n α` asserts that:
For every number of goods `m : ℕ`,
and every valuation matrix `w : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ` satisfying `∀ i g, 0 ≤ w i g`,
and every ranking profile `rank : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m`,
if `rank` is a pure Nash equilibrium of the picking sequence game under the round-robin sequence of length `m` for `n` agents with valuations given additively by `w` (that is, for every agent `i` and every alternative ranking `r : Fin m ≃ Fin m`, agent `i`'s bundle value under deviation to `r` is at most their bundle value under `rank`),
then the allocation resulting from the round-robin picking sequence under `rank` is α-EF1 with respect to `w` (that is, for every pair of distinct agents `i ≠ j`, if agent `j`'s bundle is nonempty, there exists a good `g` in `j`'s bundle such that `α * v_i(A_j \ {g}) ≤ v_i(A_i)`, where `v_i` is agent `i`'s additive valuation).

declarations.name: flow_rate_mul_two_le_sum_cap_mul_dist
declarations.informal: If a fractional multicommodity flow on net supports the common rate r, and d is a symmetric, nonnegative, triangle-satisfying function on V with d(u,u) = 0, then 2*r*(sum over sessions of d(src,tgt)) is at most the sum over all ordered pairs of vertices of cap({u,v})*d(u,v).
declarations.statement:
theorem flow_rate_mul_two_le_sum_cap_mul_dist
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r : ℝ}
    (h : FlowSupportsRate net sess r) (d : V → V → ℝ)
    (h_nonneg : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ d u v) (h_symm : ∀ u v, d u v = d v u)
    (h_diag : ∀ u, d u u = 0) (h_tri : ∀ u v w, d u v ≤ d u w + d w v) :
    2 * r * (∑ k, d (sess.src k) (sess.tgt k)) ≤ ∑ u, ∑ v, net.cap s(u, v) * d u v
declarations.source:
/-- Metric (potential) upper bound on the common rate of a fractional multicommodity flow. -/
theorem flow_rate_mul_two_le_sum_cap_mul_dist
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r : ℝ}
    (h : FlowSupportsRate net sess r) (d : V → V → ℝ)
    (h_nonneg : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ d u v) (h_symm : ∀ u v, d u v = d v u)
    (h_diag : ∀ u, d u u = 0) (h_tri : ∀ u v w, d u v ≤ d u w + d w v) :
    2 * r * (∑ k, d (sess.src k) (sess.tgt k)) ≤ ∑ u, ∑ v, net.cap s(u, v) * d u v := by
  open Finset in
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h
  have h_single : ∀ k : K, r * d (sess.src k) (sess.tgt k) ≤ ∑ v, ∑ w, f k v w * d v w := by
    intro k
    have hdiv := hf.2.2 k
    have hnn := hf.1 k
    set s := sess.src k
    set t := sess.tgt k
    have hst : s ≠ t := sess.src_ne_tgt k
    have h_lhs : (∑ v, (∑ w, f k v w - ∑ u, f k u v) * d s v) = -r * d s t := by
      have h_split : ∀ v, (∑ w, f k v w - ∑ u, f k u v) * d s v =
          (if v = s then r * d s s else 0) + (if v = t then -r * d s t else 0) := by
        intro v
        rw [hdiv v]
        split_ifs <;> (try subst_vars) <;> (try contradiction) <;> ring
      simp_rw [h_split, sum_add_distrib]
      have hd_ss : d s s = 0 := h_diag s
      simp [hd_ss]
    have h_geom : (∑ v, (∑ w, f k v w - ∑ u, f k u v) * d s v) = ∑ v, ∑ w, f k v w * (d s v - d s w) := by
      have h1 : (∑ v, (∑ w, f k v w - ∑ u, f k u v) * d s v) =
          (∑ v, (∑ w, f k v w) * d s v) - (∑ v, (∑ u, f k u v) * d s v) := by
        simp_rw [sub_mul, sum_sub_distrib]
      have h2 : (∑ v, (∑ u, f k u v) * d s v) = ∑ v, ∑ w, f k v w * d s w := by
        simp_rw [sum_mul]
        rw [sum_comm]
      have h3 : (∑ v, (∑ w, f k v w) * d s v) = ∑ v, ∑ w, f k v w * d s v := by
        simp_rw [sum_mul]
      rw [h1, h2, h3]
      simp_rw [← sum_sub_distrib, ← mul_sub]
    have h_le : - ∑ v, ∑ w, f k v w * d v w ≤ ∑ v, ∑ w, f k v w * (d s v - d s w) := by
      rw [← sum_neg_distrib]
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro v _
      rw [← sum_neg_distrib]
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro w _
      have htri : - d v w ≤ d s v - d s w := by
        have := h_tri s w v
        linarith
      have h_nonneg_f : 0 ≤ f k v w := hnn v w
      nlinarith
    rw [← h_geom, h_lhs] at h_le
    linarith

  have h_sum_k : r * (∑ k, d (sess.src k) (sess.tgt k)) ≤ ∑ k, ∑ v, ∑ w, f k v w * d v w := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro k _
    exact h_single k

  have h_comm : (∑ k, ∑ v, ∑ w, f k v w * d v w) = ∑ v, ∑ w, ∑ k, f k v w * d v w := by
    rw [sum_comm]
    congr 1
    ext v
    rw [sum_comm]

  have h_pair : 2 * (∑ v, ∑ w, ∑ k, f k v w * d v w) =
      ∑ v, ∑ w, (∑ k, (f k v w + f k w v)) * d v w := by
    have h_two : 2 * (∑ v, ∑ w, ∑ k, f k v w * d v w) =
        (∑ v, ∑ w, ∑ k, f k v w * d v w) + (∑ v, ∑ w, ∑ k, f k v w * d v w) := by ring
    rw [h_two]
    have h_swap : (∑ v, ∑ w, ∑ k, f k v w * d v w) = ∑ v, ∑ w, ∑ k, f k w v * d v w := by
      rw [sum_comm]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro w _
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro v _
      rw [h_symm w v]
    nth_rw 2 [h_swap]
    simp_rw [← sum_add_distrib, ← add_mul, ← sum_mul]

  have h_cap_le : (∑ v, ∑ w, (∑ k, (f k v w + f k w v)) * d v w) ≤ ∑ u, ∑ v, net.cap s(u, v) * d u v := by
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro u _
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro v _
    by_cases huv : u = v
    · subst huv
      rw [h_diag u]
      ring_nf
      rfl
    · have hcap := hf.2.1 u v huv
      have hd := h_nonneg u v
      nlinarith

  calc
    2 * r * (∑ k, d (sess.src k) (sess.tgt k))
      = 2 * (r * ∑ k, d (sess.src k) (sess.tgt k)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * (∑ k, ∑ v, ∑ w, f k v w * d v w) := by nlinarith
    _ = 2 * (∑ v, ∑ w, ∑ k, f k v w * d v w) := by rw [h_comm]
    _ = ∑ v, ∑ w, (∑ k, (f k v w + f k w v)) * d v w := h_pair
    _ ≤ ∑ u, ∑ v, net.cap s(u, v) * d u v := h_cap_le

declarations.name: not_is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor_three_of_three_quarters_lt
declarations.informal: For three agents, no factor strictly greater than 3/4 is guaranteed for Round-Robin pure Nash equilibria.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor_three_of_three_quarters_lt (α : ℝ) (hα : 3 / 4 < α) :
    ¬ is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor 3 α
declarations.source:
/-- No factor α > 3/4 is guaranteed for Round-Robin pure Nash equilibria with three agents. -/
theorem not_is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor_three_of_three_quarters_lt (α : ℝ) (hα : 3 / 4 < α) :
    ¬ is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor 3 α := by
  intro h
  rcases round_robin_three_agents_pne_not_alpha_ef1_of_three_quarters_lt with ⟨w, rank, hw, hpne, hnot⟩
  exact hnot α hα (h 8 w hw rank hpne)
declarations.reading:
For any real number $\alpha > 3/4$, it is not the case that the round-robin picking sequence mechanism with 3 agents guarantees an $\alpha$-EF1 allocation at every pure Nash equilibrium.

That is, it is false that: for all $m \in \mathbb{N}$ and all non-negative item valuations $w : \text{Fin } 3 \to \text{Fin } m \to \mathbb{R}$, every ranking profile $\text{rank} : \text{Fin } 3 \to (\text{Fin } m \simeq \text{Fin } m)$ that forms a pure Nash equilibrium under the round-robin sequence produces an allocation that is $\alpha$-EF1.

declarations.name: is_recursively_balanced
declarations.informal: A picking sequence of length m for n agents is recursively balanced if each complete round of n turns contains every agent exactly once and any final incomplete round contains no agent more than once.
declarations.statement: def is_recursively_balanced (n : ℕ) (seq : List (Fin n)) : Prop
declarations.reading: A list `seq` of elements of `Fin n` is recursively balanced if, for every natural number `s`, the sublist obtained by dropping the first `s * n` elements of `seq` and taking the first `n` elements of what remains has no duplicate elements (`List.Nodup`).

declarations.name: is_guaranteed_sequence_ef1_factor
declarations.informal: A factor α is guaranteed for a picking sequence mechanism seq with n agents if for every nonnegative additive valuation profile and every pure Nash equilibrium reported ranking profile, the outcome of the picking sequence is α-EF1.
declarations.statement: def is_guaranteed_sequence_ef1_factor (n : ℕ) (seq : List (Fin n)) (α : ℝ) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A factor α is guaranteed for a picking sequence if at every pure Nash equilibrium under nonnegative additive valuations, the induced allocation is α-EF1. -/
def is_guaranteed_sequence_ef1_factor (n : ℕ) (seq : List (Fin n)) (α : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : Fin n → Fin seq.length → ℝ),
    (∀ i g, 0 ≤ w i g) →
    ∀ (rank : Fin n → Fin seq.length ≃ Fin seq.length),
      is_picking_sequence_pne
        (SocialChoice.FairDivision.Indivisible.AdditiveValuation.toValuation ⟨w⟩)
        seq rank →
      is_alpha_ef1 α
        (SocialChoice.FairDivision.Indivisible.AdditiveValuation.toValuation ⟨w⟩)
        (picking_sequence_outcome seq rank)

declarations.name: not_is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor_three_fifteen_sixteenths
declarations.informal: 15/16 is not a guaranteed EF1 factor for Round-Robin pure Nash equilibria with three agents: there exists an 8-good additive instance whose pure Nash equilibrium outcome is not (15/16)-EF1.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor_three_fifteen_sixteenths :
    ¬ is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor 3 (15 / 16)
declarations.source:
/-- 15/16 is not a guaranteed EF1 factor for Round-Robin pure Nash equilibria with three agents. -/
theorem not_is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor_three_fifteen_sixteenths :
    ¬ is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor 3 (15 / 16) := by
  apply not_is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor_three_of_three_quarters_lt
  norm_num
declarations.reading:
The theorem asserts the negation of `is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor 3 (15 / 16)`.

That is, it is not the case that for 3 agents, every pure Nash equilibrium ranking profile in a round-robin picking game with non-negative additive valuations guarantees an allocation that is $(15/16)$-EF1 (envy-free up to one good with approximation factor $15/16$).

Equivalently, there exists some number of goods $m \in \mathbb{N}$, a profile of non-negative additive valuation weights $w : \mathrm{Fin}\ 3 \to \mathrm{Fin}\ m \to \mathbb{R}$, and a profile of rankings $\mathrm{rank} : \mathrm{Fin}\ 3 \to (\mathrm{Fin}\ m \simeq \mathrm{Fin}\ m)$ such that:
1. $\mathrm{rank}$ is a pure Nash equilibrium of the round-robin picking sequence (no agent $i$ can unilaterally change their reported ranking to obtain a bundle with strictly higher value according to their additive valuation), yet
2. The resulting allocation is not $(15/16)$-EF1: there exist distinct agents $i, j \in \mathrm{Fin}\ 3$ where agent $j$'s allocated bundle $A(j)$ is nonempty, and for all goods $g \in A(j)$, $(15/16) \cdot v_i(A(j) \setminus \{g\}) > v_i(A(i))$.

declarations.name: code_transmissions_cross_cut_le
declarations.informal: In a causal linear network code on net, the number of transmissions whose endpoints are separated by a vertex set S is at most T * cutCapacity net S.
declarations.statement:
theorem code_transmissions_cross_cut_le
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K)
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (S : Finset V) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin code.M => (code.snd m ∈ S) ≠ (code.rcv m ∈ S))).card : ℝ)
      ≤ (code.T : ℝ) * cutCapacity net S
declarations.source:
/-- The number of transmissions of a code crossing a cut is at most T times the cut capacity. -/
theorem code_transmissions_cross_cut_le
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K)
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (S : Finset V) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin code.M => (code.snd m ∈ S) ≠ (code.rcv m ∈ S))).card : ℝ)
      ≤ (code.T : ℝ) * cutCapacity net S := by
  let A := Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin code.M => (code.snd m ∈ S) ≠ (code.rcv m ∈ S))
  let g : Fin code.M → V × V := fun m =>
    (if code.snd m ∈ S then code.snd m else code.rcv m,
     if code.snd m ∈ S then code.rcv m else code.snd m)
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo g (↑A) (↑(S ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset V))) := by
    intro m hm
    rw [Finset.mem_coe] at hm ⊢
    rw [Finset.mem_product]
    refine ⟨?_, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    dsimp [A] at hm
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hm
    obtain ⟨_, hdiff⟩ := hm
    dsimp [g]
    split_ifs with hs
    · exact hs
    · by_contra hc
      apply hdiff
      simp [hs, hc]
  have hsum : (A.card : ℝ) = ∑ p ∈ S ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset V), ((A.filter (fun m => g m = p)).card : ℝ) := by
    have h := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hmaps
    norm_cast
  rw [hsum, Finset.sum_product]
  have h_le : (∑ u ∈ S, ∑ v : V, ((A.filter (fun m => g m = (u, v))).card : ℝ))
      ≤ ∑ u ∈ S, ∑ v : V, (if v ∈ S then 0 else (code.T : ℝ) * net.cap s(u, v)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro u _
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro v _
    split_ifs with hv
    · have hempty : A.filter (fun m => g m = (u, v)) = ∅ := by
        rw [Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
        intro m hm hgm
        dsimp [A] at hm
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hm
        obtain ⟨_, hdiff⟩ := hm
        dsimp [g] at hgm
        split_ifs at hgm with hs
        · injection hgm with _ h2
          rw [← h2] at hv
          apply hdiff
          simp [hs, hv]
        · injection hgm with _ h2
          rw [← h2] at hv
          exact hs hv
      rw [hempty, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
    · have hsub : A.filter (fun m => g m = (u, v)) ⊆
          Finset.univ.filter (fun m => s(code.snd m, code.rcv m) = s(u, v)) := by
        intro m hm
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hm ⊢
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨_, hgm⟩ := hm
        dsimp [g] at hgm
        split_ifs at hgm with hs
        · injection hgm with hu hv'
          rw [← hu, ← hv']
        · injection hgm with hu hv'
          rw [← hu, ← hv', Sym2.eq_swap]
      have hcard : ((A.filter (fun m => g m = (u, v))).card : ℝ) ≤
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun m => s(code.snd m, code.rcv m) = s(u, v))).card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub
      exact le_trans hcard (code.cap_le s(u, v))
  refine le_trans h_le ?_
  dsimp [cutCapacity]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply le_of_eq
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  split_ifs with hv
  · ring
  · ring

declarations.name: picking_prefix_state
declarations.informal: The state of a picking-sequence run after its first s turns: the bundle map together with the set of already allocated items, obtained by folding picking_turn over the first s entries of the sequence with each agent's bid as her ranking.
declarations.statement:
def picking_prefix_state {N G : Type*} [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq G] {m : ℕ}
    (seq : List N) (rank : N → Fin m ≃ G) (s : ℕ) : (N → Finset G) × Finset G

declarations.name: picking_phi_entry
declarations.informal: The coordinate phi_s of the potential of arXiv:2610.23040 (proof of Thm 3.13): at turn s the acting agent takes the highest-ranked item not yet allocated; phi_s is the 0-based position of that item in her bid (value 0 if turn s does not exist).
declarations.statement:
def picking_phi_entry {N G : Type*} [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq G] {m : ℕ}
    (seq : List N) (rank : N → Fin m ≃ G) (s : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- Paper's potential coordinate phi_s: the 0-based rank, in the acting agent's bid, of the item she takes at turn s. -/
def picking_phi_entry {N G : Type*} [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq G] {m : ℕ}
    (seq : List N) (rank : N → Fin m ≃ G) (s : ℕ) : ℕ := match seq[s]? with
  | none => 0
  | some a =>
      match (List.ofFn ⇑(rank a)).find? (fun g => decide (g ∉ (picking_prefix_state seq rank s).2)) with
      | none => 0
      | some g => ((rank a).symm g).val

declarations.name: round_robin_phi_vector
declarations.informal: The potential of arXiv:2610.23040 (Thm 3.13) for Round Robin with n agents and m goods: the vector Phi(r) = (phi_0(r), ..., phi_{m-1}(r)) of the 0-based ranks of the items selected at each of the m turns.
declarations.statement: def round_robin_phi_vector {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (m : ℕ) (rank : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m) : List ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- The lexicographic potential Phi for the Round-Robin sequence. -/
def round_robin_phi_vector {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (m : ℕ) (rank : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m) : List ℕ := List.ofFn (fun s : Fin m => picking_phi_entry (round_robin_sequence n m) rank s.val)

declarations.name: iterated_round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_zero_of_card_le
declarations.informal: When the number of goods m is at most the number of agents n, for any initial preference profile pref : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m and non-negative additive valuations v : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ (with v i g ≥ 0 for all i, g) strictly consistent with pref (with v i (pref i l) < v i (pref i k) whenever k < l), any execution f : ℕ → (Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m) starting at f 0 = pref of T steps of iterated Round Robin under item-preserving swap bids (irr_step) must have length T = 0.
declarations.statement:
theorem iterated_round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_zero_of_card_le (n m : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hm : m ≤ n)
    (pref : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m) (v : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i g, 0 ≤ v i g)
    (hcons : ∀ (i : Fin n) (k l : Fin m), k < l → v i (pref i l) < v i (pref i k))
    (f : ℕ → (Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m)) (hf0 : f 0 = pref) (T : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ t < T, irr_step v (round_robin_sequence n m)
      (is_item_preserving_swap_bid (round_robin_sequence n m)) (f t) (f (t + 1))) :
    T = 0
declarations.source:
theorem iterated_round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_zero_of_card_le_seq_count_le_one
    (n m : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hm : m ≤ n) (a : Fin n) :
    (round_robin_sequence n m).count a ≤ 1 := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun (t : Fin m) => (⟨t.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos n)⟩ : Fin n)) := by
    intro x y hxy
    simp only [Fin.mk.injEq] at hxy
    have hx : x.val < n := lt_of_lt_of_le x.isLt hm
    have hy : y.val < n := lt_of_lt_of_le y.isLt hm
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hy] at hxy
    ext
    exact hxy
  have hnodup : (round_robin_sequence n m).Nodup := by
    unfold round_robin_sequence
    exact List.nodup_ofFn.mpr hinj
  exact List.nodup_iff_count_le_one.mp hnodup a

theorem iterated_round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_zero_of_card_le_card_foldl_le
    {N G : Type*} [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq G]
    (L : N → List G) (l : List N) (a : N) (st : (N → Finset G) × Finset G) :
    ((List.foldl (fun st a => picking_turn (L a) a st) st l).1 a).card ≤ (st.1 a).card + l.count a := by
  induction l generalizing st with
  | nil => simp
  | cons h t ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.count_cons]
    have ih_st := ih (picking_turn (L h) h st)
    have hstep : ((picking_turn (L h) h st).1 a).card ≤ (st.1 a).card + if (h == a) = true then 1 else 0 := by
      unfold picking_turn
      split
      · next g hfind =>
        dsimp only
        by_cases ha : h = a
        · subst ha
          rw [Function.update_self]
          simp only [beq_self_eq_true, ite_true]
          exact Finset.card_insert_le _ _
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm ha)]
          have : (h == a) = false := beq_false_of_ne ha
          simp [this]
      · simp
    omega

/-- When m ≤ n, iterated Round Robin under item-preserving swaps terminates immediately with 0 manipulations. -/
theorem iterated_round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_zero_of_card_le (n m : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hm : m ≤ n)
    (pref : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m) (v : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i g, 0 ≤ v i g)
    (hcons : ∀ (i : Fin n) (k l : Fin m), k < l → v i (pref i l) < v i (pref i k))
    (f : ℕ → (Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m)) (hf0 : f 0 = pref) (T : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ t < T, irr_step v (round_robin_sequence n m)
      (is_item_preserving_swap_bid (round_robin_sequence n m)) (f t) (f (t + 1))) :
    T = 0 := by
  by_contra hT
  have hT0 : 0 < T := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hT
  have hstep := hf 0 hT0
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨r, hadm, hlt⟩, -⟩ := hstep
  obtain ⟨k, l, hkl, hr, hg1, hg2⟩ := hadm
  set seq := round_robin_sequence n m
  have hcount : seq.count i ≤ 1 :=
    iterated_round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_zero_of_card_le_seq_count_le_one n m hm i
  have h0 : (((fun _ : Fin n => (∅ : Finset (Fin m))), (∅ : Finset (Fin m))).1 i).card = 0 := by simp
  have hcard1 : (picking_sequence_outcome seq (f 0) i).card ≤ 1 := by
    have hcard := iterated_round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_zero_of_card_le_card_foldl_le
      (fun a => List.ofFn (f 0 a)) seq i (fun _ => ∅, ∅)
    rw [h0] at hcard
    exact hcard.trans (by omega)
  have hcard2 : (picking_sequence_outcome seq (Function.update (f 0) i r) i).card ≤ 1 := by
    have hcard := iterated_round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_zero_of_card_le_card_foldl_le
      (fun a => List.ofFn (Function.update (f 0) i r a)) seq i (fun _ => ∅, ∅)
    rw [h0] at hcard
    exact hcard.trans (by omega)
  set g := (f 0 i) k
  have eA : picking_sequence_outcome seq (f 0) i = {g} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
    exact ⟨fun hx => Finset.card_le_one.mp hcard1 x hx g hg1, fun hx => hx ▸ hg1⟩
  have eB : picking_sequence_outcome seq (Function.update (f 0) i r) i = {g} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
    exact ⟨fun hx => Finset.card_le_one.mp hcard2 x hx g hg2, fun hx => hx ▸ hg2⟩
  rw [eA, eB] at hlt
  exact lt_irrefl _ hlt

declarations.name: brgc_word
declarations.informal: The binary reflected Gray code word of rank t, read as a binary number: g(t) = t xor floor(t/2).
declarations.statement: def brgc_word (t : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- The binary reflected Gray code word of rank t, read as a binary number: g(t) = t xor floor(t/2). -/
def brgc_word (t : ℕ) : ℕ := t ^^^ (t / 2)
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.24758 (Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces), Conjecture 1 (prime case of a conjecture from 2007), Sec. 1; the BRGC g(t) = t xor floor(t/2) of Sec. 1

declarations.name: bitword_rotate
declarations.informal: Cyclic rotation of an n-bit word x (a number below 2^n) by one position: the word is shifted up and its top bit moves to the bottom.
declarations.statement: def bitword_rotate (n x : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- Cyclic rotation of an n-bit word x (a number below 2^n) by one position: the word is shifted up and its top bit moves to the bottom. -/
def bitword_rotate (n x : ℕ) : ℕ := (2 * x) % 2 ^ n + x / 2 ^ (n - 1)
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.24758 (Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces), Conjecture 1 (prime case of a conjecture from 2007), Sec. 1; cyclic shift of words

declarations.name: bitword_is_rotation
declarations.informal: The n-bit word y is a cyclic rotation of the n-bit word x, i.e. x and y lie in the same binary necklace.
declarations.statement: def bitword_is_rotation (n x y : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- The n-bit word y is a cyclic rotation of the n-bit word x, i.e. x and y lie in the same binary necklace. -/
def bitword_is_rotation (n x y : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ r < n, (bitword_rotate n)^[r] x = y
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.24758 (Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces), Conjecture 1 (prime case of a conjecture from 2007), Sec. 1; necklaces as classes under cyclic shift

declarations.name: brgc_necklace_first_rank
declarations.informal: t is the BRGC rank of the first occurrence of a nonconstant binary necklace of length n: t < 2^n, the word g(t) is neither 0^n nor 1^n, and no smaller rank s gives a word g(s) in the same necklace. The list D_n orders the nonconstant necklaces by these ranks.
declarations.statement: def brgc_necklace_first_rank (n t : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- t is the BRGC rank of the first occurrence of a nonconstant binary necklace of length n: t < 2^n, the word g(t) is neither 0^n nor 1^n, and no smaller rank s gives a word g(s) in the same necklace. The list D_n orders the nonconstant necklaces by these ranks. -/
def brgc_necklace_first_rank (n t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  t < 2 ^ n ∧ brgc_word t ≠ 0 ∧ brgc_word t ≠ 2 ^ n - 1 ∧
    ∀ s < t, ¬ bitword_is_rotation n (brgc_word s) (brgc_word t)
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.24758 (Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces), Conjecture 1 (prime case of a conjecture from 2007), Sec. 1; first occurrences and the list D_n

declarations.name: bitword_necklace_adjacent

declarations.statement: def bitword_necklace_adjacent (n x y : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.24758 (Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces), Conjecture 1 (prime case of a conjecture from 2007), Sec. 1; the necklace graph Q_n

declarations.name: digraph_common_out_count
declarations.informal: c_ij: the number of common out-neighbours of the vertices i and j of a digraph on Fin n.
declarations.statement:
def digraph_common_out_count {n : ℕ} (D : Digraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel D.Adj]
    (i j : Fin n) : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- c_ij: the number of common out-neighbours of the vertices i and j of a digraph on Fin n. -/
def digraph_common_out_count {n : ℕ} (D : Digraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel D.Adj]
    (i j : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => D.Adj i v ∧ D.Adj j v)).card
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.25886 (Extremal arborescences in graph orientations), Conjecture 6.1; the counts c_ij of Sec. 6

declarations.name: digraph_out_count
declarations.informal: The out-degree of the vertex v of a digraph on Fin n.
declarations.statement: def digraph_out_count {n : ℕ} (D : Digraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel D.Adj] (v : Fin n) : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- The out-degree of the vertex v of a digraph on Fin n. -/
def digraph_out_count {n : ℕ} (D : Digraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel D.Adj] (v : Fin n) : ℕ := (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => D.Adj v w)).card
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.25886 (Extremal arborescences in graph orientations), Conjecture 6.1; outdegrees

declarations.name: digraph_arborescence_count_at
declarations.informal: a_r(D): the number of spanning arborescences of D directed towards the root r. Each is recorded by its successor map p: p r = r, every vertex v other than r has the arc v -> p v, and iterating p from any vertex reaches r (so the arcs form a spanning tree oriented towards r).
declarations.statement:
def digraph_arborescence_count_at {n : ℕ} (D : Digraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel D.Adj]
    (r : Fin n) : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- a_r(D): the number of spanning arborescences of D directed towards the root r. Each is recorded by its successor map p: p r = r, every vertex v other than r has the arc v -> p v, and iterating p from any vertex reaches r (so the arcs form a spanning tree oriented towards r). -/
def digraph_arborescence_count_at {n : ℕ} (D : Digraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel D.Adj]
    (r : Fin n) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin n → Fin n =>
    p r = r ∧ (∀ v, v ≠ r → D.Adj v (p v)) ∧ ∀ v, p^[n] v = r)).card
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.25886 (Extremal arborescences in graph orientations), Conjecture 6.1; the rooted counts a_r(D) of Sec. 1

declarations.name: digraph_arborescence_count
declarations.informal: tau(D): the total number of arborescences of D, the sum of a_r(D) over all roots r.
declarations.statement: def digraph_arborescence_count {n : ℕ} (D : Digraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel D.Adj] : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- tau(D): the total number of arborescences of D, the sum of a_r(D) over all roots r. -/
def digraph_arborescence_count {n : ℕ} (D : Digraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel D.Adj] : ℕ := ∑ r, digraph_arborescence_count_at D r
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.25886 (Extremal arborescences in graph orientations), Conjecture 6.1; tau(D) of Sec. 1

declarations.name: digraph_arborescence_count_at_sanity
declarations.informal: Sanity check: on two vertices, the digraph with no arcs has no arborescence towards 0, and the complete digraph (with loops) has exactly one.

declarations.name: perm_offset_avoiding_count
declarations.informal: a_S(n): the number of S-avoiding permutations of an n-element set, i.e. permutations pi of {0, ..., n-1} with pi(i) - i - s not divisible by n for every i and every s in S. With S = {-1, 0} this is the menage number U(n).
declarations.statement: def perm_offset_avoiding_count (n : ℕ) (S : Finset ℤ) : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- a_S(n): the number of S-avoiding permutations of an n-element set, i.e. permutations pi of {0, ..., n-1} with pi(i) - i - s not divisible by n for every i and every s in S. With S = {-1, 0} this is the menage number U(n). -/
def perm_offset_avoiding_count (n : ℕ) (S : Finset ℤ) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter (fun π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) =>
    ∀ i : Fin n, ∀ s ∈ S, ¬ ((n : ℤ) ∣ ((π i : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - s))).card
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.23958 (Unranking S-avoiding permutations with two forbidden offsets), Sec. 1 (S-avoiding permutations; U(n) = a_{-1,0}(n)); indices shifted to {0, ..., n-1}, which does not change the condition mod n

declarations.name: perm_offset_avoiding_count_four

declarations.statement:
theorem perm_offset_avoiding_count_four :

declarations.source:
theorem perm_offset_avoiding_count_four :

declarations.name: simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling
declarations.informal: An (m,k)-radio labeling of G: each vertex gets a set of m nonnegative integer labels, and for any (possibly equal) vertices x, y and labels a of x, b of y with (x, a) ≠ (y, b), |a - b| >= k + 1 - d(x, y).
declarations.statement:
def simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (m k : ℕ)
    (f : V → Finset ℕ) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- An (m,k)-radio labeling of G: each vertex gets a set of m nonnegative integer labels, and for any (possibly equal) vertices x, y and labels a of x, b of y with (x, a) ≠ (y, b), |a - b| >= k + 1 - d(x, y). -/
def simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (m k : ℕ)
    (f : V → Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ v, (f v).card = m) ∧ ∀ x y, ∀ a ∈ f x, ∀ b ∈ f y, (x, a) ≠ (y, b) →
    (k + 1 : ℤ) - G.dist x y ≤ |(a : ℤ) - b|
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.25863 (On Multi-label radio Labelings of Graphs), Sec. 1 (definition of (m,k)-radio labelings)

declarations.name: multi_label_span
declarations.informal: The span of a multi-labeling: the largest label used minus the smallest (written as the largest difference b - a over all pairs of labels).
declarations.statement: def multi_label_span {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (f : V → Finset ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.25863 (On Multi-label radio Labelings of Graphs), Sec. 1 (span)

declarations.name: simple_graph_multi_radio_number
declarations.informal: The (m,k)-radio number lambda_k^m(G): the least span of an (m,k)-radio labeling of G.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def simple_graph_multi_radio_number {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (m k : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.source:
/-- The (m,k)-radio number lambda_k^m(G): the least span of an (m,k)-radio labeling of G. -/
noncomputable def simple_graph_multi_radio_number {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (m k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {s | ∃ f, simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling G m k f ∧ multi_label_span f = s}
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.25863 (On Multi-label radio Labelings of Graphs), Sec. 1 (radio number)

theorem multi_label_span_sanity :

declarations.name: causal_code_vals_zero_outside
declarations.informal: Let a causal linear code on net have transmission values val satisfying the recurrence for a message msg, where msg vanishes on sessions whose source is outside S and val vanishes on transmissions that leave S. Then val vanishes on every transmission whose receiver is outside S.
declarations.statement:
theorem causal_code_vals_zero_outside
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K)
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (S : Finset V) (msg : K → Fin code.L → F)
    (val : Fin code.M → F)
    (hval : ∀ m, val m = ∑ k, ∑ j, code.α m k j * msg k j + ∑ m', code.β m m' * val m')
    (hmsg : ∀ (k : K) (j : Fin code.L), sess.src k ∉ S → msg k j = 0)
    (hleave : ∀ m : Fin code.M, code.snd m ∈ S → code.rcv m ∉ S → val m = 0) :
    ∀ m : Fin code.M, code.rcv m ∉ S → val m = 0
declarations.source:
/-- Values on a cut that carry no traffic vanish on the far side of the cut. -/
theorem causal_code_vals_zero_outside
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K)
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (S : Finset V) (msg : K → Fin code.L → F)
    (val : Fin code.M → F)
    (hval : ∀ m, val m = ∑ k, ∑ j, code.α m k j * msg k j + ∑ m', code.β m m' * val m')
    (hmsg : ∀ (k : K) (j : Fin code.L), sess.src k ∉ S → msg k j = 0)
    (hleave : ∀ m : Fin code.M, code.snd m ∈ S → code.rcv m ∉ S → val m = 0) :
    ∀ m : Fin code.M, code.rcv m ∉ S → val m = 0 := by
  intro m
  induction m using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | ind m ih =>
    intro hrcv
    by_cases hsnd : code.snd m ∈ S
    · exact hleave m hsnd hrcv
    · rw [hval m]
      have h1 : (∑ k, ∑ j, code.α m k j * msg k j) = (0 : F) := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro k _
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro j _
        by_cases hα : code.α m k j = 0
        · rw [hα, zero_mul]
        · have hsrc := code.snd_local m k j hα
          have hk : sess.src k ∉ S := by
            rw [hsrc]
            exact hsnd
          rw [hmsg k j hk, mul_zero]
      have h2 : (∑ m', code.β m m' * val m') = (0 : F) := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro m' _
        by_cases hβ : code.β m m' = 0
        · rw [hβ, zero_mul]
        · have hlt : m' < m := code.causal m m' hβ
          have hrcv' : code.rcv m' = code.snd m := code.rcv_local m m' hβ
          have hrcv_not : code.rcv m' ∉ S := by
            rw [hrcv']
            exact hsnd
          have hval' : val m' = 0 := ih m' hlt hrcv_not
          rw [hval', mul_zero]
      rw [h1, h2, add_zero]

declarations.name: brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_adjacent_five
declarations.informal: The case n = 5 of the conjecture: consecutive necklaces of D_5 are adjacent in Q_5.
declarations.statement:
theorem brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_adjacent_five :
    ∀ t t' : ℕ, brgc_necklace_first_rank 5 t →
      brgc_necklace_first_rank 5 t' → t < t' →
      (∀ s, t < s → s < t' → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 5 s) →
      bitword_necklace_adjacent 5 (brgc_word t) (brgc_word t')
declarations.source:
instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_adjacent_five_dec_is_rot (n x y : ℕ) :
    Decidable (bitword_is_rotation n x y) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ r < n, (bitword_rotate n)^[r] x = y))

instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_adjacent_five_dec_first_rank (n t : ℕ) :
    Decidable (brgc_necklace_first_rank n t) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (t < 2 ^ n ∧ brgc_word t ≠ 0 ∧ brgc_word t ≠ 2 ^ n - 1 ∧
    ∀ s < t, ¬ bitword_is_rotation n (brgc_word s) (brgc_word t)))

instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_adjacent_five_dec_adj (n x y : ℕ) :
    Decidable (bitword_necklace_adjacent n x y) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ r < n, ∃ i < n, (bitword_rotate n)^[r] x ^^^ y = 2 ^ i))

lemma brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_adjacent_five_fin :
    ∀ (t t' : Fin 32), brgc_necklace_first_rank 5 t.1 →
      brgc_necklace_first_rank 5 t'.1 → t.1 < t'.1 →
      (∀ s : Fin 32, t.1 < s.1 → s.1 < t'.1 → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 5 s.1) →
      bitword_necklace_adjacent 5 (brgc_word t.1) (brgc_word t'.1) := by
  decide

theorem brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_adjacent_five :
    ∀ t t' : ℕ, brgc_necklace_first_rank 5 t →
      brgc_necklace_first_rank 5 t' → t < t' →
      (∀ s, t < s → s < t' → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 5 s) →
      bitword_necklace_adjacent 5 (brgc_word t) (brgc_word t') := by
  intro t t' ht ht' hlt hbetween
  have ht_lt : t < 32 := ht.1
  have ht'_lt : t' < 32 := ht'.1
  exact brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_adjacent_five_fin ⟨t, ht_lt⟩ ⟨t', ht'_lt⟩ ht ht' hlt
    (fun s hs1 hs2 => hbetween s.1 hs1 hs2)
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.24758 (Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces), Conjecture 1 (prime case of a conjecture from 2007), Sec. 1; the case n = 5, verified by computation in the paper

declarations.name: perm_offset_avoiding_count_eq_of_board_equiv
declarations.informal: If bijections sigma (of rows) and rho (of columns) of Fin n carry the forbidden squares of the offset set S exactly onto those of S' -- n divides j - i - s for some s in S iff n divides rho(j) - sigma(i) - s' for some s' in S' -- then a_S(n) = a_{S'}(n): pi -> rho o pi o sigma^-1 is a bijection between the avoiding permutations.
declarations.statement:
theorem perm_offset_avoiding_count_eq_of_board_equiv (n : ℕ) (S S' : Finset ℤ)
    (σ ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (h : ∀ i j : Fin n, (∃ s ∈ S, (n : ℤ) ∣ ((j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - s) ↔
      (∃ s ∈ S', (n : ℤ) ∣ ((ρ j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((σ i : ℕ) : ℤ) - s)) :
    perm_offset_avoiding_count n S = perm_offset_avoiding_count n S'
declarations.source:
theorem perm_offset_avoiding_count_eq_of_board_equiv (n : ℕ) (S S' : Finset ℤ)
    (σ ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (h : ∀ i j : Fin n, (∃ s ∈ S, (n : ℤ) ∣ ((j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - s) ↔
      (∃ s ∈ S', (n : ℤ) ∣ ((ρ j : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((σ i : ℕ) : ℤ) - s)) :
    perm_offset_avoiding_count n S = perm_offset_avoiding_count n S' := by
  unfold perm_offset_avoiding_count
  refine Finset.card_bij (fun π _ => σ.symm.trans (π.trans ρ)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro π hπ
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hπ ⊢
    intro i s hs hdvd
    obtain ⟨s', hs', hd'⟩ := (h (σ.symm i) (π (σ.symm i))).2 ⟨s, hs, by simpa using hdvd⟩
    exact hπ _ s' hs' hd'
  · intro a _ b _ hab
    refine Equiv.ext fun x => ?_
    have := congrArg (fun e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => e (σ x)) hab
    simpa using this
  · intro π' hπ'
    refine ⟨σ.trans (π'.trans ρ.symm), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hπ' ⊢
      intro i s hs hdvd
      obtain ⟨s', hs', hd'⟩ := (h i ((σ.trans (π'.trans ρ.symm)) i)).1 ⟨s, hs, hdvd⟩
      apply hπ' (σ i) s' hs'
      simpa using hd'
    · ext x; simp
declarations.citation: lemma for arXiv:2610.23958 Proposition 6.2 (PR-301): counts of avoiding permutations are invariant under relabelling rows and columns of the board

declarations.name: zmod_mul_unit_half_eq_zero_iff
declarations.informal: In ZMod n, if 2u = 1 then x u = 0 iff x = 0.
declarations.statement:
theorem zmod_mul_unit_half_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} {u : ZMod n} (hu : 2 * u = 1) (x : ZMod n) :
    x * u = 0 ↔ x = 0
declarations.source:
theorem zmod_mul_unit_half_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} {u : ZMod n} (hu : 2 * u = 1) (x : ZMod n) :
    x * u = 0 ↔ x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    calc x = x * (2 * u) := by rw [hu, mul_one]
      _ = 2 * (x * u) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hx, mul_zero]
  · intro hx; rw [hx, zero_mul]

declarations.name: regular_tournament_five_nearly_doubly_regular
declarations.informal: The case k = 1 of the conjecture, in a stronger form: every regular tournament of order 5 is nearly doubly regular (any two distinct vertices have at most one common out-neighbour), so in particular every maximizer is.
declarations.statement:
theorem regular_tournament_five_nearly_doubly_regular (D : Digraph (Fin 5))
    [DecidableRel D.Adj] (hD : digraph_is_tournament D)
    (hreg : ∀ v, digraph_out_count D v = 2) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j → digraph_common_out_count D i j = 0 ∨ digraph_common_out_count D i j = 1
declarations.source:
theorem regular_tournament_five_nearly_doubly_regular (D : Digraph (Fin 5))
    [DecidableRel D.Adj] (hD : digraph_is_tournament D)
    (hreg : ∀ v, digraph_out_count D v = 2) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j → digraph_common_out_count D i j = 0 ∨ digraph_common_out_count D i j = 1 := by
  intro i j hij
  have hsub_i : (Finset.filter (fun v => D.Adj i v ∧ D.Adj j v) Finset.univ) ⊆
      (Finset.filter (fun w => D.Adj i w) Finset.univ) := by
    intro w hw; rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hw ⊢; exact ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1⟩
  have hsub_j : (Finset.filter (fun v => D.Adj i v ∧ D.Adj j v) Finset.univ) ⊆
      (Finset.filter (fun w => D.Adj j w) Finset.univ) := by
    intro w hw; rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hw ⊢; exact ⟨hw.1, hw.2.2⟩
  have hle : digraph_common_out_count D i j ≤ 2 := by
    have h1 := Finset.card_le_card hsub_i
    have h2 := hreg i
    exact h1.trans_eq h2
  have hcases : digraph_common_out_count D i j = 0 ∨
                digraph_common_out_count D i j = 1 ∨
                digraph_common_out_count D i j = 2 := by omega
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
  · left; exact h0
  · right; exact h1
  · exfalso
    have hcard_comm : (Finset.filter (fun v => D.Adj i v ∧ D.Adj j v) Finset.univ).card = 2 := h2
    have hcard_i : (Finset.filter (fun w => D.Adj i w) Finset.univ).card = 2 := hreg i
    have hcard_j : (Finset.filter (fun w => D.Adj j w) Finset.univ).card = 2 := hreg j
    have heq_i : (Finset.filter (fun v => D.Adj i v ∧ D.Adj j v) Finset.univ) =
        (Finset.filter (fun w => D.Adj i w) Finset.univ) := by
      apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub_i
      rw [hcard_comm, hcard_i]
    have heq_j : (Finset.filter (fun v => D.Adj i v ∧ D.Adj j v) Finset.univ) =
        (Finset.filter (fun w => D.Adj j w) Finset.univ) := by
      apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub_j
      rw [hcard_comm, hcard_j]
    have hij_eq : (Finset.filter (fun w => D.Adj i w) Finset.univ) =
        (Finset.filter (fun w => D.Adj j w) Finset.univ) := by
      rw [← heq_i, ← heq_j]
    have htourn := hD.2 i j hij
    by_cases hadj : D.Adj i j
    · have hj_in_i : j ∈ Finset.filter (fun w => D.Adj i w) Finset.univ := by
        rw [Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hadj⟩
      rw [hij_eq] at hj_in_i
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hj_in_i
      exact hD.1 j hj_in_i.2
    · have h_ji : D.Adj j i := by
        by_contra h_not_ji
        apply hadj
        rwa [htourn]
      have hi_in_j : i ∈ Finset.filter (fun w => D.Adj j w) Finset.univ := by
        rw [Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, h_ji⟩
      rw [← hij_eq] at hi_in_j
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi_in_j
      exact hD.1 i hi_in_j.2

declarations.name: perm_offset_avoiding_count_neg_one_one_eq_menage_of_odd
declarations.informal: For odd n >= 3 the number of permutations avoiding the offsets {-1, 1} mod n equals the menage number U(n).
declarations.source:
theorem perm_offset_avoiding_count_neg_one_one_eq_menage_of_odd (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (ho : Odd n) :
    perm_offset_avoiding_count n {-1, 1} = perm_offset_avoiding_count n {-1, 0} := by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := ho
  set N := 2 * m + 1 with hN
  have hu : (2 : ZMod N) * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) = 1 := by
    have : ((N : ℕ) : ZMod N) = 0 := ZMod.natCast_self N
    rw [hN] at this; push_cast at this
    linear_combination this
  have h2m : (2 : ZMod N) * (m : ZMod N) = -1 := by linear_combination hu
  have hcast : ∀ a b : ℕ, (((a : ZMod N) = b) ↔ a % N = b % N) := fun a b =>
    ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' a b N
  have inj : ∀ c : ℕ, (∀ a b : ℕ, a < N → b < N →
      ((a : ZMod N) + c) * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) = ((b : ZMod N) + c) * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) → a = b) := by
    intro c a b ha hb hab
    have h1 : ((a : ZMod N) + c - (b + c)) * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) = 0 := by
      rw [sub_mul, hab, sub_self]
    rw [zmod_mul_unit_half_eq_zero_iff hu, sub_eq_zero, add_left_inj] at h1
    rw [hcast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb] at h1
    exact h1
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by omega
  -- σ i = i (m + 1), ρ j = (j + 2m) (m + 1), mod N
  let fσ : Fin N → Fin N := fun i => ⟨(i.val * (m + 1)) % N, Nat.mod_lt _ hNpos⟩
  let fρ : Fin N → Fin N := fun j => ⟨((j.val + 2 * m) * (m + 1)) % N, Nat.mod_lt _ hNpos⟩
  have vσ : ∀ i, (((fσ i : ℕ) : ZMod N)) = ((i : ℕ) : ZMod N) * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) := by
    intro i; simp [fσ, ZMod.natCast_mod]
  have vρ : ∀ j, (((fρ j : ℕ) : ZMod N)) =
      (((j : ℕ) : ZMod N) + 2 * (m : ZMod N)) * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) := by
    intro j; simp [fρ, ZMod.natCast_mod]
  have injσ : Function.Injective fσ := by
    intro a b hab
    have := congrArg (fun x : Fin N => ((x : ℕ) : ZMod N)) hab
    simp only [vσ] at this
    exact Fin.ext (inj 0 a b a.isLt b.isLt (by simpa using this))
  have injρ : Function.Injective fρ := by
    intro a b hab
    have := congrArg (fun x : Fin N => ((x : ℕ) : ZMod N)) hab
    simp only [vρ] at this
    exact Fin.ext (inj (2 * m) a b a.isLt b.isLt (by push_cast; exact this))
  let σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) := Equiv.ofBijective fσ (Finite.injective_iff_bijective.mp injσ)
  let ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) := Equiv.ofBijective fρ (Finite.injective_iff_bijective.mp injρ)
  apply perm_offset_avoiding_count_eq_of_board_equiv N _ _ σ ρ
  intro i j
  have dv : ∀ x : ℤ, (N : ℤ) ∣ x ↔ (x : ZMod N) = 0 := fun x =>
    (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd x N).symm
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, exists_eq_or_imp, exists_eq_left, dv,
    Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_zero]
  simp only [σ, ρ, Equiv.ofBijective_apply]
  rw [vσ, vρ]
  have e1 : ∀ J I : ZMod N, (J + 2 * (m : ZMod N)) * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) - I * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) - -1
      = (J - I + 1) * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) := fun J I => by
    linear_combination ((m : ZMod N) + 1) * h2m - hu
  have e2 : ∀ J I : ZMod N, (J + 2 * (m : ZMod N)) * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) - I * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) - 0
      = (J - I - 1) * ((m : ZMod N) + 1) := fun J I => by
    linear_combination ((m : ZMod N) + 1) * h2m
  rw [e1, e2, zmod_mul_unit_half_eq_zero_iff hu, zmod_mul_unit_half_eq_zero_iff hu]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | h)
    · left; linear_combination h
    · right; linear_combination h
  · rintro (h | h)
    · left; linear_combination h
    · right; linear_combination h
