declarations.name: multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top
declarations.informal: Lower bound: every (m,k)-radio labeling of the complete graph K_n has span at least k(mn - 1).
declarations.statement:
theorem multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top (n m k : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Finset ℕ)
    (hf : simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) m k f) :
    k * (m * n - 1) ≤ multi_label_span f
declarations.source:
lemma multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top_le_span {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (f : V → Finset ℕ)
    (x y : V) (a : ℕ) (ha : a ∈ f x) (b : ℕ) (hb : b ∈ f y) :
    b - a ≤ multi_label_span f := by
  have h1 : b - a ≤ (f y).sup (fun b' => b' - a) :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun b' => b' - a) hb
  have h2 : (f y).sup (fun b' => b' - a) ≤ (f x).sup (fun a' => (f y).sup (fun b' => b' - a')) :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun a' => (f y).sup (fun b' => b' - a')) ha
  have h3 : (f x).sup (fun a' => (f y).sup (fun b' => b' - a')) ≤
      Finset.univ.sup (fun y' => (f x).sup (fun a' => (f y').sup (fun b' => b' - a'))) :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun y' => (f x).sup (fun a' => (f y').sup (fun b' => b' - a'))) (Finset.mem_univ y)
  have h4 : Finset.univ.sup (fun y' => (f x).sup (fun a' => (f y').sup (fun b' => b' - a'))) ≤
      multi_label_span f :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun x' => Finset.univ.sup (fun y' => (f x').sup (fun a' => (f y').sup (fun b' => b' - a')))) (Finset.mem_univ x)
  exact h1.trans (h2.trans (h3.trans h4))

lemma multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top_dist_le_one (n : ℕ) (x y : Fin n) :
    (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).dist x y ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases h : x = y
  · subst h; rw [SimpleGraph.dist_self]; exact zero_le_one
  · rw [SimpleGraph.dist_top_of_ne h]

lemma multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top_injOn (n m k : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Finset ℕ)
    (hf : simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) m k f)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    Set.InjOn (fun (p : (Σ _ : Fin n, ℕ)) => p.2) (↑(Finset.univ.sigma f)) := by
  intro p1 hp1 p2 hp2 h_eq
  obtain ⟨x, a⟩ := p1
  obtain ⟨y, b⟩ := p2
  dsimp at h_eq
  subst h_eq
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_sigma] at hp1 hp2
  by_contra h_ne
  have h_ne' : (x, a) ≠ (y, a) := by
    intro h_c
    apply h_ne
    exact Sigma.ext (Prod.ext_iff.mp h_c).1 (heq_of_eq (Prod.ext_iff.mp h_c).2)
  have h_dist := hf.2 x y a hp1.2 a hp2.2 h_ne'
  simp only [sub_self, abs_zero] at h_dist
  have h_dist_le := multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top_dist_le_one n x y
  omega

lemma multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top_diff_ge (n m k : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Finset ℕ)
    (hf : simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) m k f)
    {x y : Fin n} {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ f x) (hb : b ∈ f y) (hab : a < b) :
    a + k ≤ b := by
  have h_ne : (x, a) ≠ (y, b) := by
    intro h_c
    have : a = b := (Prod.ext_iff.mp h_c).2
    omega
  have h_dist := hf.2 x y a ha b hb h_ne
  have h_top := multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top_dist_le_one n x y
  have h_abs : |(a : ℤ) - b| = (b : ℤ) - a := by
    rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg]
    omega
  rw [h_abs] at h_dist
  omega

theorem multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top (n m k : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Finset ℕ)
    (hf : simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) m k f) :
    k * (m * n - 1) ≤ multi_label_span f := by
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst hk; simp
  by_cases hmn : m * n = 0
  · simp [hmn]
  have hk_pos : 0 < k := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk
  have hk_ge : 1 ≤ k := hk_pos
  set pairs := Finset.univ.sigma f
  set A := pairs.image (fun p => p.2)
  have h_card_pairs : pairs.card = m * n := by
    rw [Finset.card_sigma]
    simp [hf.1, mul_comm]
  have h_inj_pairs := multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top_injOn n m k f hf hk_ge
  have h_card_A : A.card = m * n := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn h_inj_pairs, h_card_pairs]
  have hA_nonempty : A.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  set a_min := A.min' hA_nonempty
  set a_max := A.max' hA_nonempty
  have ha_min_mem : a_min ∈ A := Finset.min'_mem A hA_nonempty
  have ha_max_mem : a_max ∈ A := Finset.max'_mem A hA_nonempty
  obtain ⟨p_min, hp_min, hp_min_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha_min_mem
  obtain ⟨p_max, hp_max, hp_max_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha_max_mem
  rw [Finset.mem_sigma] at hp_min hp_max
  have h_span_ge : a_max - a_min ≤ multi_label_span f := by
    rw [← hp_min_eq, ← hp_max_eq]
    exact multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top_le_span f p_min.1 p_max.1 p_min.2 hp_min.2 p_max.2 hp_max.2
  have h_diff : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, a < b → a + k ≤ b := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    obtain ⟨pa, hpa, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
    obtain ⟨pb, hpb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    rw [Finset.mem_sigma] at hpa hpb
    exact multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top_diff_ge n m k f hf hpa.2 hpb.2 hab
  have h_min : ∀ a ∈ A, a_min ≤ a := fun a ha => Finset.min'_le A a ha
  have h_max : ∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ a_max := fun a ha => Finset.le_max' A a ha
  have h_inj_g : Set.InjOn (fun a => (a - a_min) / k) (↑A) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    dsimp at hab
    rcases lt_trichotomy a b with hlt | heq | hgt
    · have h_step : a + k ≤ b := h_diff a ha b hb hlt
      have h_le : (a - a_min) + k ≤ b - a_min := by
        have := h_min a ha; omega
      have : (a - a_min) / k < (b - a_min) / k := by
        have : (a - a_min) / k + 1 ≤ (b - a_min) / k := by
          rw [← Nat.add_div_right (a - a_min) hk_pos]
          exact Nat.div_le_div_right h_le
        omega
      omega
    · exact heq
    · have h_step : b + k ≤ a := h_diff b hb a ha hgt
      have h_le : (b - a_min) + k ≤ a - a_min := by
        have := h_min b hb; omega
      have : (b - a_min) / k < (a - a_min) / k := by
        have : (b - a_min) / k + 1 ≤ (a - a_min) / k := by
          rw [← Nat.add_div_right (b - a_min) hk_pos]
          exact Nat.div_le_div_right h_le
        omega
      omega
  generalize hd : (a_max - a_min) / k = d
  have h_sub : A.image (fun a => (a - a_min) / k) ⊆ Finset.range (d + 1) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hy
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    have : (a - a_min) / k ≤ d := by
      rw [← hd]
      exact Nat.div_le_div_right (Nat.sub_le_sub_right (h_max a ha) a_min)
    omega
  have h_card_le := Finset.card_le_card h_sub
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn h_inj_g, h_card_A, Finset.card_range] at h_card_le
  have h_mn : m * n - 1 ≤ d := by omega
  have h_mul : k * (m * n - 1) ≤ k * d :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left k h_mn
  have h_div_mul : k * d ≤ a_max - a_min := by
    rw [← hd, mul_comm]
    exact Nat.div_mul_le_self (a_max - a_min) k
  exact (h_mul.trans h_div_mul).trans h_span_ge

declarations.name: bitword_is_aperiodic
declarations.informal: The n-bit word x is aperiodic (primitive): no rotation by 0 < r < n fixes it, i.e. its necklace has n distinct rotations.
declarations.statement: def bitword_is_aperiodic (n x : ℕ) : Prop

declarations.name: bitword_is_aperiodic_sanity
declarations.informal: Sanity check: the 6-bit word 001011 is aperiodic, while 001001 is fixed by rotation by 3.
declarations.statement: theorem bitword_is_aperiodic_sanity : bitword_is_aperiodic 6 11 ∧ ¬ bitword_is_aperiodic 6 9
declarations.source:
theorem bitword_is_aperiodic_sanity : bitword_is_aperiodic 6 11 ∧ ¬ bitword_is_aperiodic 6 9 := by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => h 3 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)⟩
  intro r h0 h6
  interval_cases r <;> decide

declarations.name: exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq
declarations.informal: Upper bound: the labeling f(v_i) = {ik, (n+i)k, ..., ((m-1)n+i)k} is an (m,k)-radio labeling of K_n of span k(mn - 1).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq (n m k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∃ f : Fin n → Finset ℕ, simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) m k f ∧ multi_label_span f = k * (m * n - 1)
declarations.source:
open SimpleGraph

def exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f (n m k : ℕ) (v : Fin n) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.range m).image (fun a => (a * n + (v : ℕ)) * k)

lemma exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_card (n m k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (v : Fin n) :
    (exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f n m k v).card = m := by
  dsimp [exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f]
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective]
  · exact Finset.card_range m
  · intro a b hab
    have h1 : a * n + (v : ℕ) = b * n + (v : ℕ) := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (by omega) hab
    have h2 : a * n = b * n := Nat.add_right_cancel h1
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (by omega) h2

lemma exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_separation (n m k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∀ (x y : Fin n), ∀ a ∈ exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f n m k x,
      ∀ b ∈ exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f n m k y,
      (x, a) ≠ (y, b) → (k : ℤ) + 1 - ((⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).dist x y : ℤ) ≤ |(a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)| := by
  intro x y a ha b hb hne
  rw [exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f, Finset.mem_image] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨ia, hia, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨ib, hib, rfl⟩ := hb
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst hxy
    rw [dist_self, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero]
    have hab : ia ≠ ib := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hne rfl
    have h_eq : (↑((ia * n + (x : ℕ)) * k) : ℤ) - ↑((ib * n + (x : ℕ)) * k) =
        ((ia : ℤ) - (ib : ℤ)) * (n : ℤ) * (k : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have h_n : |(n : ℤ)| = (n : ℤ) := abs_of_nonneg (by omega)
    have h_k : |(k : ℤ)| = (k : ℤ) := abs_of_nonneg (by omega)
    rw [h_n, h_k]
    have h_diff : 1 ≤ |(ia : ℤ) - (ib : ℤ)| := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with hlt | hgt
      · have : (ia : ℤ) - (ib : ℤ) < 0 := by omega
        rw [abs_of_neg this]; omega
      · have : 0 < (ia : ℤ) - (ib : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [abs_of_pos this]; omega
    have hn' : 2 ≤ (n : ℤ) := by omega
    have hk' : 1 ≤ (k : ℤ) := by omega
    have h1 : 2 ≤ |(ia : ℤ) - (ib : ℤ)| * (n : ℤ) := by nlinarith
    have h2 : 2 * (k : ℤ) ≤ (|(ia : ℤ) - (ib : ℤ)| * (n : ℤ)) * (k : ℤ) := by nlinarith
    linarith
  · rw [dist_top_of_ne hxy, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
    have h_ne : ia * n + (x : ℕ) ≠ ib * n + (y : ℕ) := by
      intro h
      have h_mod : (ia * n + (x : ℕ)) % n = (ib * n + (y : ℕ)) % n := by rw [h]
      rw [add_comm (ia * n), Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt x.is_lt] at h_mod
      rw [add_comm (ib * n), Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt y.is_lt] at h_mod
      exact hxy (Fin.ext h_mod)
    have h_eq : (↑((ia * n + (x : ℕ)) * k) : ℤ) - ↑((ib * n + (y : ℕ)) * k) =
        ((ia * n + (x : ℕ) : ℤ) - (ib * n + (y : ℕ) : ℤ)) * (k : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, abs_mul]
    have h_k : |(k : ℤ)| = (k : ℤ) := abs_of_nonneg (by omega)
    rw [h_k]
    have h_diff : 1 ≤ |(ia * n + (x : ℕ) : ℤ) - (ib * n + (y : ℕ) : ℤ)| := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h_ne with hlt | hgt
      · have : (ia * n + (x : ℕ) : ℤ) - (ib * n + (y : ℕ) : ℤ) < 0 := by omega
        rw [abs_of_neg this]; omega
      · have : 0 < (ia * n + (x : ℕ) : ℤ) - (ib * n + (y : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [abs_of_pos this]; omega
    have hk' : 1 ≤ (k : ℤ) := by omega
    nlinarith

lemma exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_span_le (n m k : ℕ) :
    multi_label_span (exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f n m k) ≤ k * (m * n - 1) := by
  dsimp [multi_label_span]
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro x _
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro y _
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro a ha
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro b hb
  rw [exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f, Finset.mem_image] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨ia, hia, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨ib, hib, rfl⟩ := hb
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hia hib
  have hy : (y : ℕ) < n := y.is_lt
  have h1 : ib * n + (y : ℕ) < m * n := by
    have : (ib + 1) * n ≤ m * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right n hib
    calc ib * n + (y : ℕ) < ib * n + n := by omega
    _ = (ib + 1) * n := by ring
    _ ≤ m * n := this
  have h2 : ib * n + (y : ℕ) ≤ m * n - 1 := by omega
  have h3 : (ib * n + (y : ℕ)) * k ≤ (m * n - 1) * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_right k h2
  have h4 : (ib * n + (y : ℕ)) * k - (ia * n + (x : ℕ)) * k ≤ (ib * n + (y : ℕ)) * k := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have h5 : (ib * n + (y : ℕ)) * k - (ia * n + (x : ℕ)) * k ≤ (m * n - 1) * k := h4.trans h3
  rw [mul_comm (m * n - 1) k] at h5
  exact h5

theorem exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq (n m k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∃ f : Fin n → Finset ℕ, simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) m k f ∧ multi_label_span f = k * (m * n - 1) := by
  use exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f n m k
  have h_rl : simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) m k (exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f n m k) := by
    constructor
    · intro v
      exact exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_card n m k hn hk v
    · exact exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_separation n m k hn hk
  refine ⟨h_rl, ?_⟩
  have h_le := exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_span_le n m k
  have h_ge := multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top n m k (exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq_f n m k) h_rl
  exact le_antisymm h_le h_ge

declarations.name: simple_graph_multi_radio_number_top
declarations.informal: For n >= 2, k >= 1 and m >= 1, the (m,k)-radio number of the complete graph K_n is k(mn - 1).
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_multi_radio_number_top (n m k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    simple_graph_multi_radio_number (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) m k = k * (m * n - 1)
declarations.source:
theorem simple_graph_multi_radio_number_top (n m k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    simple_graph_multi_radio_number (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) m k = k * (m * n - 1) := by
  have _ := hm
  dsimp [simple_graph_multi_radio_number]
  rcases exists_radio_labeling_top_span_eq n m k hn hk with ⟨f, hf, hspan⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hmem : multi_label_span f ∈ {s | ∃ f, simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) m k f ∧ multi_label_span f = s} :=
      ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    have hle := Nat.sInf_le hmem
    rwa [hspan] at hle
  · apply le_csInf
    · exact ⟨multi_label_span f, f, hf, rfl⟩
    · rintro b ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
      exact multi_label_span_ge_of_radio_labeling_top n m k g hg

declarations.name: is_single_track_gray_code
declarations.informal: A sequence w of n-bit words is a single-track Gray code of length n and period P if it is periodic with period P, all words within a period are distinct, consecutive words differ in exactly one bit, and every column is a cyclic shift of the first column.
declarations.statement: def is_single_track_gray_code (n P : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- Predicate asserting that w is a single-track Gray code of length n and period P. -/
def is_single_track_gray_code (n P : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ t, w (t + P) = w t) ∧
  (∀ t, w t < 2 ^ n) ∧
  (∀ t₁ t₂, t₁ < P → t₂ < P → w t₁ = w t₂ → t₁ = t₂) ∧
  (∀ t, ∃ i < n, w (t + 1) ^^^ w t = 2 ^ i) ∧
  ∃ h : ℕ → ℕ, h 0 = 0 ∧
    ∀ t, ∀ j < n, Nat.testBit (w t) j = Nat.testBit (w (t + h j)) 0
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.24758: Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces
declarations.reading:
The definition `is_single_track_gray_code n P w` asserts that a sequence `w : ℕ → ℕ` is an n-bit single-track Gray code of period P, meaning that all of the following conditions hold:

1. Periodicity: For all `t : ℕ`, `w (t + P) = w t`.
2. Range: For all `t : ℕ`, `w t < 2 ^ n`.
3. Injectivity on the period: For all `t₁ t₂ : ℕ`, if `t₁ < P`, `t₂ < P`, and `w t₁ = w t₂`, then `t₁ = t₂`.
4. Gray code property: For all `t : ℕ`, there exists some bit position `i < n` such that `w (t + 1) ^^^ w t = 2 ^ i` (i.e., consecutive terms differ by exactly one bit, and that bit index is less than `n`).
5. Single-track property: There exists a shift function `h : ℕ → ℕ` such that `h 0 = 0`, and for all `t : ℕ` and all bit indices `j < n`, the `j`-th bit of `w t` (`Nat.testBit (w t) j`) is equal to the 0-th bit of `w (t + h j)` (`Nat.testBit (w (t + h j)) 0`).

declarations.name: brgc_necklace_order_not_consecutive_adjacent_six
declarations.informal: Primality cannot be dropped from the adjacency conjecture: at n = 6 the consecutive necklaces 001001 and 011011 of D_6 (both periodic) are not adjacent in Q_6. This is the smallest n where it fails.
declarations.statement:
theorem brgc_necklace_order_not_consecutive_adjacent_six :
    ¬ ∀ t t' : ℕ, brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 t → brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 t' → t < t' →
      (∀ s, t < s → s < t' → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 s) →
      bitword_necklace_adjacent 6 (brgc_word t) (brgc_word t')
declarations.source:
instance brgc_necklace_order_not_consecutive_adjacent_six_dec_rot (n x y : ℕ) :
    Decidable (bitword_is_rotation n x y) := by

instance brgc_necklace_order_not_consecutive_adjacent_six_dec_first_rank (n t : ℕ) :
    Decidable (brgc_necklace_first_rank n t) := by
  unfold brgc_necklace_first_rank
  infer_instance

instance brgc_necklace_order_not_consecutive_adjacent_six_dec_adj (n x y : ℕ) :
    Decidable (bitword_necklace_adjacent n x y) := by

theorem brgc_necklace_order_not_consecutive_adjacent_six :
    ¬ ∀ t t' : ℕ, brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 t → brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 t' → t < t' →
      (∀ s, t < s → s < t' → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 s) →
      bitword_necklace_adjacent 6 (brgc_word t) (brgc_word t') := by
  intro H
  have h1 : brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 14 := by decide
  have h2 : brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 18 := by decide
  have h3 : 14 < 18 := by omega
  have h4 : ∀ s, 14 < s → s < 18 → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 s := by
    intro s hs1 hs2
    interval_cases s
    · decide
    · decide
    · decide
  have h5 : ¬ bitword_necklace_adjacent 6 (brgc_word 14) (brgc_word 18) := by decide
  exact h5 (H 14 18 h1 h2 h3 h4)

declarations.name: gray_ordered_necklaces_is_gray_path
declarations.informal: The list D_n of non-constant binary necklaces of length n, ordered by the rank of their first occurrences in the binary reflected Gray code, forms a Gray path in the necklace graph Q_n: consecutive necklaces in this order are adjacent in Q_n.
declarations.statement: def gray_ordered_necklaces_is_gray_path (n : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- The list of non-constant binary necklaces ordered by first occurrence in the binary reflected Gray code forms a Gray path in the necklace graph. -/
def gray_ordered_necklaces_is_gray_path (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ t t' : ℕ, brgc_necklace_first_rank n t → brgc_necklace_first_rank n t' → t < t' →
    (∀ s, t < s → s < t' → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank n s) →
    bitword_necklace_adjacent n (brgc_word t) (brgc_word t')
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.24758: Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces
declarations.reading:
The declaration `gray_ordered_necklaces_is_gray_path` asserts that for a given natural number `n`, and for all natural numbers `t` and `t'`:

If:
1. `t` is the first rank of a necklace in binary reflected Gray code (BRGC) order, meaning:
   - `t < 2^n`,
   - `brgc_word t ≠ 0` (where `brgc_word t = t ^^^ (t / 2)`),
   - `brgc_word t ≠ 2^n - 1`, and
   - for all `s < t`, `brgc_word t` is not an `r`-step cyclic rotation (for any `r < n`) of `brgc_word s`;
2. `t'` is also the first rank of a necklace in BRGC order (satisfying the same four conditions);
3. `t < t'`; and
4. `t` and `t'` are consecutive such ranks, meaning there is no `s` strictly between `t` and `t'` (`t < s` and `s < t'`) that satisfies the first-rank condition;

Then:
`brgc_word t` and `brgc_word t'` are necklace-adjacent, meaning there exist `r < n` and `i < n` such that rotating `brgc_word t` cyclically by `r` steps yields a word whose bitwise XOR with `brgc_word t'` equals `2^i` (that is, some cyclic rotation of `brgc_word t` differs from `brgc_word t'` in exactly bit position `i`).

declarations.name: bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime
declarations.informal: For prime n, every n-bit word other than 0^n and 1^n is aperiodic.
declarations.statement:
theorem bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime (n x : ℕ) (hn : n.Prime) (hx : x < 2 ^ n) (h0 : x ≠ 0)
    (h1 : x ≠ 2 ^ n - 1) : bitword_is_aperiodic n x
declarations.source:
lemma bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_rotate_eq_self {n x : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hx : x < 2 ^ n)
    (h : bitword_rotate n x = x) : x = 0 ∨ x = 2 ^ n - 1 := by
  dsimp [bitword_rotate] at h
  set K := 2 ^ (n - 1)
  have hK : 0 < K := by positivity
  have hM : 2 ^ n = 2 * K := by
    have : n = n - 1 + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hn).symm
    nth_rw 1 [this]
    rw [pow_succ', mul_comm]
  rcases lt_or_ge x K with hlt | hge
  · have hdiv : x / K = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlt
    have h2x : 2 * x < 2 ^ n := by omega
    have hmod : 2 * x % 2 ^ n = 2 * x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h2x
    omega
  · have hdiv : x / K = 1 := by
      apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le
      · omega
      · rw [add_one_mul, one_mul]; omega
    have h2x_ge : 1 * 2 ^ n ≤ 2 * x := by omega
    have h2x_lt : 2 * x < (1 + 1) * 2 ^ n := by omega
    have hd : 2 * x / 2 ^ n = 1 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le h2x_ge h2x_lt
    have hmod : 2 * x % 2 ^ n = 2 * x - 2 ^ n := by
      have hdm := Nat.div_add_mod (2 * x) (2 ^ n)
      rw [hd] at hdm
      omega
    omega

lemma bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_rotate_eq_mod (n x : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 2 ^ n - 1) :
    bitword_rotate n x = (2 * x) % (2 ^ n - 1) ∧
    0 < bitword_rotate n x ∧ bitword_rotate n x < 2 ^ n - 1 := by
  dsimp [bitword_rotate]
  set K := 2 ^ (n - 1)
  have hK_ge : 2 ≤ K := by
    have : 1 ≤ n - 1 := by omega
    calc 2 = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 2 ^ (n - 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) this
  have hM : 2 ^ n = 2 * K := by
    have : n = n - 1 + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ n)).symm
    nth_rw 1 [this]
    rw [pow_succ', mul_comm]
  rcases lt_or_ge x K with hlt | hge
  · have hdiv : x / K = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlt
    have h2x : 2 * x < 2 ^ n := by omega
    have hmod1 : 2 * x % 2 ^ n = 2 * x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h2x
    have h2x' : 2 * x < 2 ^ n - 1 := by omega
    have hmod2 : (2 * x) % (2 ^ n - 1) = 2 * x := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h2x'
    omega
  · have hdiv : x / K = 1 := by
      apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le
      · omega
      · rw [add_one_mul, one_mul]; omega
    have hd1 : 2 * x / 2 ^ n = 1 := by
      apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le
      · omega
      · rw [add_one_mul, one_mul]; omega
    have hmod1 : 2 * x % 2 ^ n = 2 * x - 2 ^ n := by
      have := Nat.div_add_mod (2 * x) (2 ^ n)
      rw [hd1] at this
      omega
    have hd2 : (2 * x) / (2 ^ n - 1) = 1 := by
      apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le
      · omega
      · rw [add_one_mul, one_mul]; omega
    have hmod2 : (2 * x) % (2 ^ n - 1) = 2 * x - 2 ^ n + 1 := by
      have := Nat.div_add_mod (2 * x) (2 ^ n - 1)
      rw [hd2] at this
      omega
    omega

lemma bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_iterate_eq_mod (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (x : ℕ) (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 2 ^ n - 1) (m : ℕ) :
    (bitword_rotate n)^[m] x = (2 ^ m * x) % (2 ^ n - 1) ∧
    0 < (bitword_rotate n)^[m] x ∧ (bitword_rotate n)^[m] x < 2 ^ n - 1 := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id_eq, pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx1]
    exact ⟨rfl, hx0, hx1⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ', Function.comp_apply]
    obtain ⟨ih_eq, ih_pos, ih_lt⟩ := ih
    have hstep := bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_rotate_eq_mod n ((bitword_rotate n)^[m] x) hn ih_pos ih_lt
    refine ⟨?_, hstep.2.1, hstep.2.2⟩
    rw [hstep.1, ih_eq]
    rw [Nat.mul_mod_mod, ← mul_assoc, pow_succ, mul_comm 2 (2 ^ m)]

lemma bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_pow_mul_add_one_mul_mod (n q x : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    (2 ^ (q * n + 1) * x) % (2 ^ n - 1) = (2 * x) % (2 ^ n - 1) := by
  have hM : 1 < 2 ^ n - 1 := by
    have : 4 ≤ 2 ^ n := by
      calc 4 = 2 ^ 2 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hn
    omega
  have h_mod : (2 ^ n) % (2 ^ n - 1) = 1 := by
    have : 2 ^ n = (2 ^ n - 1) + 1 := by omega
    nth_rw 1 [this]
    rw [Nat.add_mod_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  have h_pow_mod : ((2 ^ n) ^ q) % (2 ^ n - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [Nat.pow_mod, h_mod, one_pow, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hM]
  have h2k : 2 ^ (q * n + 1) = ((2 ^ n) ^ q) * 2 := by
    rw [pow_add, pow_one, mul_comm q n, pow_mul, mul_comm]
  rw [h2k, mul_assoc, Nat.mul_mod, h_pow_mod, one_mul, Nat.mod_mod]

lemma bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_iterate_mul_apply {α : Type*} (f : α → α) (x : α) (r : ℕ) (h : f^[r] x = x) (m : ℕ) :
    f^[m * r] x = x := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [add_one_mul, Function.iterate_add, Function.comp_apply, h, ih]

theorem bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime (n x : ℕ) (hn : n.Prime) (hx : x < 2 ^ n) (h0 : x ≠ 0)
    (h1 : x ≠ 2 ^ n - 1) : bitword_is_aperiodic n x := by
  intro r hr0 hrn hfix
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := hn.two_le
  have hx_pos : 0 < x := by omega
  have hx_lt : x < 2 ^ n - 1 := by omega
  have hcop : r.Coprime n := by
    have hdvd : ¬ n ∣ r := Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt hr0 hrn
    exact (hn.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hdvd).symm
  obtain ⟨m, hm_lt, hm_mod⟩ := Nat.exists_mul_mod_eq_one_of_coprime hcop hn2
  have h_div_mod : m * r = (r * m / n) * n + 1 := by
    have hdiv := (Nat.div_add_mod (r * m) n).symm
    rw [hm_mod, mul_comm n] at hdiv
    rw [mul_comm m r]
    exact hdiv
  set q := r * m / n
  have hfix_k : (bitword_rotate n)^[m * r] x = x :=
    bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_iterate_mul_apply (bitword_rotate n) x r hfix m
  have h_mod_k := (bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_iterate_eq_mod n hn2 x hx_pos hx_lt (m * r)).1
  rw [h_div_mod] at h_mod_k hfix_k
  rw [bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_pow_mul_add_one_mul_mod n q x hn2] at h_mod_k
  have h_rot1 := (bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_rotate_eq_mod n x hn2 hx_pos hx_lt).1
  rw [← h_rot1] at h_mod_k
  rw [h_mod_k] at hfix_k
  have h_or := bitword_is_aperiodic_of_prime_rotate_eq_self (by omega) hx hfix_k
  rcases h_or with hx0 | hx1'
  · exact h0 hx0
  · exact h1 hx1'
declarations.citation: for brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent: it gives the prime case of arXiv:2610.24758 Conjecture 1

declarations.name: necklace_graph_has_hamilton_cycle
declarations.informal: There exists an indexing cycle of the non-constant necklaces of length n such that the first m = (2^n - 2) / n values are distinct valid first-occurrence Gray code ranks of non-constant necklaces, every first-occurrence Gray code rank of a non-constant necklace of length n appears at some index i < m, and for every i < m, the necklace of cycle i is adjacent in the necklace graph to the necklace of cycle ((i + 1) % m).
declarations.statement: def necklace_graph_has_hamilton_cycle (n : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- The necklace graph Q_n has a Hamilton cycle visiting all non-constant binary necklaces of length n in order. -/
def necklace_graph_has_hamilton_cycle (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ cycle : ℕ → ℕ,
    let m := (2 ^ n - 2) / n
    (∀ i < m, brgc_necklace_first_rank n (cycle i)) ∧
    (∀ i < m, ∀ j < m, cycle i = cycle j → i = j) ∧
    (∀ t, brgc_necklace_first_rank n t → ∃ i < m, cycle i = t) ∧
    ∀ i < m,
      bitword_necklace_adjacent n (brgc_word (cycle i))
        (brgc_word (cycle ((i + 1) % m)))
declarations.citation: arXiv:2610.24758: Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces

declarations.statement:

    ∀ t t' : ℕ, brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 t → brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 t' → t < t' →
      (∀ s, t < s → s < t' → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 s) →
      bitword_is_aperiodic 6 (brgc_word t) → bitword_is_aperiodic 6 (brgc_word t') →
      bitword_necklace_adjacent 6 (brgc_word t) (brgc_word t')
declarations.source:
instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_six_dec_rot (n x y : ℕ) :
    Decidable (bitword_is_rotation n x y) := by
  unfold bitword_is_rotation
  infer_instance

instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_six_dec_rank (n t : ℕ) :
    Decidable (brgc_necklace_first_rank n t) := by
  unfold brgc_necklace_first_rank
  infer_instance

instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_six_dec_adj (n x y : ℕ) :
    Decidable (bitword_necklace_adjacent n x y) := by
  unfold bitword_necklace_adjacent
  infer_instance

instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_six_dec_aperiodic (n x : ℕ) :
    Decidable (bitword_is_aperiodic n x) :=
  decidable_of_iff (∀ r < n, 0 < r → (bitword_rotate n)^[r] x ≠ x) ⟨
    fun h r hr0 hrn => h r hrn hr0,
    fun h r hrn hr0 => h r hr0 hrn
  ⟩

theorem brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_six_fin :
    ∀ t t' : Fin 64,
      brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 t.1 → brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 t'.1 → t.1 < t'.1 →
      (∀ s : Fin 64, t.1 < s.1 → s.1 < t'.1 → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 s.1) →
      bitword_is_aperiodic 6 (brgc_word t.1) → bitword_is_aperiodic 6 (brgc_word t'.1) →
      bitword_necklace_adjacent 6 (brgc_word t.1) (brgc_word t'.1) := by
  decide

theorem brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_six :
    ∀ t t' : ℕ, brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 t → brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 t' → t < t' →
      (∀ s, t < s → s < t' → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 6 s) →
      bitword_is_aperiodic 6 (brgc_word t) → bitword_is_aperiodic 6 (brgc_word t') →
      bitword_necklace_adjacent 6 (brgc_word t) (brgc_word t') := by
  intro t t' ht ht' hlt hbetween hap hap'
  have ht_lt : t < 64 := ht.1
  have ht'_lt : t' < 64 := ht'.1
  exact brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_six_fin
    ⟨t, ht_lt⟩ ⟨t', ht'_lt⟩ ht ht' hlt
    (fun s hs1 hs2 => hbetween s.1 hs1 hs2) hap hap'

declarations.name: simple_graph_path_graph_walk_length_ge
declarations.informal: Every walk in the path graph P_n from u to v has length at least |u - v|.
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_path_graph_walk_length_ge {n : ℕ} {u v : Fin n}
    (p : (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Walk u v) : |((u : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((v : ℕ) : ℤ)| ≤ p.length
declarations.source:
theorem simple_graph_path_graph_walk_length_ge {n : ℕ} {u v : Fin n}
    (p : (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Walk u v) : |((u : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((v : ℕ) : ℤ)| ≤ p.length := by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons h p ih =>
    rename_i a b c
    rw [SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj] at h
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    have h' : ((a : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = ((b : ℕ) : ℤ) ∨ ((b : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = ((a : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
    rcases abs_cases (((a : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((c : ℕ) : ℤ)) with ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩ <;>
    rcases abs_cases (((b : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((c : ℕ) : ℤ)) with ⟨h2, _⟩ | ⟨h2, _⟩ <;>
    · rw [h1]; rw [h2] at ih; omega

declarations.name: simple_graph_path_graph_dist_ge
declarations.informal: In the path graph P_n the distance between u and v is at least |u - v|.
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_path_graph_dist_ge {n : ℕ} (u v : Fin n) :
    |((u : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((v : ℕ) : ℤ)| ≤ (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).dist u v
declarations.source:
theorem simple_graph_path_graph_dist_ge {n : ℕ} (u v : Fin n) :
    |((u : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((v : ℕ) : ℤ)| ≤ (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).dist u v := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (SimpleGraph.pathGraph_preconnected n u v).exists_walk_length_eq_dist
  rw [← hp]
  exact simple_graph_path_graph_walk_length_ge p

declarations.name: int_four_sub_abs_le_abs
declarations.informal: For integers d, e: if e >= 4 - d or e <= d - 4 when d >= 0, and e >= 4 + d or e <= -4 - d when d < 0, then 4 - |d| <= |e|.
declarations.statement:
theorem int_four_sub_abs_le_abs {d e : ℤ} (h1 : 0 ≤ d → (4 - d ≤ e ∨ e ≤ d - 4))
    (h2 : d < 0 → (4 + d ≤ e ∨ e ≤ -4 - d)) : 4 - |d| ≤ |e|
declarations.source:
theorem int_four_sub_abs_le_abs {d e : ℤ} (h1 : 0 ≤ d → (4 - d ≤ e ∨ e ≤ d - 4))
    (h2 : d < 0 → (4 + d ≤ e ∨ e ≤ -4 - d)) : 4 - |d| ≤ |e| := by
  rcases abs_cases d with ⟨e1, hd⟩ | ⟨e1, hd⟩ <;> rcases abs_cases e with ⟨e2, he⟩ | ⟨e2, he⟩ <;>
    rw [e1, e2] <;> [have := h1 hd; have := h1 hd; have := h2 hd; have := h2 hd] <;> omega

declarations.name: path_radio_label_four_mul_add_three_sep
declarations.informal: The labels of the explicit labeling of P_{4m+3} (odd x: x + 4a; even x: 2((x/2) mod 2) + 4a, plus 4m when a >= x/4) at vertices x, y with indices a, b (distinct if x = y) differ by at least 4 - |x - y|.
declarations.statement:
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
theorem path_radio_label_four_mul_add_three_sep (m x y a b : ℕ) (hx : x < 4 * m + 3)
    (hy : y < 4 * m + 3) (ha : a < m) (hb : b < m) (hne : x ≠ y ∨ a ≠ b) :
    (4 : ℤ) - |(x : ℤ) - y| ≤
      |(((if x % 2 = 1 then x + 4 * a else 2 * (x / 2 % 2) + 4 * a + if a < x / 4 then 0 else 4 * m) :
          ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (((if y % 2 = 1 then y + 4 * b else 2 * (y / 2 % 2) + 4 * b + if b < y / 4 then 0 else 4 * m) :
          ℕ) : ℤ)|
declarations.source:
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
theorem path_radio_label_four_mul_add_three_sep (m x y a b : ℕ) (hx : x < 4 * m + 3)
    (hy : y < 4 * m + 3) (ha : a < m) (hb : b < m) (hne : x ≠ y ∨ a ≠ b) :
    (4 : ℤ) - |(x : ℤ) - y| ≤
      |(((if x % 2 = 1 then x + 4 * a else 2 * (x / 2 % 2) + 4 * a + if a < x / 4 then 0 else 4 * m) :
          ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (((if y % 2 = 1 then y + 4 * b else 2 * (y / 2 % 2) + 4 * b + if b < y / 4 then 0 else 4 * m) :
          ℕ) : ℤ)| := by
  apply int_four_sub_abs_le_abs <;> intro hs <;> split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> omega

declarations.name: simple_graph_path_radio_labeling_four_mul_add_three
declarations.informal: For m >= 1, the labeling of the path P_{4m+3} that gives an odd vertex v the labels v, v+4, ..., v+4(m-1) and an even vertex v the labels 2((v/2) mod 2) + 4a for a < v/4 and 2((v/2) mod 2) + 4a + 4m for v/4 <= a < m is an (m,3)-radio labeling of span at most 8m - 2. So the threshold 4m + 4 for the value 8m - 1 is sharp.
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_path_radio_labeling_four_mul_add_three (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (4 * m + 3)) m 3
        (fun v => if v.val % 2 = 1 then (Finset.range m).image (fun a => v.val + 4 * a)
          else (Finset.range m).image
            (fun a => 2 * (v.val / 2 % 2) + 4 * a + if a < v.val / 4 then 0 else 4 * m)) ∧
      multi_label_span (fun v : Fin (4 * m + 3) =>
        if v.val % 2 = 1 then (Finset.range m).image (fun a => v.val + 4 * a)
          else (Finset.range m).image
            (fun a => 2 * (v.val / 2 % 2) + 4 * a + if a < v.val / 4 then 0 else 4 * m)) ≤ 8 * m - 2
declarations.source:
theorem simple_graph_path_radio_labeling_four_mul_add_three (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (4 * m + 3)) m 3
        (fun v => if v.val % 2 = 1 then (Finset.range m).image (fun a => v.val + 4 * a)
          else (Finset.range m).image
            (fun a => 2 * (v.val / 2 % 2) + 4 * a + if a < v.val / 4 then 0 else 4 * m)) ∧
      multi_label_span (fun v : Fin (4 * m + 3) =>
        if v.val % 2 = 1 then (Finset.range m).image (fun a => v.val + 4 * a)
          else (Finset.range m).image
            (fun a => 2 * (v.val / 2 % 2) + 4 * a + if a < v.val / 4 then 0 else 4 * m)) ≤ 8 * m - 2 := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun v => ?_, fun x y a ha b hb hne => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · dsimp only
    split_ifs with hv
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun a b h => by omega)]
      exact Finset.card_range m
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun a b h => by
        split_ifs at h <;> omega)]
      exact Finset.card_range m
  · have hd := simple_graph_path_graph_dist_ge x y
    have hx := x.isLt
    have hy := y.isLt
    have hne' : x = y → a ≠ b := fun h1 h2 => hne (by rw [h1, h2])
    have hne'' : (x : ℕ) ≠ (y : ℕ) ∨ a ≠ b := by
      by_cases h : (x : ℕ) = (y : ℕ)
      · exact Or.inr (hne' (Fin.ext h))
      · exact Or.inl h
    clear hne' hne
    suffices h : (4 : ℤ) - |((x : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((y : ℕ) : ℤ)| ≤ |(a : ℤ) - b| by
      push_cast; linarith
    clear hd
    dsimp only at ha hb
    split_ifs at ha hb with h1 h2 h2 <;>
    · simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at ha hb
      obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ := hb
      have hne3 : (x : ℕ) ≠ (y : ℕ) ∨ a' ≠ b' := by
        rcases hne'' with h | h
        · exact Or.inl h
        · by_cases hxy : (x : ℕ) = (y : ℕ)
          · right; rintro rfl; apply h; (try split_ifs) <;> omega
          · exact Or.inl hxy
      have := path_radio_label_four_mul_add_three_sep m x y a' b' hx hy ha' hb' hne3
      simpa [h1, h2] using this
  · apply Finset.sup_le; intro x _; apply Finset.sup_le; intro y _
    apply Finset.sup_le; intro a ha; apply Finset.sup_le; intro b hb
    have hy := y.isLt
    dsimp only at hb
    split_ifs at hb with h2 <;> simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at hb <;>
      obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ := hb <;> (try split_ifs) <;> omega

declarations.name: simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_three_lt
declarations.informal: The threshold 4m + 4 is sharp: the (m,3)-radio number of P_{4m+3} is less than 8m - 1.
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_three_lt (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    simple_graph_multi_radio_number (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (4 * m + 3)) m 3 < 8 * m - 1
declarations.source:
theorem simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_three_lt (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    simple_graph_multi_radio_number (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (4 * m + 3)) m 3 < 8 * m - 1 := by
  obtain ⟨hf, hs⟩ := simple_graph_path_radio_labeling_four_mul_add_three m hm
  have h := Nat.sInf_le (show multi_label_span _ ∈ {s | ∃ f,
      simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (4 * m + 3)) m 3 f ∧
        multi_label_span f = s} from ⟨_, hf, rfl⟩)
  unfold simple_graph_multi_radio_number
  omega

declarations.name: StandardExample
declarations.informal: The standard example S_k of order k is a type with k minimal elements and k maximal elements.
declarations.statement: inductive StandardExample (k : ℕ) : Type
declarations.source:
/-- The standard example of order k as a bipartite type with k minimal and k maximal elements. -/
inductive StandardExample (k : ℕ) : Type | min (i : Fin k) : StandardExample k
| max (j : Fin k) : StandardExample k
declarations.reading:
An inductive type family `StandardExample` parameterized by a natural number `k : ℕ`, consisting of two constructors:
- `min`, which takes an index `i : Fin k` and produces a `StandardExample k`;
- `max`, which takes an index `j : Fin k` and produces a `StandardExample k`.
Equivalently, for a given `k`, `StandardExample k` is the disjoint union `Fin k ⊕ Fin k`.

declarations.name: standard_example_le
declarations.informal: In the standard example S_k, min i ≤ max j if and only if i ≠ j, with no relations between two minimal or two maximal elements.
declarations.statement: def standard_example_le {k : ℕ} : StandardExample k → StandardExample k → Prop
declarations.source:
/-- The partial order relation on the standard example: min i ≤ max j iff i ≠ j. -/
def standard_example_le {k : ℕ} : StandardExample k → StandardExample k → Prop
| StandardExample.min i, StandardExample.min j => i = j
| StandardExample.min i, StandardExample.max j => i ≠ j
| StandardExample.max _, StandardExample.min _ => False
| StandardExample.max i, StandardExample.max j => i = j

declarations.name: path_radio_label_eight_mul_sep
declarations.informal: The labels 8a + (3x mod 8) and 8b + (3y mod 8) (with x ≠ y or a ≠ b) differ by at least 4 - |x - y|.
declarations.statement:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
theorem path_radio_label_eight_mul_sep (x y a b : ℕ) (hne : x ≠ y ∨ a ≠ b) :
    (4 : ℤ) - |(x : ℤ) - y| ≤ |(((8 * a + 3 * x % 8 : ℕ)) : ℤ) - ((8 * b + 3 * y % 8 : ℕ) : ℤ)|
declarations.source:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
theorem path_radio_label_eight_mul_sep (x y a b : ℕ) (hne : x ≠ y ∨ a ≠ b) :
    (4 : ℤ) - |(x : ℤ) - y| ≤ |(((8 * a + 3 * x % 8 : ℕ)) : ℤ) - ((8 * b + 3 * y % 8 : ℕ) : ℤ)| := by
  rcases (show (x : ℤ) - y ≤ -4 ∨ (x : ℤ) - y = -3 ∨ (x : ℤ) - y = -2 ∨ (x : ℤ) - y = -1 ∨
      (x : ℤ) - y = 0 ∨ (x : ℤ) - y = 1 ∨ (x : ℤ) - y = 2 ∨ (x : ℤ) - y = 3 ∨ 4 ≤ (x : ℤ) - y by
        omega) with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;>
    apply int_four_sub_abs_le_abs <;> intro hs <;> push_cast <;> omega

declarations.name: simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_le_eight_mul
declarations.informal: For n, m >= 1 the (m,3)-radio number of the path P_n is at most 8m - 1.
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_le_eight_mul (n m : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    simple_graph_multi_radio_number (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) m 3 ≤ 8 * m - 1
declarations.source:
theorem simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_le_eight_mul (n m : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    simple_graph_multi_radio_number (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) m 3 ≤ 8 * m - 1 := by
  have hf : simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) m 3
      (fun v => (Finset.range m).image (fun a => 8 * a + 3 * v.val % 8)) := by
    refine ⟨fun v => ?_, fun x y a ha b hb hne => ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun a b h => by omega)]
      exact Finset.card_range m
    · have hd := simple_graph_path_graph_dist_ge x y
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at ha hb
      obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ := hb
      have hne3 : (x : ℕ) ≠ (y : ℕ) ∨ a' ≠ b' := by
        by_cases hxy : (x : ℕ) = (y : ℕ)
        · right; rintro rfl; exact hne (by rw [Fin.ext hxy])
        · exact Or.inl hxy
      have := path_radio_label_eight_mul_sep x y a' b' hne3
      push_cast at this ⊢
      linarith
  have hs : multi_label_span (fun v : Fin n => (Finset.range m).image (fun a => 8 * a + 3 * v.val % 8))
      ≤ 8 * m - 1 := by
    apply Finset.sup_le; intro x _; apply Finset.sup_le; intro y _
    apply Finset.sup_le; intro a ha; apply Finset.sup_le; intro b hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at hb
    obtain ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ := hb
    omega
  exact le_trans (Nat.sInf_le ⟨_, hf, rfl⟩) hs

declarations.name: standard_example_partial_order
declarations.informal: The standard example of order k is a partial order under standard_example_le.
declarations.statement: instance standard_example_partial_order (k : ℕ) : PartialOrder (StandardExample k)
declarations.source:
/-- PartialOrder instance on the standard example of order k. -/
instance standard_example_partial_order (k : ℕ) : PartialOrder (StandardExample k) where
  le := standard_example_le
  le_refl x := by cases x <;> simp [standard_example_le]
  le_trans x y z := by
    cases x <;> cases y <;> cases z <;> simp [standard_example_le]
    · rintro rfl; exact id
    · rintro rfl; exact id
    · rintro h rfl; exact h
    · rintro rfl; exact id
  le_antisymm x y := by
    cases x <;> cases y <;> simp [standard_example_le]
    · rintro rfl _; rfl
    · rintro rfl _; rfl
declarations.reading: For every natural number `k`, the type `StandardExample k` is equipped with a `PartialOrder` instance whose ordering relation `≤` is `standard_example_le`.

declarations.name: is_standard_example_free
declarations.informal: A poset P is S_k-free when it does not contain the standard example S_k of order k as an induced subposet.
declarations.statement: def is_standard_example_free (P : Type*) [PartialOrder P] (k : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A poset P is S_k-free if it contains no induced subposet isomorphic to the standard example of order k. -/
def is_standard_example_free (P : Type*) [PartialOrder P] (k : ℕ) : Prop := IsEmpty (StandardExample k ↪o P)
declarations.reading: Given a type `P` equipped with a partial order `[PartialOrder P]` and a natural number `k : ℕ`, `is_standard_example_free P k` asserts that the type of order embeddings from `StandardExample k` into `P` is empty (i.e., there exists no order embedding from `StandardExample k` into `P`).

declarations.name: is_min_max_incomp_pair
declarations.informal: A min-max incomparable pair (u, v) in a poset P consists of a minimal element u, a maximal element v, and u and v are incomparable.
declarations.statement: def is_min_max_incomp_pair {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (u v : P) : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A pair (u, v) is a min-max incomparable pair if u is minimal, v is maximal, and u and v are incomparable. -/
def is_min_max_incomp_pair {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (u v : P) : Prop := IsMin u ∧ IsMax v ∧ ¬ u ≤ v ∧ ¬ v ≤ u
declarations.reading:
For a partially ordered type `P` and elements `u, v : P`, `is_min_max_incomp_pair u v` is the proposition that:
1. `u` is a minimal element of `P` (`IsMin u`, i.e., for all `b : P`, `b ≤ u → u ≤ b`),
2. `v` is a maximal element of `P` (`IsMax v`, i.e., for all `b : P`, `v ≤ b → b ≤ v`),
3. `u` is not less than or equal to `v` (`¬ u ≤ v`), and
4. `v` is not less than or equal to `u` (`¬ v ≤ u`).

(In other words, `u` is minimal, `v` is maximal, and `u` and `v` are incomparable.)

declarations.name: brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_eight

instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_eight_dec_rank (n t : ℕ) :

declarations.name: poset_height_two
declarations.informal: A poset has height two when it contains no chain of three elements.
declarations.statement: def poset_height_two (P : Type*) [PartialOrder P] : Prop
declarations.source:
/-- A poset has height two if it contains no chain of three elements. -/
def poset_height_two (P : Type*) [PartialOrder P] : Prop := ∀ a b c : P, ¬ (a < b ∧ b < c)
declarations.reading: Given a type P with a partial order, for all elements a, b, c in P, it is not the case that both a < b and b < c (that is, P contains no three elements forming a strictly increasing chain a < b < c).

declarations.name: poset_downset
declarations.informal: For a poset P and an element v in P, the strict downset D_P(v) is the set of all elements x in P strictly smaller than v.
declarations.statement: def poset_downset {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (v : P) : Set P
declarations.source:
/-- The strict downset D_P(v) of an element v in a poset P. -/
def poset_downset {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (v : P) : Set P := {x | x < v}
declarations.reading: For a partially ordered type `P` and an element `v : P`, `poset_downset v` is defined as the set of all elements `x : P` such that `x < v` (strictly less than `v`).

declarations.name: poset_upset
declarations.informal: For a poset P and an element u in P, the strict upset U_P(u) is the set of all elements y in P strictly greater than u.
declarations.statement: def poset_upset {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (u : P) : Set P
declarations.source:
/-- The strict upset U_P(u) of an element u in a poset P. -/
def poset_upset {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (u : P) : Set P := {y | u < y}
declarations.reading: Given a type `P` equipped with a partial order and an element `u : P`, `poset_upset u` is defined as the set of elements `y : P` strictly greater than `u` (i.e., `{y : P | u < y}`).

declarations.name: brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine
declarations.informal: The case n = 9 (composite, with periodic necklaces that break the adjacency) of the aperiodic adjacency conjecture: consecutive aperiodic necklaces of D_9 are adjacent in Q_9.
declarations.statement:
theorem brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine :
    ∀ t t' : ℕ, brgc_necklace_first_rank 9 t → brgc_necklace_first_rank 9 t' → t < t' →
      (∀ s, t < s → s < t' → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 9 s) →
      bitword_is_aperiodic 9 (brgc_word t) → bitword_is_aperiodic 9 (brgc_word t') →
      bitword_necklace_adjacent 9 (brgc_word t) (brgc_word t')
declarations.source:
def brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks : List ℕ :=
  [1, 2, 5, 6, 9, 10, 13, 14, 17, 18, 21, 22, 25, 26, 29, 30, 33, 34, 37, 38,
   41, 42, 45, 46, 49, 50, 53, 54, 57, 58, 69, 70, 73, 74, 77, 78, 81, 82, 85, 86,
   89, 90, 101, 102, 105, 106, 109, 110, 113, 146, 149, 150, 153, 154, 165, 166, 169, 170]

instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_dec_rot (n x y : ℕ) :
    Decidable (bitword_is_rotation n x y) := by
  unfold bitword_is_rotation
  infer_instance

instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_dec_rank (n t : ℕ) :
    Decidable (brgc_necklace_first_rank n t) := by
  unfold brgc_necklace_first_rank
  infer_instance

instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_dec_adj (n x y : ℕ) :
    Decidable (bitword_necklace_adjacent n x y) := by
  unfold bitword_necklace_adjacent
  infer_instance

instance brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_dec_aperiodic (n x : ℕ) :
    Decidable (bitword_is_aperiodic n x) :=
  decidable_of_iff (∀ r < n, 0 < r → (bitword_rotate n)^[r] x ≠ x) ⟨
    fun h r hr0 hrn => h r hrn hr0,
    fun h r hrn hr0 => h r hr0 hrn
  ⟩

theorem brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_lt_171 :
    ∀ s ∈ brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks, s < 171 := by
  decide

theorem brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_rot_bound :
    ∀ (t : Fin 512), 171 ≤ ↑t → brgc_word ↑t ≠ 2 ^ 9 - 1 →
      ∃ s ∈ brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks,
        bitword_is_rotation 9 (brgc_word s) (brgc_word ↑t) := by
  decide

theorem brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks_iff :
    ∀ (s : Fin 171), brgc_necklace_first_rank 9 ↑s ↔
      ↑s ∈ brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks := by
  decide

theorem brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks_prop :
    ∀ t ∈ brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks,
    bitword_is_aperiodic 9 (brgc_word t) →
    ∀ t' ∈ brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks,
    t < t' →
    bitword_is_aperiodic 9 (brgc_word t') →
    (∀ s ∈ brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks, ¬ (t < s ∧ s < t')) →
    bitword_necklace_adjacent 9 (brgc_word t) (brgc_word t') := by
  decide

theorem brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine :
    ∀ t t' : ℕ, brgc_necklace_first_rank 9 t → brgc_necklace_first_rank 9 t' → t < t' →
      (∀ s, t < s → s < t' → ¬ brgc_necklace_first_rank 9 s) →
      bitword_is_aperiodic 9 (brgc_word t) → bitword_is_aperiodic 9 (brgc_word t') →
      bitword_necklace_adjacent 9 (brgc_word t) (brgc_word t') := by
  intro t t' ht ht' hlt hbetween hap hap'
  have ht'_lt : t' < 171 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hge : 171 ≤ t' := by omega
    have ht'_512 : t' < 512 := ht'.1
    have hne : brgc_word t' ≠ 2 ^ 9 - 1 := ht'.2.2.1
    rcases brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_rot_bound ⟨t', ht'_512⟩ hge hne with ⟨s, hs_in, hs_rot⟩
    have hs_lt_171 : s < 171 := brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_lt_171 s hs_in
    have hs_lt_t' : s < t' := by omega
    exact ht'.2.2.2 s hs_lt_t' hs_rot
  have ht_lt : t < 171 := by omega
  have ht_in : t ∈ brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks :=
    (brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks_iff ⟨t, ht_lt⟩).mp ht
  have ht'_in : t' ∈ brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks :=
    (brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks_iff ⟨t', ht'_lt⟩).mp ht'
  have hno_between : ∀ s ∈ brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks, ¬ (t < s ∧ s < t') := by
    intro s hs_in ⟨hts, hst'⟩
    have hs_lt : s < 171 := by omega
    have hs_rank : brgc_necklace_first_rank 9 s :=
      (brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks_iff ⟨s, hs_lt⟩).mpr hs_in
    exact hbetween s hts hst' hs_rank
  exact brgc_necklace_order_consecutive_aperiodic_adjacent_nine_ranks_prop t ht_in hap t' ht'_in hlt hap' hno_between

declarations.name: standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet
declarations.informal: Let P be a finite poset of height 2 and let (u, v) be a min-max incomparable pair in P. If d ≥ 3 and P is S_d-free, then the subposet induced by D_P(v) ∪ U_P(u) is S_{d-1}-free.
declarations.statement:
theorem standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet
    {P : Type*} [Fintype P] [PartialOrder P]
    (hP : poset_height_two P)
    {u v : P} (h_uv : is_min_max_incomp_pair u v)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 3 ≤ d)
    (h_free : is_standard_example_free P d) :
    is_standard_example_free {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u} (d - 1)
declarations.source:
lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_subposet_lt_downset
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (hP : poset_height_two P)
    {u v : P} {x y : {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u}}
    (h : x.val < y.val) : x.val < v := by
  cases x.property with
  | inl hx => exact hx
  | inr hx =>
    exfalso
    exact hP u x.val y.val ⟨hx, h⟩

lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_subposet_lt_upset
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (hP : poset_height_two P)
    {u v : P} {x y : {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u}}
    (h : x.val < y.val) : u < y.val := by
  cases y.property with
  | inl hy =>
    exfalso
    exact hP x.val y.val v ⟨h, hy⟩
  | inr hy => exact hy

lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_min_lt_v
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (hP : poset_height_two P)
    {u v : P} {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (f : StandardExample k ↪o {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u})
    (i : Fin k) : (f (StandardExample.min i)).val < v := by
  have : Nontrivial (Fin k) := Fin.nontrivial_iff_two_le.mpr hk
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_ne i
  have h_lt : StandardExample.min i < StandardExample.max j := by
    rw [lt_iff_le_and_ne]
    refine ⟨hj.symm, fun h => by cases h⟩
  have h_flt : f (StandardExample.min i) < f (StandardExample.max j) :=
    (OrderEmbedding.lt_iff_lt f).mpr h_lt
  exact standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_subposet_lt_downset hP (Subtype.coe_lt_coe.mpr h_flt)

lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_u_lt_max
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (hP : poset_height_two P)
    {u v : P} {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (f : StandardExample k ↪o {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u})
    (j : Fin k) : u < (f (StandardExample.max j)).val := by
  have : Nontrivial (Fin k) := Fin.nontrivial_iff_two_le.mpr hk
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_ne j
  have h_lt : StandardExample.min i < StandardExample.max j := by
    rw [lt_iff_le_and_ne]
    refine ⟨hi, fun h => by cases h⟩
  have h_flt : f (StandardExample.min i) < f (StandardExample.max j) :=
    (OrderEmbedding.lt_iff_lt f).mpr h_lt
  exact standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_subposet_lt_upset hP (Subtype.coe_lt_coe.mpr h_flt)

lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_not_u_le_min
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (hP : poset_height_two P)
    {u v : P} (h_uv : is_min_max_incomp_pair u v)
    {x : P} (hx : x < v) : ¬ u ≤ x := by
  intro h
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h with hlt | heq
  · exact hP u x v ⟨hlt, hx⟩
  · subst heq
    exact h_uv.2.2.1 hx.le

lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_not_min_le_u
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P]
    {u v : P} (h_uv : is_min_max_incomp_pair u v)
    {x : P} (hx : x < v) : ¬ x ≤ u := by
  intro h
  have hu : u ≤ x := h_uv.1 h
  have heq : x = u := le_antisymm h hu
  subst heq
  exact h_uv.2.2.1 hx.le

lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_not_max_le_v
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] (hP : poset_height_two P)
    {u v : P} (h_uv : is_min_max_incomp_pair u v)
    {y : P} (hy : u < y) : ¬ y ≤ v := by
  intro h
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h with hlt | heq
  · exact hP u y v ⟨hy, hlt⟩
  · subst heq
    exact h_uv.2.2.1 hy.le

lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_not_v_le_max
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P]
    {u v : P} (h_uv : is_min_max_incomp_pair u v)
    {y : P} (hy : u < y) : ¬ v ≤ y := by
  intro h
  have hv : y ≤ v := h_uv.2.1 h
  have heq : y = v := le_antisymm hv h
  subst heq
  exact h_uv.2.2.1 hy.le

def standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] {u v : P} {k : ℕ}
    (f : StandardExample k ↪o {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u}) :
    StandardExample (k + 1) → P
  | StandardExample.min i =>
    Fin.lastCases u (fun i' => (f (StandardExample.min i')).val) i
  | StandardExample.max j =>
    Fin.lastCases v (fun j' => (f (StandardExample.max j')).val) j

@[simp] lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_last
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] {u v : P} {k : ℕ}
    (f : StandardExample k ↪o {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u}) :
    standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem f (StandardExample.min (Fin.last k)) = u := by
  dsimp [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem]; rw [Fin.lastCases_last]

@[simp] lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_cast
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] {u v : P} {k : ℕ}
    (f : StandardExample k ↪o {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u}) (i : Fin k) :
    standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem f (StandardExample.min i.castSucc) =
      (f (StandardExample.min i)).val := by
  dsimp [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem]; rw [Fin.lastCases_castSucc]

@[simp] lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_last
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] {u v : P} {k : ℕ}
    (f : StandardExample k ↪o {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u}) :
    standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem f (StandardExample.max (Fin.last k)) = v := by
  dsimp [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem]; rw [Fin.lastCases_last]

@[simp] lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_cast
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P] {u v : P} {k : ℕ}
    (f : StandardExample k ↪o {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u}) (j : Fin k) :
    standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem f (StandardExample.max j.castSucc) =
      (f (StandardExample.max j)).val := by
  dsimp [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem]; rw [Fin.lastCases_castSucc]

lemma standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_le_iff
    {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P]
    (hP : poset_height_two P)
    {u v : P} (h_uv : is_min_max_incomp_pair u v)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (f : StandardExample k ↪o {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u})
    (a b : StandardExample (k + 1)) :
    standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem f a ≤
      standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem f b ↔ a ≤ b := by
  rcases a with i | j <;> rcases b with i' | j'
  · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      induction i' using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_last]
        exact iff_of_true le_rfl rfl
      | cast i' =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_last,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_cast]
        exact iff_of_false (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_not_u_le_min hP h_uv
          (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_min_lt_v hP hk f i'))
          (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i').ne'
    | cast i =>
      induction i' using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_last,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_cast]
        exact iff_of_false (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_not_min_le_u h_uv
          (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_min_lt_v hP hk f i))
          (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i).ne
      | cast i' =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_cast]
        rw [Subtype.coe_le_coe, OrderEmbedding.le_iff_le]
        exact Fin.castSucc_inj.symm
  · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      induction j' using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_last,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_last]
        exact iff_of_false h_uv.2.2.1 (not_not.mpr rfl)
      | cast j' =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_last,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_cast]
        exact iff_of_true (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_u_lt_max hP hk f j').le
          (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j').ne'
    | cast i =>
      induction j' using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_cast,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_last]
        exact iff_of_true (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_min_lt_v hP hk f i).le
          (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i).ne
      | cast j' =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_cast,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_cast]
        rw [Subtype.coe_le_coe, OrderEmbedding.le_iff_le]
        exact Fin.castSucc_inj.ne.symm
  · induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      induction i' using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_last,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_last]
        exact iff_of_false h_uv.2.2.2 id
      | cast i' =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_last,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_cast]
        have hlt := standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_min_lt_v hP hk f i'
        exact iff_of_false (fun hle => lt_irrefl _ (lt_of_le_of_lt hle hlt)) id
    | cast j =>
      induction i' using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_cast,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_last]
        have hlt := standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_u_lt_max hP hk f j
        exact iff_of_false (fun hle => lt_irrefl _ (lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hle)) id
      | cast i' =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_cast,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_min_cast]
        rw [Subtype.coe_le_coe, OrderEmbedding.le_iff_le]
        rfl
  · induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      induction j' using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_last]
        exact iff_of_true le_rfl rfl
      | cast j' =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_last,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_cast]
        exact iff_of_false (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_not_v_le_max h_uv
          (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_u_lt_max hP hk f j'))
          (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j').ne'
    | cast j =>
      induction j' using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_last,
          standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_cast]
        exact iff_of_false (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_not_max_le_v hP h_uv
          (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_u_lt_max hP hk f j))
          (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j).ne
      | cast j' =>
        simp only [standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_max_cast]
        rw [Subtype.coe_le_coe, OrderEmbedding.le_iff_le]
        exact Fin.castSucc_inj.symm

/-- Standard example reduction in min-max downset-upset subposets (Lemma 3.5). -/
theorem standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet
    {P : Type*} [Fintype P] [PartialOrder P]
    (hP : poset_height_two P)
    {u v : P} (h_uv : is_min_max_incomp_pair u v)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 3 ≤ d)
    (h_free : is_standard_example_free P d) :
    is_standard_example_free {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u} (d - 1) := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ : ∃ k ≥ 2, d = k + 1 := ⟨d - 1, by omega, (Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)).symm⟩
  change IsEmpty (StandardExample k ↪o {x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u})
  refine ⟨fun f => ?_⟩
  have g : StandardExample (k + 1) ↪o P :=
    OrderEmbedding.ofMapLEIff (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem f)
      (standard_example_reduction_min_max_subposet_embed_elem_le_iff hP h_uv hk f)
  exact h_free.false g
declarations.reading:
Let $P$ be a finite partially ordered type.
Assume that $P$ has height at most two, in the sense that there do not exist elements $a, b, c \in P$ such that $a < b$ and $b < c$ (`poset_height_two P`).
Let $u, v \in P$ be such that $u$ is a minimal element of $P$, $v$ is a maximal element of $P$, and $u$ and $v$ are incomparable ($u \not\le v$ and $v \not\le u$).
Let $d$ be a natural number such that $3 \le d$.
Assume that $P$ is free of the standard example of size $d$ (`is_standard_example_free P d`), meaning there is no order embedding from `StandardExample d` into $P$.
Then the subposet of elements of $P$ that are strictly less than $v$ or strictly greater than $u$ (the subtype `{x : P // x ∈ poset_downset v ∪ poset_upset u}` under the induced order) is free of the standard example of size $d - 1$, meaning there is no order embedding from `StandardExample (d - 1)` into this subposet.

declarations.name: simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono
declarations.informal: The (m,k)-radio number of the path P_n is nondecreasing in n: a labeling of P_{n+1} restricts to one of P_n.
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono (n m k : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    simple_graph_multi_radio_number (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) m k ≤
      simple_graph_multi_radio_number (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n + 1)) m k
declarations.source:
lemma simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono_dist_castSucc_le (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin n) :
    (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n+1)).dist (Fin.castSucc a) (Fin.castSucc b) ≤
      (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).dist a b := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ((SimpleGraph.pathGraph_preconnected n) a b).exists_walk_length_eq_dist
  let hhom : SimpleGraph.pathGraph n →g SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n+1) :=
    { toFun := Fin.castSucc
      map_rel' := by
        intro x y hxy
        simpa [SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj] using hxy }
  have key := SimpleGraph.dist_le (SimpleGraph.Walk.map hhom p)
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_map] at key
  rw [hp] at key
  exact key

lemma simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono_labeling_comp {V W : Type*}
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (G' : SimpleGraph W) (m k : ℕ) (f : W → Finset ℕ) (φ : V → W)
    (hf : simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling G' m k f)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ)
    (hdist : ∀ x y, G'.dist (φ x) (φ y) ≤ G.dist x y) :
    simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling G m k (fun v => f (φ v)) := by
  refine ⟨fun v => hf.1 (φ v), ?_⟩
  intro x y a ha b hb hne
  have hne' : (φ x, a) ≠ (φ y, b) := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have h1 : φ x = φ y := congrArg Prod.fst h
    have h2 : a = b := congrArg Prod.snd h
    rw [hφ h1, h2]
  have h1 := hf.2 (φ x) (φ y) a ha b hb hne'
  have h2 : ((G'.dist (φ x) (φ y) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ ((G.dist x y : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hdist x y
  linarith

lemma simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono_span_comp_le {V W : Type*}
    [Fintype V] [Fintype W] (f : W → Finset ℕ) (φ : V → W) :
    multi_label_span (fun v => f (φ v)) ≤ multi_label_span f := by
  simp only [multi_label_span]
  refine Finset.sup_le fun x _ => Finset.sup_le fun y _ => ?_
  exact le_trans
    (Finset.le_sup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset W))
      (f := fun y => (f (φ x)).sup fun a => (f y).sup fun b => b - a) (Finset.mem_univ (φ y)))
    (Finset.le_sup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset W))
      (f := fun x => (Finset.univ : Finset W).sup fun y =>
        (f x).sup fun a => (f y).sup fun b => b - a) (Finset.mem_univ (φ x)))

lemma simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono_exists_labeling {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (m k : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : V → Finset ℕ, simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling G m k f := by
  classical
  let h : V × Fin m → ℕ := fun p => (Fintype.equivFin (V × Fin m) p).val
  have h_inj : Function.Injective h := by
    intro p q hpq
    exact (Fintype.equivFin (V × Fin m)).injective (Fin.val_injective hpq)
  refine ⟨fun v => (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).image (fun a => h (v, a) * (k+1)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ ?_]
    simp
    intro a b hab
    have hk : 0 < k + 1 := Nat.succ_pos k
    have h1 : h (v, a) = h (v, b) := (Nat.mul_right_cancel_iff hk).mp hab
    exact congrArg Prod.snd (h_inj h1)
  · intro x y a ha b hb hne
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at ha hb
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hb
    have hneN : h (x, a') ≠ h (y, b') := by
      intro hEq
      apply hne
      have hp : (x, a') = (y, b') := h_inj hEq
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hp
      rw [← ha', ← hb', hp.1, hp.2]
    have hz : ((h (x, a') : ℤ)) - ((h (y, b') : ℤ)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hcon
      apply hneN
      have : ((h (x, a') : ℤ)) = ((h (y, b') : ℤ)) := by linarith
      exact_mod_cast this
    have step1 : ((a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ)) =
        (((h (x, a') : ℤ)) - ((h (y, b') : ℤ))) * ((k : ℤ) + 1) := by
      rw [← ha', ← hb']
      push_cast
      ring
    have habs : |((a : ℤ) - (b : ℤ))| =
        |(((h (x, a') : ℤ)) - ((h (y, b') : ℤ)))| * ((k : ℤ) + 1) := by
      rw [step1, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℤ) ≤ (k : ℤ) + 1)]
    have hone : (1:ℤ) ≤ |(((h (x, a') : ℤ)) - ((h (y, b') : ℤ)))| := Int.one_le_abs hz
    rw [habs]
    calc ((k : ℤ) + 1 - ((G.dist x y : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≤ (k : ℤ) + 1 := by
          have : (0:ℤ) ≤ ((G.dist x y : ℕ) : ℤ) := by positivity
          linarith
      _ = 1 * ((k : ℤ) + 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ |(((h (x, a') : ℤ)) - ((h (y, b') : ℤ)))| * ((k : ℤ) + 1) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hone (by positivity)

theorem simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono (n m k : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    simple_graph_multi_radio_number (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) m k ≤
      simple_graph_multi_radio_number (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n + 1)) m k := by
  classical
  have hne : {s : ℕ | ∃ f : Fin (n+1) → Finset ℕ,
      simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n+1)) m k f ∧
      multi_label_span f = s}.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono_exists_labeling
      (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n+1)) m k
    exact ⟨_, f, hf, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hspan⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  have hlabel : simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) m k
      (fun v => f (Fin.castSucc v)) :=
    simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono_labeling_comp _ _ m k f Fin.castSucc hf
      (Fin.castSucc_injective n)
      (fun x y => simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono_dist_castSucc_le n x y)
  have hmem : multi_label_span (fun v => f (Fin.castSucc v)) ∈ {s : ℕ | ∃ g : Fin n → Finset ℕ,
      simple_graph_is_multi_radio_labeling (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) m k g ∧
      multi_label_span g = s} := ⟨_, hlabel, rfl⟩
  have h1 : simple_graph_multi_radio_number (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) m k ≤
      multi_label_span (fun v => f (Fin.castSucc v)) := Nat.sInf_le hmem
  have h2 : multi_label_span (fun v => f (Fin.castSucc v)) ≤ multi_label_span f :=
    simple_graph_multi_radio_number_path_mono_span_comp_le f Fin.castSucc
  have h3 : multi_label_span f =
      simple_graph_multi_radio_number (SimpleGraph.pathGraph (n+1)) m k := hspan
  exact le_trans h1 (le_trans h2 (le_of_eq h3))

declarations.name: additive_sum_le_of_two_bundles_cover
declarations.informal: Two-deviation certificate: if two bundles D1, D2, each worth at most v(A) to an agent with nonnegative additive values, together cover (with multiplicity) A plus two distinct goods x, y outside A, then v(x) + v(y) <= v(A).
declarations.statement:
theorem additive_sum_le_of_two_bundles_cover {G : Type*} [DecidableEq G] (w : G → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ g, 0 ≤ w g) (A D₁ D₂ : Finset G) (x y : G) (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxA : x ∉ A) (hyA : y ∉ A)
    (h₁ : ∑ g ∈ D₁, w g ≤ ∑ g ∈ A, w g) (h₂ : ∑ g ∈ D₂, w g ≤ ∑ g ∈ A, w g)
    (hcov : ∀ g, (if g ∈ A then 1 else 0) + (if g = x then 1 else 0) + (if g = y then 1 else 0) ≤
      (if g ∈ D₁ then 1 else 0) + (if g ∈ D₂ then 1 else 0 : ℕ)) :
    w x + w y ≤ ∑ g ∈ A, w g
declarations.source:
theorem additive_sum_le_of_two_bundles_cover {G : Type*} [DecidableEq G] (w : G → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ g, 0 ≤ w g) (A D₁ D₂ : Finset G) (x y : G) (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxA : x ∉ A) (hyA : y ∉ A)
    (h₁ : ∑ g ∈ D₁, w g ≤ ∑ g ∈ A, w g) (h₂ : ∑ g ∈ D₂, w g ≤ ∑ g ∈ A, w g)
    (hcov : ∀ g, (if g ∈ A then 1 else 0) + (if g = x then 1 else 0) + (if g = y then 1 else 0) ≤
      (if g ∈ D₁ then 1 else 0) + (if g ∈ D₂ then 1 else 0 : ℕ)) :
    w x + w y ≤ ∑ g ∈ A, w g := by
  have _ := hxy; have _ := hxA; have _ := hyA
  let S : Finset G := D₁ ∪ D₂ ∪ A ∪ {x} ∪ {y}
  have hD₁ : D₁ ⊆ S := by intro g hg; simp only [S, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton]; tauto
  have hD₂ : D₂ ⊆ S := by intro g hg; simp only [S, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton]; tauto
  have hA : A ⊆ S := by intro g hg; simp only [S, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton]; tauto
  have hx : x ∈ S := by simp only [S, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton]; tauto
  have hy : y ∈ S := by simp only [S, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton]; tauto
  have hsum : ∑ g ∈ S, ((if g ∈ A then w g else 0) + (if g = x then w g else 0) + (if g = y then w g else 0)) ≤
      ∑ g ∈ S, ((if g ∈ D₁ then w g else 0) + (if g ∈ D₂ then w g else 0)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro g _
    have h := hcov g
    have hwg := hw g
    split_ifs at * <;> linarith
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hsum
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr hA,
             Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr hD₁, Finset.inter_eq_right.mpr hD₂] at hsum
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos hx] at hsum
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos hy] at hsum
  linarith
