declarations.name: saddle_gap_game
declarations.informal: Given an n-by-n payoff matrix A, the saddle-gap game S has row player choosing a pair (i, j) in [n]² and column player choosing k in [n], with payoff A_{ik} - A_{kj}.
declarations.statement: def saddle_gap_game {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : MatrixGame (Fin n × Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ
declarations.source:
/-- The saddle-gap auxiliary zero-sum matrix game S for a matrix A. -/
def saddle_gap_game {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) : MatrixGame (Fin n × Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := ⟨fun (i, j) k => A i k - A k j⟩
declarations.reading: For any natural number $n$ and any $n \times n$ real matrix $A$, `saddle_gap_game A` is defined as the matrix game (`MatrixGame`) with row strategy set $\mathrm{Fin}(n) \times \mathrm{Fin}(n)$, column strategy set $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, payoff values in $\mathbb{R}$, and payoff function $g$ given by $g(i, j)(k) = A_{i, k} - A_{k, j}$.

declarations.name: simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_alternate
declarations.informal: In a tight cover of C_n^7 (n >= 22) by 4 equivalence subgraphs in which every class starting at i (the class of the distance-7 pair (i, i+7)) contains i+1 exactly when it contains i+6, the classes alternate: the class starting at i contains i+1 if and only if the class starting at i+1 does not contain i+2. So classes {i, i+7} and larger classes alternate along the cycle.
declarations.statement:
theorem simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_alternate (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (hn : 22 ≤ n) (c : Fin 4 → ZMod n → ZMod n)
    (hc : ∀ s u v, u ≠ v → c s u = c s v → (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v)
    (hcov : ∀ u v, (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v → ∃ s, c s u = c s v)
    (h7 : ∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 7)) (h6 : ∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 6))
    (h4 : ∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 4))
    (hspan : ∀ s i, ∃ d : ℕ, d ≤ 7 ∧ c s (i - d) = c s (i - d + 7) ∧ c s (i - d) = c s i)
    (h16 : ∀ s i, c s i = c s (i + 7) → (c s i = c s (i + 1) ↔ c s i = c s (i + 6)))
    (i : ZMod n) :
    (∃ s, c s i = c s (i + 7) ∧ c s i = c s (i + 1)) ↔
      ¬ ∃ s, c s (i + 1) = c s (i + 1 + 7) ∧ c s (i + 1) = c s (i + 1 + 1)
declarations.source:
lemma simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_alternate_side
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 22 ≤ n) (c : Fin 4 → ZMod n → ZMod n)
    (hc : ∀ s u v, u ≠ v → c s u = c s v → (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v)
    (hspan : ∀ s i, ∃ d : ℕ, d ≤ 7 ∧ c s (i - d) = c s (i - d + 7) ∧ c s (i - d) = c s i)
    (h16 : ∀ s i, c s i = c s (i + 7) → (c s i = c s (i + 1) ↔ c s i = c s (i + 6)))
    (s : Fin 4) (j : ZMod n) (hj : c s j = c s (j + 6)) :
    (c s (j - 1) = c s j) ∨ (c s j = c s (j + 1) ∧ c s j = c s (j + 7)) := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd7, hdA, hdB⟩ := hspan s (j + 6)
  have hchain : c s j = c s ((j + 6) - d + 7) := (hj.trans hdB.symm).trans hdA
  have hsub : (j + 6) - (d : ZMod n) + 7 - j = ((13 - (d : ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by
    push_cast; ring
  have hne : j ≠ (j + 6) - d + 7 := by
    intro heq
    have hzero : ((13 - (d : ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod n) = ((0 : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by
      rw [← hsub, ← heq, sub_self, Int.cast_zero]
    have hlt : |(13 : ℤ) - (d : ℤ) - (0:ℤ)| < (n : ℤ) := by
      have h1 : |(13:ℤ) - (d:ℤ)| ≤ 13 := by
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> omega
      calc |(13:ℤ) - (d:ℤ) - 0| = |(13:ℤ) - (d:ℤ)| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ 13 := h1
        _ < (n:ℤ) := by omega
    have := (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n (13 - (d:ℤ)) 0 hlt).mp hzero
    omega
  have hadj : (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj j ((j + 6) - d + 7) := hc s j _ hne hchain
  obtain ⟨e, hene, heabs, hee⟩ :=
    (simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn j ((j + 6) - d + 7)).mp hadj
  have hcast : ((13 - (d:ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod n) = ((e : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by
    have h2 : (j + (e : ZMod n)) - j = ((e : ℤ) : ZMod n) := by push_cast; ring
    exact hsub.symm.trans (by rw [hee]; exact h2)
  have hde : (13 : ℤ) - (d : ℤ) = e := by
    have hlt : |(13 : ℤ) - (d : ℤ) - e| < (n : ℤ) := by
      have hb := abs_le.mp heabs
      have hd7' : ((d:ℤ)) ≤ 7 := by omega
      have hd0' : (0:ℤ) ≤ (d:ℤ) := by omega
      have hle : |(13 : ℤ) - (d : ℤ) - e| ≤ 20 := by
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> omega
      omega
    exact (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n (13 - (d:ℤ)) e hlt).mp hcast
  have hd67 : d = 6 ∨ d = 7 := by
    have hb := abs_le.mp heabs
    omega
  rcases hd67 with hd | hd
  · have hAj : c s j = c s (j + 7) := by
      have hA := hdA
      rw [hd] at hA
      rw [show (j + 6) - (6:ℕ) = j by ring] at hA
      exact hA
    exact Or.inr ⟨(h16 s j hAj).mpr hj, hAj⟩
  · left
    have hA := hdA
    rw [hd] at hA
    rw [show (j + 6) - (7:ℕ) = j - 1 by ring] at hA
    rw [show j - 1 + 7 = j + 6 by ring] at hA
    exact hA.trans hj.symm

theorem simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_alternate (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (hn : 22 ≤ n) (c : Fin 4 → ZMod n → ZMod n)
    (hc : ∀ s u v, u ≠ v → c s u = c s v → (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v)
    (hcov : ∀ u v, (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj u v → ∃ s, c s u = c s v)
    (h7 : ∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 7)) (h6 : ∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 6))
    (h4 : ∀ i, ∃! s, c s i = c s (i + 4))
    (hspan : ∀ s i, ∃ d : ℕ, d ≤ 7 ∧ c s (i - d) = c s (i - d + 7) ∧ c s (i - d) = c s i)
    (h16 : ∀ s i, c s i = c s (i + 7) → (c s i = c s (i + 1) ↔ c s i = c s (i + 6)))
    (i : ZMod n) :
    (∃ s, c s i = c s (i + 7) ∧ c s i = c s (i + 1)) ↔
      ¬ ∃ s, c s (i + 1) = c s (i + 1 + 7) ∧ c s (i + 1) = c s (i + 1 + 1) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs7, hs1⟩ ⟨t, ht8, ht2⟩
    have hs6 : c s i = c s (i + 6) := (h16 s i hs7).mp hs1
    have ht6 : c t (i + 1) = c t (i + 1 + 6) := (h16 t (i + 1) ht8).mp ht2
    obtain ⟨s6, -, huniq⟩ := h6 (i + 1)
    have hA : c s (i + 1) = c s (i + 1 + 6) := by
      rw [show (i + 1 + 6 : ZMod n) = i + 7 by ring]
      exact hs1.symm.trans hs7
    have hst : s = t := (huniq s hA).trans (huniq t ht6).symm
    have h8t : c t i = c t (i + 8) := by
      have hs1' : c t i = c t (i + 1) := by rw [← hst]; exact hs1
      have ht8' : c t (i + 1) = c t (i + 8) := by
        rw [show (i + 1 + 7 : ZMod n) = i + 8 by ring] at ht8; exact ht8
      exact hs1'.trans ht8'
    have h8 : c s i = c s (i + 8) := by rw [hst]; exact h8t
    have hne : i ≠ i + 8 := by
      intro heq
      have hzero : ((8:ℤ) : ZMod n) = ((0:ℤ) : ZMod n) := by
        have h2 : (i + 8 : ZMod n) - i = ((8:ℤ):ZMod n) := by ring
        rw [← h2, ← heq, sub_self, Int.cast_zero]
      have hlt : |(8:ℤ) - (0:ℤ)| < (n:ℤ) := by
        have h3 : (22:ℤ) ≤ (n:ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
        have h4 : |(8:ℤ) - (0:ℤ)| = 8 := by norm_num
        rw [h4]; omega
      have h8e : (8:ℤ) = 0 := (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n 8 0 hlt).mp hzero
      omega
    have hadj : (simple_graph_cycle_power n 7).Adj i (i + 8) := hc s i (i + 8) hne h8
    obtain ⟨e, hene, heabs, hee⟩ := (simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_adj_iff n hn i (i + 8)).mp hadj
    have hcast : ((8:ℤ) : ZMod n) = ((e:ℤ) : ZMod n) := by
      have h1 : (i + 8 : ZMod n) - i = ((8:ℤ):ZMod n) := by ring
      have h2 : (i + (e : ZMod n)) - i = ((e:ℤ):ZMod n) := by ring
      rw [← h1, hee, h2]
    have h8e : (8:ℤ) = e := by
      apply (zmod_intCast_eq_intCast_iff_of_abs_sub_lt n 8 e ?_).mp hcast
      have hb := abs_le.mp heabs
      have hle : |(8:ℤ) - e| ≤ 15 := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> omega
      have h3 : (22:ℤ) ≤ (n:ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
      omega
    have hb := abs_le.mp heabs
    omega
  · intro hnr
    obtain ⟨s6, hs6, -⟩ := h6 (i + 1)
    have hkey := simple_graph_cycle_power_seven_cover_four_tight_alternate_side
      n hn c hc hspan h16 s6 (i + 1) hs6
    rcases hkey with hl | ⟨hr1, hr7⟩
    · have hl' : c s6 i = c s6 (i + 1) := by
        rw [show (i + 1 - 1 : ZMod n) = i by ring] at hl
        exact hl
      have h6' : c s6 (i + 1) = c s6 (i + 7) := by
        rw [show (i + 1 + 6 : ZMod n) = i + 7 by ring] at hs6
        exact hs6
      exact ⟨s6, hl'.trans h6', hl'⟩
    · exact absurd ⟨s6, hr7, hr1⟩ hnr

declarations.name: poset_downset_subset_min
declarations.informal: In a poset of height two, every element strictly below any element v is minimal.
declarations.statement:
theorem poset_downset_subset_min {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P]
    (hP : poset_height_two P) (v : P) {x : P} (hx : x ∈ poset_downset v) :
    IsMin x
declarations.source:
/-- In a poset of height two, every element in the downset of v is minimal. -/
theorem poset_downset_subset_min {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P]
    (hP : poset_height_two P) (v : P) {x : P} (hx : x ∈ poset_downset v) :
    IsMin x := by
  rw [isMin_iff_forall_not_lt]
  intro y hy
  exact hP y x v ⟨hy, hx⟩
declarations.reading: For any partially ordered type $P$ satisfying `poset_height_two P` (that is, there do not exist elements $a, b, c \in P$ such that $a < b < c$), and for any element $v \in P$ and any element $x \in P$, if $x \in \text{poset\_downset } v$ (that is, $x < v$), then $x$ is a minimal element of $P$ (`IsMin x`).

declarations.name: poset_upset_subset_max
declarations.informal: In a poset of height two, every element strictly above any element u is maximal.
declarations.statement:
theorem poset_upset_subset_max {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P]
    (hP : poset_height_two P) (u : P) {y : P} (hy : y ∈ poset_upset u) :
    IsMax y
declarations.source:
/-- In a poset of height two, every element in the upset of u is maximal. -/
theorem poset_upset_subset_max {P : Type*} [PartialOrder P]
    (hP : poset_height_two P) (u : P) {y : P} (hy : y ∈ poset_upset u) :
    IsMax y := by
  intro b hyb
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hyb with h | h
  · exact le_of_eq h.symm
  · exact absurd ⟨hy, h⟩ (hP u y b)
declarations.reading: Let $P$ be a partially ordered type. Assume that $P$ has height at most 2, in the sense that there do not exist $a, b, c \in P$ with $a < b$ and $b < c$. Then for any $u \in P$ and any $y \in P$ strictly above $u$ ($y \in \{y' \mid u < y'\}$), $y$ is a maximal element of $P$ (`IsMax y`).

declarations.name: causal_code_val_unique
declarations.informal: For a fixed message msg, any two assignments of transmission values satisfying the linear recurrence val m = sum alpha*msg + sum beta*val agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem causal_code_val_unique
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K)
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (msg : K → Fin code.L → F)
    (val val' : Fin code.M → F)
    (hval : ∀ m, val m = ∑ k, ∑ j, code.α m k j * msg k j + ∑ m', code.β m m' * val m')
    (hval' : ∀ m, val' m = ∑ k, ∑ j, code.α m k j * msg k j + ∑ m', code.β m m' * val' m') :
    val = val'
declarations.source:
/-- The transmission values of a causal linear code are uniquely determined by the message. -/
theorem causal_code_val_unique
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K)
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (msg : K → Fin code.L → F)
    (val val' : Fin code.M → F)
    (hval : ∀ m, val m = ∑ k, ∑ j, code.α m k j * msg k j + ∑ m', code.β m m' * val m')
    (hval' : ∀ m, val' m = ∑ k, ∑ j, code.α m k j * msg k j + ∑ m', code.β m m' * val' m') :
    val = val' := by
  ext m
  induction m using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | ind m ih =>
    rw [hval m, hval' m]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m' _
    by_cases hβ : code.β m m' = 0
    · rw [hβ, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    · have hlt : m' < m := code.causal m m' hβ
      rw [ih m' hlt]

declarations.name: flow_cut_divergence_eq
declarations.informal: Summing net vertex divergence of any flow f over a vertex set S equals the cut-crossing flow leaving S minus the cut-crossing flow entering S.
declarations.statement:
theorem flow_cut_divergence_eq
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (f : V → V → ℝ) (S : Finset V) :
    ∑ v ∈ S, ((∑ w, f v w) - (∑ u, f u v)) =
    (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f v w)) - (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ u, (if u ∈ S then 0 else f u v))
declarations.source:
/-- Summing net vertex divergence of any flow f over a vertex set S equals the cut-crossing flow leaving S minus the cut-crossing flow entering S. -/
theorem flow_cut_divergence_eq
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (f : V → V → ℝ) (S : Finset V) :
    ∑ v ∈ S, ((∑ w, f v w) - (∑ u, f u v)) =
    (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f v w)) - (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ u, (if u ∈ S then 0 else f u v)) := by
  have hsplit_out (v : V) :
      (∑ w, f v w) = (∑ w ∈ S, f v w) + (∑ w ∈ Sᶜ, f v w) := by
    exact (Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S (fun w => f v w)).symm
  have hsplit_in (v : V) :
      (∑ u, f u v) = (∑ u ∈ S, f u v) + (∑ u ∈ Sᶜ, f u v) := by
    exact (Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S (fun u => f u v)).symm
  have hcompl_out (v : V) :
      (∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f v w)) = ∑ w ∈ Sᶜ, f v w := by
    calc
      (∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f v w))
          = ∑ w, (if w ∈ Sᶜ then f v w else 0) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro w _
            by_cases hw : w ∈ S
            · simp [hw]
            · simp [hw]
      _ = ∑ w ∈ Sᶜ, f v w := by
            simpa using (Finset.sum_ite_mem (Finset.univ : Finset V) Sᶜ (fun w => f v w))
  have hcompl_in (v : V) :
      (∑ u, (if u ∈ S then 0 else f u v)) = ∑ u ∈ Sᶜ, f u v := by
    calc
      (∑ u, (if u ∈ S then 0 else f u v))
          = ∑ u, (if u ∈ Sᶜ then f u v else 0) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro u _
            by_cases hu : u ∈ S
            · simp [hu]
            · simp [hu]
      _ = ∑ u ∈ Sᶜ, f u v := by
            simpa using (Finset.sum_ite_mem (Finset.univ : Finset V) Sᶜ (fun u => f u v))
  have hL1 : (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, f v w) =
      (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w ∈ S, f v w) + (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w ∈ Sᶜ, f v w) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro v _
    exact hsplit_out v
  have hL2 : (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ u, f u v) =
      (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ u ∈ S, f u v) + (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ u ∈ Sᶜ, f u v) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro v _
    exact hsplit_in v
  have hA : (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w ∈ S, f v w) = (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ u ∈ S, f u v) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have hR1 : (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f v w)) =
      ∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w ∈ Sᶜ, f v w := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro v _
    exact hcompl_out v
  have hR2 : (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ u, (if u ∈ S then 0 else f u v)) =
      ∑ v ∈ S, ∑ u ∈ Sᶜ, f u v := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro v _
    exact hcompl_in v
  rw [hR1, hR2, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hL1, hL2, hA]
  ring

declarations.name: saddle_gap_first_marginal
declarations.informal: For σ in the standard simplex `stdSimplex ℝ (Fin n × Fin n)`, its first marginal `saddle_gap_first_marginal σ` in `stdSimplex ℝ (Fin n)` has i-th coordinate equal to the sum over j of σ(i, j).
declarations.statement: def saddle_gap_first_marginal {n : ℕ} (σ : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin n × Fin n)) : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin n)
declarations.source:
/-- First marginal distribution of a joint strategy σ on Fin n × Fin n. -/
def saddle_gap_first_marginal {n : ℕ} (σ : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin n × Fin n)) : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin n) := ⟨fun i => ∑ j : Fin n, σ.val (i, j), by
  constructor
  · intro i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => σ.property.1 (i, j)
  · rw [← Finset.sum_product']
    exact σ.property.2⟩
declarations.reading: For any natural number $n$, defines a function `saddle_gap_first_marginal` mapping an element $\sigma$ of the standard simplex on $\mathrm{Fin}(n) \times \mathrm{Fin}(n)$ over $\mathbb{R}$ to the standard simplex on $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ over $\mathbb{R}$, whose value at $i : \mathrm{Fin}(n)$ is given by the marginal sum $\sum_{j : \mathrm{Fin}(n)} \sigma(i, j)$.

declarations.name: flow_session_cut_demand_eq
declarations.informal: Summing the session demand indicators over a cut S yields r if src ∈ S and tgt ∉ S, -r if src ∉ S and tgt ∈ S, and 0 otherwise.
declarations.statement:
theorem flow_session_cut_demand_eq
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K]
    (sess : UnicastSessions V K) (r : ℝ) (k : K) (S : Finset V) :
    ∑ v ∈ S, (if v = sess.src k then r else if v = sess.tgt k then -r else 0) =
      if sess.src k ∈ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∉ S then r
      else if sess.src k ∉ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∈ S then -r
      else 0
declarations.source:
/-- Summing the session demand indicators over a cut S yields r if src ∈ S and tgt ∉ S, -r if src ∉ S and tgt ∈ S, and 0 otherwise. -/
theorem flow_session_cut_demand_eq
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K]
    (sess : UnicastSessions V K) (r : ℝ) (k : K) (S : Finset V) :
    ∑ v ∈ S, (if v = sess.src k then r else if v = sess.tgt k then -r else 0) =
      if sess.src k ∈ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∉ S then r
      else if sess.src k ∉ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∈ S then -r
      else 0 := by
  have hsplit :
      (∑ v ∈ S, (if v = sess.src k then r else if v = sess.tgt k then -r else 0))
        = (∑ v ∈ S, (if v = sess.src k then r else 0))
          + (∑ v ∈ S, (if v = sess.tgt k then -r else 0)) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro v hv
    by_cases hvs : v = sess.src k
    · simp [hvs, sess.src_ne_tgt k]
    · simp [hvs]
  rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  by_cases hsrc : sess.src k ∈ S <;> by_cases htgt : sess.tgt k ∈ S <;>
    simp [hsrc, htgt]

declarations.name: symmetric_game_regret
declarations.informal: For a positive natural number n, an n-by-n matrix A over ℝ, and a strategy p in `stdSimplex ℝ (Fin n)`, the symmetric game regret `symmetric_game_regret A p` is `Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => Matrix.mulVec A p.val i) - dotProduct p.val (Matrix.mulVec A p.val)`.
declarations.statement: def symmetric_game_regret {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (p : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin n)) : ℝ
declarations.source:
/-- Symmetric game regret of a strategy p: max_i e_iᵀ A p - pᵀ A p. -/
def symmetric_game_regret {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (p : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin n)) : ℝ := (Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => Matrix.mulVec A p.val i)) - dotProduct p.val (Matrix.mulVec A p.val)
declarations.reading:
Given a positive natural number $n$ (via `[NeZero n]`), an $n \times n$ real matrix $A$, and a probability vector $p$ in the standard simplex on `Fin n` over $\mathbb{R}$ (i.e., $p \in \Delta^{n-1}$), `symmetric_game_regret A p` is defined as the real number:

$$\left(\max_{i \in \{0, \dots, n-1\}} (A p)_i\right) - p \cdot (A p)$$

that is, the maximum entry of the matrix-vector product $A p$ minus the dot product of $p$ with $A p$.

declarations.name: linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound
declarations.informal: If a linear network code over a field F supports the common rate r on net with sessions sess, then for every vertex set S, r times the number of sessions crossing S is at most the total capacity leaving S.
declarations.statement:
theorem linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r : ℝ}
    (h : LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess r) (S : Finset V) :
    r * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) ≤ cutCapacity net S
declarations.source:
noncomputable def linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    {F : Type} [Field F] {net : CapacitatedNetwork V} {sess : UnicastSessions V K}
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (msg : K → Fin code.L → F) :
    Fin code.M → F :=
  (code.correct msg).choose

theorem linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_recurrence
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    {F : Type} [Field F] {net : CapacitatedNetwork V} {sess : UnicastSessions V K}
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (msg : K → Fin code.L → F) (m : Fin code.M) :
    linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code msg m =
      ∑ k, ∑ j, code.α m k j * msg k j + ∑ m', code.β m m' * linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code msg m' :=
  (code.correct msg).choose_spec.1 m

theorem linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_decode
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    {F : Type} [Field F] {net : CapacitatedNetwork V} {sess : UnicastSessions V K}
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (msg : K → Fin code.L → F) (k : K) (j : Fin code.L) :
    msg k j = ∑ m, code.γ k j m * linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code msg m :=
  (code.correct msg).choose_spec.2 k j

theorem linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_add
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    {F : Type} [Field F] {net : CapacitatedNetwork V} {sess : UnicastSessions V K}
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (msg msg' : K → Fin code.L → F) :
    linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code (msg + msg') =
      linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code msg + linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code msg' := by
  apply causal_code_val_unique F net sess code (msg + msg')
  · exact linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_recurrence code (msg + msg')
  · intro m
    rw [Pi.add_apply, linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_recurrence code msg m,
      linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_recurrence code msg' m]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    abel

theorem linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_smul
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    {F : Type} [Field F] {net : CapacitatedNetwork V} {sess : UnicastSessions V K}
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (c : F) (msg : K → Fin code.L → F) :
    linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code (c • msg) =
      c • linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code msg := by
  apply causal_code_val_unique F net sess code (c • msg)
  · exact linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_recurrence code (c • msg)
  · intro m
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_recurrence code msg m]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
      ring
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro m' _
      ring

abbrev linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout {V K : Type} (sess : UnicastSessions V K) (S : Finset V) :=
  {k : K // sess.src k ∈ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∉ S}

abbrev linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_mout {V K F : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Field F]
    {net : CapacitatedNetwork V} {sess : UnicastSessions V K}
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (S : Finset V) :=
  {m : Fin code.M // code.snd m ∈ S ∧ code.rcv m ∉ S}

noncomputable def linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg {V K F : Type} [Zero F] [DecidableEq V]
    {sess : UnicastSessions V K} (L : ℕ) (S : Finset V)
    (f : linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess S → Fin L → F) : K → Fin L → F :=
  fun k j => if h : sess.src k ∈ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∉ S then f ⟨k, h⟩ j else 0

noncomputable def linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_cut_map {V K F : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Field F]
    {net : CapacitatedNetwork V} {sess : UnicastSessions V K}
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (S : Finset V) :
    (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess S → Fin code.L → F) →ₗ[F]
      (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_mout code S → F) where
  toFun f m := linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S f) m.1
  map_add' f g := by
    ext m
    have h_ext : linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S (f + g) =
      linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S f + linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S g := by
      ext k j
      simp only [linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg, Pi.add_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [h_ext, linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_add]
    rfl
  map_smul' c f := by
    ext m
    have h_ext : linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S (c • f) =
      c • linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S f := by
      ext k j
      simp only [linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg, Pi.smul_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    rw [h_ext, linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_smul]
    rfl

theorem linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_cut_map_injective {V K F : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Field F]
    {net : CapacitatedNetwork V} {sess : UnicastSessions V K}
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (S : Finset V) :
    Function.Injective (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_cut_map code S) := by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro f hf
  have h_mzero : ∀ m : linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_mout code S,
      linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S f) m.1 = 0 := by
    intro m
    exact congr_fun hf m
  have h_outside := causal_code_vals_zero_outside F net sess code S
    (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S f)
    (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val code (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S f))
    (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_recurrence code (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S f))
    (by
      intro k j hk
      dsimp [linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact False.elim (hk h.1)
      · rfl)
    (by
      intro m hsnd hrcv
      exact h_mzero ⟨m, hsnd, hrcv⟩)
  ext ⟨k, hk⟩ j
  have h_dec := linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_code_val_decode code
    (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg code.L S f) k j
  dsimp [linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_extend_msg] at h_dec
  split_ifs at h_dec
  rw [h_dec]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro m _
  by_cases hγ : code.γ k j m = 0
  · rw [hγ, zero_mul]
  · have h_tgt := code.dec_local k j m hγ
    have h_rcv_not : code.rcv m ∉ S := by
      rw [h_tgt]
      exact hk.2
    have h_val_zero := h_outside m h_rcv_not
    rw [h_val_zero, mul_zero]

theorem linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_cut_card_le {V K F : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Field F]
    {net : CapacitatedNetwork V} {sess : UnicastSessions V K}
    (code : CausalLinearNetworkCode V K F net sess) (S : Finset V) :
    Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess S) * code.L ≤
      Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_mout code S) := by
  have hinj := linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_cut_map_injective code S
  have hrank := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hinj
  have e : (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess S → Fin code.L → F) ≃ₗ[F]
      (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess S × Fin code.L → F) :=
    (LinearEquiv.curry F F (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess S) (Fin code.L)).symm
  rw [LinearEquiv.finrank_eq e] at hrank
  rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at hrank
  rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at hrank
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin] at hrank
  exact hrank

/-- Cut-set bound: the rate of a linear network code is at most capacity over crossing sessions on every cut. -/
theorem linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r : ℝ}
    (h : LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess r) (S : Finset V) :
    r * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) ≤ cutCapacity net S := by
  rcases h with ⟨code, hr⟩
  have h_le_S := linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_cut_card_le code S
  have h_le_Sc := linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_cut_card_le code Sᶜ
  have h_sum_le : (Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess S) +
      Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess Sᶜ)) * code.L ≤
    Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_mout code S) +
      Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_mout code Sᶜ) := by
    calc
      _ = Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess S) * code.L +
          Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess Sᶜ) * code.L := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add h_le_S h_le_Sc
  have h_k_eq : cutSeparation sess S =
      Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess S) +
      Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_kout sess Sᶜ) := by
    dsimp [cutSeparation]
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype, Fintype.card_subtype]
    have h_eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => (sess.src k ∈ S) ≠ (sess.tgt k ∈ S))) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => sess.src k ∈ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∉ S)) ∪
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => sess.src k ∈ Sᶜ ∧ sess.tgt k ∉ Sᶜ)) := by
      ext k
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_compl]
      tauto
    rw [h_eq, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint]
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro k _ h1 h2
    simp only [Finset.mem_compl] at h2
    exact h2.1 h1.1
  have h_m_eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin code.M => (code.snd m ∈ S) ≠ (code.rcv m ∈ S))).card =
      Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_mout code S) +
      Fintype.card (linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound_mout code Sᶜ) := by
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype, Fintype.card_subtype]
    have h_eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin code.M => (code.snd m ∈ S) ≠ (code.rcv m ∈ S))) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun m => code.snd m ∈ S ∧ code.rcv m ∉ S)) ∪
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun m => code.snd m ∈ Sᶜ ∧ code.rcv m ∉ Sᶜ)) := by
      ext m
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_compl]
      tauto
    rw [h_eq, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint]
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro m _ h1 h2
    simp only [Finset.mem_compl] at h2
    exact h2.1 h1.1
  rw [← h_k_eq] at h_sum_le
  rw [← h_m_eq] at h_sum_le
  have h_trans := code_transmissions_cross_cut_le F net sess code S
  have h_sep_L_le : (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) * (code.L : ℝ) ≤ (code.T : ℝ) * cutCapacity net S := by
    have h_nat : (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) * (code.L : ℝ) ≤
      ↑(Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin code.M => (code.snd m ∈ S) ≠ (code.rcv m ∈ S))).card := by
      exact_mod_cast h_sum_le
    exact le_trans h_nat h_trans
  have hT_pos : 0 < (code.T : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr code.hT
  have hsep_nonneg : 0 ≤ (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg (cutSeparation sess S)
  have h1 : r * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) ≤ ((code.L : ℝ) / (code.T : ℝ)) * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr hsep_nonneg
  have h2 : ((code.L : ℝ) / (code.T : ℝ)) * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) =
    ((cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) * (code.L : ℝ)) / (code.T : ℝ) := by ring
  rw [h2] at h1
  have h3 : ((cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) * (code.L : ℝ)) / (code.T : ℝ) ≤ cutCapacity net S := by
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hT_pos).mpr (by linarith)
  linarith

declarations.source:
/-- Express cutSeparation as a sum of real indicator functions over sessions k in K. -/
theorem cutSeparation_eq_sum

declarations.name: linear_code_rate_le_cut_cone_bound
declarations.informal: If a linear network code over a field F supports the common rate r, then for any finite family of vertex sets cuts and any nonnegative weights y on them with positive total weighted separation, r is at most (sum over cuts of y*cutCapacity)/(sum over cuts of y*cutSeparation).
declarations.statement:
theorem linear_code_rate_le_cut_cone_bound
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r : ℝ}
    (h : LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess r) (cuts : Finset (Finset V)) (y : Finset V → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ S ∈ cuts, 0 ≤ y S)
    (hpos : 0 < ∑ S ∈ cuts, y S * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ)) :
    r ≤ (∑ S ∈ cuts, y S * cutCapacity net S) / (∑ S ∈ cuts, y S * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ))
declarations.source:
/-- Cut cone bound: a linear code's rate is at most the weighted cut ratio for any nonnegative weighting of cuts. -/
theorem linear_code_rate_le_cut_cone_bound
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r : ℝ}
    (h : LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess r) (cuts : Finset (Finset V)) (y : Finset V → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ S ∈ cuts, 0 ≤ y S)
    (hpos : 0 < ∑ S ∈ cuts, y S * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ)) :
    r ≤ (∑ S ∈ cuts, y S * cutCapacity net S) / (∑ S ∈ cuts, y S * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ)) := by
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro S hS
  have hcut := linear_code_supports_rate_cut_bound F net sess h S
  have hyS := hy S hS
  nlinarith

declarations.name: flow_rate_mul_sep_le_cut_capacity
declarations.informal: If a fractional multicommodity flow supports the common rate r, then for every vertex set S, r times the number of sessions crossing S is at most the total capacity leaving S.
declarations.statement:
theorem flow_rate_mul_sep_le_cut_capacity
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r : ℝ}
    (h : FlowSupportsRate net sess r) (S : Finset V) :
    r * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) ≤ cutCapacity net S
declarations.source:
/-- A flow-supported rate is bounded on every cut by capacity over number of crossing sessions. -/
theorem flow_rate_mul_sep_le_cut_capacity
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r : ℝ}
    (h : FlowSupportsRate net sess r) (S : Finset V) :
    r * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) ≤ cutCapacity net S := by
  obtain ⟨f, hnn, hcap, hdiv⟩ := h
  -- Each session's outflow across the cut, and its inflow across the cut.
  have hout_nn : ∀ k : K, 0 ≤ ∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w) := by
    intro k
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun v _ => ?_)
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun w _ => ?_)
    by_cases hw : w ∈ S
    · simp [hw]
    · simp only [hw, if_false]
      exact hnn k v w
  have hinn_nn : ∀ k : K, 0 ≤ ∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v) := by
    intro k
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun v _ => ?_)
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun w _ => ?_)
    by_cases hw : w ∈ S
    · simp [hw]
    · simp only [hw, if_false]
      exact hnn k w v
  -- Net flow across the cut equals the demand of the session summed over the cut.
  have hdiv_cut : ∀ k : K,
      (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w)) - (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v)) =
      (if sess.src k ∈ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∉ S then r else if sess.src k ∉ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∈ S then -r else 0) := by
    intro k
    rw [← flow_cut_divergence_eq (f k) S]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => hdiv k v)]
    exact flow_session_cut_demand_eq sess r k S
  -- Per session: the total flow across the cut in both directions is at least `r` if the
  -- session crosses the cut, and at least `0` otherwise.
  have hkey : ∀ k : K,
      r * (if sess.src k ∈ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∉ S then (1:ℝ)
        else if sess.src k ∉ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∈ S then 1 else 0) ≤
      (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w)) + (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v)) := by
    intro k
    have hD := hdiv_cut k
    have hn1 := hout_nn k
    have hn2 := hinn_nn k
    by_cases hs : sess.src k ∈ S <;> by_cases ht : sess.tgt k ∈ S
    · have hD' : (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w)) - (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v)) = 0 := by
        rw [hD]; simp [hs, ht]
      simp [hs, ht]
      linarith
    · have hD' : (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w)) - (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v)) = r := by
        rw [hD]; simp [hs, ht]
      simp [hs, ht]
      linarith
    · have hD' : (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w)) - (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v)) = -r := by
        rw [hD]; simp [hs, ht]
      simp [hs, ht]
      linarith
    · have hD' : (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w)) - (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v)) = 0 := by
        rw [hD]; simp [hs, ht]
      simp [hs, ht]
      linarith
  have hsep_eq : (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) =
      ∑ k : K, (if sess.src k ∈ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∉ S then (1:ℝ)
        else if sess.src k ∉ S ∧ sess.tgt k ∈ S then 1 else 0) := by
    rw [cutSeparation_eq_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    by_cases hs : sess.src k ∈ S <;> by_cases ht : sess.tgt k ∈ S <;> simp [hs, ht]
  -- Lower bound: sum the per-session inequality over all sessions.
  have hsum_lower : r * (cutSeparation sess S : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ k : K, ((∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w)) +
        (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v))) := by
    rw [hsep_eq, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k _ => hkey k)
  have hmerge : ∀ k : K,
      (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w)) + (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v))
      = ∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else (f k v w + f k w v)) := by
    intro k
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => ?_)
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => ?_)
    by_cases hw : w ∈ S
    · simp [hw]
    · simp only [hw, if_false]
  have hstep : (∑ k : K, ∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else (f k v w + f k w v)))
      = ∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else ∑ k : K, (f k v w + f k w v)) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun w _ => ?_)
    by_cases hw : w ∈ S
    · simp [hw]
    · simp only [hw, if_false]
  -- Upper bound: the capacity constraint, summed over the ordered crossing pairs.
  have hbound : (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else ∑ k : K, (f k v w + f k w v)))
      ≤ cutCapacity net S := by
    simp only [cutCapacity]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun v hv => ?_)
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun w _ => ?_)
    by_cases hw : w ∈ S
    · simp [hw]
    · simp only [hw, if_false]
      exact hcap v w (fun hvw => hw (hvw ▸ hv))
  have hsum_upper : (∑ k : K, ((∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w)) +
        (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v)))) ≤ cutCapacity net S := by
    have h1 : (∑ k : K, ((∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k v w)) +
        (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else f k w v))))
        = ∑ k : K, ∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w, (if w ∈ S then 0 else (f k v w + f k w v)) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hmerge k)
    rw [h1, hstep]
    exact hbound
  exact le_trans hsum_lower hsum_upper

declarations.name: single_counter_step_preserves_one_coord
declarations.informal: In any single step of a 2-counter machine with single-counter updates, at least one counter remains unchanged.
declarations.statement:
theorem single_counter_step_preserves_one_coord {Q : Type*} (M : TwoCounterMachine Q)
    (hsc : two_counter_machine_is_single_counter_update M)
    (c₁ c₂ : Q × ℕ × ℕ) (hstep : two_counter_machine_step M c₁ c₂) :
    c₂.2.1 = c₁.2.1 ∨ c₂.2.2 = c₁.2.2
declarations.source:
/-- In any single step of a 2-counter machine with single-counter updates, at least one counter remains unchanged. -/
theorem single_counter_step_preserves_one_coord {Q : Type*} (M : TwoCounterMachine Q)
    (hsc : two_counter_machine_is_single_counter_update M)
    (c₁ c₂ : Q × ℕ × ℕ) (hstep : two_counter_machine_step M c₁ c₂) :
    c₂.2.1 = c₁.2.1 ∨ c₂.2.2 = c₁.2.2 := by
  rcases hstep with (⟨w₁, w₂, htr, h₁, h₂⟩ | ⟨_, _, h⟩ | ⟨_, _, h⟩)
  · have hsc' := hsc c₁.1 c₂.1 w₁ w₂ htr
    rcases hsc' with hw₁ | hw₂
    · left
      subst hw₁
      simp only [add_zero] at h₁
      exact Nat.cast_injective h₁.symm
    · right
      subst hw₂
      simp only [add_zero] at h₂
      exact Nat.cast_injective h₂.symm
  · left
    exact congr_arg Prod.fst h
  · left
    exact congr_arg Prod.fst h

declarations.name: diag_two_counter_machine_is_symmetric
declarations.informal: The 2-counter machine over Bool with a single update (1, 1) from false to true is symmetric.
declarations.statement:
theorem diag_two_counter_machine_is_symmetric :
    two_counter_machine_is_symmetric (⟨{(false, TwoCounterInstr.update 1 1, true)}⟩ : TwoCounterMachine Bool)
declarations.source:
/-- The 2-counter machine over Bool with a single update (1, 1) from false to true is symmetric. -/
theorem diag_two_counter_machine_is_symmetric :
    two_counter_machine_is_symmetric (⟨{(false, TwoCounterInstr.update 1 1, true)}⟩ : TwoCounterMachine Bool) := by
  intro q q' w₁ w₂ h
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq, TwoCounterInstr.update.injEq] at h ⊢
  tauto

declarations.name: diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff
declarations.informal: The reachability relation of the diagonal machine between false and true consists exactly of pairs (u, v) with v = (u.1 + 1, u.2 + 1).
declarations.statement:
theorem diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff (u v : ℕ × ℕ) :
    (u, v) ∈ two_counter_machine_reach_rel (⟨{(false, TwoCounterInstr.update 1 1, true)}⟩ : TwoCounterMachine Bool) false true ↔
      v.1 = u.1 + 1 ∧ v.2 = u.2 + 1
declarations.source:
abbrev diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff_M : TwoCounterMachine Bool :=
  ⟨{(false, TwoCounterInstr.update 1 1, true)}⟩

theorem diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff_step (c₁ c₂ : Bool × ℕ × ℕ) :
    two_counter_machine_step diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff_M c₁ c₂ ↔
      c₁.1 = false ∧ c₂.1 = true ∧ c₂.2.1 = c₁.2.1 + 1 ∧ c₂.2.2 = c₁.2.2 + 1 := by
  dsimp [two_counter_machine_step, diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff_M]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨w₁, w₂, h, h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩)
    · simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq, TwoCounterInstr.update.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨h1_st, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, h2_st⟩ := h
      refine ⟨h1_st, h2_st, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact_mod_cast h1.symm
      · exact_mod_cast h2.symm
    · simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      cases h.2.1
    · simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      cases h.2.1
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    left
    refine ⟨1, 1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [h1, h2]
    · exact_mod_cast h3.symm
    · exact_mod_cast h4.symm

/-- The reachability relation of the diagonal machine between false and true consists exactly of pairs (u, v) with v = (u.1 + 1, u.2 + 1). -/
theorem diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff (u v : ℕ × ℕ) :
    (u, v) ∈ two_counter_machine_reach_rel (⟨{(false, TwoCounterInstr.update 1 1, true)}⟩ : TwoCounterMachine Bool) false true ↔
      v.1 = u.1 + 1 ∧ v.2 = u.2 + 1 := by
  change Relation.ReflTransGen (two_counter_machine_step diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff_M) (false, u) (true, v) ↔
    v.1 = u.1 + 1 ∧ v.2 = u.2 + 1
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [Relation.ReflTransGen.cases_head_iff] at h
    rcases h with h_refl | ⟨c, hstep, hrest⟩
    · exfalso
      have : false = true := (Prod.ext_iff.mp h_refl).1
      cases this
    · rw [diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff_step] at hstep
      rcases hstep with ⟨-, hc_state, hu1, hu2⟩
      rw [Relation.ReflTransGen.cases_head_iff] at hrest
      rcases hrest with rfl | ⟨c', hstep', -⟩
      · rw [← hu1, ← hu2]
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · exfalso
        rw [diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff_step] at hstep'
        rw [hc_state] at hstep'
        cases hstep'.1
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single
    rw [diag_two_counter_machine_reach_rel_iff_step]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl, h1, h2⟩

declarations.name: round_robin_sequence_count_eq
declarations.informal: The number of times agent a appears in the Round-Robin sequence of n agents and m goods is (m + (n - 1 - a)) / n.
declarations.statement:
theorem round_robin_sequence_count_eq (n m : ℕ) [NeZero n] (a : Fin n) :
    (round_robin_sequence n m).count a = (m + (n - 1 - a.val)) / n
declarations.source:
lemma round_robin_sequence_count_eq_dvd_eq_self {n Y : ℕ} (h1 : 0 < Y) (h2 : Y < 2 * n) (hdiv : n ∣ Y) : Y = n := by
  rcases hdiv with ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hk_lt : k < 2 := by
    by_contra! h
    have : 2 * n ≤ n * k := by
      calc 2 * n = n * 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ n * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n h
    omega
  have hk_pos : 0 < k := by
    by_contra! h
    have : k = 0 := by omega
    subst this
    simp at h1
  have : k = 1 := by omega
  subst this
  simp

lemma round_robin_sequence_count_eq_dvd_iff (n m a : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (ha : a < n) :
    (n ∣ (m + (n - 1 - a) + 1)) ↔ m % n = a := by
  have H : m + (n - 1 - a) + 1 = n * (m / n) + (m % n + (n - 1 - a) + 1) := by
    have := Nat.div_add_mod m n
    omega
  rw [H, Nat.dvd_add_right (dvd_mul_right n (m / n))]
  have hr : m % n < n := Nat.mod_lt m hn
  have h1 : 0 < m % n + (n - 1 - a) + 1 := by omega
  have h2 : m % n + (n - 1 - a) + 1 < 2 * n := by omega
  constructor
  · intro hdvd
    have := round_robin_sequence_count_eq_dvd_eq_self h1 h2 hdvd
    omega
  · rintro rfl
    have : m % n + (n - 1 - m % n) + 1 = n := by omega
    rw [this]

lemma round_robin_sequence_count_eq_succ (n m : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    round_robin_sequence n (m + 1) = (round_robin_sequence n m).concat ⟨m % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos n)⟩ := by
  unfold round_robin_sequence
  rw [List.ofFn_succ']
  congr 1

/-- Exact pick count of an agent in the Round-Robin sequence: agent a picks (m + n - 1 - a)/n times. -/
theorem round_robin_sequence_count_eq (n m : ℕ) [NeZero n] (a : Fin n) :
    (round_robin_sequence n m).count a = (m + (n - 1 - a.val)) / n := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    have : (round_robin_sequence n 0) = [] := by
      unfold round_robin_sequence
      rfl
    rw [this]
    simp only [List.count_nil]
    have ha : a.val < n := a.isLt
    have hn : 0 < n := NeZero.pos n
    have : 0 + (n - 1 - a.val) < n := by omega
    rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt this]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [round_robin_sequence_count_eq_succ]
    rw [List.concat_eq_append, List.count_append, ih]
    rw [List.count_singleton]
    have h_count_sing : (if (⟨m % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos n)⟩ : Fin n) == a then 1 else 0) =
        (if m % n = a.val then 1 else 0) := by
      split_ifs with h1 h2 h3
      · rfl
      · exfalso
        apply h2
        rw [beq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff] at h1
        exact h1
      · exfalso
        apply h1
        rw [beq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
        exact h3
      · rfl
    rw [h_count_sing]
    have h_succ_div : (m + 1 + (n - 1 - a.val)) / n =
        (m + (n - 1 - a.val)) / n + if n ∣ (m + (n - 1 - a.val) + 1) then 1 else 0 := by
      have : m + 1 + (n - 1 - a.val) = (m + (n - 1 - a.val)) + 1 := by omega
      rw [this, Nat.succ_div]
    rw [h_succ_div]
    have h_dvd := round_robin_sequence_count_eq_dvd_iff n m a.val (NeZero.pos n) a.isLt
    simp only [h_dvd]

declarations.name: round_robin_alpha_three_eq_of_two_directions
declarations.informal: If 2/3 is a guaranteed EF1 factor for three agents and no factor above 2/3 is guaranteed, then the best guaranteed factor for three agents is 2/3.
declarations.statement:
theorem round_robin_alpha_three_eq_of_two_directions
    (hlow : is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor 3 (2 / 3))
    (hup : ∀ α : ℝ, 2 / 3 < α → ¬ is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor 3 α) :
    round_robin_alpha 3 = 2 / 3
declarations.source:
/-- Assembly step: the two halves of the characterisation give round_robin_alpha 3 = 2/3. -/
theorem round_robin_alpha_three_eq_of_two_directions
    (hlow : is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor 3 (2 / 3))
    (hup : ∀ α : ℝ, 2 / 3 < α → ¬ is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor 3 α) :
    round_robin_alpha 3 = 2 / 3 := by
  set s : Set ℝ := {α : ℝ | is_guaranteed_round_robin_ef1_factor 3 α} with hs
  have hne : s.Nonempty := ⟨2 / 3, hlow⟩
  have hupper : ∀ a ∈ s, a ≤ 2 / 3 := fun a ha => le_of_not_gt fun h => hup a h ha
  have hbdd : BddAbove s := ⟨2 / 3, hupper⟩
  have hmain : round_robin_alpha 3 = sSup s := rfl
  rw [hmain]
  exact le_antisymm (csSup_le hne hupper) (le_csSup hbdd hlow)

declarations.name: flow_rate_lt_of_strict_metric_bound
declarations.informal: If a fractional multicommodity flow supports common rate r on net with sessions sess, and d is a nonnegative, symmetric, triangle-satisfying function on V with d(u,u) = 0 and positive total session length sum_k d(src k, tgt k), and the capacity-weighted total length is strictly less than 2*c times the total session length, then r < c.
declarations.statement:
theorem flow_rate_lt_of_strict_metric_bound
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r c : ℝ}
    (h : FlowSupportsRate net sess r) (d : V → V → ℝ)
    (h_nonneg : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ d u v) (h_symm : ∀ u v, d u v = d v u)
    (h_diag : ∀ u, d u u = 0) (h_tri : ∀ u v w, d u v ≤ d u w + d w v)
    (hpos : 0 < ∑ k, d (sess.src k) (sess.tgt k))
    (hlt : ∑ u, ∑ v, net.cap s(u, v) * d u v < 2 * c * (∑ k, d (sess.src k) (sess.tgt k))) :
    r < c
declarations.source:
/-- A strict pseudometric certificate caps every fractional flow rate strictly below c. -/
theorem flow_rate_lt_of_strict_metric_bound
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K) {r c : ℝ}
    (h : FlowSupportsRate net sess r) (d : V → V → ℝ)
    (h_nonneg : ∀ u v, 0 ≤ d u v) (h_symm : ∀ u v, d u v = d v u)
    (h_diag : ∀ u, d u u = 0) (h_tri : ∀ u v w, d u v ≤ d u w + d w v)
    (hpos : 0 < ∑ k, d (sess.src k) (sess.tgt k))
    (hlt : ∑ u, ∑ v, net.cap s(u, v) * d u v < 2 * c * (∑ k, d (sess.src k) (sess.tgt k))) :
    r < c := by
  have hmain := flow_rate_mul_two_le_sum_cap_mul_dist net sess h d h_nonneg h_symm h_diag h_tri
  nlinarith

declarations.name: linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix
declarations.informal: Given M transmissions with endpoints snd, rcv on a capacitated network, a time horizon T > 0, a message dimension L > 0, capacity-respecting edge usage, encoding and decoding tables alpha, beta, gamma obeying causality and sender/receiver/decoder locality, and a transfer table W satisfying W m k j = alpha m k j + sum_{m'} beta m m' * W m' k j together with the decoding identity sum_m gamma k j m * W m k' j' = 1 if (k,j)=(k',j') and 0 otherwise, the resulting causal binary (or any-field) linear network code supports rate L/T.
declarations.statement:
theorem linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K)
    {M T L : ℕ} (hT : 0 < T) (hL : 0 < L)
    (snd rcv : Fin M → V) (hne : ∀ m, snd m ≠ rcv m)
    (hcap : ∀ e : Sym2 V,
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin M => s(snd m, rcv m) = e)).card : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) * net.cap e)
    (α : Fin M → K → Fin L → F) (β : Fin M → Fin M → F) (γ : K → Fin L → Fin M → F)
    (W : Fin M → K → Fin L → F)
    (hcausal : ∀ m m', β m m' ≠ 0 → m' < m)
    (hsnd : ∀ (m : Fin M) (k : K) (j : Fin L), α m k j ≠ 0 → sess.src k = snd m)
    (hrcv : ∀ (m m' : Fin M), β m m' ≠ 0 → rcv m' = snd m)
    (hdec : ∀ (k : K) (j : Fin L) (m : Fin M), γ k j m ≠ 0 → rcv m = sess.tgt k)
    (hW : ∀ (m : Fin M) (k : K) (j : Fin L), W m k j = α m k j + ∑ m', β m m' * W m' k j)
    (hD : ∀ (k : K) (j : Fin L) (k' : K) (j' : Fin L),
      (∑ m, γ k j m * W m k' j') = if k = k' ∧ j = j' then 1 else 0) :
    LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess ((L : ℝ) / (T : ℝ))
declarations.source:
lemma linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_sum_comm_univ {ι κ R : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [AddCommMonoid R]
    (f : ι → κ → R) : (∑ i, ∑ k, f i k) = ∑ k, ∑ i, f i k := Finset.sum_comm

lemma linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_triple_sum_swap {ι κ μ R : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype μ] [AddCommMonoid R]
    (f : ι → κ → μ → R) : (∑ i, ∑ k, ∑ l, f i k l) = ∑ l, ∑ i, ∑ k, f i k l := by
  calc (∑ i, ∑ k, ∑ l, f i k l)
      = ∑ k, ∑ i, ∑ l, f i k l := linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_sum_comm_univ _
    _ = ∑ k, ∑ l, ∑ i, f i k l := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _
          exact linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_sum_comm_univ (fun i l => f i k l)
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ k, ∑ i, f i k l := linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_sum_comm_univ _
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ i, ∑ k, f i k l := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro l _
          exact linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_sum_comm_univ (fun k i => f i k l)

lemma linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_triple_sum_rot {ι κ μ R : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype μ] [AddCommMonoid R]
    (f : ι → κ → μ → R) : (∑ i, ∑ k, ∑ l, f i k l) = ∑ k, ∑ l, ∑ i, f i k l := by
  calc (∑ i, ∑ k, ∑ l, f i k l)
      = ∑ k, ∑ i, ∑ l, f i k l := linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_sum_comm_univ _
    _ = ∑ k, ∑ l, ∑ i, f i k l := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _
          exact linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_sum_comm_univ (fun i l => f i k l)

lemma linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_rec {F : Type} [Field F] {MM K L : Type} [Fintype MM] [Fintype K] [Fintype L]
    (a : MM → K → L → F) (b : MM → MM → F) (W : MM → K → L → F) (msg : K → L → F)
    (m : MM) (hW : ∀ (m : MM) (k : K) (j : L), W m k j = a m k j + ∑ m', b m m' * W m' k j) :
    (∑ k, ∑ j, W m k j * msg k j) = (∑ k, ∑ j, a m k j * msg k j) + ∑ m', b m m' * (∑ k, ∑ j, W m' k j * msg k j) := by
  calc (∑ k, ∑ j, W m k j * msg k j)
      = ∑ k, ∑ j, (a m k j + ∑ m', b m m' * W m' k j) * msg k j := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
          rw [hW]
    _ = (∑ k, ∑ j, a m k j * msg k j) + ∑ k, ∑ j, (∑ m', b m m' * W m' k j) * msg k j := by
          simp only [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = (∑ k, ∑ j, a m k j * msg k j) + ∑ k, ∑ j, ∑ m', (b m m' * W m' k j) * msg k j := by
          congr 1
          simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = (∑ k, ∑ j, a m k j * msg k j) + ∑ m', ∑ k, ∑ j, (b m m' * W m' k j) * msg k j := by
          congr 1
          exact linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_triple_sum_swap (fun k j m' => (b m m' * W m' k j) * msg k j)
    _ = (∑ k, ∑ j, a m k j * msg k j) + ∑ m', b m m' * (∑ k, ∑ j, W m' k j * msg k j) := by
          congr 1
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro m' _
          simp only [mul_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]

lemma linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_ite_collapse {F : Type} [Field F] {K L : Type} [Fintype K] [Fintype L]
    [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L] (msg : K → L → F) (k : K) (j : L) :
    (∑ k', ∑ j', (if k = k' ∧ j = j' then (1:F) else 0) * msg k' j') = msg k j := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (a := k)]
  · simp only [true_and, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (a := j)]
    · simp
    · intro j' _ hj'
      simp [Ne.symm hj']
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) h
  · intro k' _ hk'
    simp [Ne.symm hk']
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ k) h

lemma linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_dec {F : Type} [Field F] {MM K L : Type} [Fintype MM] [Fintype K] [Fintype L]
    [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq L]
    (W : MM → K → L → F) (γ : K → L → MM → F) (msg : K → L → F) (k : K) (j : L)
    (hD : ∀ (k : K) (j : L) (k' : K) (j' : L), (∑ m, γ k j m * W m k' j') = if k = k' ∧ j = j' then 1 else 0) :
    msg k j = ∑ m, γ k j m * (∑ k', ∑ j', W m k' j' * msg k' j') := by
  symm
  calc (∑ m, γ k j m * (∑ k', ∑ j', W m k' j' * msg k' j'))
      = ∑ m, ∑ k', ∑ j', γ k j m * (W m k' j' * msg k' j') := by
          simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ k', ∑ j', ∑ m, γ k j m * (W m k' j' * msg k' j') := linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_triple_sum_rot _
    _ = ∑ k', ∑ j', (∑ m, γ k j m * W m k' j') * msg k' j' := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k' _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j' _
          simp only [← mul_assoc, Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ k', ∑ j', (if k = k' ∧ j = j' then (1:F) else 0) * msg k' j' := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro k' _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j' _
          rw [hD k j k' j']
    _ = msg k j := linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_ite_collapse msg k j

/-- A finite transfer-matrix certificate turns the code half of a witness into decidable table equations. -/
theorem linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix
    {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (F : Type) [Field F] (net : CapacitatedNetwork V) (sess : UnicastSessions V K)
    {M T L : ℕ} (hT : 0 < T) (hL : 0 < L)
    (snd rcv : Fin M → V) (hne : ∀ m, snd m ≠ rcv m)
    (hcap : ∀ e : Sym2 V,
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun m : Fin M => s(snd m, rcv m) = e)).card : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ) * net.cap e)
    (α : Fin M → K → Fin L → F) (β : Fin M → Fin M → F) (γ : K → Fin L → Fin M → F)
    (W : Fin M → K → Fin L → F)
    (hcausal : ∀ m m', β m m' ≠ 0 → m' < m)
    (hsnd : ∀ (m : Fin M) (k : K) (j : Fin L), α m k j ≠ 0 → sess.src k = snd m)
    (hrcv : ∀ (m m' : Fin M), β m m' ≠ 0 → rcv m' = snd m)
    (hdec : ∀ (k : K) (j : Fin L) (m : Fin M), γ k j m ≠ 0 → rcv m = sess.tgt k)
    (hW : ∀ (m : Fin M) (k : K) (j : Fin L), W m k j = α m k j + ∑ m', β m m' * W m' k j)
    (hD : ∀ (k : K) (j : Fin L) (k' : K) (j' : Fin L),
      (∑ m, γ k j m * W m k' j') = if k = k' ∧ j = j' then 1 else 0) :
    LinearCodeSupportsRate F net sess ((L : ℝ) / (T : ℝ)) := by
  refine ⟨{ M := M, T := T, L := L, hT := hT, hL := hL, snd := snd, rcv := rcv,
            snd_ne_rcv := hne, cap_le := hcap, α := α, β := β, γ := γ,
            causal := hcausal, snd_local := hsnd, rcv_local := hrcv, dec_local := hdec,
            correct := ?_ }, le_refl _⟩
  intro msg
  exact ⟨fun m => ∑ k, ∑ j, W m k j * msg k j,
          fun m => linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_rec α β W msg m hW,
          fun k j => linear_code_supports_rate_of_transfer_matrix_dec W γ msg k j hD⟩

open.name: spider_blocked_incoming_one_inward_options_all_eq

open.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_incoming_one_inward_options_all_eq (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free)
    (ih : ∀ r' < r, 1 ≤ r' → ∀ φ' ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free, spider_gamma (r' + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (r', φ')] = (if φ' = SpiderLegEnd.inward then r' % 2 else 1 - r' % 2))
    (x : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ ([(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (r, φ)].zipIdx.flatMap (fun ⟨⟨h, phi⟩, idx⟩ =>
      let rest := [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (r, φ)].eraseIdx idx
      (List.range h).flatMap (fun j_zero =>
        let j := j_zero + 1
        [SpiderLegEnd.inward, SpiderLegEnd.outward].filterMap (fun delta =>
          if j == h ∧ phi ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free ∧ delta ≠ phi then none
          else
            let d := spider_rho (h - j) delta phi
            if j ≥ 2 then
              let new_L := (j - 1, delta) :: rest
              some (d ^^^ spider_gamma (r + 1) CentreStatus.incoming new_L)
            else
              let new_s := spider_update_centre CentreStatus.incoming delta
              some (d ^^^ spider_gamma (r + 1) new_s rest)
        )
      )
    ))) :
    x = if φ = SpiderLegEnd.inward then 1 - r % 2 else r % 2

open.name: spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_inward
open.informal: For the configuration κ = (none;{(1,inward),(1,inward)}), the blocked family V^φ_κ(r) of Table 6 equals 1 - r mod 2 when φ = inward and r mod 2 when φ = outward, for every r ≥ 1.
open.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_none_one_inward_one_inward (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    spider_gamma (r + 3) CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (r, φ)] =
      if φ = SpiderLegEnd.inward then 1 - r % 2 else r % 2

open.name: spider_blocked_none_one_outward_one_outward
open.informal: For the configuration κ = (none;{(1,outward),(1,outward)}), the blocked family V^φ_κ(r) of Table 6 equals r mod 2 when φ = inward and 1 - r mod 2 when φ = outward, for every r ≥ 1.
open.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_none_one_outward_one_outward (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free) :
    spider_gamma (r + 3) CentreStatus.none [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (r, φ)] =
      if φ = SpiderLegEnd.inward then r % 2 else 1 - r % 2

open.name: spider_blocked_type_p_none_bounded
open.informal: For each of the twelve reachable configurations κ = (none;K) whose two attached legs K are listed (the type-P configurations with free centre of the paper's Table 6), every blocked family V^φ_κ(r) with φ ≠ free and r ≥ 1 has value at most 7.
open.statement:
theorem spider_blocked_type_p_none_bounded (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (φ : SpiderLegEnd) (hφ : φ ≠ SpiderLegEnd.free)
    (K : List (ℕ × SpiderLegEnd))
    (hK : K = [(2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (1, SpiderLegEnd.inward)] ∨
      K = [(2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] ∨
      K = [(2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (2, SpiderLegEnd.inward)] ∨
      K = [(2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (2, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] ∨
      K = [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ∨
      K = [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ∨
      K = [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.inward)] ∨
      K = [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] ∨
      K = [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.inward)] ∨
      K = [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.outward)] ∨
      K = [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.inward)] ∨
      K = [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.outward)]) :
    spider_gamma ((K.map Prod.fst).sum + r + 1) CentreStatus.none (K ++ [(r, φ)]) ≤ 7

open.name: spider_eventual_parity_two_three_option_analysis
open.informal: For z ≥ 14 the main state's option set meets {0,1} exactly as the parity decision requires: if z is even, neither 0 nor 1 is an option and the mex is 0; if z is odd, 0 is an option and 1 is not, so the mex is 1.
open.statement:
theorem spider_eventual_parity_two_three_option_analysis (z : ℕ) (hz : 14 ≤ z) :
    (z % 2 = 0 →
      spider_gamma (z + 6) CentreStatus.none
        [(2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free), (z, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 0) ∧
    (z % 2 = 1 →
      spider_gamma (z + 6) CentreStatus.none
        [(2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free), (z, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 1)

open.name: spider_free_family_bounds_four
open.informal: For every level h ≥ 14, the free families V^*_{(i;{2^*})}(h) and V^*_{(o;{2^*})}(h) are at least 4; in particular they are not 2 and not 3.
open.statement:
theorem spider_free_family_bounds_four (h : ℕ) (hh : 14 ≤ h) :
    spider_gamma (h + 3) CentreStatus.incoming [(2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (h, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≥ 4 ∧
    spider_gamma (h + 3) CentreStatus.outgoing [(2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (h, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≥ 4

open.name: spider_free_family_bounds_two
open.informal: For every level h ≥ 14, the free families V^*_σ(h) for σ = (i;{3^*}), (o;{3^*}), (n;{1^in,3^*}), (n;{1^out,3^*}), (n;{1^in,2^*}), (n;{1^out,2^*}), (n;{2^in,2^*}), (n;{2^out,2^*}) are all at least 2.
open.statement:
theorem spider_free_family_bounds_two (h : ℕ) (hh : 14 ≤ h) :
    spider_gamma (h + 4) CentreStatus.incoming [(3, SpiderLegEnd.free), (h, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≥ 2 ∧
    spider_gamma (h + 4) CentreStatus.outgoing [(3, SpiderLegEnd.free), (h, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≥ 2 ∧
    spider_gamma (h + 5) CentreStatus.none
      [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free), (h, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≥ 2 ∧
    spider_gamma (h + 5) CentreStatus.none
      [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (3, SpiderLegEnd.free), (h, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≥ 2 ∧
    spider_gamma (h + 4) CentreStatus.none
      [(1, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (h, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≥ 2 ∧
    spider_gamma (h + 4) CentreStatus.none
      [(1, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (h, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≥ 2 ∧
    spider_gamma (h + 5) CentreStatus.none
      [(2, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (h, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≥ 2 ∧
    spider_gamma (h + 5) CentreStatus.none
      [(2, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (h, SpiderLegEnd.free)] ≥ 2

open.name: spider_three_leg_one_short
open.informal: With free centre, one short leg of length 1 whose far end is blocked (δ inward or outward), together with the two free legs 1 and k, has value k for odd k and k-2 for even k, i.e. k - 2*(1 - k%2). This supplies the "c"-options of the root.
open.statement:
theorem spider_three_leg_one_short (k : ℕ) (δ : SpiderLegEnd)
    (hδ : δ = SpiderLegEnd.inward ∨ δ = SpiderLegEnd.outward) :
    spider_gamma (k + 3) CentreStatus.none
      [(1, δ), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free), (k, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = k - 2 * (1 - k % 2)

open.name: spider_two_leg_blocked_incoming_inward_val
open.informal: For incoming centre status and inward end condition on the blocked leg of length r, the Grundy value at canonical fuel r + 2 with a free leg of length 1 equals r - 1 if r % 4 = 3, and r + 1 otherwise.
open.statement:
theorem spider_two_leg_blocked_incoming_inward_val (r : ℕ) :
    spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(r, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)] =
      if r % 4 = 3 then r - 1 else r + 1

open.name: spider_two_leg_blocked_incoming_outward_val
open.informal: For incoming centre status and outward end condition on the blocked leg of length r, the Grundy value at canonical fuel r + 2 with a free leg of length 1 equals r - 1 if r % 4 = 1, and r + 1 otherwise.
open.statement:
theorem spider_two_leg_blocked_incoming_outward_val (r : ℕ) :
    spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(r, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)] =
      if r % 4 = 1 then r - 1 else r + 1

open.name: spider_two_leg_blocked_incoming_val
open.informal: For incoming centre status and canonical fuel r + 2, a blocked leg of length r with end condition inward has Grundy value r - 1 if r % 4 = 3 and r + 1 otherwise; with end condition outward it has Grundy value r - 1 if r % 4 = 1 and r + 1 otherwise.
open.statement:
theorem spider_two_leg_blocked_incoming_val (r : ℕ) :
    spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(r, SpiderLegEnd.inward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)] =
      (if r % 4 = 3 then r - 1 else r + 1) ∧
    spider_gamma (r + 2) CentreStatus.incoming [(r, SpiderLegEnd.outward), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)] =
      (if r % 4 = 1 then r - 1 else r + 1)

open.name: spider_two_leg_blocked_one_free_parity
open.informal: For incoming or outgoing centre, a blocked leg of length r with end condition inward or outward together with a free leg of length 1 has Grundy value of parity (r + 1) % 2 for any fuel at least r + 2.
open.statement:
theorem spider_two_leg_blocked_one_free_parity (F r : ℕ) (s : CentreStatus) (δ : SpiderLegEnd)
    (hs : s = CentreStatus.incoming ∨ s = CentreStatus.outgoing)
    (hδ : δ = SpiderLegEnd.inward ∨ δ = SpiderLegEnd.outward)
    (hF : r + 2 ≤ F) :
    spider_gamma F s [(r, δ), (1, SpiderLegEnd.free)] % 2 = (r + 1) % 2

open.name: spider_two_leg_free_free
open.informal: For incoming or outgoing centre, the two free legs 2 and k give Grundy value k for odd k and k-2 for even k, i.e. k - 2*(1 - k%2), for any fuel at least k+3.
open.statement:
theorem spider_two_leg_free_free (F k : ℕ) (s : CentreStatus)
    (hs : s = CentreStatus.incoming ∨ s = CentreStatus.outgoing) (hk : k + 3 ≤ F) :
    spider_gamma F s [(2, SpiderLegEnd.free), (k, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = k - 2 * (1 - k % 2)

open.name: spider_two_leg_one_free
open.informal: For incoming or outgoing centre, the two free legs 1 and k give Grundy value 1 - k%2 (i.e. (k+1) mod 2), for any fuel at least k+2. This is paper Lemma 9.4's Γ(i;(1,*),(i,*)) = (i+1) mod 2.
open.statement:
theorem spider_two_leg_one_free (F k : ℕ) (s : CentreStatus)
    (hs : s = CentreStatus.incoming ∨ s = CentreStatus.outgoing) (hk : k + 2 ≤ F) :
    spider_gamma F s [(1, SpiderLegEnd.free), (k, SpiderLegEnd.free)] = 1 - k % 2

open.name: maxcut_game_optimal_strong_equilibrium_exists
open.informal: Open problem (arXiv:2610.04948, Sec. 4, second question): for every finite simple unweighted graph G and every k ≥ 3, some optimal coloring of the Max-k-Cut game on (G, k) is a strong equilibrium. This would imply that every such game has a strong equilibrium.
open.statement:
theorem maxcut_game_optimal_strong_equilibrium_exists :
    ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (k : ℕ),
      3 ≤ k → ∃ σ : V → Fin k, is_maxcut_optimal G σ ∧ is_maxcut_strong_equilibrium G σ
open.citation: second open question of arXiv:2610.04948, Sec. 4 (does every game admit an optimal coloring that is a strong equilibrium?); the paper's Theorem 2 shows not every optimal coloring is one, and Remark 6 notes its counterexample does not rule out another, stable optimum

open.name: maxcut_game_strong_equilibrium_exists
open.informal: Open problem (arXiv:2610.04948, Sec. 4): for every finite simple unweighted graph G and every k ≥ 3, the unweighted Max-k-Cut game on (G, k) has a strong equilibrium, i.e. a coloring σ : V → [k] from which no nonempty coalition can deviate so that every member strictly gains.
open.statement:
theorem maxcut_game_strong_equilibrium_exists :
    ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (k : ℕ),
      3 ≤ k → ∃ σ : V → Fin k, is_maxcut_strong_equilibrium G σ
open.citation: open question of arXiv:2610.04948, Sec. 4 (Concluding remarks); that paper shows an optimal coloring need not be a strong equilibrium (Theorem 2), which leaves existence open; known: optimal colorings are strong equilibria when the maximum degree is at most 2k − 1 (Corollary 9) and are 7-strong equilibria in general

open.name: maxcut_optimal_not_strong_degree_66
open.informal: There is a finite simple graph of maximum degree at most 66 with an optimal coloring of the Max-3-Cut game that is not a strong equilibrium; hence Δ*(3) ≤ 65. (The graph G_3 of arXiv:2610.04948, Sec. 2, has 91 vertices and maximum degree 66, attained by the anchor vertices r_{3,1}.)
open.statement: theorem maxcut_optimal_not_strong_degree_66 : ¬ maxcut_optimal_strong_up_to_degree 3 66
open.citation: arXiv:2610.04948, Theorem 2 for k = 3, with the degree bound read off the construction G_3 of Sec. 2.1 (the paper does not state the degree); the upper bound side of the threshold question after Corollary 9

open.name: irr_step_changed_agent_strict
open.informal: Every irr_step is carried out by a single agent i: her new bid b' i is an admissible bid for her at b, nothing but her own bid changes (b' = Function.update b i (b' i)), and the additive value of her own picking-sequence bundle strictly increases.
open.statement:
theorem irr_step_changed_agent_strict {N G : Type*} [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq G] {m : ℕ}
    (v : N → G → ℝ) (seq : List N) (adm : (N → Fin m ≃ G) → N → (Fin m ≃ G) → Prop)
    (b b' : N → Fin m ≃ G) (h : irr_step v seq adm b b') :
    ∃ i, adm b i (b' i) ∧ b' = Function.update b i (b' i) ∧
      ∑ g ∈ picking_sequence_outcome seq b i, v i g
        < ∑ g ∈ picking_sequence_outcome seq b' i, v i g

open.name: iterated_round_robin_two_agents_adjacent_swaps_converges
open.informal: Conjecture 3.14 of arXiv:2610.23040: with two agents, m >= 5 goods and additive nonnegative utilities consistent with strict rankings, iterated Round Robin from truthful bids, where at each step an agent with a strictly profitable adjacent swap replaces its bid by a best response among its adjacent swaps, always converges: there is no infinite run.
open.statement:
theorem iterated_round_robin_two_agents_adjacent_swaps_converges (m : ℕ) (hm : 5 ≤ m)
    (pref : Fin 2 → Fin m ≃ Fin m) (v : Fin 2 → Fin m → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i g, 0 ≤ v i g)
    (hcons : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (k l : Fin m), k < l → v i (pref i l) < v i (pref i k)) :
    ¬ ∃ f : ℕ → (Fin 2 → Fin m ≃ Fin m), f 0 = pref ∧
      ∀ t, irr_step v (round_robin_sequence 2 m) is_adjacent_swap_bid (f t) (f (t + 1))
open.citation: arXiv:2610.23040 Conjecture 3.14 (open); the paper proves convergence for n = 2, m = 4 and gives a cycle for n = 3, m = 5. Termination (no infinite run) is the same as reaching a PNE under adjacent swaps, since the dynamics stops exactly there.

open.name: iterated_round_robin_two_agents_item_preserving_swaps_le
open.informal: For two agents with additive utilities consistent with strict rankings, iterated Round Robin from truthful bids, where at each step an agent with a strictly profitable item-preserving swap replaces its bid by a best response among its item-preserving swaps, makes at most m(m-1)/2 manipulations.
open.statement:
theorem iterated_round_robin_two_agents_item_preserving_swaps_le (m : ℕ)
    (pref : Fin 2 → Fin m ≃ Fin m) (v : Fin 2 → Fin m → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i g, 0 ≤ v i g)
    (hcons : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (k l : Fin m), k < l → v i (pref i l) < v i (pref i k))
    (f : ℕ → (Fin 2 → Fin m ≃ Fin m)) (hf0 : f 0 = pref) (T : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ t < T, irr_step v (round_robin_sequence 2 m)
      (is_item_preserving_swap_bid (round_robin_sequence 2 m)) (f t) (f (t + 1))) :
    T ≤ m * (m - 1) / 2
open.citation: arXiv:2610.23040 Theorem 3.12 (n = 2: IRR reaches a PNE under item-preserving swaps after at most m(m-1)/2 manipulations); stated as: every run of the dynamics from the truthful profile has at most m(m-1)/2 steps.

open.name: mms_threshold_monotone_asymptotic
open.informal: Open problem (arXiv:2610.06125, Sec. 3): for monotone valuations over goods, μ(n) = n + log₂ n + o(log₂ n) as n → ∞; i.e. (μ(n) − n − log₂ n) / log₂ n → 0.
open.statement:
theorem mms_threshold_monotone_asymptotic :
    (fun n : ℕ => (mms_threshold_monotone n : ℝ) - n - Real.logb 2 n) =o[Filter.atTop]
      (fun n : ℕ => Real.logb 2 n)
open.citation: open question of arXiv:2610.06125 (On MMS allocations with few items), Sec. 3; the paper proves n + 0.93 log₂ n ≤ μ(n) ≤ n + log₂ n + O(log log n) for large n (Theorem 1, Theorem 6, Lemmas 8 and 9)

open.name: picking_phi_entry_le
open.informal: For the Round-Robin sequence of n agents and m goods, the 0-based rank phi_s of the item selected at turn s is at most s (the paper's 1 <= phi_s <= s, one-based).
open.statement:
theorem picking_phi_entry_le (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (m : ℕ) (rank : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m) (s : ℕ) :
    picking_phi_entry (round_robin_sequence n m) rank s ≤ s

open.name: picking_prefix_state_allocated_card_le
open.informal: After s turns of a picking sequence at most s items have been allocated: every picking_turn inserts at most one item into the allocated set.

open.name: picking_prefix_state_eq_of_agree
open.informal: If two bid profiles assign the same ranking to every agent that appears among the first s entries of the sequence, then the states of the two runs after s turns coincide.
open.statement:
theorem picking_prefix_state_eq_of_agree {N G : Type*} [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq G] {m : ℕ}
    (seq : List N) (rank rank' : N → Fin m ≃ G) (s : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ seq.take s, rank a = rank' a) :
    picking_prefix_state seq rank s = picking_prefix_state seq rank' s

open.name: round_robin_alpha_three_eq_two_thirds
open.informal: The best guaranteed EF1 factor for Round-Robin pure Nash equilibria with three agents is 2/3.
open.statement: theorem round_robin_alpha_three_eq_two_thirds : round_robin_alpha 3 = 2 / 3

open.name: round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_polynomial_convergence
open.informal: For any fixed number of agents n ≥ 3, there exist natural numbers C, k : ℕ such that for any number of goods m : ℕ (modeled by Fin m), any initial preference profile pref : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m, and any non-negative additive valuations v : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ (with v i g ≥ 0 for all i, g) strictly consistent with pref (with v i (pref i l) < v i (pref i k) whenever k < l), every execution f : ℕ → (Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m) starting at f 0 = pref of T steps of iterated Round Robin under item-preserving swap bids (irr_step) satisfies T ≤ C * m ^ k.
open.statement:
theorem round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_polynomial_convergence (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ (C k : ℕ), ∀ (m : ℕ) (pref : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m) (v : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ)
      (hv : ∀ i g, 0 ≤ v i g)
      (hcons : ∀ (i : Fin n) (k l : Fin m), k < l → v i (pref i l) < v i (pref i k))
      (f : ℕ → (Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m)) (hf0 : f 0 = pref) (T : ℕ)
      (hf : ∀ t < T, irr_step v (round_robin_sequence n m)
        (is_item_preserving_swap_bid (round_robin_sequence n m)) (f t) (f (t + 1))),
      T ≤ C * m ^ k

open.name: round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_three_agents_four_items_le_one
open.informal: For 3 agents and 4 goods (modeled concretely by Fin 4), given an initial preference profile pref : Fin 3 → Fin 4 ≃ Fin 4 and non-negative additive valuations v : Fin 3 → Fin 4 → ℝ (satisfying v i g ≥ 0 for all i, g) strictly consistent with pref (satisfying v i (pref i l) < v i (pref i k) whenever k < l), any execution f : ℕ → (Fin 3 → Fin 4 ≃ Fin 4) starting at f 0 = pref of T steps of iterated Round Robin under item-preserving swap bids (irr_step) satisfies T ≤ 1.
open.statement:
theorem round_robin_item_preserving_swaps_three_agents_four_items_le_one
    (pref : Fin 3 → Fin 4 ≃ Fin 4) (v : Fin 3 → Fin 4 → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i g, 0 ≤ v i g)
    (hcons : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (k l : Fin 4), k < l → v i (pref i l) < v i (pref i k))
    (f : ℕ → (Fin 3 → Fin 4 ≃ Fin 4)) (hf0 : f 0 = pref) (T : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ t < T, irr_step v (round_robin_sequence 3 4)
      (is_item_preserving_swap_bid (round_robin_sequence 3 4)) (f t) (f (t + 1))) :
    T ≤ 1

open.name: round_robin_phi_lex_strict_increase
open.informal: For the Round-Robin sequence, every irr_step whose admissible bids are item-preserving swaps strictly increases the potential Phi lexicographically (arXiv:2610.23040, Theorem 3.13).
open.statement:
theorem round_robin_phi_lex_strict_increase (n m : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (v : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ) (b b' : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m)
    (h : irr_step v (round_robin_sequence n m)
      (is_item_preserving_swap_bid (round_robin_sequence n m)) b b') :
    List.Lex (· < ·) (round_robin_phi_vector m b) (round_robin_phi_vector m b')

open.name: round_robin_pne_ef1_of_card_le_two_mul_add_one
open.informal: Conjecture: with n agents and at most 2n + 1 goods, every pure Nash equilibrium of Round-Robin (nonnegative additive valuations) is EF1. With round_robin_pne_not_ef1_of_two_mul_add_two this says the least number of goods for which a Round-Robin equilibrium can fail EF1 is exactly 2n + 2 for every n ≥ 3.
open.statement:
theorem round_robin_pne_ef1_of_card_le_two_mul_add_one (n m : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hm : m ≤ 2 * n + 1)
    (w : Fin n → Fin m → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i g, 0 ≤ w i g) (rank : Fin n → Fin m ≃ Fin m)
    (h : is_picking_sequence_pne
      (SocialChoice.FairDivision.Indivisible.AdditiveValuation.toValuation ⟨w⟩)
      (round_robin_sequence n m) rank) :
    SocialChoice.FairDivision.Indivisible.IsEF1
      (SocialChoice.FairDivision.Indivisible.AdditiveValuation.toValuation ⟨w⟩)
      (picking_sequence_outcome (round_robin_sequence n m) rank)
open.citation: Posed from arXiv:2610.23686 (Proposition 1 and the two-agent theorem); the threshold 2n + 2 is new.

open.name: round_robin_pne_envy_zero_ef1_of_two_mul_add_one
open.informal: With n agents and 2n + 1 goods, in every pure Nash equilibrium of Round-Robin (nonnegative additive valuations) every agent i ≠ 0 is EF1 towards agent 0, the only agent with three goods. With round_robin_pne_ef1_pair_of_count_le_two and round_robin_sequence_count_le_two_of_ne_zero this is the m = 2n + 1 case of round_robin_pne_ef1_of_card_le_two_mul_add_one.
open.statement:
theorem round_robin_pne_envy_zero_ef1_of_two_mul_add_one (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
